TEXT_GAIUSE411_00079_SEQ_00: Ilberd is convinced that he has discovered the Ivy's identity and is preparing to move against the Garlean spy.
TEXT_GAIUSE411_00079_SEQ_01:
This quest has been adjusted. Please abandon the quest and restart it by speaking to Ilberd in Gridania.

※The Main Scenario Guide shows the next available quest. You can toggle it on and off in Character Configuration, under UI Settings.
TEXT_GAIUSE411_00079_SEQ_02: Eline Roaille appears to be bound for the Blue Badger Gate. Continue to shadow the suspect.
TEXT_GAIUSE411_00079_SEQ_03: Eline Roaille has entered the Carline Canopy, and Ilberd bids you look for her within. If she is not on the upper level, take your search to the landing area below and speak with Crystal Brave Ephemie.
TEXT_GAIUSE411_00079_SEQ_04: Ephemie is certain that Eline Roaille has not boarded an airship. Make your way back outside the Carline Canopy, and report her mysterious disappearance to Ilberd.
TEXT_GAIUSE411_00079_SEQ_05: Ilberd believes that Eline Roaille may have availed herself of a room at the Roost to throw pursuers off her trail. While he conducts a thorough search of the premises, speak with the Crystal Braves posted at Gridania's four main egresses─the Blue Badger Gate, the White Wolf Gate, the Yellow Serpent Gate, and Westshore Pier. If the flame marshal has left the city, one of them will surely have spotted her.
TEXT_GAIUSE411_00079_SEQ_06: It would seem that none of the Crystal Braves stationed around Gridania have seen Eline Roaille. Report your findings to Ilberd, who awaits you at the aetheryte plaza.
TEXT_GAIUSE411_00079_SEQ_07: Just when it seems as though your quarry has eluded you, a shinobi of Doma appears with word that Eline Roaille has left Gridania by way of Westshore Pier. Your hunt will next take you to the East Shroud.
TEXT_GAIUSE412_00080_SEQ_00: Ilberd is eager to resume the pursuit of Eline Roaille.
TEXT_GAIUSE412_00080_SEQ_01:
This quest has been adjusted. Please abandon the quest and restart it by speaking to Ilberd in Gridania.

※The Main Scenario Guide shows the next available quest. You can toggle it on and off in Character Configuration, under UI Settings.
TEXT_GAIUSE412_00080_SEQ_02: After joining Ilberd at Sweetbloom Pier, the two of you are met by Yugiri, who informs you that Eline Roaille is headed in the direction of the Hawthorne Hut. However, your reunion with the Garlean spy must wait, for another matter requires your immediate attention. An imperial squadron has set forth from Castrum Oriens on a mission to destroy an Alliance communications-jamming device in the South Shroud. If they succeed, Eline Roaille may well abort her secret rendezvous, thus depriving you of the chance to secure damning evidence of her treachery. Make haste to the South Shroud, and seek out the shinobi at Quarrymill who will brief you on the situation.
TEXT_GAIUSE412_00080_SEQ_03: The shinobi informs you that the advancing imperial squadron is presently near Amdapor Keep. Intercept the Garleans, and destroy their magitek weapons.
TEXT_GAIUSE412_00080_SEQ_04: You have destroyed all the death claws. Report your success to the shinobi who awaits nearby.
TEXT_GAIUSE412_00080_SEQ_05: With the imperial squadron defeated, the jamming device is now safe. As such, Eline Roaille will have no choice but to communicate with her accomplices in person. All that remains is to catch her in the act.
TEXT_GAIUSE413_00081_SEQ_00: The shinobi seems eager to send you on your way.
TEXT_GAIUSE413_00081_SEQ_01:
This quest has been adjusted. Please abandon the quest and restart it by speaking to Ilberd in Gridania.

※The Main Scenario Guide shows the next available quest. You can toggle it on and off in Character Configuration, under UI Settings.
TEXT_GAIUSE413_00081_SEQ_02: You arrive at the Hawthorne Hut to find that Eline Roaille has already departed for the Bramble Patch. Rendezvous with Yugiri ahead of what promises to be the dramatic conclusion of your hunt.
TEXT_GAIUSE413_00081_SEQ_03: With the Domans' aid, you have apprehended Eline Roaille in the act of meeting her imperial contact. Her guilt is now surely beyond dispute. Speak with Yugiri to hear her thoughts on the mission.
TEXT_GAIUSE413_00081_SEQ_04: Yugiri promises to attend to the aftermath of your hunt, leaving you free to report your recent adventures to Minfilia, back at the Rising Stones.
TEXT_GAIUSE413_00081_SEQ_05: Minfilia is shocked to learn of Eline Roaille's arrest and the accusations that have been brought against her. Setting aside her dismay, she informs you that the Scions have made progress in their quest to gain entry into Iceheart's sanctum.
TEXT_SUBFST031_00125_SEQ_00: Pauline at Gabineaux's Bower needs an adventurer to cull the growing anole population, as well as gather some of the scalekin's eggs.
TEXT_SUBFST031_00125_SEQ_01:
This quest has been adjusted. Please abandon the quest and restart it by speaking to Pauline at Gabineaux's Bower.

※The Main Scenario Guide shows the next available quest. You can toggle it on and off in Character Configuration, under UI Settings.
TEXT_SUBFST031_00125_SEQ_02: You have thinned the number of anoles and collected their eggs. Report to Pauline at Gabineaux's Bower.
TEXT_SUBFST031_00125_SEQ_03: Large and rich in nutrients, anole eggs make a perfect breakfast for a soldier. Deliver them to Tsubh Khamazom at the Bannock.
TEXT_SUBFST031_00125_SEQ_04: Upon taking receipt of your gift of anole eggs, Tsubh Khamazom notes with admiration that you appear not to have sustained any serious injury in the course of their collection.
TEXT_SUBFST034_00128_SEQ_00: Galfrid, chief instructor at the Bannock, wishes you to collect chigoe egg sacs.
TEXT_SUBFST034_00128_SEQ_01:
This quest has been adjusted. Please abandon the quest and restart it by speaking to Galfrid at the Bannock.

※The Main Scenario Guide shows the next available quest. You can toggle it on and off in Character Configuration, under UI Settings.
TEXT_SUBFST034_00128_SEQ_02: You have collected eight chigoe egg sacs. Deliver them to Monranguin at Gilbert's Spire.
TEXT_SUBFST034_00128_SEQ_03: Chigoes are known carriers of the Creeping Death─a terrifying illness that almost invariably proved fatal to its Hyuran victims. Though a cure is now available, Gridanian researchers periodically check the chigoes for signs of the disease in order to prevent further outbreaks.
TEXT_SUBFST050_00156_SEQ_00: Keitha, the head wrangler at Bentbranch Meadows, wishes you to gather roselet seeds from which she hopes to extract an oil known to calm agitated chocobos.
TEXT_SUBFST050_00156_SEQ_01:
This quest has been adjusted. Please abandon the quest and restart it by speaking to either Eylgar or Luquelot at Bentbranch Meadows, Lothaire at Galvanth's Spire, or Armelle at the Mirror Planks, depending on your progress.

※The Main Scenario Guide shows the next available quest. You can toggle it on and off in Character Configuration, under UI Settings.
TEXT_SUBFST050_00156_SEQ_02: You have collected six roselet seeds. Deliver them to Keitha at Bentbranch Meadows.
TEXT_SUBFST050_00156_SEQ_03: Having delivered the roselet seeds to Keitha, the head wrangler admits she is none the wiser as to what might have been troubling her chocobos. She remains hopeful, nevertheless, that the oil obtained from the seeds will help to calm the distressed birds.
TEXT_SUBFST053_00159_SEQ_00: Armelle at the Mirror Planks is seeking a valiant adventurer to slay marshlights.
TEXT_SUBFST053_00159_SEQ_01:
This quest has been adjusted. Please abandon the quest and restart it by speaking to Armelle at the Mirror Planks.

※The Main Scenario Guide shows the next available quest. You can toggle it on and off in Character Configuration, under UI Settings.
TEXT_SUBFST053_00159_SEQ_02: You have slain the marshlights. Return to Armelle at the Mirror Planks.
TEXT_SUBFST053_00159_SEQ_03: Armelle can scarce express her gratitude for your deed. Perhaps now the people of the Mirror Planks will know peace for a time.
TEXT_SUBFST039_00196_SEQ_00: Galfrid, chief instructor at the Bannock, wishes you to assist with the training of new recruits.
TEXT_SUBFST039_00196_SEQ_01:
This quest has been adjusted. Please abandon the quest and restart it by speaking to Galfrid at the Bannock.

※The Main Scenario Guide shows the next available quest. You can toggle it on and off in Character Configuration, under UI Settings.
TEXT_SUBFST039_00196_SEQ_02: You have slain the black efts. Report to Galfrid at the Bannock.
TEXT_SUBFST039_00196_SEQ_03: After witnessing your display of skill, the recruits resume their training with renewed enthusiasm. Continue to hone your abilities, lest the deeds of the Bannock's soldiers one day outshine your own.
TEXT_SUBFST042_00198_SEQ_00: Pauline, a conjurer at Gabineaux's Bower, seeks an able adventurer to cull the local hoglet population.
TEXT_SUBFST042_00198_SEQ_01:
This quest has been adjusted. Please abandon the quest and restart it by speaking to Pauline at Gabineaux's Bower.

※The Main Scenario Guide shows the next available quest. You can toggle it on and off in Character Configuration, under UI Settings.
TEXT_SUBFST042_00198_SEQ_02: You have butchered half a dozen hoglets. Report to Pauline at Gabineaux's Bower.
TEXT_SUBFST042_00198_SEQ_03: Pauline senses the elementals' joy at your efforts to restore the natural balance. Each small victory brings stability to the forest's cycle of life.
TEXT_FESHLW101_00236_SEQ_00:
Trouble is brewing this All Saints' Wake, and Godriquelain needs your help to keep it from boiling over.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESHLW101_00236_SEQ_01:
It is All Saints' Wake, and the Continental Circus is in town to help the citizens celebrate. According to Godriquelain, however, the members of this traveling troupe are in fact fiends in disguise. He asks that you answer the troupe's call for volunteers, that you may get close to its members and determine whether they pose a threat. If you would oblige him, speak with the uncanny illusionist at Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre, and offer her your services.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESHLW101_00236_SEQ_02:
In excited tones, the uncanny illusionist informs you of her troupe's mission to see that everyone has a frighteningly good time during All Saints' Wake. Using her arts to bestow upon you a frightening form, she bids you terrorize people in Old Gridania.

※If the illusion wears off, you may receive it again by speaking with the uncanny illusionist.
TEXT_FESHLW101_00236_SEQ_03: You have finished making your round of Old Gridania. Make your way back to Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre and report to the uncanny illusionist.
TEXT_FESHLW101_00236_SEQ_04: Strangely, the uncanny illusionist seems disappointed to hear that your guise was met with delight rather than fright. Having regained her composure, she bids you assist with the festivities over in Limsa Lominsa, but not before muttering some rather unsettling things. Return to Godriquelain and report all that you have learned.
TEXT_FESHLW101_00236_SEQ_05: Godriquelain believes that the Continental Circus may be attempting to usher in the legendary Night of Devilry, when creatures of darkness descend upon the realm. The investigation will next take you to Limsa Lominsa; make your way there, and seek out Godriquelain at the Aftcastle.
TEXT_FESHLW101_00236_SEQ_06: You arrive at the Aftcastle to find Godriquelain waiting and eager to pick up where you left off.
TEXT_FESHLW102_00237_SEQ_00:
Godriquelain is eager to resume his investigation of the Continental Circus.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESHLW102_00237_SEQ_01:
Godriquelain has learned that the Continental Circus is also recruiting volunteers for its festive endeavors in Limsa Lominsa. In order to prevent the Night of Devilry from coming to pass, you must pretend to cooperate with the twisted troupe, that you might uncover the details of their dark plot. Speak with the untrustworthy illusionist near the Aftcastle, and offer your services to him.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESHLW102_00237_SEQ_02:
The untrustworthy illusionist has entrusted you with three pumpkin lanterns, which he bids you place at three locations in Limsa Lominsa, and in the order specified. The first lantern is bound for the Drowning Wench.

※If the illusion wears off, you may receive it again by speaking with the untrustworthy illusionist.
TEXT_FESHLW102_00237_SEQ_03: You have convinced Baderon to let you place a pumpkin lantern inside the Drowning Wench. Now make your way to the Coral Tower, and find a likely spot for the second lantern.
TEXT_FESHLW102_00237_SEQ_04: With some conditions, Commodore Reyner permits you to leave the second pumpkin lantern inside the Coral Tower. The third and final lantern is earmarked for Maelstrom Command. Make your way there, and find a likely spot for it.
TEXT_FESHLW102_00237_SEQ_05: Though Commander R'ashaht Rhiki consents to your leaving the third pumpkin inside Maelstrom Command, she warns you that the Maelstrom will not be responsible for its care. You have now placed the three lanterns as prescribed. Return to the Aftcastle and report your success to the untrustworthy illusionist.
TEXT_FESHLW102_00237_SEQ_06: It appears that the untrustworthy illusionist had been plotting to summon forth a horde of dark creatures, and he would have succeeded─with your help─were it not for the unwitting intervention of the locals. For now, you are assured in the knowledge that the realm is safe. Return to Godriquelain and report all that you have seen and heard.
TEXT_FESHLW102_00237_SEQ_07: Though relieved for the present, Godriquelain fears that the Continental Circus may yet usher in the Night of Devilry. He bids you meet him in Ul'dah, where another dark scheme is in the offing. Make haste to the sultanate, and join Godriquelain in the vicinity of the Ruby Road Exchange.
TEXT_FESHLW102_00237_SEQ_08: You arrive in Ul'dah and find Godriquelain waiting at the Ruby Road Exchange. Take a deep breath and steel yourself, for the night promises to be dark and full of terrors.
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_SEQ_00:
Godriquelain is eager to resume his investigation of the Continental Circus.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_SEQ_01:
Godriquelain has learned that the Continental Circus is recruiting volunteers for the costume parade it is hosting in Ul'dah. As you have done thus far, you must pretend to cooperate with the twisted troupe, that you might uncover the details of its dark plot. Speak with the unsavory illusionist by the entrance to the Ruby Road Exchange, and offer your services to her.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_SEQ_02:
Desiring to spread word of the parade, the unsavory illusionist entrusts you with three flyers to hand out at the Quicksand. Head inside the tavern, and find likely recipients for the flyers.

※If the illusion wears off, you may receive it again by speaking with the unsavory illusionist.
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_SEQ_03: You have handed out all three flyers. Report the completion of your task to the unsavory illusionist.
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_SEQ_04:
Satisfied that the parade has been sufficiently advertised, the unsavory illusionist next bids you participate in the parade itself. While transfigured, take your place in the parade alongside your fellow adventurers, and cast the Festal Cant charm upon the citizens who have come to spectate.

※The FATE “Main Street Spectral Parade” can be commenced by speaking with the ogre pumpkinhead on Emerald Avenue.
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_SEQ_05: In no small part due to your participation, the parade has proved to be a rousing success. Report the completion of your task to the unsavory illusionist.
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_SEQ_06: Having thanked you for your assistance, the unsavory illusionist lets it slip that she has a clandestine meeting with someone she calls the Impresario. In spite of her earnest request that you do not follow her, your instincts tell you that this is a meeting you do not want to miss. Make your way to the Gold Court, and find a suitable place to observe the rendezvous.
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_SEQ_07: You have overheard the conversation between the Impresario and the unsavory illusionist, both of whom are revealed to be imps in disguise. As you have suspected all along, the parade is but a means to usher in the Night of Devilry; the charm does not actually grant happiness and fortune, but transforms people into fiends. Make haste to the Quicksand, and report all that you have seen and heard to Godriquelain.
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_SEQ_08: Godriquelain is shocked to learn of the charm's true nature, and moves to put a stop to the parade. However, Momodi, on her way back from spectating the parade, assures him that the charm is in fact harmless. It would seem that the Continental Circus had been misled all this time, and the citizens are perfectly safe. So ends your quest to forestall the Night of Devilry. And though the danger is past─or rather, never was─the festivities yet continue. Why not participate in another parade?
TEXT_FESXMS001_00247_SEQ_00:
The saint's little helper in the Lavender Beds seeks your assistance in running the Starlight Celebration festivities.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESXMS001_00247_SEQ_01:
You have volunteered your services to assist with the Starlight Celebration festivities. Pull on your Starlight tunic, and collect a child's message from one of the Starlight sentinels found within the Lavender Beds.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESXMS001_00247_SEQ_02: You have collected a letter to the Spinner. Return to Yainu-Par and deliver the message to the saint's little helper.
TEXT_FESXMS001_00247_SEQ_03: You have delivered the message to the grateful little helper. Take the gift from the festival volunteer, and hand it to the child waiting nearby.
TEXT_FESXMS001_00247_SEQ_04: You have performed your duty as a little helper, and brought gift-wrapped happiness to a child. Report to the saint's little helper in Yainu-Par.
TEXT_FESXMS001_00247_SEQ_05: The volunteer is pleased with your efforts, and looks forward to your continuing assistance during the remainder of the Starlight Celebration.
TEXT_FESXMS002_00248_SEQ_00:
The saint's little helper in Mist seeks your assistance in running the Starlight Celebration festivities.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESXMS002_00248_SEQ_01:
You have volunteered your services to assist with the Starlight Celebration festivities. Pull on your Starlight tunic, and collect a child's message from one of the Starlight sentinels found within Mist.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESXMS002_00248_SEQ_02: You have collected a letter to the Spinner. Return to the Seagaze Markets and deliver the message to the saint's little helper.
TEXT_FESXMS002_00248_SEQ_03: You have delivered the message to the coarse but emotional little helper. Take the gift from the festival volunteer, and hand it to the child waiting nearby.
TEXT_FESXMS002_00248_SEQ_04: You have performed your duty as a little helper, and brought gift-wrapped happiness to a child. Report to the saint's little helper in the Seagaze Markets.
TEXT_FESXMS002_00248_SEQ_05: The volunteer is pleased with your efforts, and looks forward to your continuing assistance during the remainder of the Starlight Celebration.
TEXT_FESXMS003_00249_SEQ_00:
The saint's little helper in the Goblet seeks your assistance in running the Starlight Celebration festivities.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESXMS003_00249_SEQ_01:
You have volunteered your services to assist with the Starlight Celebration festivities. Pull on your Starlight tunic, and collect a child's message from one of the Starlight sentinels found within the Goblet.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESXMS003_00249_SEQ_02: You have collected a letter to the Spinner. Return to the Brimming Heart and deliver the message to the saint's little helper.
TEXT_FESXMS003_00249_SEQ_03: You have delivered the message to the brusque and businesslike little helper. Take the gift from the festival volunteer, and hand it to the child waiting nearby.
TEXT_FESXMS003_00249_SEQ_04: You have performed your duty as a little helper, and brought gift-wrapped happiness to a child. Report to the saint's little helper in the Brimming Heart.
TEXT_FESXMS003_00249_SEQ_05: The volunteer is pleased with your efforts, and looks forward to your continuing assistance during the remainder of the Starlight Celebration.
TEXT_FESXMS004_00250_SEQ_00:
Xavalien, a correspondent for The Raven, seeks an adventurer to help ensure the smooth running of this year's Starlight Celebration.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESXMS004_00250_SEQ_01:
Xavalien, a reporter for The Raven, has published an article on the ambitious festivities planned for this year's Starlight Celebration. It appears, however, that the celebrant in charge of the event has encountered some unexpected difficulties. Seek out Amh Garanjy in Yainu-Par in the Lavender Beds and offer your assistance.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESXMS004_00250_SEQ_02: Amh Garanjy, the Starlight celebrant, explains the dilemma that now threatens to steal the smiles from the expectant faces of the children. Promise your aid to the troubled organizer, and do what you can to help save the celebration.
TEXT_FESXMS005_00251_SEQ_00:
Amh Garanjy is not-so-subtly hinting that your help is needed to save this year's Starlight Celebration.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESXMS005_00251_SEQ_01:
You have pledged to aid Amh Garanjy and her helpers gather the messages that children have mistakenly placed at trees throughout the expansive Lavender Beds. Equip your Starlight tunic, and collect the letter recently left at the base of the Starlight sentinel in Yainu-Par.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESXMS005_00251_SEQ_02: You collect your first letter to the Spinner, much to the delight of the little girl on the lookout for one of the saint's little helpers. Return to Amh Garanjy with the young lady's message.
TEXT_FESXMS005_00251_SEQ_03: After showing the message to Amh Garanjy, the Starlight celebrant next charges you with the delivery of the child's seasonal gift. Take the celestial present to the good little girl waiting nearby.
TEXT_FESXMS005_00251_SEQ_04: The young lady is overjoyed to receive her gift from a little helper, but is also surprised to find another child's letter wrapped up with her present. Return to Amh Garanjy and show her the misplaced message.
TEXT_FESXMS005_00251_SEQ_05: Amh Garanjy reads the new letter you have brought her, only to learn that the youngling author wants nothing more than the return of his departed father. The Starlight celebrant vows to discover what may be done to ease the poor lad's suffering. Meanwhile, she urges you to continue your work as a little helper, both in the Lavender Beds and in the residential districts abroad.
TEXT_FESNYR101_00252_SEQ_00:
The heavens have turned once more, bringing a fresh flock of Easterlings to Lominsan shores.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESNYR101_00252_SEQ_01:
The lights are lit in Limsa Lominsa in celebration of the turning of the year, and the changing of the heavenly guard. A delegation from the Far East has set to shore in Eorzea to lead the festivities. But while the townspeople choose their new year's resolutions, the leader of the Easterlings seems singularly lacking in resolve. Speak with the hitsuji bugyo, lest the dark clouds that gather on his brows usher in a year of sorrows.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESNYR101_00252_SEQ_02: The bugyo unburdens himself: he dreams of expanding his pet project─an army of spell-slinging sheep known as the Fleece Force─into Eorzea, but his calls have fallen on deaf ears. Convinced that an Eorzean adventurer would have better luck, he recruits you to the Force's propaganda arm. But an immediate problem stalls your progress─the prototype tender lamb refuses to acknowledge your existence. Perhaps a taste of the special fodder the bugyo has ordered through Engerrand, a trader in Hawkers' Alley, might help to win her over.
TEXT_FESNYR101_00252_SEQ_03: Engerrand hands over the nutritious fodder. Return to the Aftcastle, and entice the tender lamb with the platter of toothsome twigs.
TEXT_FESNYR101_00252_SEQ_04: The lamb is delighted with the shoots and leaves, and acknowledges you as its master. Satisfied, the hitsuji bugyo presents you with a ceremonial helm to consecrate your alliance with the Fleece Force. By wearing this kabuto, his underlings across the land will recognize you as a fellow sheepwielder. And so it falls to you to travel to the three city-states, and spread the fame of the Fleece Force to every corner of the realm.
TEXT_FESNYR102_00287_SEQ_00:
The hitsuji bugyo is eager to learn of your progress in the three city-states.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESNYR102_00287_SEQ_01:
Having dispatched you to the ends of the realm to rally support for the Fleece Force, the hitsuji bugyo is eager to hear of your achievements. His assistants in the three city-states have instructions to reward any adventurer who supports their cause with a colored kabuto. Once you have earned all three kabuto, return to the Aftcastle, and present them to the bugyo.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESNYR102_00287_SEQ_02: You present the three kabuto to the hitsuji bugyo, and earn his undying gratitude. But while all Eorzea is abuzz with talk of the merits of sheep, mention of the Fleece Force is notable by its absence. The bugyo would have you canvass a cross section of Lominsans to find out why.
TEXT_FESNYR102_00287_SEQ_03: The people of Limsa Lominsa speak as one: sheep are simply too adorable to have any place on the battlefield. Report this discovery to the hitsuji bugyo.
TEXT_FESNYR102_00287_SEQ_04: The bugyo is incensed by the townspeople's soft-heartedness, and pledges to prove them wrong with a show of force. But the merry maid of Limsa Lominsa─now revealed as the hitsuji ometsuke in disguise─stands in the way of his drastic design. He attempts to use the lamb's power to put her─and you─to sleep, but the lamb rebels and blasts the bugyo instead. You escape unscathed, but the lamb is not so lucky. Activating her own magic without the proper preparation has exhausted her life force, and left her on the brink of oblivion. Reenergize the lamb with a /cheer of encouragement.
TEXT_FESNYR102_00287_SEQ_05: You cheer for the lamb, but she barely responds. With the chat mode in Say, enter “Don't give up!” to rally the tender lamb's dissipated spirits.
TEXT_FESNYR102_00287_SEQ_06: The tender lamb is moved by your cry of encouragement, but still lacks the strength to stand, let alone smile. The hitsuji ometsuke urges you to make one last, great effort, and /pray for the lamb with all your heart.
TEXT_FESNYR102_00287_SEQ_07: The tender lamb hears your prayers, and makes a miraculous recovery. His heart heavy with regret, the bugyo entrusts the lamb to you, while he sets about righting the wrongs he has caused. Though the lamb may no longer be able to use the hypnoturgical blast, the friendship that has blossomed between you shall surely bring peace to your heart in the years to come.
TEXT_FESNYR103_00289_SEQ_00:
The hitsuji bugyo is eager to fill the Black Shroud with white wool.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESNYR103_00289_SEQ_01:
Keen to proceed with his plan, the hitsuji bugyo dispatches you to Gridania, to assist his man on the forest floor. He has sent the tender lamb on ahead, with word that a sheep-crowned comrade is to follow. Don your hitsuji kabuto, and rendezvous with the golden hitsuji yoriki in Gridania.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESNYR103_00289_SEQ_02: The golden hitsuji yoriki welcomes you to the fold, and briefs you on the current situation: a traveling trader en route to Gridania has been waylaid in Bentbranch Meadows, her chocobo laid low by a mystery affliction. It refuses to move, or eat, or─more importantly─sleep. A sad situation, but an unmissable opportunity to showcase the tender lamb's talents. Take her to Bentbranch Meadows, and talk with the troubled trader.
TEXT_FESNYR103_00289_SEQ_03: The skeptical merchant grudgingly accepts your offer to calm her restless chocobo, but before you can blast the bird, the tender lamb is distracted by a certain something outside the ranch gates. Could your flossy friend have espied some clue to the causes of the chocobo's distress?
TEXT_FESNYR103_00289_SEQ_04: You discover a chocobo tailfeather pressed into the ground on the southbound road. It seems it was this that caught the tender lamb's attention. Return to the trader, and see if it bears any special significance.
TEXT_FESNYR103_00289_SEQ_05: The merchant is unimpressed by your find, but it deeply affects her chocobo. The bird gazes longingly at the feather, and seems somehow soothed. Her astonished owner urges you to take advantage of this moment of calm to activate the lamb's magic. Let out a /cheer for the chocobo to trigger your companion's hypnoturgical blast.
TEXT_FESNYR103_00289_SEQ_06: The soporific spell lays the agitated bird to rest. But what of the strange feather? Keitha, head wrangler at Bentbranch Meadows and chocobo expert extraordinaire, may be able to make something of it.
TEXT_FESNYR103_00289_SEQ_07: Keitha identifies the feather as belonging to a chocobo recently sold to a wealthy visitor. The chocobo in question was an old clutchmate of the trader's bird─perhaps it was the thwarting of their reunion that plunged her into depression. With your lamb in tow, return to the trader and relate Keitha's supposition.
TEXT_FESNYR103_00289_SEQ_08: The traveling trader can well see the truth in Keitha's story, and vows to do what it takes to cheer her heartsore bird. Instead of pushing on to Gridania, they will follow the rich man's trail to the south, that the long-awaited reunion may come to pass. Return to the golden hitsuji yoriki, and report on the outcome of your mission.
TEXT_FESNYR103_00289_SEQ_09: The golden hitsuji yoriki lauds your efforts as a great success. He presents you with a kabuto of his own design, to bear testimony to your service to the Fleece Force in Gridania. Repeat the feat in the other city states, and the triumph of the bugyo's plan is all but assured.
TEXT_FESNYR104_00290_SEQ_00:
The hitsuji bugyo wishes to shore up support for the Fleece Force in La Noscea.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESNYR104_00290_SEQ_01:
His hands full with Heavensturn formalities, the hitsuji bugyo has appointed an able ally to champion the Fleece Force in La Noscea on his behalf. He would have you assist this man, the red hitsuji yoriki, in his efforts. Don the hitsuji kabuto to prove your allegiance to the cause, and speak with the wary Easterner.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESNYR104_00290_SEQ_02: The red hitsuji yoriki has caught wind of an ideal opportunity to publicize the tender lamb's powers: in Aleport, a baby has been crying without cease for days, to the chagrin of both the townspeople and its increasingly fraught mother. Take the tender lamb to western La Noscea, and see if you can be of service to the straitened saltwife.
TEXT_FESNYR104_00290_SEQ_03: The wailing baby's mother is fast approaching the end of her tether, and welcomes your offer of a sleeping spell with open arms. With the tiny lamb in tow, /cheer for the baby to activate the hypnoturgical blast.
TEXT_FESNYR104_00290_SEQ_04: The lamb's magic hits its mark, but fails to stifle the baby's screams. Its desperate mother pleads with you to work your magic on the baby again, but the tender lamb seems more interested in her than in the baby. Follow the lamb's lead, and /cheer for the stalwart saltwife.
TEXT_FESNYR104_00290_SEQ_05: The hypnoturgical blast takes effect, forcing the worries from the saltwife's tired mind. And as the mother's agitation ebbs away, so do her daughter's tears. She thanks you effusively, and asks you to pass on her gratitude to the red hitsuji yoriki. Return to the Aftcastle to report on your success.
TEXT_FESNYR104_00290_SEQ_06: The red hitsuji yoriki commends your actions, and presents you with a crimson hitsuji kabuto to honor your service to the Fleece Force in La Noscea. If his comrades in Ul'dah and Gridania meet with equal success, the bugyo's plan is sure to succeed.

TEXT_SUBWIL062_00305_SEQ_03: Though taken aback at first, Warin recognizes your potential and welcomes you warmly. He offers to give you more work, if you are willing and able.

TEXT_FESNYR105_00309_SEQ_00:
The black sheep of the bugyo's flock seeks to entertain the troops in Thanalan.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESNYR105_00309_SEQ_01:
The hitsuji bugyo fears for the health of his man in Thanalan, his unfortunate choice of headwear incompatible with the desert heat. He would have you journey to Ul'dah to assist him, wearing the hitsuji kabuto to show both your allegiance, and the error of the black sheep's ways.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESNYR105_00309_SEQ_02: The black hitsuji yoriki is keen to present the tender lamb to the Brass Blades, and believes he has spotted the ideal opportunity to do just that. In the Coffer & Coffin, a group of Blades are drinking like fishes and acting the goat. The yoriki urges you to take the lamb to the watering hole, and cast its spell on the Brass Blade captain, to save him from the clutches of the demon drink.
TEXT_FESNYR105_00309_SEQ_03: The hypnoturgical blast has little effect on the inebriated captain. In fact, it only seems to have redoubled his thirst. He dispatches you and your sheep to the bar─the proprietor, Roger, has failed to deliver the latest round, and the captain will brook no delay.
TEXT_FESNYR105_00309_SEQ_04: Roger reluctantly agrees to fulfill the captain's order rather than risk his wrath. But as the tankards fill with the bubbling brew, the tender lamb espies something unusual at the end of the bar: a pair of spectacles belonging to the captain's wife. Roger urges you to take them to him, in the hope that this token of home might compel him to call it a night.
TEXT_FESNYR105_00309_SEQ_05: You hand the glasses to the Brass Blade captain, who unexpectedly bursts into tears. His wife recently passed away, and the grieving captain was drinking to forget his pain. Shocked into unwelcome sobriety, he craves the sleep his troubled mind refuses to offer him. Give the captain a reassuring /cheer to activate the lamb's magic once more.
TEXT_FESNYR105_00309_SEQ_06: The hypnoturgical blast takes effect, and the captain finally finds rest. In his dreams, he is reunited with his wife, fulfilling his promise that they would welcome in the new year together. While his comrades carry him home to bed, they bid you pass on their apologies to Roger.
TEXT_FESNYR105_00309_SEQ_07: Learning the truth behind the Brass Blades' binge, and mortified by his own misgivings about the mourning captain, Roger pledges to start the new year on the right foot: by footing the bill for the day's revelries. He thanks you and your sheep for bringing a modicum of peace to his suffering customer, and asks you to pass on his gratitude to the black hitsuji yoriki, for assigning you to the case.
TEXT_FESNYR105_00309_SEQ_08: The black hitsuji yoriki, pleased with your achievements, presents you with a special kabuto as proof of your friendship. With the Brass Blades now fully apprised of the tender lamb's powers, it is only a matter of time before they place an order. Should his colleagues in Gridania and La Noscea meet with equal success, the air of Eorzea will soon be ringing with the martial bleats of the Fleece Force.

TEXT_SUBWIL073_00327_SEQ_03: While many miners revere spriggans as bearers of good fortune, Warin has no objections to your culling the critters. The spriggans may not mean any ill, but their actions would have eventually led to disaster.

TEXT_SUBWIL083_00331_SEQ_03: Leofric thanks you for aiding the people of Lost Hope, who continue to suffer in spite of Ul'dah's growing prosperity. Reflecting on his downfall, the captain concludes that the Brass Blades of the Rose must look to others for guidance.
TEXT_SUBWIL087_00335_SEQ_00: Merilda needs help preparing a meal for unscrupulous guests.

TEXT_FESXMS009_00354_SEQ_00:
Amh Garanjy has another favor to ask of you.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESXMS009_00354_SEQ_01:
After thanking you for your hard work across the realm, Amh Garanjy informs you that she has discovered the identity of the grieving child responsible for writing the misplaced letter. The celebrant requests that you speak with the boy, and see what can be done to ease his troubled heart. Take the message, don your Starlight apparel, and seek out Timothey by Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre in Old Gridania.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESXMS009_00354_SEQ_02: You confirm that Timothey was, in fact, the author of the angry letter, but the child storms off before you are able to learn anything more. Show the message to the boy's mother, and listen to what she has to say about their family's woes.
TEXT_FESXMS009_00354_SEQ_03: Timothey's mother lays bare their tragic history. Refugees of the Calamity, it seems that the boy lost some treasured mementos─a pair of bracelets crafted by his departed father─during their long and difficult journey to Gridania. Return to Amh Garanjy in the Lavender Beds and relay the child's tale.
TEXT_FESXMS009_00354_SEQ_04: Upon hearing your recital of Timothey's story, the celebrant once more returns you to your mission of kindness. Travel to the Central Shroud and search the area near the Mirror Planks for Timothey's missing bracelets.
TEXT_FESXMS009_00354_SEQ_05: You see no sign of the missing bracelets. Expand your search, and keep looking for Timothey's treasured mementos.
TEXT_FESXMS009_00354_SEQ_06: You still have yet to discover any trace of the dropped bracelets. Continue searching the nearby area.
TEXT_FESXMS009_00354_SEQ_07: As you scour the ground for Timothey's missing bracelets, you are approached by a snowy-haired gentleman in scarlet garb who claims to have found the treasures you seek. The wandering pilgrim explains that he discovered the damaged jewelry by accident, and has repaired them with some minor improvements. Return to Timothey at Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre and deliver the brassy bangles.
TEXT_FESXMS009_00354_SEQ_08: Although initially dubious of the authenticity of the bracelets, your explanation eventually convinces Timothey that the Saint of Nymeia himself had a hand in returning to him his treasured possessions. Return to Amh Garanjy in the Lavender Beds, and tell her of Timothey's joyous transformation.
TEXT_FESXMS009_00354_SEQ_09: After listening to your happy tale, Amh Garanjy is reminded of a similar encounter she had with a snowy-haired pilgrim when she was a young girl. The celebrant believes that that moment of kindness was what set her on her current path, and wonders if the wandering gentleman you both met was not the Saint of Nymeia in truth. Content to believe it to be so, Amh Garanjy urges you to return to your work of gift giving and joy bringing for as long as the Starlight Celebration continues.
TEXT_GAIUSE505_00367_SEQ_00: Alphinaud has a message from Moenbryda for the Scions.
TEXT_GAIUSE505_00367_SEQ_01:
This quest has been adjusted. Please abandon the quest and restart it by speaking to Alphinaud at the Rising Stones.

※The Main Scenario Guide shows the next available quest. You can toggle it on and off in Character Configuration, under UI Settings.
TEXT_GAIUSE505_00367_SEQ_02: You have located the Roegadyn scholar and informed her that her requested meeting may now take place. Make your way to the solar and speak with Moenbryda once more.
TEXT_GAIUSE505_00367_SEQ_03: Moenbryda reveals that she has formulated a means of producing the staggering amount of aether required to destroy a captured Ascian soul─namely, by siphoning energy from the corrupted crystals found across Eorzea. It is at this point in her presentation that Alphinaud arrives and suggests that she conduct her experiments in northern Thanalan, where such crystal formations are bountiful yet not too closely grouped. He soon adds, however, that the imperial forces in the area are seeking to ransack the resources of the Ceruleum Processing Plant. With a knowing smile, Alphinaud laments that Moenbryda's experiments will be nigh impossible to perform without the Scions first cooperating with the Crystal Braves to defeat the Garlean threat. Speak with Alphinaud at the Rising Stones to learn more about your role in defending the processing plant from the advancing imperial soldiers.
TEXT_GAIUSE505_00367_SEQ_04: Alphinaud has bid you rendezvous with the 4th in northern Thanalan while he moves to take command of the Crystal Braves stationed in Ul'dah. As you make to depart, you encounter Hoary Boulder and Coultenet, who have been charged with escorting F'lhaminn during her efforts to recruit her influential Ul'dahn acquaintances to the Scions' cause. It seems that the call of duty shall once more empty the Rising Stones of Eorzea's stalwart defenders. Travel to the Ceruleum Processing Plant and report to Wilred.
TEXT_GAIUSE505_00367_SEQ_05: After reporting to Wilred, the eager Crystal Braves member takes you to Lieutenant Edelstein for a briefing on the current situation. Edelstein appears elated at your presence, but his mood quickly turns sour as he relates to you the news of how several imperial explosive devices have been discovered within the perimeter of the plant. Join the soldiers and the newly arrived Scions in the search for any suspicious boxes that could prove a danger to the garrison.
TEXT_GAIUSE505_00367_SEQ_06: You have scoured the entire compound and uncovered what you believe to be four more imperial explosive devices. Return to Lieutenant Edelstein and deliver the suspicious containers.
TEXT_GAIUSE505_00367_SEQ_07: Lieutenant Edelstein gingerly receives the crates from your steady hands, and puts them aside for his sappers to disable. Though one threat has been effectively neutralized, the garrison commander informs you that returning scouts have reported movement amongst the nearby Garlean forces...
TEXT_SUBFST047_00374_SEQ_00: Keitha, the head wrangler at Bentbranch Meadows, has some work for you on the ranch.

TEXT_SUBFST047_00374_SEQ_03: You have replenished all of the chocobos' feeding troughs. Return to Keitha and let her know that the task is complete.
TEXT_SUBFST047_00374_SEQ_04: Keitha explains that the chocobos at Bentbranch Meadows are closely nurtured from the moment they hatch until the time they reach young adulthood. Offer your assistance to the workers around the ranch, and help keep the birds happy and healthy.

TEXT_SUBFST066_00382_SEQ_03: Thanks to your efforts, travelers on the road to Bentbranch will have less to fear in the future. However, the ultimate cause behind the increase of magicked bones has yet to be determined, and Lothaire wonders what could drive the dead to walk again.
TEXT_SUBSEA101_00398_SEQ_00: Wyrkrhit, a Skylift operator, needs an adventurer to deliver some forgotten packages.

He also acknowledges that Limsa Lominsa's governing body is highly unlikely to divert resources to such a mundane endeavor while the city-state is occupied with the threat of the beast tribes and the Garlean Empire. For the time being, he must be content with overseeing the tedious business of loading and unloading the balloons.

TEXT_SUBSEA107_00404_SEQ_03: The casket you uncovered proves to hold nothing more than a handful of wheat seeds. Lyulf is momentarily disappointed until he recalls a comment his father once made concerning the success of his family's crops. With seeds that thrive even in the most barren soil, the farmer hopes to soon see the day when the desolate fields of Swiftperch are transformed into a golden sea of swaying wheat.
TEXT_GAIUSE607_00419_SEQ_00: Ser Marcelain wishes to prepare you for the siege of Ishgard.
