TEXT_GAIUSE607_00419_SEQ_03: As the remnants of the Dravanian Horde take to the skies in disarray, Ishgard's weary defenders breathe a sigh of relief. The siege is ended. Speak with Alphinaud at the Gates of Judgement and find out how your allies fared in the battle at the Steel Vigil.
TEXT_GAIUSE607_00419_SEQ_04: Moments after greeting Alphinaud, you are joined by a grateful Ser Aymeric, who humbly thanks you for your service. When the lord commander subsequently takes his leave, Alphinaud triumphantly declares that the stage has been set for Ishgard's return to the Eorzean Alliance. Make your way back to Revenant's Toll, and report your success to Minfilia.
TEXT_GAIUSE607_00419_SEQ_05: Minfilia greets your return with a mixture of triumph and relief. Having snuffed out the Dravanian threat, it is time to enjoy a well-earned rest.
TEXT_SUBSEA052_00464_SEQ_00: Gurcant is eyeing fertile new fields for Summerford Farms, but pests perturb his plows.
TEXT_SUBSEA052_00464_SEQ_01:
This quest has been adjusted. Please abandon the quest and restart it by speaking to either Staelwyrn or Gurcant at Summerford Farms, depending on your progress.

※The Main Scenario Guide shows the next available quest. You can toggle it on and off in Character Configuration, under UI Settings.
TEXT_SUBSEA052_00464_SEQ_02: The fields are now ripe for tillage. Deliver the good news to Gurcant.
TEXT_SUBSEA052_00464_SEQ_03: Gurcant laments having to ask outsiders for help, especially considering all the one-time swashbucklers loitering about. All the same, he is grateful for your assistance.
TEXT_FESPDY101_00499_SEQ_00:
The sophisticated servitor would beseech your aid on behalf of his troubled master.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESPDY101_00499_SEQ_01:
The sophisticated servitor explains to you that his master, one Nanapasi, means to fashion a special gift for his dear daughter, but the preparations have hit an unfortunate snag. Make your way to Emerald Avenue and offer the forlorn father what assistance you can.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESPDY101_00499_SEQ_02: At Emerald Avenue, you encounter a visibly flustered Nanapasi, who appears convinced that his dear daughter has come to utterly despise him. Rendezvous with the troubled trader outside the Quicksand, where he will meet you after taking a walk to settle his troubled mind.
TEXT_FESPDY101_00499_SEQ_03: You meet with Nanapasi outside the Quicksand, where the flustered father explains his plight in detail. As he tells it, he sought to take advantage of this year's Little Ladies' Day festivities to repair a strained relationship with his daughter Ninimo, promising the girl that he would oversee the construction of a modern-day replica of the Thorne Dynasty decorations that she has long adored. Unfortunately, failing to exercise due diligence before he spoke, he now finds himself without the materials he needs to see his words become reality. Pleading for assistance, he entrusts you with an ancient map and directs you to speak with the disciplined domestic beside him if you are willing to offer your aid.
TEXT_FESPDY102_00500_SEQ_00:
The disciplined domestic seeks assistance in acquiring the materials necessary for Nanapasi's masterwork.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESPDY102_00500_SEQ_01:
As the disciplined domestic tells it, the map entrusted to you by Nanapasi will lead you to a buried stash of the age-old doll parts he requires to assemble the decorations he has promised his daughter.

Decipher the Thorne Dynasty map to reveal the location of the parts, then acquire them and deliver them to the disciplined domestic.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESPDY102_00500_SEQ_02: The disciplined domestic rejoices at your success, assuring you that the parts that you have recovered will contribute greatly to the realization of Nanapasi's grand stage. Should the spirit of Little Ladies' Day strike you, continue to lend your aid to Nanapasi and his attendants, that the dreams of both father and daughter alike may come to fruition.
TEXT_FESPDY103_00501_SEQ_00:
Nanapasi has a triumphant gleam in his eye.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESPDY103_00501_SEQ_01:
Visibly impressed with himself, Nanapasi gleefully informs you of the successful completion of his magnum opus, a modern-day recreation of the grand Little Ladies' Day decorations from the Thorne Dynasty days. As a token of his appreciation for the role you played in making this possible, he invites you to be present at the moment of its grand unveiling before his daughter Ninimo. Make your way to Emerald Avenue and await father and daughter there.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESPDY103_00501_SEQ_02: Nanapasi unveils his creation to his daughter, only to be met with a less-than-enthusiastic reaction. Summoning the courage to speak her mind, Ninimo reveals that her true intention behind proposing the construction of the doll stand was to spend more time with her father, a message that at long last reaches the over-doting Nanapasi. Moved by his daughter's pure and gentle heart, Nanapasi apologizes for his obtusity and vows that he will endeavor to be the father she has always wanted him to be. For your role in bringing father and daughter together─not unlike Baldric and Edvya Thorne so many years ago─Nanapasi would offer you due reward. Seek him out in front of the Quicksand.
TEXT_FESPDY103_00501_SEQ_03: Nanapasi reiterates his gratitude for your efforts, informing you that he and Ninimo have decided to recraft the doll stand─this time, together. Expressing his confidence that today's events will lead to a healthy and happy family for years to come, he asks for your continued assistance in recovering the doll parts that will allow them to realize their dream together.
TEXT_FESVLT101_00512_SEQ_00:
Lisette de Valentione seeks the assistance of an experienced adventurer in her labors of love.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESVLT101_00512_SEQ_01:
Lisette de Valentione and her band of loyal retainers have once again journeyed from Ishgard to bring the passionate spirit of their noble house's motto─ardor and affection─to all Eorzea. However, in their efforts to aid those Eorzeans unable to confess their love in person, the party has met with an unforeseen obstacle that only an experienced adventurer can overcome. Lisette bids you speak with Hortefense, the man spearheading the mission, to learn more.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESVLT101_00512_SEQ_02: Hortefense explains how he and his emissaries have been tasked with delivering tokens of love in petitioners' steads. However, while the service was intended to aid those shackled by shyness, they have received requests from another, unexpected source: those who would gladly present their gifts directly, if only they knew where their loved ones were. Hortefense has pledged to locate these absent sweethearts, but as a stranger to these lands, he has thus far met with little success. Hence does he seek the assistance of learned adventurers to find these missing men, and ensure that no love goes unspoken this Valentione's Day.
TEXT_FESVLT102_00515_SEQ_00:
Hortefense would have you assist his man in Gridania in a search for an absent adventurer.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESVLT102_00515_SEQ_01:
Hortefense asks you to assist his mission in Gridania by tracking down a local lady's missing swain. The emissary in charge of the case awaits you by the amphitheatre gates. He will introduce you to the lady in question, so that you might listen to her plea.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESVLT102_00515_SEQ_02:
The troubled maiden explains how her love is an adventurer, who recently departed on yet another mission. Unfortunately, the absent-minded fellow left no word of his destination. All that the lady can recall is that he often spoke of  in the days before his disappearance. She would be most grateful if you could track down her roving beau, and deliver to him a fragrant charm of her own design.

※Please note that the adventurer you seek will not be marked on the map, nor will any identifying symbol appear above the character's head. Share your information with other players, and try to find him.
TEXT_FESVLT102_00515_SEQ_03: You present the charm to Frageorloix in Bentbranch Meadows. He recognizes its craftsmanship as that of his sweetheart, confirming that he is indeed the swain you seek. He returns to Gridania to be reunited with his lady love, and to prepare a gift of his own. All that remains is to return to Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre, and report your success to the emissary.
TEXT_FESVLT102_00515_SEQ_04: The emissary thanks you for your efforts in finding Frageorloix, and for passing on the maiden's token of affection. But there is another whose suit remains unanswered: it seems that Ser Hortefense searches for his own lost love─a “noblewoman of paramount virtue.” Might this fit the description of anyone you know?
TEXT_FESVLT103_00523_SEQ_00:
Hortefense would have you assist his man in Ul'dah to track down a traveling trader.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESVLT103_00523_SEQ_01:
Hortefense dispatches you to Ul'dah to assist his subordinate in sifting the sands for love gone astray. He bids you meet with the House Valentione emissary there, who will introduce you to one of the ladies who requires your services.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESVLT103_00523_SEQ_02:
The  maiden explains that the object of her affections is a traveling trader, who has selected a most inopportune time to head out into the desert. The only clue to his destination is a snippet of half-heard conversation: the lady recalls him mentioning  while discussing his route with a fellow merchant. She hands you a tearstained love letter and bids you locate her darling, that you might deliver it to him.

※Please note that the trader you seek will not be marked on the map, nor will any identifying symbol appear above the character's head. Share your information with other players, and try to find him.
TEXT_FESVLT103_00523_SEQ_03: You hand the letter to  in , who recognizes the hand and scent of his sweetheart. He vows to return to Ul'dah forthwith, to repay his darling for her heartfelt gift. Follow him back to the city, and report your success to the emissary.
TEXT_FESVLT103_00523_SEQ_04: You report to the emissary, who welcomes you with open arms. Thanks to your efforts, the  maiden is  no more. However, there is less welcome news for Hortefense─the “noble lady of Ishgard” for whom he searches has not been found in Thanalan. Perhaps he might have more luck hunting a little closer to home?
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_SEQ_00: Raubahn has some parting words for you ahead of the final phase of Operation Archon.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_SEQ_01:
This quest has been adjusted. Please abandon the quest and restart it by speaking to Raubahn at Raubahn's Push.

※The Main Scenario Guide shows the next available quest. You can toggle it on and off in Character Configuration, under UI Settings.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_SEQ_02:
You are ready to depart for the Praetorium, the stage upon which the fate of the realm shall soon be decided. Fight your way into the depths of the structure, in search of the Ultima Weapon, and when you find the Allagan relic...send a piece of it to each of the seven hells.

※The Praetorium can be accessed via the Duty Finder.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_SEQ_03:
With Gaius van Baelsar slain, and the Ultima Weapon destroyed, it would seem that Eorzea may finally look forward to an era of peace. Yet even as the people of the three city-states gather to celebrate their deliverance, a deafening roar reverberates throughout every corner of the realm...
A dread primal has awakened.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_SEQ_04: What fearsome primal is this that has been roused? Perhaps Minfilia will be able to shed some light on the mystery.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_SEQ_05: In troubled tones, Minfilia reveals to you that shortly after the roar was heard around the land, an aetheric disturbance was observed, bearing a disquieting similarity to a phenomenon recorded five years ago. It would seem that your struggles are far from over. Steel your resolve anew, and set forth to shine the Crystal's light upon the realm.
TEXT_FESVLT104_00527_SEQ_00:
Hortefense would have you assist his man in Limsa Lominsa to hunt for a wayward wagoner.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESVLT104_00527_SEQ_01:
Hortefense asks you to help his man in La Noscea, who has been inundated with requests to deliver gifts to missing beaus. The nobleman bids you travel to Limsa Lominsa to meet with his assistant by the Aftcastle. This emissary will introduce you to one of his careworn clients, so that she might relate to you any clues she has to the location of her lost love.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESVLT104_00527_SEQ_02:
You speak with the  maiden, who explains how her wagon-pulling beloved has gone out to find work, and cannot be traced. She has prepared a batch of his favorite confection─an especially minty chocolate─that must be delivered to him before Valentione's Day is out. However, she has but one clue as to his location: the  she recalls him speaking of before he departed. She begs you to search for her missing sweetheart and deliver her gift to him.

※Please note that the wagoner you seek will not be marked on the map, nor will any identifying symbol appear above the character's head. Share your information with other players, and try to find him.
TEXT_FESVLT104_00527_SEQ_03: You meet with  . He recognizes his sweetheart from your descriptions, and accepts the gift with unrestrained delight. Return to the Aftcastle and report your success to the emissary.
TEXT_FESVLT104_00527_SEQ_04: The emissary thanks you profusely for bringing together the  maiden and her wayward swain. However, he has less welcome words for Hortefense: the hunt for the nobleman's lost love has met with the expected lack of success. For how is one to find a lady when one knows neither her name nor her face? If only there were some other clue as to her identity...
TEXT_FESVLT105_00547_SEQ_00:
Hortefense would hear how you fare in spreading ardor and affection across the realm.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESVLT105_00547_SEQ_01:
Amazed at your success in reuniting pining sweethearts with their lost loves, Hortefense entrusts you with his own petition. Some years ago, he was gravely wounded in battle and left to die in a northern snowfield. And he would have done just that, had his life not been saved by a noblewoman of Ishgard─a lady he has searched for ever since. Perhaps Lisette de Valentione might have some inkling as to who the lady might be.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESVLT105_00547_SEQ_02: Hortefense's story seems somehow familiar to Lisette, but she cannot recall the names of the persons involved. She bids you speak with her retainer, the emissary of House Valentione currently stationed outside the amphitheatre gates, to see if he can remember any further details.
TEXT_FESVLT105_00547_SEQ_03: You recount Hortefense's story to the emissary, who immediately discerns the identity of the noblewoman involved. He asks you to return to Lisette, and bid her remain in place while he informs Hortefense of the news.
TEXT_FESVLT105_00547_SEQ_04: The truth is finally revealed: the noblewoman who saved Hortefense's life was none other than Lady Lisette de Valentione herself. Carried away by the excitement of rediscovering his lost love, Hortefense makes a surprise proposal, but is angrily rejected by Lisette. Hortefense is undeterred by her uncharacteristic lack of decorum, however, and the lady reluctantly allows him to remain in her company, provided they begin as friends and nothing more. With Hortefense's lost love discovered, and his long-unspoken ardor confessed, your duties as a laborer of love are finally complete. And while the world below basks in the warmth of passions both revealed and renewed, Countess Arabelle de Valentione smiles down from the heavens, her aims achieved for another year.
TEXT_FESEST101_00556_SEQ_00:
Jihli Aliapoh has a dream, and hopes that an adventurer like yourself might help it come true.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESEST101_00556_SEQ_01:
Jihli Aliapoh asks that you join her in celebrating the coming of Hatching-tide, a festival born from a vision bestowed on her by the Twelve Archons of yore; a vision that came to reality a twelvemoon prior. However, this year's event is to be no mere memorial, for Jihli has again been visited by the Archons: in her most recent dream, she saw adventurers in spriggan form following an auspicious spriggan, who guided them to a wondrous treasure. She bids you speak with her sylphic helper by the amphitheatre gates, so that you too might be transfigured into the shape of a spriggan, and bring her vision to life.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESEST101_00556_SEQ_02:
The sorceress, a sylph in Lalafellin clothing, transfigures you into spriggan form with illusory magicks. She bids you remain in disguise as you hunt for Archon eggs around Old Gridania, and collect three of the cards contained within, that you might exchange them with Jihli for a special prize.

※If the transfiguration should fade, speak with the sylphic sorceress again to be changed back into spriggan form.
TEXT_FESEST101_00556_SEQ_03: You successfully hunt for three Archon eggs, and collect the cards within. Return to Jihli Aliapoh in Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre to collect your reward.
TEXT_FESEST101_00556_SEQ_04: You deliver the Archon cards to Jihli Aliapoh, who is amazed to find a platinum card among your collection. She asks how you could have discovered the egg that contained this rarest of prizes, and you relate how an unusual spriggan holding a checkered egg drew your attention to it. Jihli is delighted to hear your news, recognizing the auspicious spriggan from her vision in your words. Convinced once more that the Archons' prophecy is coming true, she asks for your assistance in tracking down the auspicious spriggan, that he might guide you to the wondrous treasure of which the Archons spoke.
TEXT_FESEST102_00557_SEQ_00:
Jihli Aliapoh would enlist your assistance in fulfilling the next stage of the prophecy.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESEST102_00557_SEQ_01:
The auspicious spriggan from Jihli's dream has finally made its appearance, and Jihli would relate to you the continuance of the prophecy. In her vision, she saw the spriggan depart Gridania, and reappear amid the dusty lanes of Ul'dah. Jihli bids you follow him there, and speak with Nonotta, her faithful assistant based near the Ruby Road Exchange, to learn of the latest developments.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESEST102_00557_SEQ_02: Nonotta confirms that the auspicious spriggan has made its entrance to Ul'dah, but to the Dreamer's alarm, the spriggan did not come alone: villainous roughnecks calling themselves the “Shellshockers” have also made their way into the city, and are hunting the creature down to who knows what nefarious end. She bids you aid in the spriggan's escape, recommending you first have the local sylphic sorceress disguise you in spriggan form, to avoid attracting the brigands' unwelcome attentions.
TEXT_FESEST102_00557_SEQ_03:
The sylphic sorceress gladly transfigures you, and presents you with a clouding scalebomb to aid in the auspicious spriggan's escape. Search the streets around the Quicksand, the spriggan's last known location, and if you should come across a Shellshocker, present him with the diverting gift.

※If the transfiguration should fade, speak with the sylphic sorceress again to be changed back into spriggan form.
TEXT_FESEST102_00557_SEQ_04: You find the spriggan cornered by a pair of infamous Shellshockers, and despite the leader's grumblings, you press your present into his hands. In the ensuing chaos, the spriggan bolts from their clutches. Return to the Ruby Road Exchange to report your successful rescue effort to Nonotta.
TEXT_FESEST102_00557_SEQ_05: Nonotta is glad to hear of the auspicious spriggan's escape, but fears the Shellshockers will not cease their wicked hunt until the creature has fled the confines of the city. She bids you transform into spriggan form once more, so that you might aid the auspicious spriggan's flight without attracting the ruffians' ire.
TEXT_FESEST102_00557_SEQ_06:
The sylphic sorceress magicks you into furry form, and hands you another clouding scalebomb to distract the evil Shellshockers. The auspicious spriggan was seen racing towards the Gate of the Sultana, but chances are the bandits have got there first. Head to the gate, and ensure the auspicious spriggan evades their greedy clutches.

※If the transfiguration should fade, speak with the sylphic sorceress again to be changed back into spriggan form.
TEXT_FESEST102_00557_SEQ_07: You find the auspicious spriggan cornered once again, this time by a trio of salivating Shellshockers. Their leader waves you away, but your insistence pays off─he agrees to accept the booby-trapped gift. With his would-be captors incapacitated by a fit of coughing, the spriggan makes a break for the gates, and flees into the wide blue yonder. Return to Nonotta, and inform her of the spriggan's safe escape.
TEXT_FESEST102_00557_SEQ_08: Nonotta is relieved to hear of the spriggan's escape, and rejoices in the fact that all is proceeding as Jihli's vision predicted. But just as she is about to explain the next stage of the prophecy, a Shellshocker approaches, and speaks to her with suspicious familiarity. Nonotta tries to gloss over the unusual exchange, but the air remains heavy with lingering doubt: could the day's commotions have all been a ruse, orchestrated by Nonotta herself? And if so, to what end...?
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_SEQ_00:
Nonotta is keen to put the past behind her, and move on to the final part of the prophecy.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_SEQ_01:
After securing your silence regarding the strange exchange you witnessed between her and the leader of the Shellshockers, Nonotta bids you head to Limsa Lominsa to defend the auspicious spriggan from the ruffians' assuredly evil plans. Motte, the Dreamer in charge of the Hatching-tide festivities in La Noscea, awaits you by the Aftcastle.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_SEQ_02: Motte is pleased to reveal that the auspicious spriggan has indeed been sighted in Limsa Lominsa. At least, she thinks he has: three similar spriggans, each carrying an unusual egg, have been seen scurrying around the upper decks. She bids you speak with her sylphic helper, who has a cunning plan to expose the suspicious spriggans' true nature.
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_SEQ_03:
The sylphic sorceress has laid in store an arsenal of sylphic scalebombs that can break through the strongest of illusory magicks. Transforming you into spriggan form so that you might blend into the crowd, she entrusts you with three bombs─one for each of the suspicious spriggans. Seek out a spriggan holding an unusual egg, and toss a truesight scalebomb at the creature before it can get away.

※If the transfiguration should fade, speak with the sylphic sorceress again to be changed back into spriggan form.
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_SEQ_04:
You toss a truesight scalebomb at the first of the suspicious spriggans, stripping a Shellshocker of his disguise. The boastful brigand escapes, leaving you with two suspicious spriggans remaining. Hunt down another, and use a truesight scalebomb to expose its true nature.

※If the transfiguration should fade, speak with the sylphic sorceress again to be changed back into spriggan form.
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_SEQ_05:
The second suspicious spriggan was another Shellshocker in disguise, leaving just one of their number still at large. Could this be the real auspicious spriggan? Track down the creature, and throw a truesight scalebomb at him to make sure.

※If the transfiguration should fade, speak with the sylphic sorceress again to be changed back into spriggan form.
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_SEQ_06: The truesight scalebomb has no effect on the creature, confirming that it is indeed the auspicious spriggan of Jihli Aliapoh's vision. The spriggan departs, leaving you with a fragmentary message of big eggs and lucky treasure. Could he have been speaking of the wondrous treasure revealed to Jihli by the Archons of yore? Return to Motte, to see if she can divine any meaning from the spriggan's words.
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_SEQ_07:
The spriggan's words strike a chord with Motte. Jihli did not only dream of spriggans in the cities; she saw spriggans out in the wilds, too─dancing around giant, floating eggs, and trying to crack them open. Her Dreamers managed to track down the locations of these scenes, and found the very eggs Jihli dreamed of. Sylphic sorceresses have been dispatched to each location, to bring the scenes from Jihli's vision to life: to crack open the eggs, and win whatever prizes hide inside. Win a lucky egg by participating in the FATE “Gloria in Eggcelsis,” and give it to Motte. The FATE can be found at the following locations: southwest of Summerford Farms in middle La Noscea; east of the Salt Strand in lower La Noscea; south of Hyrstmill in the North Shroud; southeast of the Ul'dah Dispatch Yard in central Thanalan; and east of Camp Drybone in eastern Thanalan.

※To participate in the FATE, you must first be transfigured into spriggan form by the nearby sylphic sorceress.
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_SEQ_08: Motte's hands tremble with anticipation as you hand over the lucky egg that she is sure contains the prophesied treasure. But as Jihli arrives to witness the crowning glory of her festival, so too does the auspicious spriggan, who is clearly not all he seems. Motte is forced into a confession: the events of the day were nothing but a drama staged by her and the other Dreamers. The auspicious spriggan, the Shellshockers, the treasure inside the lucky egg─all were false. At Jihli's angry insistence, Motte explains how the play was to end: she was to substitute the lucky egg's contents with a treasure map guiding Jihli to the Bismarck. By way of apology, Motte bids you come to the Bismarck too, to partake in the “wondrous treasure” that she and her accomplices have prepared. Speak to the one-eyed wretch in the restaurant to witness the unveiling.
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_SEQ_09:
You and Jihli arrive at the Bismarck to find that her Dreamers have organized a surprise nameday party for her. Jihli is moved to see so many well-wishers joining together to share the warmth of their hearts, and recalls the words the Archons of yore spoke unto her in her dream─how she was to follow a bearer of fortune and tour the wonders of the land, to overcome a grave peril and find a wondrous treasure. She realizes that the prophecy has indeed come true: she has overcome the peril posed by her friends' deceit, and gained the wondrous treasure of a closer understanding with her friends, and a renewed determination to make Hatching-tide a day of great joy. The “bearer of fortune” can only be you: the one who has toured the land in pursuit of the treasure, and led Jihli to such a happy conclusion.

Sated with the night's revelries, you prepare to depart the Bismarck, but just as you are about to leave, you are called to a halt by Baderon Tenfingers, proprietor of the Adventurers' Guild. To your surprise, he congratulates you for saving the realm from imminent destruction. Unbeknownst to you or the Dreamers, the enormous eggs from Jihli's vision were actually Allagan doomsday devices, relics of the ancient empire that would have reduced Eorzea to ruins had they been left unattended. Realizing with some discomfort that it was luck alone that led to the weapons' discovery and deactivation, Baderon bids you never to speak of this knowledge to anyone, lest they live their lives in fear of what other unholy menaces sleep unnoticed beneath the soil.
TEXT_MANFST203_00675_SEQ_00: Baderon, the proprietor of the Drowning Wench, has need of a capable adventurer.
TEXT_MANFST203_00675_SEQ_01:
This quest has been adjusted. Please abandon the quest and restart it by speaking to Baderon at the Drowning Wench.

※The Main Scenario Guide shows the next available quest. You can toggle it on and off in Character Configuration, under UI Settings.
TEXT_MANFST203_00675_SEQ_02: Make your way north of Aleport, and speak with the Yellowjacket stationed outside the entrance to Sastasha.
TEXT_MANFST203_00675_SEQ_03:
The Yellowjackets are concerned that the unsavory-looking men seen entering Sastasha may belong to the Serpent Reavers, the pirate allies of the Sahagin. Search the caves and ascertain whether or not such suspicions are well founded.

※Sastasha can be accessed via the Duty Finder.
TEXT_MANFST203_00675_SEQ_04: You have discovered a pirate den in the depths of Sastasha. Just as the Yellowjackets feared, it would appear the Serpent Reavers and their Sahagin masters are using the caves as a base for their nefarious operations. Return to Limsa Lominsa without delay, and report your findings to Baderon at the Drowning Wench.
TEXT_MANFST203_00675_SEQ_05: Having listened to your findings, Baderon expresses his satisfaction with your work, and mentions another task which might be of interest to you. It seems the Adventurers' Guild in Gridania wishes to employ the services of a seasoned adventurer. Prepare your gear, then speak with Baderon when you are ready to embark on the next stage of your journey.
TEXT_GAIUSA002_00708_SEQ_00: Commander Vorsaile Heuloix has been awaiting the aid of the Scions.
TEXT_GAIUSA002_00708_SEQ_01:
This quest has been adjusted. Please abandon the quest and restart it by speaking to Vorsaile Heuloix in the Adders' Nest.

※The Main Scenario Guide shows the next available quest. You can toggle it on and off in Character Configuration, under UI Settings.
TEXT_GAIUSA002_00708_SEQ_02: Mitainie has instructed you to take the ferry from Westshore Pier to reach the East Shroud. Once there, you will only need to head due east to find the Hawthorne Hut. Before going there, however, stop off along the way at Fullflower Comb and pay your regards to Rosa Hawthorne.
TEXT_GAIUSA002_00708_SEQ_03: Rosa Hawthorne has a sticky situation on her hands, what with killer hornets assailing her precious honeybees. Slay three hornet clouds to put her heart at ease.
TEXT_GAIUSA002_00708_SEQ_04: You have triumphed over the killer hornets. Report your success to Rosa.
TEXT_GAIUSA002_00708_SEQ_05: Rosa thanks you for having protected her beehives from the swarm of hornets. To express her gratitude, she has given you a pot of fresh honey, which she knows will help loosen the lips of the serpent officer you are seeking, Amelain. Proceed to the Hawthorne Hut and deliver the honey as bade.
TEXT_GAIUSA002_00708_SEQ_06: The sweet-toothed Amelain has informed you that Rosa's husband, Rolfe Hawthorne, is well versed in sylphic culture and should hold the answers you seek.
TEXT_GAIUSA103_00717_SEQ_00: Yda has a notion of how one might earn the sylphs' trust.
TEXT_GAIUSA103_00717_SEQ_01:
This quest has been adjusted. Please abandon the quest and restart it by speaking to Yda in Little Solace.

※The Main Scenario Guide shows the next available quest. You can toggle it on and off in Character Configuration, under UI Settings.
TEXT_GAIUSA103_00717_SEQ_02: That was certainly exhausting. Return to Yda and tell her that you have danced as you have never danced before.
TEXT_GAIUSA103_00717_SEQ_03: Your dancing has won many a smile, but have you truly succeeded in winning the hearts of the sylphs of Little Solace? This remains to be seen.
TEXT_GAIUSA104_00718_SEQ_00: Papalymo has a notion of how you might endear yourself to the sylphs of Little Solace.
TEXT_GAIUSA104_00718_SEQ_01:
This quest has been adjusted. Please abandon the quest and restart it by speaking to Papalymo in Little Solace.

※The Main Scenario Guide shows the next available quest. You can toggle it on and off in Character Configuration, under UI Settings.
TEXT_GAIUSA104_00718_SEQ_02: As Imedia would tell it, the sylphs live in constant fear of attacks by ill-tempered forest creatures. She bids you slay five ziz gorlins and five gall gnats, that the residents of Little Solace might rest easy, and suggests that procuring five brownie brushes in the process would also go far to curry the sylphs' favor.
TEXT_GAIUSA104_00718_SEQ_03: You have dispatched the invasive fauna, and obtained brownie brushes for the sylphs. Report to Komuxio of Little Solace and impress upon him your good intentions.
TEXT_GAIUSA104_00718_SEQ_04: Komuxio expresses gratitude for your efforts on behalf of Little Solace. It would seem the sylphs have begun to warm to your presence, albeit gradually.
TEXT_GAIUSA203_00726_SEQ_00: Buscarron could use an adventurer to douse a fight brewing at his establishment.
TEXT_GAIUSA203_00726_SEQ_01:
This quest has been adjusted. Please abandon the quest and restart it by speaking to Buscarron at Buscarron's Druthers.

※The Main Scenario Guide shows the next available quest. You can toggle it on and off in Character Configuration, under UI Settings.
TEXT_GAIUSA203_00726_SEQ_02: You have obtained the empty tub. Take it to the river behind the tavern and lay it down.
TEXT_GAIUSA203_00726_SEQ_03: You have placed the tub in the water. Now fill it up with water.
TEXT_GAIUSA203_00726_SEQ_04: You have filled the tub with water. Pick it up.
TEXT_GAIUSA203_00726_SEQ_05: You have finally armed yourself with a mighty tub of cool water. Return to the area immediately outside the Druthers, douse the drunken lout, and remind him of the house rules.
TEXT_GAIUSA203_00726_SEQ_06: Drenched with river water, the drunkard runs off, having come to his senses enough to realize that Buscarron means business when he says there's to be no fighting in or about his establishment. Report your success to Buscarron.
TEXT_GAIUSA203_00726_SEQ_07: Thanks to your actions, the tavern's regulars are able to enjoy their drinks in peace. Buscarron prides himself on opening his doors to all customers─even those with unsavory reputations─so long as they pay good coin and stay out of trouble.

TEXT_GAIUSA308_00740_SEQ_04: You have defeated the Garlean soldier summoned by Laurentius. Confront him and ascertain the nature of his relationship with the Empire.
TEXT_GAIUSA308_00740_SEQ_05: Laurentius has taken to his heels once more. Give chase before he makes good his escape.

TEXT_GAIUSA308_00740_SEQ_08: After listening to the tale of Laurentius's betrayal and subsequent repentance, Buscarron expresses hope that the Order of the Twin Adder will take pity on the disgraced Wood Wailer. He then shares some exciting news: the missing sylph elder has been found.

TEXT_GAIUSB313_00854_SEQ_03: Given the skill with which you decorated the feasting table, none would fault you if you chose to abandon adventuring and become a professional florist. Next, unleash your inner tavernkeep and position the bottles in ideal locations.
TEXT_GAIUSB313_00854_SEQ_04: Dyrstweitz eyes you with suspicion as you arrange the wine with alarming alacrity. Perhaps he believes you to have designs on his job. In any case, it may be best for you to portion out the feast quickly so you may excuse yourself before things become awkward.

TEXT_GAIUSB502_00871_SEQ_03: According to Marques, the makeshift oven should take no longer than a day to prepare─a truly amazing feat of engineering. Just how the refugee acquired such advanced skills is a mystery to all, including the man himself...

TEXT_GAIUSB503_00872_SEQ_03: Upon receiving the tools, Marques immediately sets to work and repairs the horologe, as if by instinct─an act that only serves to unnerve the troubled refugee. Apologizing for the inconvenience, he bids you take the device to Sister Eluned, who is currently tending to the body of its owner outside the church.
TEXT_GAIUSB503_00872_SEQ_04: Sister Eluned has never before seen an intricate device like the horologe, which is reminiscent of the technological marvels Garlemald is said to possess. The brief association causes her to suspect that the deceased owner may have been a Garlean spy, and she considers informing the Immortal Flames stationed in Camp Drybone. However, Marques's ability to repair the horologe appears to be an even more stunning revelation, one which also bears further investigation.

TEXT_GAIUSB508_00877_SEQ_03: What will result from your pilgrimage can never truly be known. Nevertheless, Sister Eluned believes that the souls of the departed Scions will be comforted by your actions.

TEXT_GAIUSB701_00896_SEQ_03: Lord Haurchefant praises your performance, admitting that he observed everything from the stronghold's walls. Remarking that you are doubtless a  of action, he proposes that you take a more active role in his inquiries into the whereabouts of the Enterprise.

TEXT_GAIUSB808_00917_SEQ_02: The cataloger states that he saw the Enterprise land somewhere far northwest of the Observatorium five years ago. Though he cannot provide a more accurate location at the moment, he is confident that, with the right astroscope log, he could calculate one. To that end, he asks that you bring to him volume six of the 1572 readings─a large red leather-bound tome, which should be stored on the uppermost floor of the Observatorium.
TEXT_GAIUSB808_00917_SEQ_03: Much to your surprise, you quickly locate and retrieve the correct volume. Return to the cataloger and present to him the tome.
TEXT_GAIUSB808_00917_SEQ_04: The cataloger quickly concludes that the airship landed somewhere near the Stone Vigil, which means that it was almost certainly seized by the garrison which occupied it at the time. Report your findings to Lord Haurchefant and see what advice he proffers.
TEXT_GAIUSB808_00917_SEQ_05: Lord Haurchefant explains that the Stone Vigil is currently held by Dravanian forces, and that all access to the ruined outpost is restricted by House Durendaire. To help you obtain permission to enter the Stone Vigil, he writes for you a letter of introduction to Lord Drillemont of Whitebrim Front. However, he suspects that his endorsement alone will not suffice, and he advises you to ask Lord Francel to write a letter for you as well.
TEXT_GAIUSB808_00917_SEQ_06: Lord Francel is happy to oblige your request. Before you depart, he reminds you that the cravens who attempted to destroy House Haillenarte have yet to be revealed, and that they may target you in the future in retaliation for your interference. Duly warned, proceed to Whitebrim Front and present your letters to the sentry at the gates.
TEXT_GAIUSB808_00917_SEQ_07: The surly sentry's demeanor quickly changes when he recognizes the seals on the letters you bear. Nevertheless, he seems reluctant to simply wave you inside...
TEXT_GAIUSB902_00925_SEQ_00: Ser Benedict appears to be stifling a laugh.

TEXT_GAIUSB902_00925_SEQ_02: One might be inclined to tell you that those crocs fought the good fight. That they gave you a memorable challenge, one that you would proudly share with comrades over a tankard of ale. But Eorzea is no faerie-tale world, and life is not a song. Sometimes you slay a primal, sometimes not. But perhaps Ser Clotairion will have a greater appreciation for your accomplishments.
TEXT_GAIUSB902_00925_SEQ_03: Ser Clotairion is grateful for your service, though he realizes full well that your intent was only to ingratiate yourself with him. Nevertheless, he promises that Lord Drillemont will know of your deeds.

TEXT_GAIUSB903_00926_SEQ_03: Lord Drillemont scoffs at the missive from houses Fortemps and Haillenarte, which calls for the increased reliance on foreign sellswords. He rejects the proposal without hesitation, shouting that Ishgard need not rely on outside help to win its war against Dravania. Though Nivie will doubtless not welcome the news, you should probably share with her Lord Drillemont's response.

Despite it being her duty to convey Lord Drillemont's exact words to Lord Francel, she is understandably reluctant to do so.

TEXT_GAIUSC103_00954_SEQ_03: The “unremarkable piece of rubbish,” so dubbed by the good professor, will suffice for your purposes. Now, watch and be amazed as he uses science to transform the pot into something far greater.

The creature has grown so fearsome that other spriggans, fearing for their safety, have begun to petition the kinder inhabitants of the Twelveswood for aid. One such spriggan recently visited Little Solace, and Hedyn suggests that you journey there and attempt to track down the wayward creature.
TEXT_GAIUSC301_00968_SEQ_03: Komuxio confirms that a spriggan did indeed come to Little Solace, though he is deeply concerned for the creature's safety. It may be in your best interests to locate the spriggan quickly...

TEXT_GAIUSC304_00971_SEQ_02: You come upon the spriggan desperately trying to escape the wrath of a tempered sylph. In typical heroic fashion, you rescue the creature, who promises to return to the safety of Little Solace. Return to the settlement and speak with Komuxio to ensure that the spriggan kept his word.
TEXT_GAIUSC304_00971_SEQ_03: Tiggy, the wayward spriggan, had petitioned the sylphs of Little Solace to put an end to Giggity's reign of terror. However, Komuxio observes that the notorious spriggan is clever and cautious, and will likely not reveal itself unless it is tempted by an especially rare ore. While Komuxio knows little and less of ore, he remarks that a goldsmith helping to restore the Sanctum of the Twelve surely does. Journey to the Sanctum and speak with Maerwynn.
TEXT_GAIUSC304_00971_SEQ_04: Giggity's deeds are known even to Maerwynn the goldsmith. After a moment's thought, she states that she may have a way to lure out the rampaging spriggan, though she warns you that the idea is both unorthodox and convoluted.
TEXT_GAIUSC307_00974_SEQ_00: Maerwynn has hatched a ridiculous plan to ensnare the dastardly Giggity.
TEXT_GAIUSC307_00974_SEQ_01:

TEXT_GAIUSC307_00974_SEQ_02: After dealing the errant golem a right thrashing, you now find yourself in possession of a golem soulstone. However, in its current state, it will not serve as bait. In accordance with Maerwynn's instructions, you must journey to Amberscale Rock in the Central Shroud, and rub the soulstone against the giant concentration of amber in order to dispel the enchantments woven into the chunk of true heart ore.
TEXT_GAIUSC307_00974_SEQ_03: Through a series of bizarre and rather random actions, you have obtained a chunk of true heart ore. Your new prize is being eyed hungrily by Tiggy the spriggan, who apparently followed you to Amberscale Rock. Explain your strategy to the spriggan before he attempts to devour your ore.
TEXT_GAIUSC307_00974_SEQ_04: Tiggy is delighted to learn of your plans, and tells you that the ravenous Giggity is presently lurking within the Spriggan Dig. Make your way into the lair of the spriggans and use the true heart to lure out and slay Giggity.
TEXT_GAIUSC307_00974_SEQ_05: The furry inhabitants of the Spriggan Dig can at last breathe a collective sigh of relief, for the notorious Giggity has finally fallen. In a primal frenzy, you rip and tear open the spriggan's huge guts and claim the corrupted crystal nestled deep within. Present your prize to Hedyn so that he can confirm it is the crystal you seek.
TEXT_GAIUSC307_00974_SEQ_06: Hedyn confirms that the foul-smelling, offal-laden crystal is comprised of ice-aspected aether. To your chagrin, you learn that you cannot cleanse the crystal of the spriggan entrails, as the thick coating of digestive juices is the only thing protecting you from the crystal's detrimental effects. Hopefully Cid will have developed a less irksome way to do the same...
TEXT_GAIUSC603_01003_SEQ_00: Sark Malark wishes to help you acquire the disguises you need for your rescue mission.
TEXT_GAIUSC603_01003_SEQ_01:
This quest has been adjusted. Please abandon the quest and restart it by speaking to Sark Malark in Revenant's Toll.

※The Main Scenario Guide shows the next available quest. You can toggle it on and off in Character Configuration, under UI Settings.
TEXT_GAIUSC603_01003_SEQ_02: You have succeeded in wresting imperial helms and uniforms from their owners, but the items did not survive your fury unscathed. Return to Revenant's Toll and present the damaged equipment to Sark Malark.
TEXT_GAIUSC603_01003_SEQ_03: Sark Malark declares that the damaged items are likely to draw suspicion, and urges you to have them repaired. Take the uniforms to the Weavers' Guild in Ul'dah, and the helms to the Armorers' Guild in Limsa Lominsa.
TEXT_GAIUSC603_01003_SEQ_04: Both the uniforms and the helms are now in good repair─at least outwardly. Return to Revenant's Toll and present them for Sark Malark's inspection.
TEXT_GAIUSC603_01003_SEQ_05: Sark Malark has given your imperial uniforms and helms his seal of approval. All that remains of your preparation is to obtain a suit of magitek armor.
TEXT_GAIUSC704_01016_SEQ_00: Arenvald would seek your aid in putting a plan of his into motion.
TEXT_GAIUSC704_01016_SEQ_01: This quest has been adjusted. Please abandon the quest and restart it by speaking to Wigstan at the Waking Sands.
TEXT_GAIUSC704_01016_SEQ_02: U'odh Nunh has heard your plea. Though the nunh himself is not averse to the plan, he doubts his fellow tribesmen will be so eager to cooperate.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_SEQ_00: Minfilia would brief you on the Eorzean Alliance's planned counteroffensive against the Empire.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_SEQ_01:
This quest has been adjusted. Please abandon the quest and restart it by speaking to Minfilia at the Waking Sands.

※The Main Scenario Guide shows the next available quest. You can toggle it on and off in Character Configuration, under UI Settings.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_SEQ_02: The Immortal Flames stand ready to launch their assault on the imperial outpost at Cape Westwind. Make your way to the staging point situated before the enemy stronghold, and report for duty to Lieutenant Adalbert.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_SEQ_03: Phase one of Operation Archon is now in motion. Enter the imperial outpost and fight your way through to the innermost sector.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_SEQ_04:
The path leading to the innermost sector of the imperial outpost is now open, and a confrontation with Rhitahtyn sas Arvina awaits. Proceed when you are ready and strike down the praefectus.

※Cape Westwind can be accessed via the Duty Finder.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_SEQ_05: At the end of a fierce struggle, you deal Rhitahtyn his death-blow, consigning the first Roegadyn to hold the rank of praefectus to history. Phase one of Operation Archon has ended in success.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_SEQ_06: With Rhitahtyn's demise, the forces garrisoned at Castrum Occidens have been thrown into disarray. For now, withdraw to the Immortal Flames encampment north of Vesper Bay, and report to the Allied communications officer.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_SEQ_07: The time has come to commence the second phase of Operation Archon. When you are ready, request further orders from the Allied communications officer.
TEXT_GAIUSC904_01039_SEQ_00: Sergeant Cracked Fist needs a hero to make a stew.
TEXT_GAIUSC904_01039_SEQ_01:
This quest has been adjusted. Please abandon the quest and restart it by speaking to Cracked Fist at Camp Bluefog.

※The Main Scenario Guide shows the next available quest. You can toggle it on and off in Character Configuration, under UI Settings.
TEXT_GAIUSC904_01039_SEQ_02: You have obtained enough basilisk meat. Take it to the cookfire just outside Camp Bluefog's northern gate, and add it to the bubbling cauldron.
TEXT_GAIUSC904_01039_SEQ_03: It will take a little while for the meat to be cooked through. Watch the cauldron until the stew is ready.
TEXT_GAIUSC904_01039_SEQ_04: Your keen instincts tell you that the basilisk stew is now ready. Scoop it from the bubbling cauldron.
TEXT_GAIUSC904_01039_SEQ_05: You have three steaming bowls of basilisk stew expertly balanced in your hands. Make your way around Camp Bluefog and give them to the neediest soldiers.
TEXT_GAIUSC904_01039_SEQ_06: You have doled out all of the basilisk stew, which seems to have had the desired effect. Report your success to Sergeant Cracked Fist.
TEXT_GAIUSC904_01039_SEQ_07: A jubilant Sergeant Cracked Fist thanks you for inspiriting his troops. They now remember their purpose, and stand ready to do their part in the impending phase of the operation.

TEXT_GAIUSC907_01042_SEQ_02: You have successfully delivered the message to both watchtowers. Continue on to the Ceruleum Processing Plant and report to Lieutenant Edelstein.
TEXT_GAIUSC907_01042_SEQ_03: You have spoken with Lieutenant Edelstein, who informs you that the Flame General himself has arrived at the plant.
TEXT_GAIUSC908_01043_SEQ_00: Lieutenant Edelstein wants you to report to the Flame General.
TEXT_GAIUSC908_01043_SEQ_01:
This quest has been adjusted. Please abandon the quest and restart it by speaking to Cracked Fist at Camp Bluefog.

TEXT_GAIUSC908_01043_SEQ_02: Raubahn bids you rally the garrison at the Ceruleum Processing Plant as you did at Camp Bluefog. Make your way around the plant and /psych up the green recruits whose resolve appears to be failing.
TEXT_GAIUSC908_01043_SEQ_03: Your visceral gesticulations have helped the recruits steel themselves for the battle to come. Now go to Lieutenant Edelstein and /psych him up as you did the recruits.
TEXT_GAIUSC908_01043_SEQ_04: Lieutenant Edelstein admits that the fire of his resolve had grown dim, and thanks you for making it rage anew. With both the Bull of Ala Mhigo and your good self present, the entire garrison is fairly ablaze with determination.

TEXT_GAIUSC911_01046_SEQ_02: You have sufficiently thinned out the imperial presence at Raubahn's Push. Proceed to the operation's staging point and report to Raubahn.
TEXT_GAIUSC911_01046_SEQ_03: You find the Flame General standing in the shadow of Castrum Meridianum. The final battle for the future of Eorzea will soon be joined.
TEXT_COMLIM001_01104_SEQ_00: R'ashaht Rhiki would have you begin your training in earnest.
TEXT_COMLIM001_01104_SEQ_01: High Storm Commander R'ashaht Rhiki has great hopes for your future in the Maelstrom, and would send you for training to see your potential fulfilled. Board the ferry from the Moraby Drydocks in lower La Noscea to get to the Wolves' Den. Once there, seek out Storm Captain Berkoeya Loetahlsyn.
TEXT_COMLIM001_01104_SEQ_02: After seeing fit to batter every last shred of confidence and self-respect out of you with a brutal tongue-lashing, Storm Captain Berkoeya Loetahlsyn reluctantly grants you permission to begin your training at the Wolves' Den.

TEXT_COMLIM010_01128_SEQ_00: R'ashaht Rhiki has a special assignment for you.
TEXT_COMLIM010_01128_SEQ_01: Dzemael Darkhold in the central highlands of Coerthas has been overrun by voidsent, and you have been selected to lead the extermination mission. Travel to the Darkhold and receive a briefing from Ophelie, a knight of House Dzemael.
TEXT_COMLIM010_01128_SEQ_02:
Explore the depths of Dzemael Darkhold and purge the fortress of the voidsent menace.

※Dzemael Darkhold can be accessed via the Duty Finder.
TEXT_COMLIM010_01128_SEQ_03: Your mission is a success. Return to Maelstrom Command and report to R'ashaht Rhiki.
TEXT_COMLIM010_01128_SEQ_04: Your brave deeds at Dzemael Darkhold have raised the reputation of the Maelstrom in Ishgard, and earned you the admiration of your superiors.

TEXT_COMLIM011_01131_SEQ_01: R'ashaht Rhiki tasks you with responding to a petition for aid from the Holy See of Ishgard. Make for the southwestern reaches of the central highlands of Coerthas and seek out Ser Willielmus at the Aurum Vale.
TEXT_COMLIM011_01131_SEQ_02:
Delve into the Aurum Vale and purge the deathly cavern of the foul fronds that inhabit its depths. Mind the vast pools of goldbile, a lethal ooze that─despite its glitter─offers not riches, but an excruciating demise for the unwary.

※The Aurum Vale can be accessed via the Duty Finder.

※The Main Scenario Guide shows the next available quest. You can toggle it on and off in Character Configuration, under UI Settings.
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_SEQ_02: You have successfully disabled the magitek field generator protecting the Praetorium, and defeated Livia sas Junius into the bargain. Though you are eager to press on with the fourth and final phase of Operation Archon, you will require the use of an airship if you are to reach the Ultima Weapon's resting place. For now, make your way back outside and report to Raubahn.
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_SEQ_03: After gruffly reaffirming his trust in your abilities, Raubahn declares the third phase of Operation Archon a success. All that remains is the small matter of finding and destroying the Ultima Weapon.
TEXT_FESLGT001_01153_SEQ_00:
Petyr Winsome, a reporter for the Harbor Herald in Limsa Lominsa, wishes to interview an adventurer.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESLGT001_01153_SEQ_01:
Petyr Winsome wishes you to participate in one of the monster-culling operations taking place at Three-malm Bend in middle La Noscea and Quarterstone in western La Noscea, and regale him with an account of your firsthand experience.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESLGT001_01153_SEQ_02: During your efforts to whittle down the rising numbers of monstrous wildlife, you encounter an enigmatic knight who introduces herself as “Lightning.” After retrieving an odd parcel she left behind after the battle, you return to Limsa Lominsa to share your experiences with Petyr Winsome. At the reporter's insistence, you both tear open the strange parcel to reveal gloves of highly unusual design. Petyr, more than pleased with your contribution to his article, gladly places the handwear into your keeping. You are left wondering, however, who Lightning truly is, and whence the warrior has come.
TEXT_FESLGT002_01154_SEQ_00:
Dural Tharal, a reporter for the Mythril Eye in Ul'dah, wishes to enlist the aid of an adventurer.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESLGT002_01154_SEQ_01:
You have been tasked with tracking down the suddenly famous lady-knight known as Lightning. According to rumor, the mysterious warrior is said to be hunting a monstrosity in the wilds beyond the walls of Ul'dah. Conduct your search near Highbridge in eastern Thanalan, or in the vicinity of Little Ala Mhigo in southern Thanalan.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESLGT002_01154_SEQ_02: You have successfully located and fought alongside Lightning in the wilds of Thanalan, and recovered another parcel which she left behind. After giving your account of events to an enthralled Dural Tharal, the reporter eagerly suggests opening the strange package. Inside, he discovers an unusual garment that he graciously returns to your possession. If the gossip Dural Tharal describes is any indication, Lightning's appearances seem to have become the favored subject of every rumormonger and tale-teller in Eorzea.
TEXT_FESLGT003_01155_SEQ_00:
Kipih Jakkya, reporter for The Raven, wishes to enlist the aid of an adventurer.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESLGT003_01155_SEQ_01:
Kipih Jakkya would like nothing more than to write an article about Lightning, the lady-knight with whom the public has developed an unhealthy obsession. To that end, she bids you seek Lightning out in the Coerthas central highlands, where the knight was last seen headed. Should you encounter the enigmatic figure, the reporter would like to hear of your experiences, as well as examine any evidence of her passing you might acquire.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESLGT003_01155_SEQ_02: You encounter the lady-knight Lightning as well as an unfamiliar mechanical enemy. After besting the gargantuan construct, she once again leaves behind an otherworldly parcel, which you bring back on your return to Gridania. After handing the parcel over to Kipih Jakkya, you are suddenly approached by Lightning herself. Though it appears the warrior has been sent to Eorzea against her will, she nevertheless expresses a growing fondness for the realm's vibrant beauty. Kipih Jakkya believes the parcel Lightning left behind is actually a gift meant for you─a sign of the lady-knight's gratitude for your timely assistance. Could this be the last you will see of the mysterious visitor?
TEXT_FESLGT004_01156_SEQ_00:
Kipih Jakkya, reporter for The Raven, has some urgent news for you.

※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESLGT004_01156_SEQ_01:
Kipih Jakkya has learned that Lightning, the lady-knight with whom you have crossed paths several times before, is being pursued by fell demons. The intrepid reporter implores you to journey to Mor Dhona and offer your assistance to the enigmatic warrior. Should you encounter Lightning, Kipih Jakkya would like to hear of your experiences, as well as examine any evidence of her passing you might acquire.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESLGT004_01156_SEQ_02: After fighting alongside Lightning and helping her vanquish her black-hearted pursuers, you once again come into possession of an otherworldly parcel. You return to Gridania and hand the parcel to Kipih Jakkya, at which point Lightning once more appears at your side. The lady-knight speaks of her desire to remain in Eorzea, but your bravery has rekindled her own sense of determination. Drawn away by inexorable forces, Lightning returns to a world besieged by chaos and destruction. In whatever distant land she calls home, you are certain that her struggles continue.
TEXT_FESHLW001_01163_SEQ_00:
The shifty thespian is recruiting adventurers to help enliven the festivities of All Saints' Wake.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESHLW001_01163_SEQ_01:
Harvest season has come to Eorzea, and with it the annual observance of All Saints' Wake. This year, a traveling circus troupe has been summoned to Gridania with the aim of reviving the revelrous traditions that have fallen out of favor since the Calamity. The shifty thespian invites you to speak with the Impresario─the leader of the troupe─to obtain a costume, that you too might join in the celebration.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESHLW001_01163_SEQ_02: After recounting the origins of All Saints' Wake, the Impresario gifts you with a traditional disguise, that you might take your place among the costumed troupers and help to bring about a hauntingly delightful night.
TEXT_FESHLW002_01164_SEQ_00:
The Impresario would invite you to participate in a devilishly delightful All Saints' Wake celebration.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESHLW002_01164_SEQ_01:
In order to fully enjoy the All Saints' Wake festivities, the Impresario has gifted you with a costume befitting the occasion. Don the guise to take your place among the terrors of the night, then speak with him anew.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESHLW002_01164_SEQ_02: Now that you look the part, the Impresario encourages you to travel to each of the three city-states and put a scare in the performers found within, for which you will be rewarded with toothsome treats. For your first objective, seek out the spirited thespian who haunts Gridania.
TEXT_FESHLW002_01164_SEQ_03: The performer informs you that while he is clean out of candy, his partner─a strongman most convincingly disguised as an ogre─still has a full supply, and happens to be more skittish than he appears. Try spooking him with a /clap of your hands.
TEXT_FESHLW002_01164_SEQ_04: The ogre of a strongman appears unimpressed by your efforts. Take his partner at his word and pretend to /congratulate the hulking brute to see if a rousing round of applause might do the trick.
TEXT_FESHLW002_01164_SEQ_05: Sufficiently spooked, the strongman rewards you with a piece of wind candy. Continue on your way to Ul'dah, and seek out a skittish acrobat, who shall serve as the next target of your spooking skills.
TEXT_FESHLW002_01164_SEQ_06: Thoroughly spooked by your actions, the zombie-like acrobat has dropped the cookies that he was using to patch up the gaping holes in his body. Retrieve the moldy, maggot-infested confections from the ground.
TEXT_FESHLW002_01164_SEQ_07: You have recovered the cookies. Be a kind soul and return them to their owner.
TEXT_FESHLW002_01164_SEQ_08: In return for your kindness, the acrobat rewards you with a piece of earth candy. Proceed to Limsa Lominsa and seek out an oversized clown disguised as a gelatinous glob.
TEXT_FESHLW002_01164_SEQ_09: Genuinely frightened by your casual threat to practice your culinary skills on him, the mucose mummer offers you a piece of fire candy in hopes of sating your appetite. Having completed your set of candy, return to Gridania and feed a piece of wind candy to the magic pot.
TEXT_FESHLW002_01164_SEQ_10: The magic pot is pleased. Feed it a piece of earth candy.
TEXT_FESHLW002_01164_SEQ_11: The magic pot is delighted. Feed it a piece of fire candy to complete the set.
TEXT_FESHLW002_01164_SEQ_12: The magic pot is overjoyed, and returns your kindness with a batch of pumpkin cookies. What further treats and terrors await you before the festivities are through? Seek out the Impresario after sundown to delve deeper into the shadows of the night.
TEXT_FESHLW003_01165_SEQ_00:
As the festivities of All Saints' Wake continue, the Impresario has another task for you.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESHLW003_01165_SEQ_01:
Duly impressed with your efforts on his troupe's behalf, the Impresario would seek your aid with another All Saints' Wake tradition─the lighting of the traditional warding lanterns. Donning your costume, first speak to the shifty thespian and obtain a bomb digit for the task.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESHLW003_01165_SEQ_02: The performer entrusts you with some still-smoldering bomb digits that should serve as makeshift torches. Remaining in costume, scour the town for any warding lanterns that have gone dim and restore them to light.
TEXT_FESHLW003_01165_SEQ_03: You have succeeded in rekindling the flames of the warding lanterns. Inform the Impresario that the deed is done.
TEXT_FESHLW003_01165_SEQ_04: The Impresario congratulates you on your efforts, and invites you to remain in town to enjoy the remaining festivities. The tone of his words suggests that the culminating act is yet to come...
TEXT_FESHLW004_01166_SEQ_00:
The Impresario has yet another task for you. He just isn't quite sure what it is yet.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESHLW004_01166_SEQ_01:
The Impresario, pleased with your honest efforts on his troupe's behalf, has entrusted you with the most vital task of placing one final warding lantern in a dimly lit area by Apkallu Falls. Speak once more to the shifty thespian to obtain the necessary supplies.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESHLW004_01166_SEQ_02: You have obtained the final warding lantern and the means by which to light it. Proceed to place it as directed in the vicinity of Apkallu Falls.
TEXT_FESHLW004_01166_SEQ_03: The lantern having been successfully placed, proceed to light it with the bomb digit.
TEXT_FESHLW004_01166_SEQ_04: Upon lighting the final warding lantern, a curious voice speaks to you, raising doubts as to the true identity of the Impresario, and encouraging you to seek the truth from his troupe's purported patrons. Begin your investigation by speaking to Serpent Captain Uphanne at the Adders' Nest
TEXT_FESHLW004_01166_SEQ_05: Uphanne insists that the Order of the Twin Adder has had no dealings with the Impresario and his dubious band, saying that she heard they were personally invited to Gridania by the Elder Seedseer herself. Seek the truth from Hearer Damaris at Nophica's Altar.
TEXT_FESHLW004_01166_SEQ_06: Damaris insists that the Seedseers know nothing of the Impresario and his troupe, saying that she heard that they were invited by the Adventurers' Guild. Make for the Carline Canopy and see what Mother Miounne might know of the matter.
TEXT_FESHLW004_01166_SEQ_07: Hearing your words, Mother Miounne concludes that the Impresario is not who he claims to be. Use the sparkler she has given you to spook the dubious troupemaster into showing his true colors.
TEXT_FESHLW004_01166_SEQ_08: Spooked clean out of his costume, the Impresario is revealed to be an actual imp. As he tells it, he and his monstrous minions cooked up their scheme in hopes for a return to the old days, when All Saints' Wake afforded an opportunity for his kind to frolic and purvey mischief in town. Assuring you that he means no harm, you agree to keep his secret. All told, this has proven to be an eventful All Saints' Wake─though the true identity of the disembodied voice that guided you to the truth remains cloaked in shadows...

TEXT_FESHLW011_01167_SEQ_01:
Harvest season has come to Eorzea, and with it the annual observance of All Saints' Wake. This year, a traveling circus troupe has been summoned to Limsa Lominsa with the aim of reviving the revelrous traditions that have fallen out of favor since the Calamity. The shifty thespian invites you to speak with the Impresario─the leader of the troupe─to obtain a costume, that you too might join in the celebration.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESHLW011_01167_SEQ_02: After recounting the origins of All Saints' Wake, the Impresario gifts you with a traditional disguise, that you might take your place among the costumed troupers and help to bring about a hauntingly delightful night.
TEXT_FESHLW012_01168_SEQ_00:
The Impresario would invite you to participate in a devilishly delightful All Saints' Wake celebration.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESHLW012_01168_SEQ_01:
In order to fully enjoy the All Saints' Wake festivities, the Impresario has gifted you with a costume befitting the occasion. Don the guise to take your place among the terrors of the night, then speak with him anew.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESHLW012_01168_SEQ_02: Now that you look the part, the Impresario encourages you to travel to each of the three city-states and put a scare in the performers found within, for which you will be rewarded with toothsome treats. For your first objective, seek out the mucose mummer who haunts Limsa Lominsa.
TEXT_FESHLW012_01168_SEQ_03: Genuinely frightened by your casual threat to practice your culinary skills on him, the mucose mummer offers you a piece of fire candy in hopes of sating your appetite. Continue on your way to Ul'dah, and seek out a skittish acrobat, who shall serve as the next target of your spooking skills.
TEXT_FESHLW012_01168_SEQ_04: Thoroughly spooked by your actions, the zombie-like acrobat dropped the cookies that he was using to patch up the gaping holes in his body. Retrieve the moldy, maggot-infested confections from the ground.
TEXT_FESHLW012_01168_SEQ_05: You have recovered the cookies. Be a kind soul and return them to their owner.
TEXT_FESHLW012_01168_SEQ_06: In return for your kindness, the acrobat rewards you with a piece of earth candy. Proceed to Gridania and seek out a spirited thespian and his silent sidekick.
TEXT_FESHLW012_01168_SEQ_07: The performer informs you that while he is clean out of candy, his partner─a strongman most convincingly disguised as an ogre─still has a full supply, and happens to be more skittish than he appears. Try spooking him with a /clap of your hands.
TEXT_FESHLW012_01168_SEQ_08: The ogre of a strongman appears unimpressed by your efforts. Take his partner at his word and pretend to /congratulate the hulking brute to see if a rousing round of applause might do the trick.
TEXT_FESHLW012_01168_SEQ_09: Sufficiently spooked, the strongman rewards you with a piece of wind candy. Having completed your set of candy, return to Limsa Lominsa and feed the fire candy to the magic pot.
TEXT_FESHLW012_01168_SEQ_10: The magic pot appears pleased. Feed it a piece of earth candy.
TEXT_FESHLW012_01168_SEQ_11: The magic pot is delighted. Feed it a piece of wind candy to complete the set.
TEXT_FESHLW012_01168_SEQ_12: The magic pot is overjoyed, and returns your kindness with a batch of pumpkin cookies. What further treats and terrors await you before the festivities are through? Seek out the Impresario after sundown to delve deeper into the shadows of the night.
TEXT_FESHLW013_01169_SEQ_00:
As the festivities of All Saints' Wake continue, the Impresario has another task for you.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESHLW013_01169_SEQ_01:
Duly impressed with your efforts on his troupe's behalf, the Impresario would seek your aid with another All Saints' Wake tradition─the lighting of the traditional warding lanterns. Donning your costume, first speak to the shifty thespian and obtain a bomb digit for the task.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESHLW013_01169_SEQ_02: The performer entrusts you with some still-smoldering bomb digits that should serve as makeshift torches. Remaining in costume, scour the town for any warding lanterns that have gone dim and restore them to light.
TEXT_FESHLW013_01169_SEQ_03: You have succeeded in rekindling the flames of the warding lanterns. Inform the Impresario that the deed is done.
TEXT_FESHLW013_01169_SEQ_04: The Impresario congratulates you on your efforts, and invites you to remain in town to enjoy the remaining festivities. The tone of his words suggests that the culminating act is yet to come...
TEXT_FESHLW014_01170_SEQ_00:
The Impresario has yet another task for you. He just isn't quite sure what it is yet.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESHLW014_01170_SEQ_01:
The Impresario, pleased with your honest efforts on his troupe's behalf, has entrusted you with the most vital task of placing one final warding lantern in a dimly lit area of town. Speak once more to the shifty thespian to obtain the necessary supplies.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESHLW014_01170_SEQ_02: You have obtained the final warding lantern and the means by which to light it. Proceed to place it as directed.
TEXT_FESHLW014_01170_SEQ_03: The lantern having been successfully placed, proceed to light it with the bomb digit.
TEXT_FESHLW014_01170_SEQ_04: Upon lighting the final warding lantern, a curious voice speaks to you, raising doubts as to the true identity of the Impresario and his men, and encouraging you to seek the truth from the troupe's purported patrons. Begin your investigation by speaking to Storm Captain O'adenek at Maelstrom Command.
TEXT_FESHLW014_01170_SEQ_05: O'adenek insists that the Maelstrom has had no dealings with the Impresario and his dubious band, saying that she hears they were personally summoned by the Yellowjackets. Seek the truth from Sundyrund at the Coral Tower.
TEXT_FESHLW014_01170_SEQ_06: Sundyrund is adamant that the Yellowjackets know nothing of the Impresario and his troupe, saying that he heard that they were invited by the Adventurers' Guild. Make for the Drowning Wench and see what Baderon might know of the matter.
TEXT_FESHLW014_01170_SEQ_07: Hearing your words, Baderon concludes that the Impresario is not who he claims to be. Use the sparkler he has given you to spook the dubious troupemaster into showing his true colors.
TEXT_FESHLW014_01170_SEQ_08: Spooked clean out of his costume, the Impresario is revealed to be an actual imp. As he tells it, he and his monstrous minions cooked up their scheme in hopes for a return to the old days, when All Saints' Wake afforded an opportunity for his kind to frolic and purvey mischief in town. Assuring you that he means no harm, you agree to keep his secret. All told, this has proven to be an eventful All Saints' Wake─though the true identity of the disembodied voice that guided you to the truth remains cloaked in shadows...
