TEXT_GAIUSE102_01176_SEQ_00: Once again, Minfilia appears to be lost in thought.
TEXT_GAIUSE102_01176_SEQ_01:
This quest has been adjusted. Please abandon the quest and restart it by speaking to Minfilia at the Waking Sands.

※The Main Scenario Guide shows the next available quest. You can toggle it on and off in Character Configuration, under UI Settings.
TEXT_GAIUSE102_01176_SEQ_02: According to Alphinaud, the Antecedent's blind refusal to contemplate leaving Ul'dah stems from the empty hope that her late mother F'lhaminn still lives. For whatever reason, rumors have recently begun to circulate that the famed songstress did not perish in the fires of the Calamity. Convinced that Minfilia will not see sense until these rumors have been proven false, Alphinaud has resolved to determine their origin, and asks that you assist him. Speak with Father Iliud at the Church of Saint Adama Landama to learn the source of one such rumor.
TEXT_GAIUSE102_01176_SEQ_03: Father Iliud makes no claim to have seen F'lhaminn himself, only to have met someone who claims to have done so... Fortunately, the fellow in question is close at hand. Seek him out in the lichyard and hear his testimony.
TEXT_GAIUSE102_01176_SEQ_04: The visitor seems supremely confident that the woman he spied in Costa del Sol was indeed F'lhaminn, despite having only seen the famous performer once before─a full seven years ago. It may be prudent to ask Father Iliud whether he believes this man's tale should be taken seriously.
TEXT_GAIUSE102_01176_SEQ_05: Without proof, it is impossible to determine whom the visiting mourner did or did not see. Nevertheless, you now know the location of an alleged sighting, and Father Iliud believes it merits further investigation.
TEXT_GAIUSE103_01177_SEQ_00: Father Iliud wishes to say a few words before you depart for Costa del Sol.
TEXT_GAIUSE103_01177_SEQ_01:
This quest has been adjusted. Please abandon the quest and restart it by speaking to Minfilia at the Waking Sands.

※The Main Scenario Guide shows the next available quest. You can toggle it on and off in Character Configuration, under UI Settings.
TEXT_GAIUSE103_01177_SEQ_02: A heartbroken Gegeruju is further dismayed to learn that the object of his affections, who only recently left, was none other than the famed Songstress of Ul'dah. Though he recalls her expressing a desire to visit Wineport, he assures you that F'lhaminn will soon tire of her rough style of living and return to his waiting arms. Providing you do not share his optimism, journey to Wineport and question the local residents.
TEXT_GAIUSE103_01177_SEQ_03: Your cursory investigation yields a promising lead, provided by the incorrigible Wine Baron of Limsa Lominsa. Apparently, a woman matching F'lhaminn's description visited Byrglaent's winery very recently, but, finding her perfume to be intolerable, he expelled her from the premises. Though he has no inkling as to where she went next, the Wine Baron suggests that you solicit the aid of Shamani Lohmani, reasoning that his unique talents may enable him to track the perfumed lady.
TEXT_GAIUSE103_01177_SEQ_04: Shamani Lohmani vividly recalls the woman's scent, as well as the conversation he had with her. After observing that her perfume was reminiscent of a local species of flower, she asked him where she might find the most pristine specimens, and he duly told her. Assuming she followed his directions, she would then have proceeded south into Raincatcher Gully. With luck, she may still be there.
TEXT_GAIUSE103_01177_SEQ_05: You succeed in locating your quarry mere moments before a ravenous goobbue emerges from the forest, seemingly intent on devouring you both. Undeterred, you set about the beast, and it soon succumbs to your onslaught. All that remains is to verify the identity of the perfumed lady.
TEXT_GAIUSE103_01177_SEQ_06: Your attempts to ascertain the perfumed lady's identity succeed only in arousing her suspicion, but when Alphinaud subsequently enters the scene, she has no choice but to admit that she is indeed F'lhaminn. With much to discuss, the three of you agree to adjourn to Wineport, where you may continue your conversation in safety.
TEXT_GAIUSE103_01177_SEQ_07: Alphinaud informs you that, despite his best efforts, F'lhaminn will not be persuaded to accompany you to Vesper Bay until she has completed her perfume. Left with no better option, he asks that you hasten the process by assisting her in whatever way necessary.
TEXT_GAIUSE104_01178_SEQ_01:
This quest has been adjusted. Please abandon the quest and restart it by speaking to F'lhaminn in Wineport.

※The Main Scenario Guide shows the next available quest. You can toggle it on and off in Character Configuration, under UI Settings.
TEXT_GAIUSE104_01178_SEQ_02: Gazing upon the foul-smelling pugil carcasses is enough to deprive you of any lingering appetite. You can only hope that the gurangatch will regard them more favorably. Place the bait at the water's edge in gurangatch territory and find out if your quarry's tastes truly are so different from your own.
TEXT_GAIUSE104_01178_SEQ_03: The trap now set, you can but wait and hope. Retreat to a safe distance and bide your time.
TEXT_GAIUSE104_01178_SEQ_04: As if to confirm the fundamental differences between the palates of your respective species, the pugil carcasses prove irresistible to a truly gigantic gurangatch, which you duly slay. While you set about the nauseating task of scraping the creature's belly oil into a flask, you ponder what manner of individual first thought to use the secretions in a perfume... Push such irrelevant musings aside and deliver the fetid fruits of your labors to F'lhaminn in Wineport.
TEXT_GAIUSE104_01178_SEQ_05: F'lhaminn requires only a brief moment to finish her perfume. Her preparations complete, she agrees to accompany you and Alphinaud to Vesper Bay. Return to the Waking Sands and seek an audience with Minfilia.
TEXT_GAIUSE104_01178_SEQ_06: Upon seeing Alphinaud escort F'lhaminn into the solar, Minfilia rushes forward to embrace her long-lost mother, overjoyed to learn that reports of her death were indeed exaggerated. During their tearful reunion, Minfilia explains that her father was once a member of the Ala Mhigan Resistance, and that following his death in a tragic accident, F'lhaminn raised her as her own. After praising Minfilia for her victories over the Empire, F'lhaminn states that the Scions must leave Ul'dah behind if they are to continue their work. Agreeing at last to Alphinaud's proposal, a reinvigorated Minfilia declares that the order will quit Vesper Bay and establish a new headquarters in Revenant's Toll.
TEXT_GAIUSE105_01179_SEQ_00: Minfilia wishes to discuss plans for the forthcoming move to Mor Dhona.
TEXT_GAIUSE105_01179_SEQ_01:
This quest has been adjusted. Please abandon the quest and restart it by speaking to Minfilia at the Waking Sands.

※The Main Scenario Guide shows the next available quest. You can toggle it on and off in Character Configuration, under UI Settings.
TEXT_GAIUSE105_01179_SEQ_02: The cause of F'lhaminn's sudden sadness appears to be a damaged earring. Though she would like to have it repaired, she cannot bring herself to set foot in the Goldsmiths' Guild for reasons she refuses to explain. Take the earring to Ul'dah in her stead and seek the services of a guild goldsmith.
TEXT_GAIUSE105_01179_SEQ_03: At the Goldsmiths' Guild, you meet a Lalafell by the name of Memedesu, who immediately recognizes the earring as F'lhaminn's Aria, a famous design created by the master goldsmith Niellefresne. Honored to be entrusted with the task of repairing the legendary piece, he refuses payment─asking only that you attend to a minor errand in his stead so that he may focus on his work. Travel to Byregot's Strike in southern Thanalan and collect a shipment of ores from Memedesu's supplier, Odinel.
TEXT_GAIUSE105_01179_SEQ_04: A surprised Odinel is more than happy to give you the ores, remarking that doing so will spare him the tedium of one of Memedesu's time-consuming inspections. Deliver the shipment to the Goldsmiths' Guild and see if the earrings are ready.
TEXT_GAIUSE105_01179_SEQ_05: Memedesu accepts the ores with a cursory glance, before assuring you that he took every precaution when handling F'lhaminn's Aria. Deliver the restored earrings to F'lhaminn at the Waking Sands.
TEXT_GAIUSE105_01179_SEQ_06: F'lhaminn grows somber at the sight of the earrings, and grimly recounts the tale of their creator's fate. Murdered with a magicked blade, his body refuses to decay, and to this day she still prays that his soul finds peace in Thal's realm. Regaining her composure, she insists that Minfilia has no need to worry about her, and that you should both concentrate on more important matters. Visit Minfilia in the solar and inform her of all that has transpired.
TEXT_GAIUSE105_01179_SEQ_07: With everyone assembled in the solar, Alphinaud proclaims that negotiations with the Adventurers' Guild have concluded, and that the Scions of the Seventh Dawn will soon have a new home: the Rising Stones. Minfilia follows this momentous announcement with the news that the Alliance leaders have pledged to support the Scions' plans, before finally declaring that the time is now right for the order to cast off the remaining vestiges of its former secrecy, that none may ever doubt its independence again. Though these plans entail significant risks, she is confident that the Scions will rise to the challenge, and together overcome.
TEXT_GAIUSE106_01180_SEQ_00: Minfilia has a mind to dispatch you to Revenant's Toll.
TEXT_GAIUSE106_01180_SEQ_01:
This quest has been adjusted. Please abandon the quest and restart it by speaking to Minfilia at the Waking Sands.

※The Main Scenario Guide shows the next available quest. You can toggle it on and off in Character Configuration, under UI Settings.
TEXT_GAIUSE106_01180_SEQ_02: Slafborn is pleased that you were the Scion chosen to represent the order in Revenant's Toll, and waggishly declares that he intends to impose the work of a dozen men upon you. Though he subsequently claims to be jesting, his wry expression leads you to suspect that your time in Mor Dhona will not be spent in idleness...
TEXT_GAIUSE107_01181_SEQ_00: A supply carriage to Revenant's Toll is late, and Guolgeim will know the reason why.
TEXT_GAIUSE107_01181_SEQ_01:
This quest has been adjusted. Please abandon the quest and restart it by speaking to Slafborn in Revenant's Toll.

※The Main Scenario Guide shows the next available quest. You can toggle it on and off in Character Configuration, under UI Settings.
TEXT_GAIUSE107_01181_SEQ_02: The Wood Wailer you speak with is somewhat distracted, having just received word of an Ixali attack on a carriage. The duty officer doubts that it is the selfsame carriage you seek, but you know there are no coincidences in the North Shroud. Another of Fallgourd Float's finest is on the scene, if you wish to inquire further.
TEXT_GAIUSE107_01181_SEQ_03: You arrive only to be informed that it was indeed a supply carriage that was attacked, and both the cargo and the coachmen were captured. Your suspicions are vindicated, but now a difficult rescue-and-recovery mission is indicated. To the logging grounds you must go, to free the captives and recover whatever provisions remain.
TEXT_GAIUSE107_01181_SEQ_04: You successfully liberate several crates of cargo, as well as the two coachmen. Only they can tell you whether Revenant's Toll will get its provisions. Return to the carriage and speak with the Elezen coachman.
TEXT_GAIUSE107_01181_SEQ_05: You discover that the carriage is in no condition to continue on to Revenant's Toll. Though Guolgeim will not be pleased to hear it, the result could have been much worse. Return with due optimism to Revenant's Toll and give your report to Guolgeim.
TEXT_GAIUSE107_01181_SEQ_06: Your optimism turns out to have been justified, for Guolgeim was not surprised in the slightest. As a denizen of Revenant's Toll, she is privy to all manner of rumors, including persistent whispers of the primals' inevitable return...
TEXT_GAIUSE108_01182_SEQ_00: When it comes to keeping its home fires burning, the Adventurers' Guild is no stranger to caution. What fuel does Slafborn intend for you to gather today?
TEXT_GAIUSE108_01182_SEQ_01:
This quest has been adjusted. Please abandon the quest and restart it by speaking to Slafborn in Revenant's Toll.

※The Main Scenario Guide shows the next available quest. You can toggle it on and off in Character Configuration, under UI Settings.
TEXT_GAIUSE108_01182_SEQ_02:
Bibimu welcomes you to the temple with a slightly funereal air. Plumb the ruin's depths and obtain a wardstone.

※The Sunken Temple of Qarn can be accessed via the Duty Finder.
TEXT_GAIUSE108_01182_SEQ_03: You have gained a wardstone, as well as a few more nightmares to carry to the end of your days. Deliver the precious find to Slafborn at Revenant's Toll and be done with it.
TEXT_GAIUSE108_01182_SEQ_04: Slafborn is happy to add the stone to the settlement's considerable defenses. If safety is an illusion, there is much magic in the Roegadyn...
TEXT_GAIUSE109_01183_SEQ_00: Sark Malark is a man of mystery. Where did he come from? How did he get here? And what does he want from you today?
TEXT_GAIUSE109_01183_SEQ_01:
This quest has been adjusted. Please abandon the quest and restart it by speaking to Slafborn in Revenant's Toll.

※The Main Scenario Guide shows the next available quest. You can toggle it on and off in Character Configuration, under UI Settings.
TEXT_GAIUSE109_01183_SEQ_02: The explosives had the last word in that encounter. Report to Sark Malark that the crates are no more.
TEXT_GAIUSE109_01183_SEQ_03: Sark Malark was appreciative, but not confiding. It seems he means to keep his old life a secret, even─or especially─from a fellow adventurer.
TEXT_GAIUSE110_01184_SEQ_00: Slafborn's brow is clouded with worry and the forecast calls for rain─unless you can save the day.
TEXT_GAIUSE110_01184_SEQ_01:
This quest has been adjusted. Please abandon the quest and restart it by speaking to Slafborn in Revenant's Toll.

※The Main Scenario Guide shows the next available quest. You can toggle it on and off in Character Configuration, under UI Settings.
TEXT_GAIUSE110_01184_SEQ_02: You and other intrepid adventurers return from the guildhest, tired but triumphant. Report the happy news to Slafborn.
TEXT_GAIUSE110_01184_SEQ_03: Slafborn is pleased with the excitement your actions have stirred among the adventurers of Revenant's Toll. With a greater sense of fellowship comes greater strength─a fact that Slafborn, always scanning the horizon for shadows of Garlemald, is all too mindful of.
TEXT_GAIUSE111_01185_SEQ_00: When a man like Slafborn thinks well of you, you are wont to find yourself performing a dangerous and unpleasant task in short order.
TEXT_GAIUSE111_01185_SEQ_01:
This quest has been adjusted. Please abandon the quest and restart it by speaking to Slafborn in Revenant's Toll.

※The Main Scenario Guide shows the next available quest. You can toggle it on and off in Character Configuration, under UI Settings.
TEXT_GAIUSE111_01185_SEQ_02: Though your sense of smell has deserted you for what you hope is only a short while, the guildhest is an unqualified success. Report the happy fact to Slafborn.
TEXT_GAIUSE111_01185_SEQ_03: Thanks to your fellow adventurers' fondness for ale and gossip, Toxic Tamlyn's demise has become the talk of Revenant's Toll. Slafborn declares the guild's morale to be unwaveringly high, before slyly reminding you that this too is a kind of sorcery.
TEXT_GAIUSE112_01186_SEQ_00: Slafborn seems intent on putting you to work yet again.
TEXT_GAIUSE112_01186_SEQ_01:
This quest has been adjusted. Please abandon the quest and restart it by speaking to Slafborn in Revenant's Toll.

※The Main Scenario Guide shows the next available quest. You can toggle it on and off in Character Configuration, under UI Settings.
TEXT_GAIUSE112_01186_SEQ_02: Upon returning to the Waking Sands, Alphinaud declares that preparations for the move to Mor Dhona have fallen behind. Demonstrating an almost Slafbornian eagerness to put you to work, he then bids you scour the headquarters for any packages labeled for shipment to Revenant's Toll. It would seem your report will have to wait.
TEXT_GAIUSE112_01186_SEQ_03: A cursory search yields four labeled packages. Though an average  might feasibly struggle to carry them all, the same cannot be said of you. Bluntly, you have faced greater challenges. Take the packages to Tataru who is waiting outside.
TEXT_GAIUSE112_01186_SEQ_04: No sooner have you washed your hands of one errand than Tataru begs your assistance with another. With luck, it will take no longer than the previous one...
TEXT_GAIUSE113_01187_SEQ_00: Tataru regards you with a grim countenance. Whatever could the matter be?
TEXT_GAIUSE113_01187_SEQ_01:
This quest has been adjusted. Please abandon the quest and restart it by speaking to Slafborn in Revenant's Toll.

※The Main Scenario Guide shows the next available quest. You can toggle it on and off in Character Configuration, under UI Settings.
TEXT_GAIUSE113_01187_SEQ_02: Medguistl states that her stores of highland tea leaves were depleted but a few bells prior to your arrival. She advises you to seek out Emanuel the wine seller, who plies his wares in the courtyard of Camp Dragonhead.
TEXT_GAIUSE113_01187_SEQ_03: Recognizing you from your previous escapades in Coerthas, Emanuel regretfully explains that his next shipment of highland tea leaves is unlikely to arrive for some time. This being the case, he proposes that you harvest the leaves yourself from the plants which grow along the riverbanks in Boulder Downs─adding that you may need to mind your surroundings whilst doing so.
TEXT_GAIUSE113_01187_SEQ_04: Braving all manner of unfriendly wildlife, you succeed in harvesting a sufficiency of highland tea leaves. Deliver your fragrant haul to Tataru, who is waiting outside the Waking Sands, and be done with this second errand.
TEXT_GAIUSE113_01187_SEQ_05: Tataru wastes no time preparing her tonic, and you listen with mounting disgust as she recites its ingredients in song. For a mercy, you are spared the full horror of the recipe when she abruptly remembers that a crisis has erupted in your absence.
TEXT_GAIUSE114_01188_SEQ_00: Though you would not have thought it possible, Tataru has somehow managed to adopt a countenance still more grim than before.
TEXT_GAIUSE114_01188_SEQ_01:
This quest has been adjusted. Please abandon the quest and restart it by speaking to Slafborn in Revenant's Toll.

※The Main Scenario Guide shows the next available quest. You can toggle it on and off in Character Configuration, under UI Settings.
TEXT_GAIUSE114_01188_SEQ_02: Evidence suggests that a primal─or an entity resembling one─has been summoned in Gridania, and the Scions are duty-bound to investigate. High Serpent Commander Heuloix of the Order of the Twin Adder has requested you by name, and Minfilia bids you answer his summons. Make for the Adders' Nest with all haste.
TEXT_GAIUSE114_01188_SEQ_03: You receive a warm welcome from the high serpent commander, who affirms his belief that you are the most qualified for the task at hand. Endeavor to live up to his high opinion and press him for further details.
TEXT_GAIUSE119_01193_SEQ_00: Minfilia has a final favor to ask of you.
TEXT_GAIUSE119_01193_SEQ_01:
This quest has been adjusted. Please abandon the quest and restart it by speaking to Minfilia at the Waking Sands.

※The Main Scenario Guide shows the next available quest. You can toggle it on and off in Character Configuration, under UI Settings.
TEXT_GAIUSE119_01193_SEQ_02: By curious coincidence, Minfilia contacts you via linkpearl immediately after you deliver the journal to Urianger. She has departed for Revenant's Toll, and bids you follow as soon as you are able. Travel to Mor Dhona, and speak with Tataru inside the Seventh Heaven to gain entrance to the Rising Stones.
TEXT_GAIUSE119_01193_SEQ_03: Tataru welcomes you as warmly as always, and assures you that the Scions' new headquarters will more than meet with your expectations. Take a moment to explore the Rising Stones, and speak with Minfilia when you are satisfied that you know your way around.
TEXT_GAIUSE119_01193_SEQ_04: Even as the Scions of the Seventh Dawn celebrate the inauguration of their new headquarters, Urianger arrives unannounced, bearing troubling news. The distant yet dependable Students of Baldesion are no longer responding to his messages. Fearing the worst, Minfilia bids Urianger do everything he can to determine the cause of their uncharacteristic silence. For the time being, however, the Scions have no choice but to continue their work without the aid of one of their closest allies.
TEXT_GAIUSD201_01199_SEQ_00: An oddly garbed man visiting Revenant's Toll has some information which might be of interest to an experienced adventurer.
TEXT_GAIUSD201_01199_SEQ_01: This quest has been adjusted. Please abandon the quest and restart it by speaking the outlandish man in Revenant's Toll.
TEXT_GAIUSD201_01199_SEQ_02: Upon arriving at your destination, you find the Sons of Saint Coinach making preparations for an expedition into the forbidding Crystal Tower─aided by your old friend Cid Garlond. Speak with Rammbroes when you are ready to assist in the Sons' mission to understand and preserve the potent technology of the fallen Allagan Empire.
TEXT_GAIUSD201_01199_SEQ_03: According to Rammbroes, the entrance to the Crystal Tower is guarded by potent elemental defenses which will need to be circumvented before any expedition into the structure can be attempted. Cid's research suggests that the wrath of the elements can theoretically be reflected by crystals of sufficient clarity. Unfortunately, such flawless specimens are most likely to be found in the midst of the various beast tribe strongholds, and will not be had without a fight. It falls to you to obtain a flawless earth crystal from U'Ghamaro Mines in outer La Noscea, and a flawless water crystal from the Sapsa Spawning Grounds in western La Noscea by participating in the FATEs “Stopping the Shakes” and “Making Waves,” respectively.
TEXT_GAIUSD201_01199_SEQ_04: You have wrested the flawless crystals from the clutches of the kobolds and the Sahagin. Deliver your prizes to Rammbroes where he awaits you at Saint Coinach's Find.
TEXT_GAIUSD201_01199_SEQ_05: After taking receipt of the two flawless crystals you acquired in La Noscea, Rammbroes asks that you seize the equivalent fire- and wind-aspected specimens held by the Amalj'aa and the Ixal. Obtain a flawless fire crystal from Zahar'ak in southern Thanalan, and a flawless wind crystal from Natalan in the Coerthas central highlands by participating in the FATEs “He's a Firestarter” and “The Storm Caller,” respectively.
TEXT_GAIUSD201_01199_SEQ_06: You succeed in infiltrating the strongholds of the Amalj'aa and the Ixal, and escape with the beastmen's flawless fire and wind crystals. Deliver them both to Rammbroes at Saint Coinach's Find.
TEXT_GAIUSD201_01199_SEQ_07: Thanks to your daring forays into the beastmen's strongholds, the Sons of Saint Coinach now possess flawless crystals of each of the four elements. If they are to be relied upon to reflect the wrath of the tower's sentinels, however, the crystals must be cut and polished to exacting specifications. According to Rammbroes, this process calls for certain extraordinary materials. Clearly, much work remains to be done.
TEXT_FESEVN001_01287_SEQ_00:
Khloe Bajhiri seeks an adventurer's aid to investigate a promising scoop.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESEVN001_01287_SEQ_01:
In recent days, Eorzea finds itself plagued with alarming atmospheric phenomena that have its denizens fearing another coming of the Calamity. As Khloe Bajhiri of Gridania's The Raven tells it, Commander Vorsaile Heuloix insists that it is simply a Garlean diversion, but the savvy reporter is convinced that forces far more sinister are afoot. To answer her earnest plea, seek out proof of the otherworldly nature of the disturbances, that you might secure a scoop worthy of The Raven's front page. Witnesses have sighted the supernatural storms in various locations: south of Fullflower Comb in the East Shroud, south of Camp Tranquil in the South Shroud, southeast of Horizon in western Thanalan, south of Forgotten Springs in southern Thanalan, northeast of the Foremast in middle La Noscea, and south of Costa del Sol in eastern La Noscea.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESEVN001_01287_SEQ_02: After a hard-fought battle, you have emerged with a curious doll that would seem to be conclusive evidence that the Garlean Empire is not behind the disturbances plaguing the Twelveswood. Deliver it to Commander Vorsaile Heuloix at the Adders' Nest to prove his theory in error, then prepare to report your findings to Khloe Bajhiri.
TEXT_FESEVN001_01287_SEQ_03: The otherworldly force behind the disturbances was revealed to be one Shantotto, a formidable sorceress hailing from a distant world. As the mighty mage herself explains it, an oversized golem of her creation went berserk, raining destruction upon the land with no rhyme or reason─though given that the construct's original purpose was to conquer Eorzea in its mistress's name, this could be seen as a fortunate turn of events. Shantotto has returned to her realm, but her rampaging minion remains behind, leaving you and your fellow adventurers to see that it wreaks no further havoc upon the realm.
TEXT_FESDXQ001_01288_SEQ_00:
Havak Alvak, an editorialist for the Mythril Eye in Ul'dah, has word of an opportunity for an intrepid adventurer.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESDXQ001_01288_SEQ_01:
The appearance of golems of unknown geological composition has spurred Amajina & Sons Mineral Concern into hiring a competent adventurer to assess the potential for profit. Meet with the company's representative outside Arrzaneth Ossuary to discuss the nature of your employment.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESDXQ001_01288_SEQ_02: According to the Amajina & Sons representative, the unusual golems can be found lumbering about in every corner of Eorzea. Obtain a chunk of one of the blocky constructs by participating in the FATE “Brick by Brick,” followed by the FATE “Brick by Stone Brick” or “Brick by Gold Brick” in one of the following locations: the Sil'dih Excavation Site in central Thanalan; the south of Blind Iron Mines in lower La Noscea; the east of Bronze Lake in upper La Noscea; Spirithold in the Central Shroud; or the south of Finders' Bluff in the North Shroud.
TEXT_FESDXQ001_01288_SEQ_03: You have obtained a sample of one of the mysterious golems. Return to Arrzaneth Ossuary and deliver it to the waiting Amajina & Sons representative.
TEXT_FESDXQ001_01288_SEQ_04: You have delivered a piece of one of the lumbering constructs to the Concern's representative. As promised, the ladies of Amajina & Sons treat you to a uniquely refreshing reward.
TEXT_FESNYR001_01292_SEQ_00:
The season of Heavensturn has come, and Damaris would tell you of a madcap visitor.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESNYR001_01292_SEQ_01:
Damaris informs you that Heavensturn celebrates the changing of the guard among the Twelve─as if any Eorzean of your age would not know such a thing! The conversation was not without profit, however. Enter Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre and receive a souvenir from a certain uma bugyo from the Far East.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESNYR001_01292_SEQ_02: You learn that the Easterlings choose a totemic animal for every Heavensturn, and this turn is presided over by something they call the “horse.” A land almost beyond imagining is the East, where mounts neigh, not kweh. The uma bugyo presents you with a horse helm and bids you show the good folk of Gridania, Limsa Lominsa, and Ul'dah the spirit of this animal. No opportunity for professional development is unwelcome to the intrepid adventurer. Embrace your inner horse, or die in the attempt.
TEXT_FESNYR002_01293_SEQ_00:
The golden uma yoriki seeks help sharing the joy of horses with a singularly unappreciative audience.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESNYR002_01293_SEQ_01:
The golden uma yoriki would like to advertise the beauty of horses. Wear the uma kabuto and seek out his confederate, the golden uma doshin, at Bentbranch Meadows.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESNYR002_01293_SEQ_02: The uma doshin would have you do your utmost to prove that horses are more beautiful than chocobos. With your equine head held high, proudly strut into the Moogle's Gift Mounts stables within Bentbranch Meadows and strike a /pose.
TEXT_FESNYR002_01293_SEQ_03: Your provocative pose has set the chocobos kweh-ing. Speak with the chocobokeep without losing hold of your inner horse.
TEXT_FESNYR002_01293_SEQ_04: You have successfully maneuvered the chocobokeep into praising the beauty of horses. See that your kabuto is at a rakish angle and report to the golden uma doshin.
TEXT_FESNYR002_01293_SEQ_05: You have told the doshin that the chocobos are upset. He bids you show the beauty of a horse's nature by donning the kabuto and rousing the nervous birds with a spirited /rally.
TEXT_FESNYR002_01293_SEQ_06: Your rallying has been met with much avian excitement. With the kabuto on, speak with the doshin.
TEXT_FESNYR002_01293_SEQ_07: Clearly moved by your horsey antics, the doshin has rewarded you with a carrot. Take this proof of success to the golden uma yoriki back in Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre in Gridania.
TEXT_FESNYR002_01293_SEQ_08: His mien much thawed, the yoriki presents you with the golden uma kabuto. Gridanians have had their first taste of the beauty of horses. After you have performed the same act for both Limsa Lominsa and Ul'dah, report your success to the uma bugyo.
TEXT_FESNYR003_01294_SEQ_00:
The black uma yoriki of Ul'dah is in need of a speedy solution to his conundrum.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESNYR003_01294_SEQ_01:
The black uma yoriki yearns to show the speed of a horse to the plodding folk of Ul'dah, and has asked you to don the uma kabuto and run to the Silver Bazaar. Under your own power, race to the first marker at the Eighty Sins of Sasamo in western Thanalan.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESNYR003_01294_SEQ_02: You have passed the first marker. The uma kabuto may lie heavy on your untried head, but be steadfast and run to the second marker in western Thanalan.
TEXT_FESNYR003_01294_SEQ_03: You have passed the second marker. Resist the temptation to come up for air from under the kabuto, and run to the third marker in western Thanalan.
TEXT_FESNYR003_01294_SEQ_04: You have passed the third marker and persuaded a passing adventurer of the speed of the horse. Know that you have grown into the kabuto, and run to the fourth marker in western Thanalan.
TEXT_FESNYR003_01294_SEQ_05: You have passed the fourth marker. Feel anew the graceful contours of the kabuto upon your head, and run to the fifth marker in western Thanalan.
TEXT_FESNYR003_01294_SEQ_06: You have passed the fifth marker. Raise your helmed head high and speak with the black uma doshin in the Silver Bazaar.
TEXT_FESNYR003_01294_SEQ_07: The black uma doshin has breathlessly praised your efforts and given you a carrot as a token of her approbation. Deliver the carrot to the black uma yoriki in Ul'dah.
TEXT_FESNYR003_01294_SEQ_08: The black uma yoriki gleefully exclaims over your achievement and has thrust a black uma kabuto into your tired hands. You seem to have covered yourself in glory, at least in Ul'dah. Seek the same in Limsa Lominsa and Gridania, then present yourself to the uma bugyo back in Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre.
TEXT_FESNYR004_01295_SEQ_00:
The red uma yoriki has a clear, present, and progressive need for a horsey advocate.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESNYR004_01295_SEQ_01:
The red uma yoriki would shout of the power of the horse from the rooftops. Don the uma kabuto and speak with the yoriki's vassal, the red uma doshin, at the Red Rooster Stead in lower La Noscea.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESNYR004_01295_SEQ_02: You have found the doshin unmanned, unhorsed, and unaccented. As the sole wearer of the kabuto, it now falls to you to collect the carrots in the farm.
TEXT_FESNYR004_01295_SEQ_03: You have collected the carrots. With your kabuto on, give them to the Stead botanist.
TEXT_FESNYR004_01295_SEQ_04: Impressed by your strength, the botanist has asked you to try using your equine-like muscles to bring him an enormous carrot that was left in the field. Let your mane fly in the wind as you hunt for it around the Stead.
TEXT_FESNYR004_01295_SEQ_05: You have found the enormous carrot. See it delivered to the botanist, who will readily recognize you with the kabuto on.
TEXT_FESNYR004_01295_SEQ_06: Pleased by your delivery of the giant carrot, the botanist has declared himself convinced of the horse's magnificent power. Give the happy news to the doshin, keeping the proud visage of the horse gracefully atop your head.
TEXT_FESNYR004_01295_SEQ_07: The doshin praises you through his own pain. Deliver the carrot, the token of your success, to the red uma yoriki in Limsa Lominsa.
TEXT_FESNYR004_01295_SEQ_08: The yoriki lauds your achievement and rewards you with a crimson uma kabuto. Tales of the horse's prowess should spread on the next market day. Would that it were so in Gridania and Ul'dah! Offer yourself wherever you are needed, then let the uma bugyo be the final arbiter of your success.
TEXT_FESNYR005_01296_SEQ_00:
Having sent you hotfooted on a mission, the uma bugyo is eager to know the results.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESNYR005_01296_SEQ_01:
The uma bugyo bids you advocate for an unknown mount, the horse, in Gridania, Limsa Lominsa, and Ul'dah, and bring back a kabuto from each as a token of your success. You may visit the cities in any order, but the three kabuto must be presented to the uma bugyo starting with Gridania. Obtain and don the golden uma kabuto, and present yourself to the uma bugyo.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESNYR005_01296_SEQ_02: You have donned the golden uma kabuto, thus proving your success in Gridania. Obtain and don the crimson uma kabuto in Limsa Lominsa, and present yourself to the uma bugyo.
TEXT_FESNYR005_01296_SEQ_03: You have donned the crimson uma kabuto, thus proving your success in Limsa Lominsa. Obtain and don the black uma kabuto in Ul'dah, and present yourself to the uma bugyo.
TEXT_FESNYR005_01296_SEQ_04: You have donned the black uma kabuto, thus proving your success in Ul'dah. Your advocacy complete in all three city-states, you must now quell opposition by speaking with ordinary Gridanians who are favorably disposed toward the horse. Grace your head with the stately uma kabuto once more, then set about gathering those words.
TEXT_FESNYR005_01296_SEQ_05: You have found three Gridanians who support the introduction of horses to their land. Stay in character as the horse, and speak with the head of the Fraternal Order of Chocowackers.
TEXT_FESNYR005_01296_SEQ_06: You have relayed the voice of the people, but the chief chocowacker is less than tractable. In fact, she declares she will send for a chocobo fine enough to put the uma bugyo in her place. Diplomatically report the developments to the uma bugyo.
TEXT_FESNYR005_01296_SEQ_07: Despite your calm retelling of the chief chocowacker's words, the uma bugyo is much offended, and has accepted the challenge set forth. Hide your dismay behind your kabuto and speak with the chocowacker at Treespeak Stables.
TEXT_FESNYR005_01296_SEQ_08: The encounter between the uma bugyo and the chief chocowacker quickly devolves into a war of words. However, a mysterious stranger arrives just in time to avert an escalation from insult to injury. Return to Gridania and speak with the uma bugyo.
TEXT_FESNYR005_01296_SEQ_09: The uma bugyo thanks you for all you have done, and reveals that she will work with the chocowackers to find a way for horses and chocobos to coexist. Someday, the horse may be a common sight in Eorzea─but the horse that you were will never be forgotten.
TEXT_FESVLT001_01297_SEQ_00:
Ser Larsonient would see you partake in the Valentione's Day festivities.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESVLT001_01297_SEQ_01:
Ser Larsonient, an Ishgardian knight of House Valentione, proudly states that he and his lady have traveled far and wide to bring the gift of love to lonely shores. He exhorts you to speak with Lady Lisette and lend your strength to their efforts.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESVLT001_01297_SEQ_02: Lisette de Valentione, a descendant of the legendary Countess Arabelle de Valentione, seeks to honor the memory of her ancestress by sharing the gift of love with the denizens of Eorzea, and seeks adventurers to assist in the task. Should the fair lady's promises of rewards most sweet win you over, you need only converse with her again.
TEXT_FESVLT002_01298_SEQ_00:
Lisette would send you across the realm to bring succor to those lost in love.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESVLT002_01298_SEQ_01:
Summoning the holy powers of her ancestors, Lady Lisette has divined the identity and location of a young maiden in need of aid to convey the depths of her love. Seek out the lass─Yellow Moon of the Weavers' Guild in Ul'dah─and see what ails her.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESVLT002_01298_SEQ_02: Yellow Moon would return the affection of her many admirers in the traditional Valentione's Day manner─with chocolate─yet her admirers are too many and her kitchen shelves too bare. Travel about town and procure the necessary ingredients from her acquaintances, taking care not to make any unnecessary promises.
TEXT_FESVLT002_01298_SEQ_03: You have procured some most curious ingredients from young men eager to please. Return to the Weavers' Guild and deliver them to Yellow Moon, who is sure to be pleased.
TEXT_FESVLT002_01298_SEQ_04: Yellow Moon is appreciative of your efforts, but her culinary magnum opus has just begun. Take to the streets once more to procure the additional ingredients she needs.
TEXT_FESVLT002_01298_SEQ_05: You have obtained yet more unusual ingredients from the lovesick young men. What manner of confection can be made from morbol bile, anyway? Such concerns notwithstanding, return to the Weavers' Guild and deliver the goods to the hardworking Yellow Moon.
TEXT_FESVLT002_01298_SEQ_06: Yellow Moon continues to slave away at her stove and─perhaps not surprisingly─would be terribly appreciative if you could acquire one last set of ingredients for her. It is fortunate the young miss has so many “friends” to help her...
TEXT_FESVLT002_01298_SEQ_07: You have procured the final batch of ingredients from young men who regard the golden-tressed lass as some sort of deity. Is this stuff even edible? Return to the Weavers' Guild and deliver them to Yellow Moon before you are arrested and tossed in gaol for possession of hazardous substances.
TEXT_FESVLT002_01298_SEQ_08: Yellow Moon rejoices─thanks to your selfless acts, she will be able to fashion a batch of chocolate sizable enough to feed all of her admirers, most importantly her one true love. In an entirely unrelated turn of events, numerous residents of Ul'dah─strangely, all male─have been stricken down by a vile poison. Take your reward, a present from Yellow Moon for your kindness, and make a discreet retreat before you can be implicated in the plot.
TEXT_FESVLT003_01299_SEQ_00:
Lisette would send you across the realm to bring succor to those lost in love.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESVLT003_01299_SEQ_01:
Summoning the holy powers of her ancestors, Lady Lisette has divined the identity and location of a young maiden who awaits the return of her lost love. Seek out the lass─Nemoh Maimhov of Gridania─and see how you might assist in soothing her aching heart.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESVLT003_01299_SEQ_02: Years have passed since the Calamity, yet Nemoh Maimhov patiently awaits the return of her betrothed, a soldier by the name of Gwayne. Recent talk of a visitor to Gridania matching Gwayne's description has filled the young maiden's heart with hope, yet she cannot work up the courage to investigate for herself. Make for Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre and see if there is any truth to the rumors.
TEXT_FESVLT003_01299_SEQ_03: Your search of the Amphitheatre turned up only Gwayne look-alikes, including a childhood friend of Nemoh's whose unrequited love drove him to a desperate act of deception. Your efforts, however, were not entirely unfruitful, as one of the Gwayne-esque individuals was able to provide you with information regarding the man's true whereabouts. Return and share the news with Nemoh Maimhov.
TEXT_FESVLT003_01299_SEQ_04: Though disappointed that Gwayne remains unfound, Nemoh Maimhov holds out hope that the man sighted at E-Tatt's Spire is indeed her lost love. Travel to the spire and seek out the man in question.
TEXT_FESVLT003_01299_SEQ_05: Good news followed by bad: you have successfully found Gwayne, but the man's memories─including those of his erstwhile betrothed─have been lost to a grievous battle wound, and he abruptly takes his leave. Return to Nemoh Maimhov and break the news as softly as you can.
TEXT_FESVLT003_01299_SEQ_06: Refusing to accept that her love has forgotten her, Nemoh unleashes her frustrations on her childhood friend Gylbart, then entrusts you with a box of chocolates to deliver to Gwayne, in hopes that his memory might yet be stirred. Gylbart, shaken but strong, would speak to you out of Nemoh's earshot, and asks that you meet him at E-Tatt's Spire.
TEXT_FESVLT003_01299_SEQ_07: Gylbart shares with you a sad revelation─the man named Gwayne was actually a notorious philanderer who swindled numerous women out of gifts and gil with empty promises of love and marriage. Out of kindness, he spared Nemoh the cruel truth, choosing to play the villain while he worked in secret to apprehend the true criminal. He entrusts Nemoh's chocolates to you, promising to remain by Nemoh's side as a friend, even if that is all he shall ever be.
TEXT_FESVLT004_01300_SEQ_00:
Lisette would send you across the realm to bring succor to those lost in love.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESVLT004_01300_SEQ_01:
Summoning the divine powers of her ancestors, Lady Lisette has ascertained that a pirate lass only a stone's throw from the festival square in Limsa Lominsa has an uneasy heart on this Valentione's Day. Speak with O'kalkaya and see what troubles her.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESVLT004_01300_SEQ_02: O'kalkaya of the Sanguine Sirens is concerned for Captain Rhoswen, who she suspects is preparing in secret for a fateful confrontation with the Kraken's Arms, the Sirens' longtime archrivals. Speak with Guildmaster Lyngsath at the Bismarck, which Rhoswen has been frequenting often in recent days.
TEXT_FESVLT004_01300_SEQ_03: Lyngsath is reluctant to share Rhoswen's secrets, offering only a cryptic comment that whatever the two are preparing, it is sure to cause sparks. Deliver this somewhat concerning news to O'kalkaya.
TEXT_FESVLT004_01300_SEQ_04: Your report strikes fear into O'kalkaya, who is now convinced that her captain is preparing firesand for a showdown with the Krakens. No sooner does she voice this concern, however, than she realizes that a Kraken deckhand has overheard the entire conversation. She bids you go in pursuit of the man.
TEXT_FESVLT004_01300_SEQ_05: The Kraken deckhand smugly informs you that he has already relayed what he overheard to his captain, who would speak with you about the matter. Seek out Carvallain at the Seventh Sage.
TEXT_FESVLT004_01300_SEQ_06: It would appear that O'kalkaya's concerns were not unfounded, as Carvallain reveals that Rhoswen has challenged him to a duel. Suspecting that the Siren has some underhanded scheme up her sleeve, he insists that you serve as witness to ensure a fair fight. Travel to the designated location ahead of Carvallain to put a preemptive stop to any foul play.
TEXT_FESVLT004_01300_SEQ_07: You are not entirely sure whether you just witnessed a duel or a botched confession of love, but whatever it was, it is mercifully over, with only a single piece of Rhoswen's chocolate remaining in the aftermath. Return the captain's confection to her crewman O'kalkaya.
TEXT_FESVLT004_01300_SEQ_08: O'kalkaya is taken aback upon realizing the true meaning behind the challenge. To defend her captain's honor, she insists that you speak not a word of what has transpired, offering a small gift to buy your silence. One can only hope that Rhoswen's wounds do not cut too deep.
TEXT_FESVLT005_01301_SEQ_00:
Lisette would hear a full report of your efforts as an emissary of love.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESVLT005_01301_SEQ_01:
Lisette commends your service on House Valentione's behalf, her ancestral senses telling her that your deeds have provided no small degree of solace to those lost in love. To reward you for your efforts, she deigns to offer you the opportunity to find love of your own. Trade with a  to obtain two types of chocolate─bitter and pure heart─and deliver the pair of confections to Lisette.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESVLT005_01301_SEQ_02: Lisette gladly accepts your chocolates, seemingly quite relieved that the Valentione's Day festivities may now draw gradually to a close. For all of her efforts on behalf of lovers the realm over, it would appear that the fiery Ishgardian has had considerably less fortune in her own romantic endeavors...
TEXT_FESPDY001_01302_SEQ_00:
The royal seneschal would see you enjoy the Little Ladies' Day festivities to the fullest.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESPDY001_01302_SEQ_01:
As the royal seneschal tells it, a doll contest will be the focal point of this year's Little Ladies' Day. He urges you to participate, suggesting that you speak with Serendipity, mistress of the Goldsmiths' Guild in Ul'dah, about acquiring a doll for the contest.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESPDY001_01302_SEQ_02: As might be expected given the season, the Goldsmiths' Guild already struggles to meet a deluge of doll orders, and cannot accept any further commissions. All hope is not lost, however, as Serendipity appears to have one last trick up her sleeve. Should your heart be set on proving yourself the daintiest doll-dresser in the land, speak with her once more.

TEXT_FESPDY004_01305_SEQ_00:
Serendipity would help you procure a doll for Little Ladies' Day.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESPDY004_01305_SEQ_01:
Eshtaime's Lapidaries is in need of a trustworthy adventurer who can promote its entry in the Little Ladies' Day doll contest. With the princess doll in tow, Serendipity would have you visit Gridania, offering the gossiping girls there budding blossoms in the spirit of the festival.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.

※The Princess Edvya doll minion will be lost upon dismissing it or logging out of the game. The doll can be retrieved by speaking with Serendipity.
TEXT_FESPDY004_01305_SEQ_02: Delighted by your beautiful blossoms and the Princess Edvya doll, the gossiping girls have chosen to vote for Eshtaime's Lapidaries' contest entry. Head back to Ul'dah and tell Serendipity of the good news.
TEXT_FESPDY004_01305_SEQ_03: Although the results are not yet final, Serendipity is pleased to tell you that your efforts have placed the doll from Eshtaime's Lapidaries very high in this year's rankings. Its jubilant demeanor is sure to impress even more little ladies as the contest continues.
TEXT_FESPDY005_01306_SEQ_00:
Serendipity has found another opportunity to garner attention for the princess doll.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESPDY005_01306_SEQ_01:
With your trip to Gridania a resounding success, Serendipity would now have you visit Limsa Lominsa, to dazzle the capricious maidens with peach confetti in the spirit of Little Ladies' Day.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.

※The Princess Edvya doll minion will be lost upon dismissing it or logging out of the game. The doll can be retrieved by speaking with Serendipity.
TEXT_FESPDY005_01306_SEQ_02: Impressed by your ardor for tradition and the elegance of your Princess Edvya doll, the capricious maidens have decided to vote for Eshtaime's Lapidaries' contest entry. Make haste to Ul'dah and share the good tidings with Serendipity.
TEXT_FESPDY005_01306_SEQ_03: Thanks to your efforts, Eshtaime's Lapidaries' entry has taken the lead in the contest rankings. It seems all but certain that their doll will win the contest and be sold for a handsome sum. Your path to victory is not yet clear, however, as the Princess Edvya doll begins to exhibit unusual behavior.
TEXT_FESPDY006_01307_SEQ_00:
Serendipity has learned of another opportunity to showcase the princess doll.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESPDY006_01307_SEQ_01:
Serendipity delightfully informs you that your tour of Eorzea has been a success─the doll she entrusted to you on behalf of Eshtaime's Lapidaries has surged to the top of the princess contest polls. In order to ensure victory, she suggests you put on a show in Ul'dah. With the princess doll in tow, set out to the streets and perform a /dance for crowds of potential voters.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.

※The Princess Edvya doll minion will be lost upon dismissing it or logging out of the game. The doll can be retrieved by speaking with Serendipity.
TEXT_FESPDY006_01307_SEQ_02: Your sure-footed display of festival spirit has Ul'dah's most influential aesthetes abuzz with talk of your princess doll. Head back to the Goldsmiths' Guild and relay the good tiding to Serendipity.
TEXT_FESPDY006_01307_SEQ_03: No sooner did Serendipity make mention of your now-commanding lead in the polls, nearly guaranteeing victory, than did your princess doll have a curious fit, ceasing to function before your eyes. Upon closer examination, Serendipity discovers that its core has burned out, and suspects that the princess doll had grown quite fond of you─so much so, that the thought of being sold at auction overwhelmed its systems. The doll may yet be saved, but due to its unique architecture, Serendipity requires peach tree oil before any repairs can be attempted. Gather petals from the peach trees in Ul'dah, that Serendipity may extract the oil needed to save the doll.
TEXT_FESPDY006_01307_SEQ_04: You have scoured the flora of Ul'dah for the freshest, most fragrant peach blossoms to be had, and gathered three sackfuls for Serendipity. Deliver them to the Goldsmiths' Guild, that Serendipity may begin making repairs to the doll.
TEXT_FESPDY006_01307_SEQ_05: Just when it seemed that all repair efforts were for naught, the doll's eyes lit up again upon hearing Serendipity offer it to you. It would seem the doll feigned a malfunction in order to realize its one true desire: to remain in the company of the adventurer of whom it had grown so fond. The guildmaster then muses that this behavior is not unlike Princess Edvya's own ruse so many years ago. Though the contest has long since been lost, Serendipity is comforted by the knowledge that you, she, and the doll have celebrated the true spirit of Little Ladies' Day in a way that few do these days. She implores you to take the doll as your own, and grant its holiday wish.
TEXT_GAIUSE201_01345_SEQ_00: Minfilia has a new assignment for you.
TEXT_GAIUSE201_01345_SEQ_01:
This quest has been adjusted. Please abandon the quest and restart it by speaking to Minfilia at the Rising Stones.

※The Main Scenario Guide shows the next available quest. You can toggle it on and off in Character Configuration, under UI Settings.
TEXT_GAIUSE201_01345_SEQ_02: You find Y'shtola preoccupied and unwilling to converse at length. Speak to Fufulupa, the Brass Blade leading the investigation, to learn more about the thefts.
TEXT_GAIUSE201_01345_SEQ_03: Fufulupa informs you that a heavily laden carriage recently broke through a checkpoint on the Royal Allagan Sunway. Convinced that it must belong to the thieves, he bids you share this news with Y'shtola forthwith.
TEXT_GAIUSE201_01345_SEQ_04: Though plainly unconvinced by Fufulupa's assertion that the incident at the checkpoint and the crystal thefts are connected, Y'shtola cannot wholly discount the possibility. Accordingly, she bids you rendezvous with Thancred in eastern Thanalan, where the carriage was said to be headed.
TEXT_GAIUSE201_01345_SEQ_05: Thancred reports that the carriage was filled with somnus, not crystals, and that the coachman appears to have no ties to the crystal thieves. Although the Brass Blades are more than satisfied with the seizure, Y'shtola will likely not be so pleased. Return to Horizon and see what other information Thancred has to offer.
TEXT_GAIUSE201_01345_SEQ_06: According to Thancred, there is nothing to suggest that the Amalj'aa have come into possession of significant quantities of crystals. As he communicates his findings to Urianger via linkpearl, you cannot help but wonder who is behind the crystal thefts, and what their designs might be.
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_SEQ_00: Raubahn would like to discuss how to handle the Doman refugees.
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_SEQ_01:
This quest has been adjusted. Please abandon the quest and restart it by speaking to Raubahn on the Royal Promenade.

※The Main Scenario Guide shows the next available quest. You can toggle it on and off in Character Configuration, under UI Settings.
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_SEQ_02: Concluding that the other city-states are unlike to accept the refugees, Alphinaud proffers an alternative solution. Rather than petitioning another nation for aid, the Domans might instead travel to the outpost of Revenant's Toll, where they could work as frontier hands in exchange for food and shelter. Though Yugiri is amenable to the idea, the matter of how the refugees would make a journey of so great a distance remains. Believing that the Ul'dahn Adventurers' Guild may be of assistance, Alphinaud departs for the Quicksand and invites you to follow.
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_SEQ_03: Momodi has agreed to provide temporary accommodations for the Domans, so that they might regain their strength before embarking on their journey. Alas, the lack of a ready means of transportation remains an insurmountable obstacle─until Teledji Adeledji generously offers to contract the services of the Seventy-Seven Caravans at personal expense. To ensure that all goes according to plan, Alphinaud bids you meet with Gigiyon, the Seventy-Seven Caravans representative in Scorpion Crossing.
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_SEQ_04: Gigiyon confesses that his ideal choice for the caravan's overseer is a man no longer in his employ. Believing that a venture of this import demands nothing less than the very best, he suggests that you speak with the Hyuran coachman at the Coffer & Coffin.
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_SEQ_05: The coachman is disinclined to aid you on account of myriad personal problems. Look him squarely in the eye, and, in time-honored fashion, utter the wordless promise: you can leave your problems to /me.
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_SEQ_06: Emerging momentarily from his trough of self-pity, the coachman directs you to Nophica's Wells, where the Brass Blades who seized his possessions are said to take their ill-gotten goods. Mindful that the upstanding gentlemen in question are not like to relinquish the confiscated items willingly, he advises you to proceed with caution.
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_SEQ_07: Unfamiliar with the face of Eorzea's savior, the Brass Blades attempt to rearrange your heroic features with predictable results. Having demonstrated your primal-shaming capacity for violence, inquire of the remaining Blade if he is now willing to cooperate.
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_SEQ_08: Happily, you find the Brass Blade far more receptive to your request at the second time of asking. Return the stolen goods to their rightful owner at the Coffer & Coffin.
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_SEQ_09: Finally able to settle his accounts, the coachman departs for Scorpion Crossing. Speak with Gigiyon to confirm that everything is in order.
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_SEQ_10: According to Gigiyon, all preparations are now complete, and his coachmen are awaiting further orders. Return to the Quicksand and speak with Alphinaud.
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_SEQ_11: Alphinaud is pleased to receive your report, and states that the next order of business is ensuring the safe passage of the Domans from Vesper Bay to Ul'dah. Judging by his tone, he means for you to play an active role in this endeavor as well...
TEXT_GAIUSE205_01349_SEQ_00: Alphinaud has a mind to send you to Vesper Bay.
TEXT_GAIUSE205_01349_SEQ_01:
This quest has been adjusted. Please abandon the quest and restart it by speaking to Alphinaud at the Quicksand.

※The Main Scenario Guide shows the next available quest. You can toggle it on and off in Character Configuration, under UI Settings.
TEXT_GAIUSE205_01349_SEQ_02: After speaking with Hozan in Vesper Bay, he observes that an experienced adventurer such as you should not be burdened with the kinds of menial tasks he would assign. Nevertheless, he and his people are in need, and he asks that you retrieve a heavy crate at the docks.
TEXT_GAIUSE205_01349_SEQ_03: The crate, while admittedly heavy, is a far cry from some of the more cumbersome objects you have carried over the course of your adventuring career. Return to Hozan and present to him the crate.
TEXT_GAIUSE205_01349_SEQ_04: Upon inspection, Hozan is horrified to discover that the scale armor within the crate was damaged during its long storage. Fortunately, it is not beyond repair─assuming that you can locate and retrieve the four missing scales which slipped through holes in the bottom of the crate. Retrace your steps and search for the scales.
TEXT_GAIUSE205_01349_SEQ_05: With relatively little difficulty, you recover the errant scales. Hozan will be relieved to receive them.
TEXT_GAIUSE205_01349_SEQ_06: Although Hozan is full glad for your help, he remains somewhat withdrawn. Gazing upon his father's armor, he wonders what will become of his people, who have naught but mementos and memories of their homeland...
TEXT_GAIUSE206_01350_SEQ_00: Hozan has another favor to ask of you.
TEXT_GAIUSE206_01350_SEQ_01:
This quest has been adjusted. Please abandon the quest and restart it by speaking to Alphinaud at the Quicksand.

※The Main Scenario Guide shows the next available quest. You can toggle it on and off in Character Configuration, under UI Settings.
TEXT_GAIUSE206_01350_SEQ_02: Hozan is proud of his son, and with good reason: Yozan has already instructed the other children to make their preparations. The only ones who have yet to be located are a trio who were engaged in a game of hide-and-seek. It would seem that the children are very serious when it comes to the game, and will not move from their hiding spots unless found, leaving you with no choice but to find them yourself.
TEXT_GAIUSE206_01350_SEQ_03: Despite their dedication to the game, the three remaining children were not particularly good at it. Inform Hozan that your work is finished.
TEXT_GAIUSE206_01350_SEQ_04: You learn that Yugiri is responsible for the children's regular practice of hide-and-seek, as she deemed it necessary to ensure their survival in the event of an imperial attack. Many would consider it a valuable skill, to be sure─albeit one Hozan hopes the children never need to use.
TEXT_GAIUSE207_01351_SEQ_00: Hozan requires your assistance with another personal matter.
TEXT_GAIUSE207_01351_SEQ_01:
This quest has been adjusted. Please abandon the quest and restart it by speaking to Hozan in Vesper Bay.

※The Main Scenario Guide shows the next available quest. You can toggle it on and off in Character Configuration, under UI Settings.
TEXT_GAIUSE207_01351_SEQ_02: Folclind has taken to eschewing carriages entirely, and thus cannot offer a foolproof solution. What she can offer is a vial of peach blossom perfume, and the dubious suggestion that you douse the chocobos with it.
TEXT_GAIUSE207_01351_SEQ_03: The nearby coachman is less than pleased with your experiment, but states that what is done is done. That being said, the efficacy of your approach is yet unknown. For the sake of Hozan's father, you must press your face against the chocobo and breathe deep of its musk.
TEXT_GAIUSE207_01351_SEQ_04: As the pungent odor fills your sinuses─and the coachman's laughter fills your ears─you realize at once that you have made a huge mistake. After taking pleasure at your expense, the coachman advises you to try a different method─one utilized by goblins, it would seem. Press him for further information.
TEXT_GAIUSE207_01351_SEQ_05: The coachman explains that goblins pack their masks with herbs and other fragrant compounds in order to filter the surrounding air. He then proposes a similar method utilizing a scarf and your perfume, which upon cursory inspection seems more than satisfactory. Deliver the perfumed scarf to Hozan.
TEXT_GAIUSE207_01351_SEQ_06: Hozan is delighted with your solution and leaves at once to present the scarf to his father. Follow Hozan to the docks so that you may see if the scarf meets with his father's approval.
TEXT_GAIUSE207_01351_SEQ_07: As his father breathes deep of the peach-scented scarf and recalls cherished memories, Hozan speaks fondly of the great orchards of Doma. However, he soon falls silent, and states that it is time to move on.
TEXT_GAIUSE209_01353_SEQ_00: Alphinaud would have you and Yugiri depart for Revenant's Toll without delay.
TEXT_GAIUSE209_01353_SEQ_01:
This quest has been adjusted. Please abandon the quest and restart it by speaking to Alphinaud at the Quicksand.

※The Main Scenario Guide shows the next available quest. You can toggle it on and off in Character Configuration, under UI Settings.
TEXT_GAIUSE209_01353_SEQ_02: Slafborn warmly welcomes Yugiri to Revenant's Toll, insisting that they dispense with unnecessary formality and treat each other as equals. Having paid your respects to the guild representative, ask Yugiri if she is ready to meet with Minfilia.
TEXT_GAIUSE209_01353_SEQ_03: Deep in thought, Yugiri requests a moment's privacy, assuring you that she will join you anon. Enter the Rising Stones and look for Minfilia in the solar.
TEXT_GAIUSE209_01353_SEQ_04: You find Minfilia attempting to contact the Students of Baldesion via linkpearl─more, you suspect, out of habit than hope. After briefly speculating upon their fate, she changes the subject and asks about the Domans─to which you reply that Yugiri will arrive at any moment. In the subsequent meeting, Minfilia assures Yugiri that she will do her utmost to accommodate her people, as well as any others who may follow. With formal introductions now complete, all present part ways to make ready for the imminent arrival of the first carriages.
TEXT_GAIUSE210_01354_SEQ_00: The plight of the refugees weighs heavily on Minfilia's mind.
TEXT_GAIUSE210_01354_SEQ_01:
This quest has been adjusted. Please abandon the quest and restart it by speaking to Alphinaud at the Quicksand.

※The Main Scenario Guide shows the next available quest. You can toggle it on and off in Character Configuration, under UI Settings.
TEXT_GAIUSE210_01354_SEQ_02: F'lhaminn informs you that the Seventh Heaven is responsible for preparing the meals, and that all should be proceeding according to plan. However, it would seem she too is a proponent of excess caution. You are to speak with Alys to confirm the state of the meals─but not before collecting several bottles of wine which are to be delivered as well.
TEXT_GAIUSE210_01354_SEQ_03: Wine bottles in hand, you are now ready to speak with Alys. Venture outside and inquire as to the status of the meals.
TEXT_GAIUSE210_01354_SEQ_04: Alys willfully misinterprets your concern as an offer to deliver the meals in her stead, placing them on the counter and waiting expectantly for you to pick them up. Refusing at this point would accomplish little; collect the meals as bade.
TEXT_GAIUSE210_01354_SEQ_05: In a remarkable display of dexterity, you secure the plates of food without the use of trays, bags, cases, or anything of the sort. Deliver the meals and wine to the Adventurers' Guild assistant outside the northern gates.
TEXT_GAIUSE210_01354_SEQ_06: The assistant is bemused to see that it is none other than the legendary Warrior of Light who brought her the Domans' food. Regardless of the circumstances which led to your arrival, she is nonetheless grateful for your presence, as there is a situation which would benefit from your personal attention.
TEXT_GAIUSE211_01355_SEQ_00: The Adventurers' Guild assistant is concerned about an outbreak of local fauna.
TEXT_GAIUSE211_01355_SEQ_01:
This quest has been adjusted. Please abandon the quest and restart it by speaking to Alphinaud at the Quicksand.

※The Main Scenario Guide shows the next available quest. You can toggle it on and off in Character Configuration, under UI Settings.
TEXT_GAIUSE211_01355_SEQ_02: You have vanquished all the rampant cobras. Return to Revenant's Toll and report your success to the Adventurers' Guild assistant.
TEXT_GAIUSE211_01355_SEQ_03: Having thanked you for your services, the attentive assistant informs you that something is brewing at the Rising Stones. Hasten there and speak with Minfilia to learn what is afoot.
TEXT_GAIUSE211_01355_SEQ_04: Y'shtola returns from her investigation in Vylbrand, having confirmed beyond a shadow of a doubt that the Serpent Reavers were behind the crystal thefts. All evidence suggests that the Sahagin are preparing to summon Leviathan once more, and Admiral Merlwyb has petitioned the Scions' aid in preventing the primal's return. Desiring to learn the true nature of the Echo, Minfilia declares her intent to join you on this mission.
TEXT_GAIUSE213_01357_SEQ_00: Falkbryda would have you assist in diversionary maneuvers.
TEXT_GAIUSE213_01357_SEQ_01:
This quest has been adjusted. Please abandon the quest and restart it by speaking to Falkbryda at Camp Skull Valley.

※The Main Scenario Guide shows the next available quest. You can toggle it on and off in Character Configuration, under UI Settings.
TEXT_GAIUSE213_01357_SEQ_02: You offer your services to U'jughal, who is at first reluctant to have an irreplaceable hero risk self for a trifling matter. However, she relents under your insistence, and bids you go to Halfstone and destroy Sahagin pavises with the explosives provided. If detected, you are at liberty to engage the enemy.
TEXT_GAIUSE213_01357_SEQ_03: You have successfully blown up the Sahagin pavises and vanquished the sentries that were drawn to the commotion. Return to Camp Skull Valley and report your success to Falkbryda.
TEXT_GAIUSE213_01357_SEQ_04: Falkbryda thanks you for your part in ensuring the scouts' safety. All that remains now is to await their safe return.
TEXT_FESEST001_01414_SEQ_00:
Jihli Aliapoh would have you experience the miracle of Hatching-tide.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESEST001_01414_SEQ_01:
Jihli Aliapoh teaches you the origins of Hatching-tide, a fledgling festival born from a vision she claims was bestowed upon her by the Twelve Archons of the Sixth Umbral Era. Eager to have you partake in the celebration, Jihli bids you speak with one of her Dreamers to acquire a pristine egg cap. Retrieve a cap from one of the Dreamers, then speak with her again when you've made yourself presentable.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESEST001_01414_SEQ_02:
There is still time before Hatching Hour, the final ceremony heralding the Twelve Archons' return to Eorzea. To that end, Jihli Aliapoh encourages you to try your hand at egg hunting, a popular Hatching-tide festival activity. She informs you of the different kinds of eggs which can be opened to reveal a gift, or exchanged for eggs of higher quality with richer rewards.

As you prepare to set out on an egg-hunting adventure, however, she asks that you pay her a visit when you've had your fill of festival games. Though preparations appear to be going as planned, perhaps this year's Hatching-tide is beset with more troubles than she would have you believe.
TEXT_FESEST002_01415_SEQ_00:
Oscarlet would have you experience the miracle of Hatching-tide.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESEST002_01415_SEQ_01:
Oscarlet teaches you the origins of Hatching-tide, a fledgling festival founded by Jihli Aliapoh, who claims to have been blessed with a vision from the Twelve Archons of the Sixth Umbral Era. Eager to have you partake in the revelry, Oscarlet bids you speak with the celebration's founder, but not before acquiring a pristine egg cap from one of his fellow Dreamers. After donning your festival cap, proceed to Gridania and seek out Jihli Aliapoh, that you may learn more about Hatching-tide.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
