Orselfaux would have you experience the miracle of Hatching-tide.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESEST003_01416_SEQ_01:
Orselfaux teaches you the origins of Hatching-tide, a fledgling festival founded by Jihli Aliapoh, who claims to have been blessed with a vision from the Twelve Archons of the Sixth Umbral Era. Eager to have you partake in the revelry, Orselfaux bids you speak with the celebration's founder, but not before acquiring a pristine egg cap from one of his fellow Dreamers. After donning your festival cap, proceed to Gridania and seek out Jihli Aliapoh, that you may learn more about the Hatching-tide celebration.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESEST003_01416_SEQ_02:
There is still time before Hatching Hour, the final ceremony heralding the Twelve Archons' return to Eorzea. To that end, Jihli Aliapoh encourages you to try your hand at egg hunting, a popular Hatching-tide festival activity. She informs you of the different kinds of eggs which can be opened to reveal a gift, or exchanged for eggs of higher quality with richer rewards.

As you prepare to set out on an egg-hunting adventure, however, she asks that you pay her a visit when you've had your fill of festival games. Though preparations appear to be going as planned, perhaps this year's Hatching-tide is beset with more troubles than she would have you believe.
TEXT_FESEST004_01417_SEQ_00:
Jihli Aliapoh seeks an adventurer's aid in preparing for Hatching Hour.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESEST004_01417_SEQ_01:
Jihli Aliapoh tells you of her vision which inspired the designs for this year's Hatching-tide eggs. However, because the celebration requires eggs, both great and small, in seemingly unreasonable quantities, the frequent delivery of these goods has caught the eye of local spriggans. Ever wont to procure all things small and round, they now work to make all the eggs their own, stealing the Archon eggs in the process.

Maisenta of Black Rabbit Traders dispatched men to retrieve two of the eggs, which have since been delivered to the Yellow Serpent Gate. With spriggans now forcing their way into Gridania, however, she can spare no one to bring them further into town. Jihli implores you to retrieve the eggs, that they may serve as vessels for the Twelve Archons.

Before you set off to retrieve them, however, she offers you a warning: the Archon eggs may only be touched by one who bears their mark. In order to transport both eggs to a safe location in a timely manner, join forces with another adventurer. One of you must wear a pristine egg cap, the other a vibrant egg cap. When you have found a comrade-in-arms, and are both wearing an appropriate cap, speak with Augustiniel at the Yellow Serpent Gate.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESEST004_01417_SEQ_02: You have arrived at the Yellow Serpent Gate, relieved to find Augustiniel and the Archon eggs safe and sound. Although ill equipped to deliver the eggs to Jihli Aliapoh himself, Augustiniel is confident that you and your friend can outwit the spriggans that have managed to find their way into town. Together with your comrade, don your respective caps to transport the pristine Archon egg and vibrant Archon egg to Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre.
TEXT_FESEST004_01417_SEQ_03: You have picked up one of the Archon eggs. See that it is carried safely to Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre, avoiding any spriggans that may cross your path.
TEXT_FESEST004_01417_SEQ_04: Averting the fuzzy grasp of the spriggans, you have safely transported your Archon egg to its rightful place at Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre. Trust your faithful companion to have done the same, and speak with Jihli Aliapoh to inform her of the good news.
TEXT_FESEST004_01417_SEQ_05: Jihli Aliapoh is beside herself with joy to hear that two of the Archon eggs have been returned. Thanks to your selfless actions, this year's Hatching-tide may still yet prove to be a success. Until all of the eggs have been retrieved, however, it might be best to stay close to Jihli in case your talents are needed once more.
TEXT_FESEST005_01418_SEQ_00:
Jihli Aliapoh has discovered the location of two more Archon eggs, and would once again ask for your aid.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESEST005_01418_SEQ_01:
Jihli Aliapoh has been granted another vision, revealing the location of two more Archon eggs along the beaches of Costa del Sol. She has sent her Dreamers to retrieve the eggs, and asks that you seek out Oscarlet in Limsa Lominsa, and ensure they have been retrieved without incident.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESEST005_01418_SEQ_02:
You have arrived in Limsa Lominsa to discover the two eggs have been transported unharmed, but their carriers were attacked by a gang of spriggans in the process. What's more, they have forced their way through the city gates and now scour the decks in search of the Archon eggs. Oscarlet informs you that Augustiniel was one of the two tasked with egg delivery, and has since made his way to the Coral Tower, perhaps in the hope of eluding the rogue spriggans now roaming the decks of Limsa Lominsa. Injured and with only one way in or out of the Coral Tower, however, there will be no escape should a second confrontation with the spriggans take place.

The eggs must be moved as quickly as possible, but both eggs cannot be carried alone. To see the eggs safely back to the Aftcastle, you must seek the aid of another adventurer. One of you must wear a pristine egg cap, and the other a brilliant egg cap. Join forces with a fellow adventurer and make your way to the Coral Tower, where you will prepare to relocate the Archon eggs.
TEXT_FESEST005_01418_SEQ_03: Upon reaching the Coral Tower, you find Augustiniel still weary from his encounter with the spriggans. Although he assures you the eggs are safe at present, the air of disconcertion about him would suggest otherwise. If they are to be delivered without incident, both you and your partner must carry an egg to the Aftcastle. Wearing the cap you have chosen, pick up your matching Archon egg and prepare for some fancy footwork.
TEXT_FESEST005_01418_SEQ_04: You have picked up one of the Archon eggs. See that it is carried safely to the Aftcastle, avoiding any spriggans that may cross your path.
TEXT_FESEST005_01418_SEQ_05: With a watchful eye, you and your comrade have navigated your way to the Aftcastle, delivering the Archon eggs to a safe location. Report to Oscarlet and confirm if there is aught else that needs be done.
TEXT_FESEST005_01418_SEQ_06: With a sigh of relief, Oscarlet thanks you for your deft delivery of the eggs. The matter of invading spriggans remains, but he takes satisfaction in knowing the eggs will be nurtured by the warmth of resident Dreamers until the time of Hatching Hour. Return to Gridania and inform Jihli Aliapoh of your success.
TEXT_FESEST005_01418_SEQ_07: Jihli Aliapoh is all too delighted to hear the Archon eggs in Limsa Lominsa have been secured once more. She informs you that there are but a few eggs left to be recovered, and the tone of excitement in her voice is unmistakable. With time still remaining until the egg ceremony, Jihli bids you take a much-needed rest.
TEXT_FESEST006_01419_SEQ_00:
Jihli Aliapoh has gleaned the location of yet another set of eggs, and would ask for your aid in retrieving them.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESEST006_01419_SEQ_01:
Jihli Aliapoh has been granted a vision of what she claims to be the last set of stolen Archon eggs in southern Thanalan. With Dreamers dispatched to retrieve them, she wishes to ensure their security, and would have you speak with Orselfaux in Ul'dah to confirm they have arrived without incident. Travel to Ul'dah and speak with Orselfaux to discern the status of the Archon eggs.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESEST006_01419_SEQ_02: You learn from Orselfaux that Augustiniel has once again volunteered to help in the delivery of the eggs in spite of his recent exertions. With a group of spriggans now roaming the halls of Ul'dah, Orselfaux is concerned that Augustiniel is not fit to watch the eggs, and would ask that you seek him out to ensure they are secure. Orselfaux suspects the eggs may need to be moved to a safer location, and suggests you seek the aid of another adventurer to assist you in Augustiniel's stead. Team up with a like-minded adventurer and search for Augustiniel and the eggs on the Steps of Thal.
TEXT_FESEST006_01419_SEQ_03: You find Augustiniel in the Steps of Thal, too weak to go on and in desperate need of assistance. Having collapsed after reaching the Gate of Thal, his partner ran off in search of assistance, leaving him to care for both eggs on his own. No longer fit to continue with the delivery, he implores you and your friend to carry them to the Gold Court where they may be protected until the spriggans are driven out of Ul'dah. One of you must carry the pristine Archon egg, and the other the midnight Archon egg. Wearing your respective caps, carry the eggs together with your companion to the Gold Court.
TEXT_FESEST006_01419_SEQ_04: See that your Archon egg is carried safely to the Gold Court, avoiding any spriggans that may cross your path.
TEXT_FESEST006_01419_SEQ_05: Carefully maneuvering through the corridors of the Steps of Thal, you deliver the Archon eggs to the Dreamers waiting in the Gold Court. Report to Orselfaux and tell him the eggs are now in safe hands.
TEXT_FESEST006_01419_SEQ_06: Orselfaux is glad to hear the Archon eggs have been safely delivered to the Gold Court, and thanks you for your efforts. With time still remaining until Hatching Hour, he returns to the affairs of the celebration, and bids you speak with Jihli Aliapoh to assure her that the eggs are safe.
TEXT_FESEST006_01419_SEQ_07: With all of the Archon eggs back in the possession of her Dreamers, Jihli Aliapoh is at a loss for words in expressing her gratitude for your efforts. Though you must now part ways until the long-awaited egg ceremony, she assures you it will be an unforgettable experience.
TEXT_FESEST007_01420_SEQ_00:
Jihli Aliapoh seems distressed about Hatching Hour.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESEST007_01420_SEQ_01:
You have arrived at Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre to find Jihli Aliapoh in tears, and the Archon eggs nowhere to be found. With all the eggs assembled together in Gridania, it would seem another gang of spriggans seized the opportunity to steal them all in one fell swoop. As luck would have it, however, Augustiniel and his fellow Dreamers crossed paths with these furry fiends, and managed to reclaim two of the pristine variety. Moreover, Maisenta of Black Rabbit Traders has convinced the Wood Wailers to seal off the city, so that not one spriggan can escape.

As the hour of the Archons approaches, there is much to do, and too few hands to both prepare for the ceremony and relieve the spriggans of their stolen goods. Four Archon eggs remain in the spriggans' custody, and Maisenta asks that you find three able adventurers to help you retrieve them. Once you have teamed up with three fellow adventurers, speak with Augustiniel to see if the Dreamers have discovered the stolen eggs' whereabouts.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESEST007_01420_SEQ_02: With three faithful companions in tow, you have arrived back at Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre, where Augustiniel has just received word of the Archon eggs' whereabouts. The Wood Wailers have confirmed that the remaining pristine egg is near the Botanists' Guild, the vibrant egg is outside the Conjurers' Guild, the brilliant egg is at Westshore Pier, and the midnight egg is next to the Leatherworkers' Guild. He asks that you decide amongst yourselves who will retrieve which egg, then bids that you see them delivered before Hatching Hour. Wearing your respective caps, carry one of the four Archon eggs together with your companions, and return it to Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre.
TEXT_FESEST007_01420_SEQ_03: You have picked up one of the Archon eggs. See that it is carried safely to Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre, avoiding any spriggans that may cross your path.
TEXT_FESEST007_01420_SEQ_04:
You and your comrades return the Archon eggs to Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre with nary a scratch. With the eggs finally assembled, and Hatching Hour nearly upon you, Jihli Aliapoh instructs her fellow Dreamers to prepare for their final rehearsal. Just as they begin to take their places, Augustiniel asks of you one last favor to help prepare for the ceremony. As one would surely guess, presentation is very important, and so he asks you to assemble the eggs together onstage.

After placing the final egg in its basket, Jihli Aliapoh is suddenly taken aback by the scene before her. As you stand encircled by the ring of Archon eggs, she comes to the realization that her vision has at last come to pass. It would appear the hero that she foresaw did not appear from within the casing of the eggs, but from within the ring itself. Although the Twelve Archons did not make their return to Eorzea, the celebration has brought people together in the spirit of what they stood for. To that end, Jihli would call this year's Hatching-tide a success.
TEXT_FESEST007_01420_SEQ_05: Although your presence in Gridania has left no need for this year's Hatching Hour, Jihli Aliapoh still wishes to thank you for all you have done for her. To that end, she bestows upon you a gift that she had kept for the hero she dreamed of those many years past.
TEXT_GAIUSE303_01444_SEQ_00: The terrified refugee would have you find his brethren and convince them to lay down their arms.
TEXT_GAIUSE303_01444_SEQ_01:
This quest has been adjusted. Please abandon the quest and restart it by speaking to the terrified refugee in Lost Hope.

※The Main Scenario Guide shows the next available quest. You can toggle it on and off in Character Configuration, under UI Settings.
TEXT_GAIUSE303_01444_SEQ_02: Though you came to make an example of the twins, the refugees refuse to stand aside. Only after you subdue five of their number do the sellswords appear. Fortunately, their defeat seems to have had the desired effect. Speak with the desperate refugee, and confirm that he has taken your lesson to heart.
TEXT_GAIUSE303_01444_SEQ_03: The refugee falls to his knees in despair, his will to fight broken. Inform the survivor in Lost Hope of all that has transpired.
TEXT_GAIUSE303_01444_SEQ_04: Though saddened to learn that his comrades forced your hand, the survivor is grateful for your intervention. He is, however, concerned that the merchant will attempt to recruit more desperate refugees, perpetuating the bloodshed. Recalling that the merchant wished to approach the people of Stonesthrow, the survivor bids you continue your search there.
TEXT_GAIUSE303_01444_SEQ_05: You find yourself drawn to a sobbing child, who tells you of a man who visited Stonesthrow and persuaded a number of people, including her parents, to leave with him. The child's account strongly suggests that it was the selfsame merchant who visited Lost Hope, but it offers no clue as to his current whereabouts. Return to the Hall of Flames in Ul'dah and share your findings with Commander Swift.
TEXT_GAIUSE303_01444_SEQ_06: Commander Swift is full glad to hear that you convinced the refugees of Lost Hope to lay down their arms. That joy soon gives way to anger as you share the revelation that a single merchant has influenced recent events so greatly. The high flame commander declares that the merchant must be apprehended at once; doubtless he desires your help in this endeavor.
TEXT_GAIUSE304_01445_SEQ_00: Swift is determined to stop the rabble-rousing merchant from sowing further sedition.
TEXT_GAIUSE304_01445_SEQ_01:
This quest has been adjusted. Please abandon the quest and restart it by speaking to the terrified refugee in Lost Hope.

※The Main Scenario Guide shows the next available quest. You can toggle it on and off in Character Configuration, under UI Settings.
TEXT_GAIUSE304_01445_SEQ_02: It would seem that word has spread of the drubbing you dealt the refugees of Lost Hope... Unsurprisingly, Landebert has no intention of listening to your side of the story, nor less of helping you. Yet in a curious twist of fate, your quarry chooses that exact moment to return to Pearl Lane, presumably hoping to recruit more refugees. As your eyes meet, the merchant grasps the situation and turns to flee. Do not let him escape!
TEXT_GAIUSE304_01445_SEQ_03: As one would expect, the merchant is quick to deny your accusations, and equally quick to confess when pressed. He offers to divulge all that he knows, only to fall at your feet a moment later, an arrow having pierced his chest. The commotion draws the attention of two Stone Torches, one of whom would like to know why you are standing next to a dead man.
TEXT_GAIUSE304_01445_SEQ_04: You explain to the Stone Torch that the merchant was felled by an arrow from afar, and that he was the subject of your investigation into the refugee uprisings. Satisfied with your statement, the Stone Torch bids you carry on with your work. Return to the Hall of Flames and report your findings to Commander Swift.
TEXT_GAIUSE304_01445_SEQ_05: Swift concludes that the merchant was murdered to protect the identity of his employer. Despite this setback, he seems confident that the identity of the uprising's true orchestrator will soon be revealed.
TEXT_GAIUSE308_01449_SEQ_00: The serpent lieutenant is eager to explain the details of your foray into the Sylphlands.
TEXT_GAIUSE308_01449_SEQ_01:
This quest has been adjusted. Please abandon the quest and restart it by speaking to the serpent lieutenant in Little Solace.

※The Main Scenario Guide shows the next available quest. You can toggle it on and off in Character Configuration, under UI Settings.
TEXT_GAIUSE308_01449_SEQ_02: You have tended to the stricken scouts. Confront the touched sylph responsible for their suffering.
TEXT_GAIUSE308_01449_SEQ_03: His sack of mischief seemingly misplaced, the touched sylph retreats into the forest to prepare more stinging scalebombs. Speak with Maxio at the border to the Sylphlands and plan your next move.
TEXT_GAIUSE308_01449_SEQ_04: Maxio proudly confesses to the theft of his fellow sylph's sack of scalebombs, and suggests that you track down his touched counterpart before he can acquire more of the stinging agent. Offering to render you unseen with his magic, the Little Solace resident hands you a scalebomb with which to incapacitate the touched sylph. Speak with Maxio when you are ready to begin the hunt, and he will cast the spell of invisibility.
TEXT_GAIUSE308_01449_SEQ_05:
You signal your readiness to Maxio, and he uses his “clever trick” to turn you invisible. Track down the touched sylph and use the stolen scalebomb to give him a taste of his own medicine.

※The spell of invisibility will only last for a limited time. Find and touch the sweet-smelling wildflower to extend the duration of the enchantment.
TEXT_GAIUSE308_01449_SEQ_06: You treat the touched sylph to an intimate encounter with one of his own stinging scalebombs, forcing your vengeful victim to flee. Report your success to Maxio.
TEXT_GAIUSE308_01449_SEQ_07: After hearing of your success, Maxio seems confident that the touched sylph will be unable to work any more mischief for a time. Speak with the teary-eyed private, and see if he can shed any light on the whereabouts of your comrades.
TEXT_GAIUSE308_01449_SEQ_08: Much recovered from his tearful ordeal, the private appears ready to explain the fate of your fellow Scions...
TEXT_GAIUSE309_01450_SEQ_00: The teary-eyed private appears ready to explain the fate of your fellow Scions.
TEXT_GAIUSE309_01450_SEQ_01:
This quest has been adjusted. Please abandon the quest and restart it by speaking to the serpent lieutenant in Little Solace.

※The Main Scenario Guide shows the next available quest. You can toggle it on and off in Character Configuration, under UI Settings.
TEXT_GAIUSE309_01450_SEQ_02: You find Papalymo waiting for you at the Goldleaf Dais. Before you can exchange more than a few words with him, however, a fearsome denizen of the forest crashes into view, and you are forced to defend yourself. Needless to say, you have faced worse, and the creature is soon subdued. With the coast apparently clear, resume your conversation with Papalymo.
TEXT_GAIUSE309_01450_SEQ_03: You speak with Papalymo, but find his manner to be oddly stilted. Plainly, he is not quite himself. Return to Maxio and share your suspicions.
TEXT_GAIUSE309_01450_SEQ_04: Maxio believes that the touched sylphs are using an enchantment to disguise themselves as your fellow Scions. Accordingly, he provides you with scalebombs that will nullify their illusory magicks. Throw the trueform scalebombs at Papalymo and Yda's doubles, and defeat the devious dissemblers.
TEXT_GAIUSE309_01450_SEQ_05: You have defeated the touched sylphs who were masquerading as Yda and Papalymo. Report your success to Maxio.
TEXT_GAIUSE309_01450_SEQ_06: Your sylphic guide suggests continuing the search for your comrades elsewhere. It seems you have no choice but to press on into the Sylphlands.
TEXT_GAIUSE309_01450_SEQ_07: You locate Yda and Thancred, but have no way of knowing if they are who they seem to be...save one. Make use of the trueform scalebombs given to you by Maxio, and defeat any tricksters you reveal.
TEXT_GAIUSE309_01450_SEQ_08: Though your scalebombs have no effect on Yda─besides affront and discomfort─they do serve to unmask the sylph posing as Thancred. With the impostor out of the way, you may now speak freely with your fellow Scion.
TEXT_GAIUSE309_01450_SEQ_09: It would seem that Yda had no inkling of the touched sylph's deception, nor does she know where the real Thancred might be. Give the exasperated pugilist a moment to think before discussing how best to proceed.
TEXT_GAIUSE310_01451_SEQ_00: Yda is eager to rejoin the other Scions.
TEXT_GAIUSE310_01451_SEQ_01:
This quest has been adjusted. Please abandon the quest and restart it by speaking to the serpent lieutenant in Little Solace.

※The Main Scenario Guide shows the next available quest. You can toggle it on and off in Character Configuration, under UI Settings.
TEXT_GAIUSE310_01451_SEQ_02: You finally locate Papalymo, only to find him accompanied by not one, but two Y'shtolas. Confer with Maxio, and devise a strategy to reveal which of the Scions are real and which are impostors.
TEXT_GAIUSE310_01451_SEQ_03: Maxio suggests that you attempt to unmask any potential impostors all at once. Toss a trueform scalebomb at the suspect Scions, and reveal their true identities.
TEXT_GAIUSE310_01451_SEQ_04: Maxio's handy gift explodes in a cloud of choking dust, revealing one of the two Y'shtolas to be a skin-changed sylph. Confront the trickster, and show him the error of his ways.
TEXT_GAIUSE310_01451_SEQ_05: You have defeated the touched sylph's boar ally. It is time to confront the sylvan trickster himself.
TEXT_GAIUSE310_01451_SEQ_06: Though he has apologized for his mischief, the touched sylph is nevertheless determined to convince you of Lord Ramuh's absence. Return to Papalymo and discuss the obvious deceit.
TEXT_GAIUSE310_01451_SEQ_07: Based on your tiny antagonist's dubious claims to the contrary and his own aetheric measurements, Papalymo believes he has pinpointed the spot where Lord Ramuh was summoned. Your audience with the Lord of Levin looms ever closer...
TEXT_GAIUSE311_01452_SEQ_00: Papalymo believes he has determined the site upon which the primal Ramuh was summoned.
TEXT_GAIUSE311_01452_SEQ_01:
This quest has been adjusted. Please abandon the quest and restart it by speaking to the serpent lieutenant in Little Solace.

※The Main Scenario Guide shows the next available quest. You can toggle it on and off in Character Configuration, under UI Settings.
TEXT_GAIUSE311_01452_SEQ_02:
Upon approaching the beastman aetheryte, you find yourself in the presence of Lord Ramuh. Though initially dismissive of your attempts at mediation, the primal elects to suspend judgment until you have undergone a trial by combat. Enter the Lord of Levin's domain, and prove your worth!

※The Striking Tree (Hard) can be accessed via the Duty Finder.
TEXT_GAIUSE311_01452_SEQ_03: You have defeated the Lord of Levin, and thus earned the right to champion the cause of peace in the Black Shroud. After witnessing your battle with the primal, it appears that Urianger has also found that which he sought...
TEXT_GAIUSE311_01452_SEQ_04: Return to Little Solace and make your report to the serpent lieutenant.
TEXT_GAIUSE311_01452_SEQ_05: You inform the Twin Adder lieutenant of your encounter with─and subsequent victory over─the primal Ramuh. His shock at the news that your audience culminated in combat soon gives way to joy as he realizes the ramifications of your deed for both Gridania and Little Solace.
TEXT_GAIUSE313_01454_SEQ_00: Minfilia has some correspondence she wishes to share with you.
TEXT_GAIUSE313_01454_SEQ_01:
This quest has been adjusted. Please abandon the quest and restart it by speaking to Minfilia at the Rising Stones.

※The Main Scenario Guide shows the next available quest. You can toggle it on and off in Character Configuration, under UI Settings.
TEXT_GAIUSE313_01454_SEQ_02: You gather that the inexperienced adventurers who now flock to Revenant's Toll are sorely testing Slafborn's patience. According to him, one young lady in particular would benefit from the guidance of an accomplished veteran like you. Make your way to the Singing Shards, and rescue the would-be hapalit slayer from her intended target.
TEXT_GAIUSE313_01454_SEQ_03: You have slain the scabrous hapalit. Offer your aid to the struggling adventurer.
TEXT_GAIUSE313_01454_SEQ_04: You have rescued the adventurer from almost certain death, but the young lady appears intent on blaming others for her own failings. Show her what you think of her attitude with a resounding /huh.
TEXT_GAIUSE313_01454_SEQ_05: Devastated by your disappointment, the green adventurer swears to do better before slinking off in the direction of town. Return to Revenant's Toll and report to Slafborn.
TEXT_GAIUSE313_01454_SEQ_06: You return to the bustling settlement to find an appreciative Slafborn. He has witnessed the result of your chastisement, and claims─somewhat hopefully─that the lesson will soon spread through the ranks to the rest of his young charges. He then speaks of the unavoidable hard work required to become a hero, and praises you as a fine example of what dedication and perseverance can achieve.
TEXT_GAIUSE314_01455_SEQ_00: Slafborn is concerned for the Scions' receptionist.
TEXT_GAIUSE314_01455_SEQ_01:
This quest has been adjusted. Please abandon the quest and restart it by speaking to Minfilia at the Rising Stones.

※The Main Scenario Guide shows the next available quest. You can toggle it on and off in Character Configuration, under UI Settings.
TEXT_GAIUSE314_01455_SEQ_02: After convincing Tataru to confide to you her woes, you learn that the burgeoning fame and swelling ranks of the Scions are straining the organization's limited resources. Not one to bow before adversity, the determined administrator has been learning the mining trade in a bid to secure more revenue. Without the sledgehammer she commissioned from the Blacksmiths' Guild, however, Tataru fears her efforts will be far less fruitful. Head to Limsa Lominsa, and question Forgemaster Brithael about the failed delivery.
TEXT_GAIUSE314_01455_SEQ_03: You ask Brithael about the sledgehammer, but the guildmaster is adamant that the tool in question was completed some time ago. He suggests you head south from the Octant until you find the porters responsible for its delivery, and express your /doubt in their work practices.
TEXT_GAIUSE314_01455_SEQ_04: After interrogating one of the porters, you learn that Tataru's tool was simply lost in the shuffle. Search the piles of cargo, and find the sealed crate addressed to the Rising Stones receptionist.
TEXT_GAIUSE314_01455_SEQ_05: You have liberated the box containing Tataru's sledgehammer from the forgetful porters. Make your way back to Revenant's Toll, and deliver the tool to F'lhaminn in the Rising Stones.
TEXT_GAIUSE314_01455_SEQ_06: You return to the Rising Stones and entrust the sledgehammer to F'lhaminn. While impressed by Tataru's determination, the graceful Miqo'te is concerned that the wilds of Mor Dhona may prove too dangerous for the lone Lalafellin miner. Head out to her planned mining site northeast of the Tangle, and, with the chat mode in Say, enter any phrase containing “Tataru” to attract the receptionist's attention.
TEXT_GAIUSE314_01455_SEQ_07: You call out to Tataru, and hear an alarmed scream in response. Rush over to the panicked Lalafell and slay the threatening morbol before it has a chance to rend her limb from limb.
TEXT_GAIUSE314_01455_SEQ_08: You have slain the malodorous morbol. Speak with Tataru and reassure her that the danger has passed.
TEXT_GAIUSE314_01455_SEQ_09: Though none the worse for her ordeal, the shaken receptionist is eager to return to town. Head back to the Rising Stones and speak with Tataru.
TEXT_GAIUSE314_01455_SEQ_10: You return to the Rising Stones, and are once more thanked by a grateful Tataru─this time for the delivery of her long-awaited sledgehammer. Swearing to never again wander the outskirts of Revenant's Toll alone, the able administrator is nevertheless still determined to raise enough coin to keep the Scions in business...not to mention blood currant tarts.
TEXT_COMGRD002_01527_SEQ_00: Lieutenant Scarlet is looking for a few good soldiers.
TEXT_COMGRD002_01527_SEQ_01: The member nations of the Eorzean Alliance do not see eye to eye in all matters. Nevertheless, their disagreements have not been irreconcilable─until now. Control of the Carteneau Flats is to be decided on the field of battle, and Lieutenant Scarlet would have you fight for the Twin Adder. Speak with the Yellow Serpent flyer to learn more of this new conflict, and to decide if you wish to become involved.
TEXT_COMGRD002_01527_SEQ_02: Civilized violence. Civilized war. The concept seems contradictory, if not ludicrous, yet your fellow soldiers take no issue with this proposed resolution. It is clear now that the Order of the Twin Adder will not be swayed from its course. You, however, are yet free to decide. To embrace this cause, or to renounce it─it is your choice.
TEXT_COMLIM002_01528_SEQ_00: Lieutenant Trachraet is looking for a few good soldiers.

TEXT_FESSUM001_01534_SEQ_00:
Event organizing is a cruel mistress, and one chaperone of the Moonfire Faire is determined that you should feel its heartless lash.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESSUM001_01534_SEQ_01:
According to a roving chaperone of the Moonfire Faire, the Adventurers' Guild is looking for members willing to help with the festivities. As a proud  and something of a sartorial adventurer, it would behoove you to slip on a  and take yourself to the Aftcastle. If the chief chaperone, Haermaga, is all that he is promised to be, this transaction would prove to be in your favor.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESSUM001_01534_SEQ_02: Haermaga is a trifle vague on the rationale of these festivities, but quite clear on the matter of reward. In return for participating in three events, you will receive prizes, plus a special costume. Your summer wardrobe is a little lacking, and it would be well for the commonfolk to see what an adventurer is made of. And if that should prove insufficient motivation, do it for the children.
TEXT_FESSUM002_01535_SEQ_00:
An adventurer without a guild is no adventurer at all, and one chaperone of the Moonfire Faire is determined that you should do your part.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.

TEXT_FESSUM003_01536_SEQ_00:
All work and no play makes  a dull adventurer, and one chaperone of the Moonfire Faire is determined that you should let your hair down.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESSUM003_01536_SEQ_01:

In return for participating in three events, you will receive prizes, plus a special costume. Your summer wardrobe is a little lacking, and it would be well for the commonfolk to see what an adventurer is made of. And if that should prove insufficient motivation, do it for the children.
TEXT_FESSUM004_01537_SEQ_00:
The summer heat and the festival spirit make a combustible combination. Who better to put a damper on things than you?
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESSUM004_01537_SEQ_01:
Haermaga believes you would make a great addition to a fire-fighting event called the Rousing Douse. What exactly makes it so rousing, he would not say. You will find the answer at the Blind Iron Mines from a chaperone called Ethelia.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESSUM004_01537_SEQ_02: Ethelia is rather more cavalier than you expected of a chaperone, but it is surely a sign of her confidence in your ability to handle a large, ill-tempered monster traditionally in the employ of your sworn enemies. The clamor of the children grows louder; give your assent to Ethelia, mount the elbst, and commence the waterworks.
TEXT_FESSUM005_01538_SEQ_00:
Unlike certain other guilds, the Adventurers' Guild is a family-friendly organization, as you will prove with explosive flair.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESSUM005_01538_SEQ_01:
Haermaga is inordinately proud of his take on traditional demon-slaying exhibitions, and would like you to man the cannons down in the Salt Strand. Seek out the Moonfire Faire chaperone Mayaru Moyaru down in lower La Noscea─you are sure to have a blast.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESSUM005_01538_SEQ_02: Mayaru Moyaru insists on explaining some basic safety rules before he allows you near a cannon. As the representative of the guild, both masterful aim and noble conduct are expected of you. Speak with Mayaru Moyaru when you are ready to begin.
TEXT_FESSUM006_01539_SEQ_00:
Life is short and the nights too dark. This you know, as do other adventurers who dare paint the sky with reckless fire.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESSUM006_01539_SEQ_01:
Something special is afoot in the midlands of La Noscea. Haermaga feels that of all Moonfire Faire events, this is the one most suited to your talents. Seek out J'nangho down by the Zephyr Gate and ask about the Very Cherry Bomb event.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESSUM006_01539_SEQ_02: Bomb disposal need not be a tense and solitary work when the air is sultry and the crowd friendly. The mortars are ready, the Bombards aloft, and the children are wide-eyed with excitement. Speak with chaperone J'nangho again, and let the fireworks begin!
TEXT_FESSUM007_01540_SEQ_00:
Say the word to Ethelia, and the Moonfire Faire event Rousing Douse is yours to try, try again.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESSUM007_01540_SEQ_01:
Ever the quizzer, Ethelia is nevertheless deadly earnest about the import of this fire-fighting exhibition. If you would mount an elbst, find a Moonfire marine east of the Blind Iron Mines.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESSUM007_01540_SEQ_02: Someone once said that one can see more clearly while astride an elbst. Whether or not that's so, it would be hard to miss the fires burning merrily in three designated spots in Cedarwood. Go forth, elbst rider, and Saturate the flames with water, cold and clear.
TEXT_FESSUM007_01540_SEQ_03: Thrice you have spurred the elbst to spew forth its watery ballast, and thrice have you seen a pillar of fire crumble to sodden cinders. The chaperone Ethelia would no doubt like to hear of this, as well as disconcert you again with her quizzing ways.
TEXT_FESSUM007_01540_SEQ_04: All's well that ends wet, according to Ethelia─at least when it comes to an event billed as a Rousing Douse. Your time on an elbst was all too brief, but fortunately, a return engagement with the Moonfire Marines is on offer, should you decide to accept.
TEXT_FESSUM008_01541_SEQ_00:
Moonfire Faire chaperone Mayaru Moyaru is on alert for your call, for not many adventurers have the Cannon-do Spirit.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESSUM008_01541_SEQ_01:
Mayaru Moyaru is quite the demon whisperer; confined within the event venue are womandragoras and sabotenders both. Use any of the 18-ponze cannons at your disposal to batter the former twice and the latter once.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESSUM008_01541_SEQ_02: All targets are moving targets when there are cannons and crowds involved. Despite the difficulties, you have triumphed. Mayaru Moyaru will be relieved to hear how well and precisely you comported yourself.
TEXT_FESSUM008_01541_SEQ_03: Mayaru Moyaru is delighted that this family-friendly event concluded without any bystander injuries. How wonderful it is to see the smiles of the children, and watch them run after the cannonballs. Some actions cannot be undone, but you may always return to the Cannon-do Spirit.
TEXT_FESSUM009_01542_SEQ_00:
There is a Very Cherry Bomb with your name on it, if only you would speak with J'nangho.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESSUM009_01542_SEQ_01:
Combining high-explosives disposal and crowd-pleasing pyrotechnics takes a merry heart and a steady hand. Follow J'nangho's instructions to chase flaming Bombard blanks towards a mortar full of fireworks. Whether to use the northern or the eastern venue is entirely up to you.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESSUM009_01542_SEQ_02: Off go the fireworks, the bomb core turns to ashes, and, as J'nangho predicted, the crowd goes wild. It would only be fair to let her know that she was right.
TEXT_FESSUM009_01542_SEQ_03: J'nangho has her own two bits to add to the inside tale of the Moonfire Faire. All this talk of energy is a happy reminder that, should you so choose, you can always return to the Zephyr Gate for another round of a Very Cherry Bomb.
TEXT_FESSUM010_01543_SEQ_00:
Haermaga has special rewards to give to those who have completed all three Moonfire Faire events.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESSUM010_01543_SEQ_01:
You have completed all three Moonfire Faire events, and Haermaga has special rewards for you as promised. The first is a lavish selection of fireworks, currently in the safekeeping of another chaperone. The second is quite a different set of tailfeathers─a lesson in dance of the Eastern tradition. Don your  and ask the Moonfire chaperone in the Aftcastle about the fireworks.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESSUM010_01543_SEQ_02: The homespun chaperone voices her concern regarding Haermaga's distracted demeanor, and urges you to involve yourself in some mysterious rendezvous at the Bismarck. When you return, the fireworks should be waiting.
TEXT_FESSUM010_01543_SEQ_03: The elusive visitor turns out to be Yamimi, a merchant on a mission. She brings a memento and a message from Haermaga's late friend, a young boy who dreamt of living an adventurer's life in the Far East. Your disquiet at learning of Haermaga's secret sorrow is only natural, but do not let it prevent you from delivering the twisted hachimaki to the grieving adventurer.
TEXT_FESSUM010_01543_SEQ_04: You have seen into Haermaga's heart today, and it was a strangely beautiful landscape of unexpected loss and unsung devotion. Was this what made this year's Moonfire Faire a living thing, as J'nangho named it? The child that Haermaga yearned to journey with has left him a remarkable gift, one that brooks no refusal. Love never dies; it goes east.
TEXT_FESANV001_01546_SEQ_00:
Bran the gazetteer would ask for your aid in tracking down an elusive individual.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESANV001_01546_SEQ_01:
Bran is on the trail of the mysterious minstrel sighted throughout the realm. Why not do your part for journalism and speak with three good citizens of Limsa Lominsa?

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESANV001_01546_SEQ_02: It seems everyone has a tale to tell of the mysterious minstrel. Share the reports with Bran, and see what he has to say.
TEXT_FESANV001_01546_SEQ_03: With the nimbleness of mind that marks his kind, Bran leaps to the conclusion that the minstrel will next appear in Limsa Lominsa. Since even the seemingly ubiquitous scribbler cannot actually be in two places at once, take yourself to the Aftcastle and speak to those of bardic aspect.
TEXT_FESANV001_01546_SEQ_04: A puzzle, an artist, a lawbreaker, and a champion of adventurers─the wandering minstrel is all these, and more. Having expressed his admiration for adventurers, he shares with you the words of the late Archon Louisoix. In light of the grim future they foretell, the minstrel gifts you with one of Eorzea's favorite pastimes, which he hopes will keep you and your thoughts from the encroaching shadows.
TEXT_FESHLW301_01548_SEQ_00:
An investigator for the Adventurers' Guild appears in need of assistance.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESHLW301_01548_SEQ_01:
An investigator from the Adventurers' Guild has asked your help in uncovering the nefarious plans of the Continental Circus─a troupe of mischievous fiends disguised as entertainers. Approach the illusionist in Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre, and learn what you can of their impending devilry.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESHLW301_01548_SEQ_02: Suspiciously eager to accept your offer of aid, the Continental Circus illusionist asks that you help prepare for the opening of their haunted manor. Your tasks will take you to the Goldsmiths' Guild in Ul'dah, the Culinarians' Guild in Limsa Lominsa, and the Carpenters' Guild in Gridania.
TEXT_FESHLW301_01548_SEQ_03: You have collected the commissions, and spoken with the distracted circus member. Return to the illusionist in Old Gridania and deliver the requested items.
TEXT_FESHLW301_01548_SEQ_04: You hand over the commissions to the waiting illusionist. She bids you wait in the area for your reward whilst she is busy organizing the final preparations. Almost immediately following this exchange however, a mysterious voice urges you to visit the place where they “work the hides of dead things” if you care for the fate of the living...
TEXT_FESHLW301_01548_SEQ_05: You linger outside the Leatherworkers' Guild, not sure what to expect, when you witness the arrival of the illusionist. She is soon joined by the Impresario, and, after checking to see that they are alone, they both revert to their true impish forms. They proceed to discuss their plans for the haunted manor, and of how the terror they induce within its walls will be used to call down a new Night of Devilry. Return to the investigator near the amphitheatre and report this vile scheme.
TEXT_FESHLW301_01548_SEQ_06: Once he has digested the details of the imps' plans, the investigator is quick to proffer a solution: convince the people that the horrors within the manor are clever illusions so that their fear will be replaced with amusement. Wishing to know more of what waits inside the haunted house, the investigator then requests that you conduct a thorough investigation of its ghostly halls. Speak once more with the illusionist, and gain entrance to the manor.
TEXT_FESHLW301_01548_SEQ_07: After thanking you for your assistance with the preparations, the illusionist suggests that you pay a visit to a harlequin guide if you wish to enter the haunted house. Find one of the informative circus members in either the amphitheatre or the Acorn Orchard, and learn the nature of the manor's “amusements.” Once you have explored its ghastly rooms, return to the Adventurers' Guild investigator with the evidence of your experience.
TEXT_FESHLW301_01548_SEQ_08:
You explain to the investigator how the amusements inside the manor were designed to instill fear in unsuspecting visitors. He examines one of the cookies you earned from enduring the entertainment, and is grudgingly impressed by the imps' diabolical plan. Upon witnessing the jubilant reactions of a mother and her child after their return from the haunted house, however, the guild member concludes that his rumors have had their intended effect. And fortunately, it seems that the circus members are none the wiser for your interference.
Once more the mysterious voice reaches your ears, and commends you for preserving the joyful atmosphere of All Saints' Wake...
TEXT_FESNYR301_01549_SEQ_00:
The tori bugyo is desperately trying to catch your eye.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESNYR301_01549_SEQ_01:
The tori bugyo and his entourage from the Far East have arrived in Eorzea and are eager to introduce their customs to the people of the West with the upcoming Heavensturn festival. To their dismay, however, their very best efforts have fallen flat, and they have been unable to stir even a passing interest in the local citizens. Deciding the only way to prevent an absolute disaster is to entice passersby to attend with free rice cakes─a customary treat from his homeland─the tori bugyo asks that you help him to spread the word.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESNYR301_01549_SEQ_02: You speak with several of the citizens loitering about the lower decks of Limsa Lominsa. Most of them are very enthusiastic about the idea of receiving complimentary desserts. It seems the tori bugyo has finally received the opportunity he had been hoping for. Hurry back and share with him the good news.
TEXT_FESNYR301_01549_SEQ_03: As you relay to the tori bugyo that his plan to lure people in with promise of free dessert has worked, you are interrupted by the arrival of the mochi daikan. The rice cake expert is completely out of breath but manages to tell you that birds have been flocking to the mochi pounding site and are devouring all the cakes meant for festival-goers. He begs you to accompany him so that together you might chase off the menacing beasts and salvage what is left of the mochi. As you make ready to leave, he tells you that he will meet you there as he must escort Jiromaru, a paissa who will help look after the rice cakes you recover, to the pounding site. Retrieve the advent cakes necessary to continue the festivities by participating in the FATE: “Pounding More Mochi, Pounding More Hearts” at either of the following locations: southeast of the Zephyr Gate in middle La Noscea or east of the Salt Strand in lower La Noscea.
TEXT_FESNYR301_01549_SEQ_04: You manage to rescue what is left of the advent rice cakes from the swarm of ravenous birds. There is, however, precious little time to celebrate, for the tori bugyo is eagerly awaiting your return.
TEXT_FESNYR301_01549_SEQ_05: The tori bugyo is elated to see you. Motioning in the direction of where Jiromaru, the mochi daikan, and the chocobo are handing out rice cakes, he tells you that your hard work is to thank for the success of this year's Heavensturn. To show you just how grateful he is for all you have done, he presents you with a─as he calls it─cock kabuto of your very own.
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_SEQ_00: This hunter's unbridled enthusiasm can mean only one thing: the hunt is on!
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_SEQ_01: Though you have never met him, this hearty hunter seems to know you quite well. So well, in fact, he considers you his rival. Perhaps that is why he chooses to share with you an unusual Clan Hunt bill he procured from their board. The strange scribblings describe a great wyvern by the name Rathalos. Though the bill makes no mention of its origins, the hearty hunter has discovered it was last seen somewhere at the Azim Steppe. He suggests you visit Reunion to learn more of your prey while he readies himself for the hunt.
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_SEQ_02: Try as you might, you fail to find anyone who can attest to the existence of this great wyvern. On the word of a wayfaring hunter, however, you decide to consult the Qestir, masters of the Reunion markets, in hopes of learning more of your prey.
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_SEQ_03: You speak with a merchant of the Qestir tribe, though his initial response is only an expression of grave concern. He then points southwest toward Yat Khaal. Perhaps there you will find some trace of the Rathalos.
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_SEQ_04: While waiting for signs of the wyvern, you are confronted by a curious talking cat claiming to be a fledgling Felyne hunter. He too has come in search of the Rathalos, and no sooner does he speak its name than a colossal, crimson-scaled wyvern swoops down from the sky to claim a dzo for its next meal. At last, the hunt begins. The Felyne hunter wastes no time chasing after the Rathalos, heading northwest toward Bardam's Mettle.
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_SEQ_05: You arrive at Bardam's Mettle to find the Felyne hunter is ready, not to fight, but support. Preferably from the safety of the entrance. That said, he does offer you several potions to ensure you are duly prepared. The battle before you will likely be fierce, and to that end the Felyne hunter suggests you seek reinforcements before jumping into the fray.
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_SEQ_06: The Rathalos was truly a beast worthy of its title, but not even the King of the Skies was a match for you and your comrades. The Felyne hunter is certain to be glad to hear of your success.
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_SEQ_07: The Felyne hunter is in awe of your strength. Wishing to bear witness to your future feats of heroism and derring-do, he asks to join you as an adventuring companion. It was quite fortunate that you happened to glimpse his mark bill. He is surprised, however, to hear you saw it not on the Clan Hunt board, but from a hunter in Kugane. He asks if you might introduce him to the man who ultimately guided you to aid him.
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_SEQ_08: You arrive in Kugane to find your supposed rival has just finished warming up and is ready to hunt. A pity you have already claimed his prize. You expect him to be disappointed, perhaps even cross with you, but instead he is pleased to see you proved yourself worthy of being his adversary. His smithy companion is more concerned with what, if anything, you recovered from the Rathalos. Hearing you carved a scale from its hide, he jumps at the opportunity to use it in his work, offering to fashion you armor if you can procure more. If you should take him up on his offer, the hunt for Rathalos has only begun.
TEXT_STMBDY992_01555_SEQ_00: Judging by the hunter's jovial expression, the hunt is still on.
TEXT_GAIUSX110_01561_SEQ_00: Slafborn's brow is clouded with worry and the forecast calls for rain─unless you can save the day.
TEXT_GAIUSX110_01561_SEQ_01:
This quest has been adjusted. Please abandon the quest and restart it by speaking to Slafborn in Revenant's Toll.

※The Main Scenario Guide shows the next available quest. You can toggle it on and off in Character Configuration, under UI Settings.
TEXT_GAIUSX110_01561_SEQ_02: You have delved deep into morbol territory, stemming their assaults for the time being. Report the news of your courage to Slafborn.
TEXT_GAIUSX110_01561_SEQ_03: Slafborn is pleased with the excitement your actions have stirred among the adventurers of Revenant's Toll. Your deed has inspired others to take on responsibility for the growth of the outpost, a trend that Slafborn hopes continues.
TEXT_GAIUSX111_01562_SEQ_00: When a man like Slafborn thinks well of you, you are wont to find yourself performing a dangerous and unpleasant task in short order.
TEXT_GAIUSX111_01562_SEQ_01:
This quest has been adjusted. Please abandon the quest and restart it by speaking to Slafborn in Revenant's Toll.

※The Main Scenario Guide shows the next available quest. You can toggle it on and off in Character Configuration, under UI Settings.
TEXT_GAIUSX111_01562_SEQ_02: The hapalits prove little challenge, and the scouting party can now proceed with their mission. Report the happy news to Slafborn.
TEXT_GAIUSX111_01562_SEQ_03: Thanks to your fellow adventurers' fondness for ale and gossip, your brave deeds have once again become the talk of Revenant's Toll. Slafborn declares the guild's morale to be unwaveringly high, before slyly reminding you that this too is a kind of sorcery.
TEXT_COMGRD003_01563_SEQ_00: One man's scourge is another man's chance to splurge, and Lieutenant Scarlet can help you find reason in this rhyme.
TEXT_COMGRD003_01563_SEQ_01: Lieutenant Scarlet informs you that the Eorzean Alliance has instituted a bounty system called the Hunt. For the finer points of this most profitable venture, you must speak with the Hunt billmaster within the Adders' Nest.
TEXT_COMGRD003_01563_SEQ_02: The Hunt billmaster has briefed you on the fundamentals of the Hunt. Whether you seek more advice or wish to spend your hard-earned Allied Seals, he is the man with whom you must speak. Do your part to preserve the peace, and you will be richly rewarded.
TEXT_COMLIM003_01564_SEQ_00: Lieutenant Trachraet detects in you a certain whiff of brine and vinegar, a perfect cure for the realm's plague of villainy.
TEXT_COMLIM003_01564_SEQ_01: According to Lieutenant Trachraet, the Eorzean Alliance has instituted a bounty system referred to as the Hunt. For the piquant particulars of this most challenging venture, seek out the Hunt billmaster within Maelstrom Command.
TEXT_COMLIM003_01564_SEQ_02: The Hunt billmaster tells you what you need to know of the Hunt. Though all the talk of pudding and death is discomfiting, it is good to know someone you can turn to for information─or to spend your hard-earned Allied Seals. Do your part to preserve the peace, and you will be richly rewarded.
TEXT_COMULD003_01565_SEQ_00: The hectic flush of commerce is upon Lieutenant Mimio of the Immortal Flames, and she fully intends for you to catch the fever.
TEXT_COMULD003_01565_SEQ_01: Lieutenant Mimio is pleased to share with you that the Alliance has instituted a bounty system called the Hunt. If you would see what the officer is so excited about, a visit to the Hall of Flames is in order. You may present yourself to the Hunt billmaster to learn more.
TEXT_COMULD003_01565_SEQ_02: Though the Hunt billmaster seems to have dealt with more than his fair share this day, you have still managed to learn from him how you might join in the Hunt. He is also the man to go to should you require more information on the subject, or if you have hard-earned Allied Seals to turn in. For now, do your part to preserve the peace, and you will be richly rewarded.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_SEQ_00:
Claribel wishes to see you and your partner eternally bonded before the eyes of gods and men.

※For details, please visit the Ceremony of Eternal Bonding site via the Lodestone.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_SEQ_01:
Claribel, the ceremony planner, would like nothing more than to see you and your partner host a Ceremony of Eternal Bonding at the Sanctum of the Twelve. However, there are a number of preparations which must be seen to before you can make formal arrangements. First, you must speak with the ceremony outfitter and collect your complimentary garments.

※This objective may be completed without your partner.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_SEQ_02:
After furnishing you with your garments, the ceremony outfitter advises you to return to Claribel─though not before encouraging you to /embrace your beloved during the ceremony. Speak with the ceremony planner to continue with your preparations.

※This objective may be completed without your partner.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_SEQ_03:
In accordance with tradition, you and your partner must prepare symbols of your undying devotion─the blessed rings you will exchange during the ceremony. Using whatever means you deem appropriate, obtain a flawless band suitable for this purpose and present it to Jemime at the Goldsmiths' Guild in Ul'dah.

※This objective may be completed without your partner.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_SEQ_04:
The master goldsmiths of the guild engrave the band with the runes of the Twelve so that it may receive Their divine blessings. Return to the Sanctum of the Twelve and present the ring to Claribel for her inspection.

※This objective may be completed without your partner.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_SEQ_05:
Claribel regales you with an ancient tale of two souls who wandered Eorzea in search of answers from the Twelve, from which the next tradition you and your partner must observe originates. To wit, you and your partner must embark upon a pilgrimage to the marks of the Twelve, where together you must /pray to receive Their blessings. Begin by retracing the steps of the original pilgrims and /pray at the marks of the Matron, the Builder, and the Keeper in the Twelveswood.

※To complete this objective, you and your partner must have completed all previous objectives. Moreover, you must form a party of two with your partner, you must both equip yourselves with promise wristlets, and your partner must be present when you /pray.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_SEQ_06:
You visit all three marks in the Twelveswood, praying to each as instructed by Claribel. You must now proceed to La Noscea and /pray at the marks of the Navigator, the Spinner, and the Wanderer.

※To complete this objective, you and your partner must have completed all previous objectives. Moreover, you must form a party of two with your partner, you must both equip yourselves with promise wristlets, and your partner must be present when you /pray.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_SEQ_07:
Having completed the La Noscean leg of your pilgrimage, journey to Thanalan and /pray at the marks of the Dusk Trader, the Destroyer, and the Warden.

※To complete this objective, you and your partner must have completed all previous objectives. Moreover, you must form a party of two with your partner, you must both equip yourselves with promise wristlets, and your partner must be present when you /pray.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_SEQ_08:
Only three more marks remain. Proceed to Coerthas and /pray at the marks of the Fury and the Lover.

※To complete this objective, you and your partner must have completed all previous objectives. Moreover, you must form a party of two with your partner, you must both equip yourselves with promise wristlets, and your partner must be present when you /pray.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_SEQ_09:
Far though you have come, your pilgrimage is not yet finished. Travel to Mor Dhona and /pray at the mark of the Scholar.

※To complete this objective, you and your partner must have completed all previous objectives. Moreover, you must form a party of two with your partner, you must both equip yourselves with promise wristlets, and your partner must be present when you /pray.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_SEQ_10:
Perhaps it is but a trick of the light, but the band you prepared for your beloved now seems to sparkle with a newfound radiance. Return to Claribel and present the ring to her for inspection.

※This objective may be completed without your partner.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_SEQ_11:
Claribel shares with you the conclusion of the ancient tale, in which the two souls discover that the salvation they sought was to be found in the eternal bond they had forged with one another. She then takes your rings into safekeeping until the day of the ceremony and instructs you to speak with Raitmeaux inside the Ivory Chapel, who will help you to prepare a ceremony plan.

※This objective may be completed without your partner.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_SEQ_12:
You and your partner have now completed all mandatory requirements, and you may now plan, schedule, and host your Ceremony of Eternal Bonding.

※To change your ceremony plan, you may speak with Raitmeaux inside the Ivory Chapel at any time prior to your ceremony.
※To make a reservation for your ceremony, speak with Etoinelle outside the Ivory Chapel.

※To make a reservation for your ceremony, you and your partner must have completed all previous objectives. Moreover, you must form a party of two with your partner, and you must both equip yourselves with promise wristlets.
※Registration opens each  at :00  for ceremonies to be held during the week-long period beginning the next  at :00  Please note that registration opens at different times depending on the service plan (platinum, gold, or standard) as denoted by your wristlet. For further details, please visit the Ceremony of Eternal Bonding site via the Lodestone.
※Please be advised that ceremonies cannot be held when Worlds are undergoing maintenance. To view the latest maintenance information, select System in the main menu, then select Support Desk.
※Upon making a reservation, you will receive a blank invitation, which you may use to create invitations which may be given to friends in the same manner as an ordinary item.

※During the ceremony, you and your partner will receive eternity rings in exchange for your promise wristlets. On the day, please ensure that you have your blank invitation, your wristlet, and one free slot in your inventory.

※Within 20 minutes (Earth time) of doors opening, you and your partner must finalize your ceremony plans, after which the guests will be ushered to the ceremony hall. The ceremony will automatically commence 20 minutes (Earth time) from this point. Please be advised that failure to finalize ceremony plans will result in the ceremony's cancellation.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_SEQ_13:
In a glorious day that shall ever be remembered, the gods themselves bless the union between you and your beloved. Now that the ceremony has been concluded, thank Claribel for her assistance.

※This objective may be completed without your partner.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_SEQ_14: Eyes brimming with emotion, the ceremony planner congratulates you on your newly forged bond. Reminding you that this is just the beginning of a far greater journey, she states that, come what may, she has faith that you and your beloved will ever bask in the glory of the Twelve.
TEXT_HEAVNY806_02106_SEQ_00: Eloin thinks you are just the  he is looking for.
TEXT_HEAVNY806_02106_SEQ_01: In accordance with the Lord Commander's orders, the Temple Knights have established a system for accepting and issuing leves similar to the one administered by the Adventurers' Guilds of Eorzea. Should you wish to undertake any of these leves, you need only speak with Eloin in Foundation.
TEXT_HEAVNY808_02117_SEQ_00: Arnoulain believes your chocobo capable of reaching still greater heights.
TEXT_HEAVNY808_02117_SEQ_01: This quest has been adjusted. Please abandon it.
TEXT_HEAVNY808_02117_SEQ_02: Priorfaix is most impressed with . As he tells it, the process of training a flightless chocobo to take to the heavens involves providing it with experiences that will rouse the instincts of its wild ancestors that lie dormant within. For the first stage of the training, bring your chocobo to the Chocobo Forest and slay Dravanian bee clouds.
TEXT_HEAVNY808_02117_SEQ_03: You slay Dravanian bee clouds, allowing  to experience the life-and-death battle that his wild brethren face each day. Return to Tailfeather and report your success to Priorfaix.
TEXT_HEAVNY808_02117_SEQ_04: Priorfaix congratulates you on your success. For the next phase of the training, your chocobo must feel the high winds that his flying forebears once knew. The chocobo trainer suggests two locations suitable for the task: one in the northeast part of Tailfeather, and one in the northwest of Falcon's Nest in the Coerthas western highlands. As the heights are too precarious for a flightless bird to reach, the chocobo trainer suggests that you take in the winds alone, then convey them to  by way of scent.
TEXT_HEAVNY808_02117_SEQ_05: You have bathed in the winds of the Dravanian and Coerthan heights, in the hopes that their brisk scent will suffice to awaken your steed's long-forgotten ability of flight. Report your success to Priorfaix.
TEXT_HEAVNY808_02117_SEQ_06: Priorfaix congratulates you on your efforts, and confirms that 's training is now complete. Read the winds closely, and take to the skies atop your loyal steed!
TEXT_FESSUM101_02124_SEQ_00:
The Moonfire Faire is in full swing, and Haermaga is ready to outdo himself once again─with the help of a certain adventurer.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESSUM101_02124_SEQ_01:
Once again it is time for the Moonfire Faire, and the Adventurers' Guild is in need of extra hands to help make it the most memorable one yet. Haermaga has asked you to assist the chaperones at Costa del Sol with the many problems they are facing. Help the guild with the faire by reporting to the chaperone P'obyano to hear what it is she requires from you.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESSUM101_02124_SEQ_02: P'obyano happily explains that the Adventurers' Guild has no shortage of work for an eager volunteer. A few difficulties are bound to occur during a celebration as exciting as the Moonfire Faire, and right now P'obyano is dealing with unruly pirates, dirty beaches, inquisitive beasts, and hungry customers. Anyone willing to lend their aid can receive Faire tokens as a reward. Choose the tasks most suitable for yourself and ensure that the Moonfire Faire proceeds without a hitch.
TEXT_FESSUM102_02125_SEQ_00:
You can't help but notice how awfully busy C'zibho Tia looks─it would be a shame to leave him to his own devices.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESSUM102_02125_SEQ_01:
C'zibho Tia can barely keep up with the appetites of Costa del Sol's faire-goers, and needs someone to help him prepare servings of battered fish. He informs you that the main ingredient, haddock, can be purchased from a nearby stall. Once you have prepared the battered fish, bring it to C'zibho Tia before he runs out of food to sell.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESSUM102_02125_SEQ_02: C'zibho Tia is pleased at the battered fish you have delivered him, and relieved that he will not have to turn customers away yet. It seems that he and Espan have a difference of opinion when it comes to what makes a dish important: Espan is a stickler for the quality of the fish, while C'zibho Tia maintains that the quality matters not once the fish is fried. However, the many guests of the Moonfire Faire do not seem to mind either way, and C'zibho Tia asks you to deliver more servings of battered fish once you prepare them.
TEXT_FESSUM103_02126_SEQ_00:
You can tell from Espan's expression that he believes himself to be the busiest man at the stall.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESSUM103_02126_SEQ_01:
Espan is a man of refined tastes and believes that the attendees of this year's Moonfire Faire deserve battered fish made from only the freshest haddock on offer. However, due to pirate-related troubles, the Adventurers' Guild cannot spare any hands for fishing. He judges you as an adventurer of taste and skill with a fishing rod, and asks that you board the Rhotano privateer to catch the fish.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESSUM103_02126_SEQ_02: You have caught a fresh haddock that is sure to please even the most discerning fishmonger. Bring the fish to Espan so he can serve superior battered fish to the faire-goers.
TEXT_FESSUM103_02126_SEQ_03: Espan is pleased with the fish you present to him, and bemoans the fact that C'zibho Tia lacks the eye for freshness that he does. He assures you that haddock will always be in demand, and asks that you bring him any more that you catch in the future.
TEXT_FESSUM104_02127_SEQ_00:
P'obyano is waiting for someone to ask her about her special prize.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESSUM104_02127_SEQ_01:
P'obyano eagerly explains that in order to receive her special reward, you must deliver to her seven Faire tokens. Complete various tasks around the beach, and return to P'obyano once you have gathered seven Faire tokens.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESSUM104_02127_SEQ_02: P'obyano happily accepts your Faire tokens, but before she can give you her reward, a burly Roegadyn pirate frightens the faire-goers on the beach away. Gegeruju, displeased that someone would dare to disturb his gazing, demands that something be done. P'obyano determines that the best course of action is to try and reach a peaceful resolution with the pirate, and requests your support. She asks you to go ahead and look for Wunthyll while she finds someone to run the stall in her absence.
TEXT_FESSUM104_02127_SEQ_03: It appears Wunthyll is part of a group that was meant to settle the lands surrounding Bloodshore. The group worked hard to make an honest living, until one day Gegeruju bought the land, and the troubled settlers returned to a life of piracy. P'obyano sympathizes with the group's hardship, but insists that piracy is not the only way to make one's way in life. Sensing a golden opportunity, she suggests that the pirate join the Adventurers' Guild. The pirate is eventually convinced to seriously consider a change in careers, and even offers to tell his fellow pirates about the opportunity. P'obyano seems satisfied with this conclusion and returns to her duties at the faire, and from now on will treat pirates with the same consideration as other guests. With the main problems of the faire solved, now there is nothing left to do but revel in the beachfront festivities.
TEXT_FESEST201_02128_SEQ_00:
Jihli Aliapoh's face lights up as she sees you approach.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESEST201_02128_SEQ_01:
Jihli joyfully fills you in on a dream she had, which she believes to be a vision sent from the Twelve Archons, past heroes of legend. The mirthful Miqo'te dreamt of a scene of revelry with Eorzeans from all over gathering in Gridania to participate in an egg hunt and other festivities. Although the dream grew too bright to see it herself, she recalls with confidence that at the height of the celebration, the so-called Hatching Hour, a chosen egg cracked to reveal a gold treasure. Believing this to be a message sent from the heavens to herald the Archons' forthcoming descent, Jihli asks you to help her recreate the scene in her dream, promising to share the prophesized wealth with you should you succeed. Speak to Nonotta to learn how you can participate.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESEST201_02128_SEQ_02: Nonotta provides you with more details about how to successfully recreate Jihli's vision in order for the golden treasure to appear. She explains that the Dreamers, along with Black Rabbit Traders of Gridania, have set up three Hatching-tide activities for the realm to enjoy. Once you have completed each activity at least once, she asks you check with her to see if they are any closer to the Hatching Hour.
TEXT_FESEST202_02129_SEQ_00:
The cock-a-hoop collector awaits you with bated breath.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESEST202_02129_SEQ_01:
The overenthusiastic Au Ra explains the simple activity to you, delivering a Hatching-tide decoration to her hiding counterpart. However, she says you must do so without it getting snatched by any spriggans strolling around the quarter. Pick up one of the egg decorations from the basket to begin. 

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESEST202_02129_SEQ_02: You have picked up one of the decorative eggs. Carry it safely to the collector-in-training hiding in Old Gridania, avoiding any spriggans that may cross your path.
TEXT_FESEST202_02129_SEQ_03: Adeptly sneaking past the coddled spriggans, you eventually arrive at the Lalafell's hiding place and deliver the egg decoration to him and he attempts to see you off with some egg humor. Return to Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre and report to the cock-a-hoop collector.
TEXT_FESEST202_02129_SEQ_04: The cock-a-hoop collector hands over a fortune egg and welcomes you to challenge again, but not before charming you with more of her eccentric disposition.
TEXT_FESEST203_02130_SEQ_00:
The cultured collector flashes a smile at you.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESEST203_02130_SEQ_01:
The cultured collector tells you that the enormous benediction egg rolling throughout the quarters of Old Gridania is actually an enchantment of sylphic design. Although it appears practically unblemished despite the speed at which it plunges through the crowd, the collector bids you break off a piece of its shell by rubbing a magicked powder onto it. Chase after the egg fit for a king. 

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESEST203_02130_SEQ_02: You successfully break off a piece of the benediction egg. Return to Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre and deliver it to the cultured collector.
TEXT_FESEST203_02130_SEQ_03: The cultured collector is satisfied with the choice piece you were able to break off and hands over your prize. You patiently await a bit of egg humor, only to find the collector would rather leave it to his other compeers.
TEXT_FESEST204_02131_SEQ_00:
Motte looks at you with a twinkle in her eye. 
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESEST204_02131_SEQ_01:
Motte invites you to play the Spriggan Scramble, one of the activities set up for Hatching-tide. She explains that it is a tallying game in three rounds with different levels of difficulty, and should you clear them all, you will receive a prize. Head over to the beginner eggsaminer to begin the game.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESEST204_02131_SEQ_02: The beginner eggsaminer provides you with further details for the activity before letting loose a handful of spriggans who scamper between the partitions. As you have confidently counted their eggs with ease, head over to the intermediate eggsaminer for a more respectable challenge.
TEXT_FESEST204_02131_SEQ_03: The intermediate eggsaminer adds another egg design to the mix and more spriggans to the fray, but your impeccable memory has again reigned supreme. Head over to the advanced eggsaminer for the final round.
TEXT_FESEST204_02131_SEQ_04: Although your focus falters slightly under the advanced eggsaminer's intimidating personality, you were able to steel yourself and pick out every egg. Return to Motte and inform her you have successfully completed all three rounds.
TEXT_FESEST204_02131_SEQ_05: Motte is amazed by your egg counting abilities, confessing even she was unable to pass the advanced round. Speak to her again should you feel the pressing need to count your eggs before they hatch.
TEXT_FESEST205_02132_SEQ_00:
Nonotta looks around as if she is waiting for a miracle.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESEST205_02132_SEQ_01:
Nonotta informs you that while the festival is going splendidly, the Hatching Hour has yet to arrive. Puzzled as to why there has been no sign of the Archons' gift and noting Jihli's somewhat disappointed expression, she requests that you ask the Hatching-tide founder if there were any details of the dream that she forgot to mention.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESEST205_02132_SEQ_02: Like her assistant, Jihli cannot help but wonder what could be missing from the festival, until Nonotta rushes over and exclaims that the egg chosen for the Hatching Ceremony has been stolen by a spriggan. Though annoyed at first, Jihli has a sudden revelation: the egg hunt in her dream was for a single egg. Excited, she declares that the true hunt has begun, and asks you to help her find the thieving spriggan.
TEXT_FESEST205_02132_SEQ_03: The gatekeeper of the Blue Badger Gate in New Gridania tells you that he did indeed let a lone spriggan through, thinking that it was taking Hatching-tide decorations to Bentbranch. Hurry back to Old Gridania and tell Jihli where the spriggan is headed.
TEXT_FESEST205_02132_SEQ_04: Jihli implores you to give chase and states that she will join you after she instructs the Dreamers to assemble and prepare for the ceremony at the amphitheatre. Make for Bentbranch Meadows.
TEXT_FESEST205_02132_SEQ_05: In Bentbranch Meadows, Keitha confirms that a spriggan passed by, struggling to carry an enormous egg, which he then laid carefully in the stables before taking a long nap and departing the Shroud. Jihli beseeches Keitha to return the egg, explaining the importance of decorating and displaying it for Hatching-tide. The head wrangler refuses, however, asserting that chocobo eggs are extremely delicate─a statement which surprises and confuses the two Dreamers. Recalling the unusual size and warmth of that egg, Nonotta realizes her mistake and apologizes. Keitha then invites everyone to witness the hatching for themselves, and afterwards, as the two Dreamers fuss over the newborn baby chocobo, Jihli has another epiphany: the gold-colored feathers of the bird must have been the “golden treasure” of which she dreamt. While not entirely accurate (and lacking the proper audience she envisioned), both Jihli and Nonotta concur that the prophecy has been fulfilled, bringing them one step closer to the Archons' descent.
