※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESPDY304_02406_SEQ_02: The royal seneschal is delighted when he hears that you chose Masha to star in the upcoming show and is just as excited to inform you that Redolent Rose has made good upon his promise. Having received the girls' costumes while you were away, he tells you that they are every bit as glamorous as he had hoped they would be.
TEXT_FESPDY305_02407_SEQ_00:
Narumi appears surprised to see you.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESPDY305_02407_SEQ_01:
Narumi, while initially terrified at the thought of being the center of attention, quickly comes to realize that leading the group may be the perfect opportunity to help her overcome her indecisiveness─a habit which lands her in hot water from time to time. Promising to give their performance her all, she then rushes off to see to some last-minute preparations. Your job, however, is still far from done, as there is one last person who must be informed of your decision. Make your way back to the Ruby Road Exchange and let the royal seneschal know your Songbird of choice.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESPDY305_02407_SEQ_02: The royal seneschal is delighted when he hears that you chose Narumi to star in the upcoming show and is just as excited to inform you that Redolent Rose has made good upon his promise. Having received the girls' costumes while you were away, he tells you that they are every bit as glamorous as he had hoped they would be.
TEXT_FESPDY306_02408_SEQ_00:
The royal seneschal is ready to burst with excitement.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESPDY306_02408_SEQ_01:
All the preparations are in order, and the Songbirds are finally ready to step out onto the stage and give the audience what they have been waiting for. The ever-eager royal seneschal, however, wishes to get in a few last words with you and the girls before the show begins. It has been a long day for the man, and he is certain to appreciate your attention.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESPDY306_02408_SEQ_02: With the Little Ladies' Day concert tapering to a finish, now seems a good time to make your way to the steps at the Ruby Road Exchange, where the royal seneschal awaits.
TEXT_FESPDY306_02408_SEQ_03: The end of the Songbirds' concert has taken a great load off the royal seneschal's shoulders, and he thanks you profusely for your help in ensuring its success. As a token of his gratitude, he presents you with a small stack of vouchers that can be exchanged for a variety of Little Ladies' Day goods, including replicas of the Songbirds' costume─for ladies and gentlemen both. Bidding you enjoy the rest of the festival, he reminds you that the trio of preteen troubadours will continue performing throughout the event, and urges you to drop by to see them, should the fancy strike you.
TEXT_FESVLT301_02419_SEQ_00:
Lisette de Valentione is awfully eager to share the love with you during this special season.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESVLT301_02419_SEQ_01:
Love is in the air and that can mean only one thing: Lisette de Valentione is back, trusty retainers in tow, and ready to aid those in need of romantic succor. After giving you a brief explanation of Valentione's Day, she bids you speak with Hortefense in Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre, in the hope that he might teach you how to express your true feelings.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESVLT301_02419_SEQ_02: As Lisette promised, Hortefense gives you a demonstration of a charming new way for you to express yourself. After more than a few unremarkable attempts, you finally succeed in perfecting your technique. Now, equipped with one of the more potent kisses in the realm, it is time to seek out your special someone.
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_SEQ_00:
Hortefense has the look of a man with a plan.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_SEQ_01:
Hortefense encourages you to practice your newly acquired smooching skills on the proprietors of each Adventurers' Guild, in the hope that the experience will ready you for your one true love. You make tracks for the Carline Canopy, to share some festive feelings with friends─although your method of expressing said sentiments may not be quite what they were expecting.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_SEQ_02: Upon arriving at the Carline Canopy, you promptly set about blowing a barrage of kisses at your guildmaster of choice. Unsurprisingly, this doesn't go down quite as smoothly as a simple handshake might have. Nevertheless, you are confident the message was received and set off for your next destination: the Quicksand.
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_SEQ_03: Much like in Gridania, the guildmaster you express your gratitude to in the Quicksand is somewhat confounded, but ultimately flattered by your actions. It is up to you whether or not you decide to think up a slightly more conventional way of sharing your thanks, or simply double down on blowing kisses. You ponder this weighty issue as you head for the Drowning Wench.
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_SEQ_04: Love is more than a feeling, which is something the guildmasters well and truly know by this point. Some of them even begin to wonder if you haven't gone a bit strange in the head, but all misunderstandings are sorted out in the end. Having visited all three proprietors' establishments, you return to Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre to regale Hortefense with tales of your oh-so-romantic travels.
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_SEQ_05: Hortefense is delighted to hear that you have gone to great pains to master the time-honored House Valentione art of doting, and declares you free to go forth and capture the heart of your special someone. If you still don't feel confident in your ability to dote, mayhap you should try visiting your favored guildmaster─or masters─again before the season comes to a close.
TEXT_FESEST301_02421_SEQ_00:
Jihli Aliapoh would have you participate in the Hatching-tide celebration.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESEST301_02421_SEQ_01:
Hatching-tide, that most eggcentric of festivals, has returned to Eorzea. This year Jihli Aliapoh has seen a vision of a hovering egg, from which a chocobo emerges to startle people before going on to lay a magnificent, dazzling gemstone. If you would help Jihli recreate her vision, make your way to Hyrstmill in the North Shroud, where her friend and helper Nonotta awaits with detailed instructions.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESEST301_02421_SEQ_02: Nonotta tasks you with startling folk while riding a hovering egg of dubious origin, which she inadvertently reveals is an invention she calls the eggshilaration system. Realizing her error, she implores you to keep this fact to yourself lest you shatter Jihli's dreams.
TEXT_FESEST302_02422_SEQ_00:
Nonotta wants you to keep the truth of the eggshilaration system a secret, cross your heart and hope to die.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESEST302_02422_SEQ_01:
You promise Nonotta not to reveal the eggshilaration system's true nature to Jihli. Her mind set at ease, she turns her attention back to the festivities, and directs you to speak with her fellow Dreamer Motte when you are ready to ride on eggback.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESEST302_02422_SEQ_02:
Motte gives you a rundown of the eggshilaration system's functionality, namely how to launch the shockobo. Hop on the egg now and use the shockobo on Nonotta.

※Speak with Motte at Hyrstmill to ride the eggshilaration system.
TEXT_FESEST302_02422_SEQ_03:
You use the shockobo on Nonotta, and it proves effective even on its creator, who shrieks out loud for the fright. Unfortunately, that effect was lost on Jihli, a result which has left Nonotta disheartened. For now, do your part in the festivities by seeking out three festival participants in the Twelveswood and startling them with the shockobo. Once you have three shock eggs for your troubles, deliver them to Nonotta.

※Speak with Motte at Hyrstmill to ride the eggshilaration system.
TEXT_FESEST302_02422_SEQ_04: You have startled three people and earned three shock eggs. Take them back to Nonotta at Hyrstmill.
TEXT_FESEST302_02422_SEQ_05: No sooner do you hand Nonotta the eggs than the three people you received them from come running up. In excited and appreciative tones, they tell of a rock-riding spriggan that gave them the shock of their lives. The news leaves Nonotta puzzled and perturbed, as spriggans aren't part of the plan. The creature in question has since headed to Gridania, and it seems likely that trouble will follow...
TEXT_FESEST303_02423_SEQ_00:
Nonotta needs your assistance to resolve an unforeseen spriggan problem.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESEST303_02423_SEQ_01:
A rock-riding spriggan, unknown to and unendorsed by Hatching-tide organizers, has taken to startling folk in the forest. The creature was last seen making for the city; should it cause a commotion there, the blame is like to fall upon the festival. Nonotta bids you return with her to Gridania in order to alert Jihli at Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESEST303_02423_SEQ_02: Jihli informs you that the spriggan has indeed come to Gridania and begun making mischief, startling townsfolk indiscriminately. At this rate, the Wood Wailers may be dispatched to hunt down the unwelcomed intruder. Dismayed by the prospect of violence, Jihli is determined to resolve the matter peacefully, and bids you reach out to the spriggan. Find the creature at Greatloam Growery and soothe him.
TEXT_FESEST303_02423_SEQ_03: You find the spriggan, one Riggy, greatly agitated, but succeed in calming him down. From what you can make of his limited vocabulary, the creature was merely mimicking your actions in hopes of making people happy. Jihli invites Riggy to be an official part of the festival, and together they head back to Hyrstmill. Make your own way there and speak with Nonotta to learn what manner of plans they have in store.
TEXT_FESEST303_02423_SEQ_04: According to Nonotta, Riggy is happily playing out in the forest. Having had his fill of startling, the spriggan now wishes to be startled for a change, and it falls to you to deal the shocks. Speak with Motte when you are ready to ride the egg and set about your task.
TEXT_FESEST303_02423_SEQ_05:
Motte helps you onto eggback and furnishes you further instructions. While on eggback, search for Riggy at his hiding place and startle him with the shockobo.

※Speak with Motte at Hyrstmill to ride the eggshilaration system.
TEXT_FESEST303_02423_SEQ_06:
You find and startle Riggy, much to his delight. Keen for another shock, the spriggan goes off to hide himself again. While on eggback, search for Riggy at his next hiding place and startle him with the shockobo.

※Speak with Motte at Hyrstmill to ride the eggshilaration system.
TEXT_FESEST303_02423_SEQ_07:
You find and startle Riggy again, and again the spriggan goes off to hide himself. While on eggback, search for Riggy at his last hiding place and startle him with the shockobo.

※Speak with Motte at Hyrstmill to ride the eggshilaration system.
TEXT_FESEST303_02423_SEQ_08: You find and startle Riggy for the third and last time. Though the spriggan is sad that the fun must end, he goes off well satisfied. Your task now complete, return to Hyrstmill and present your three hard-earned shock eggs to Nonotta.
TEXT_FESEST303_02423_SEQ_09: You show Nonotta your haul of shock eggs, after which Riggy arrives with other festival helpers in tow. Reflecting upon recent events, Jihli experiences an epiphany: the gemstone in her dream is none other than Riggy, who rode atop his magnificent rock and spread dazzling smiles to those around him. Grateful for your part in making her vision a reality, she spontaneously decides to gift you the eggshilaration system. Loath to part with her creation, Nonotta inadvertently reveals its secret, but much to her surprise, the truth impresses rather than upsets Jihli. After a tender moment, she undergoes a change of heart and gives you her blessing to be the proud owner of a hovering egg. May it bear you to all you have ever dreamed.
TEXT_FESGSC101_02424_SEQ_00:
This beggarly bloke seems to want for an ear to listen to his woes.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESGSC101_02424_SEQ_01:
The beggarly bloke jumps at the chance to start up a conversation, promptly regaling you with tiresome tales of his financial woes. Just as you reach for your coinpurse to toss him a gil and move on, he mentions that the Gold Saucer is currently hosting the Make It Rain campaign, an annual festival where guests have the chance to win magnificent prizes galore. Interest piqued, you make your way to the Ruby Road Exchange to find out more from the Saucer attendant.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESGSC101_02424_SEQ_02: The Saucer attendant has barely begun her explanation of the festivities when she is interrupted by none other than the Saucer's esteemed owner, Godbert Manderville. Greeting you with all the flair one would expect from a Manderville man, he offers you a limited-edition VIP card bearing the stamp of House Manderville. His duty done, Godbert returns to the Saucer and the attendant instructs you to present your card to Ollier in Wonder Square.
TEXT_FESGSC101_02424_SEQ_03: You show your VIP card to an enthusiastic Ollier, who informs you of the myriad of spectacular prizes now within your reach─should the Spinner smile upon you, of course. With clouds of untold riches billowing on the horizon, you stride confidently into the Saucer, knowing that the time has come to make it rain.
TEXT_FESNYR401_02425_SEQ_00:
The inu bugyo perks to attention at the sight of you.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESNYR401_02425_SEQ_01:
Upon the decks of Limsa Lominsa, you are fairly pounced upon by the inu bugyo, who relates to you his mission to foster the bonds of friendship between Eorzea and the Far East. To this end, he is hosting a Heavensturn celebration in the Far Eastern style, and requests your help in spreading the word. Aiding you in this task is Taro, a dog as clever as he is cute, who will give the locals a taste of the spectacle to come. No sooner is Taro introduced than he rushes off, eager to find crowds to please, and you spin on your heels after him.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESNYR401_02425_SEQ_02: Taro performs a trick to the delight of an onlooker, and you follow his efforts by giving her the particulars of the festival. His work here complete, the little dog goes off to find the next likely spot to win hearts.
TEXT_FESNYR401_02425_SEQ_03: Taro performs a trick for another onlooker, and you again speak your piece for the festival. His work here complete, the little dog goes off to find the next likely spot to win hearts.
TEXT_FESNYR401_02425_SEQ_04: The third time proves to be a curse; you are shocked to find Taro not being doted upon, but snarled at by a menacing dog and its equally menacing owner. The obnoxious man claims to belong to a band of pirates called the Rabid Wives, and makes his dislike of Taro abundantly plain, sending your canine companion scurrying away in fear. Though a part of you yearns to teach the brute a lesson in humility, you decide to give priority to Taro and report the incident to his master.
TEXT_FESNYR401_02425_SEQ_05: Shaken as Taro is, the inu bugyo fears he is in no state to perform. Even as it seems the festival must proceed with only advent cakes, the mochi daikan returns with grave tidings: the Rabid Wives have disrupted the mochi pounding by unleashing their deckhounds. As you make to hasten to the mochi's rescue, Taro lets out a beseeching whine; for all his trauma, he still wishes to be of help. And so you strike out together to save the festival, by participating in the FATE “Who Let the Hounds Out” in one of the following locations: southeast of the Zephyr Gate in middle La Noscea; east of the Salt Strand in lower La Noscea.
TEXT_FESNYR401_02425_SEQ_06: Owing to your timely assistance, the mochi has been saved. And for an unexpected but welcome turn, your show of bravery has inspired Taro to regain his former spirit. The inu bugyo will doubtless be pleased to hear of this.
TEXT_FESNYR401_02425_SEQ_07: Back in Limsa Lominsa, the festival has begun in earnest, and the citizens are enjoying their advent cakes and themselves. Alas, the Rabid Wives are not yet finished with their villainy, and they appear once more to disrupt the proceedings. This time, however, Taro refuses to be cowed, and he courageously confronts his deckhound nemesis. The sight of the little fellow standing up to a foe many times his size lights a fire in the hearts of festival participants, who band together to drive away the pirates. Upon seeing this display of unity between Eorzeans and Far Easterners, the mochi daikan declares this Heavensturn celebration a great success. As a token of his appreciation, the inu bugyo presents you with an inu kabuto, and you promise to rise to the mochi's defense again should the need arise.
TEXT_FESSUM301_02956_SEQ_00:
Mayaru Moyaru at the Aftcastle wishes to tell you all there is to be told of the Moonfire Faire.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESSUM301_02956_SEQ_01:
Mayaru Moyaru tells you that the Moonfire Faire is being held on the Isle of Endless Summer. Travel to the isle in eastern La Noscea and learn more from the faire's chaperone, Haermaga.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESSUM301_02956_SEQ_02: The Moonfire Faire aims to energize the Isle of Endless Summer and promote it as a new paradise resort. Things are going so exceedingly well, however, that some extra aid is needed. Speak with P'obyano on the isle to learn how you can help.
TEXT_FESSUM301_02956_SEQ_03: You are tasked with helping launch the maritime fireworks display. Speak with Jiriri on the Isle of Endless Summer to learn more about the festivities.
TEXT_FESSUM301_02956_SEQ_04: Use the summer firework on a firework mortar on the Isle of Endless Summer.
TEXT_FESSUM301_02956_SEQ_05: You used the summer firework on a firework mortar. Report back to P'obyano on the Isle of Endless Summer.
TEXT_FESSUM301_02956_SEQ_06: P'obyano tells you that Haermaga may know more of treasure spoken by those who saw your fireworks display. You have been asked to aid further in the Moonfire Faire efforts. Take a look around and help where help is needed.
TEXT_FESSUM302_02957_SEQ_00:
P'obyano requires an adventurer to aid in the fireworks festivities of the Moonfire Faire.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESSUM302_02957_SEQ_01:
P'obyano asks that you help light fireworks for the Moonfire Faire. Use the summer firework at three firework mortars located in the vicinity of the Isle of Endless Summer.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESSUM302_02957_SEQ_02: You used the summer firework on the firework mortars. Report back to P'obyano on the Isle of Endless Summer.
TEXT_FESSUM302_02957_SEQ_03: You took word of your deeds back to P'obyano. Speak to her again if you wish to help further with the Moonfire Faire fireworks.
TEXT_FESSUM303_02958_SEQ_00:
Hildelana is charged with provisioning all the food for the Moonfire Faire, but has bitten off more than she can chew.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESSUM303_02958_SEQ_01:
Hildelana asks that you prepare some battered fish for the faire. Obtain some and deliver it to her.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.

※Battered fish can be crafted as a culinarian, or purchased from the market boards.
TEXT_FESSUM303_02958_SEQ_02: You delivered the battered fish to Hildelana. Speak to her again if you wish to fulfill any other food orders for the Moonfire Faire.
TEXT_FESSUM304_02959_SEQ_00:
Beaudefoin is looking for adventurers to help him with his Moonfire Faire duties.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESSUM304_02959_SEQ_01:
Beaudefoin has asked you to fish up some fresh haddock. Catch three of them on the North Isle of Endless Summer and deliver them to him.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESSUM304_02959_SEQ_02: You caught three fresh haddock! Deliver them to Beaudefoin.
TEXT_FESSUM304_02959_SEQ_03: You delivered the fresh haddock to Beaudefoin. Speak to him again if you wish to aid in the provisioning of the Moonfire Faire.
TEXT_FESSUM305_02960_SEQ_00:
Haermaga wishes to know why you have seen fit to interrupt his faire duties.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESSUM305_02960_SEQ_01:
Haermaga promises to reveal all of the rumors of treasure after you earn seven Faire vouchers.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESSUM305_02960_SEQ_02: You delivered seven Faire vouchers to Haermaga. Wait for him at the designated location near the Isle of Endless Summer.
TEXT_FESSUM305_02960_SEQ_03: Haermaga tells you the rumor of a treasure hidden by Gegeruju that he himself is hunting. He has already learned of several places Gegeruju has visited on multiple occasions, and asks that you investigate one of them. Travel to the vantage point near the Isle of Endless Summer and discover what you can.
TEXT_FESSUM305_02960_SEQ_04: You discovered Gegeruju's spyglass. Travel to the vantage point near the Isle of Endless Summer and look through it to see what Gegeruju saw.
TEXT_FESSUM305_02960_SEQ_05: You surmise that vantage point is the perfect location from which to view faire-goers from afar. Deliver Gegeruju's spyglass to Haermaga and report your findings to him.
TEXT_FESSUM305_02960_SEQ_06: Haermaga plans to catch Gegeruju in the act and confront him directly, but first he must be found. Search for Gegeruju around the vantage point near the Isle of Endless Summer.
TEXT_FESSUM305_02960_SEQ_07: You discover Gegeruju in the act of watching faire-goers, and learn that he and Jiriri spread the rumors of treasure to attract more visitors to the isle. Return to Haermaga's post and speak with him once more about how best to handle the situation.
TEXT_FESSUM305_02960_SEQ_08: Haermaga determines that he and the others will continue to make the Moonfire Faire the most festive occasion they can, but will insist that Gegeruju resolve any problems that arise as a result of the treasure rumors. Be sure to lend Haermaga a hand wherever you can in the faire effort.
TEXT_FESANV301_02961_SEQ_00:
Nonora is seeking help in her search for a missing friend.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESANV301_02961_SEQ_01:
According to Nonora, a mechanical menace thought long since defeated has returned to disrupt the realm's celebration of remembrance. Hoping to resolve the matter quickly, and without incident, she enlisted the aid of the wandering minstrel who helped drive off these insectoid machines once before. Though there have been no sightings of the creatures for several days, the wandering minstrel has yet to return, causing Nonora to worry. She bids you venture to Nophica's Wells, where she last heard word from him, and see what you can find.

※Please note that you will not be able to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESANV301_02961_SEQ_02: Not long after arriving at Nophica's Wells you discover a strange aetherial rift near the water, as well as several metallic bugs strewn across the ground. Though he is nowhere in sight, you are certain this is the handiwork of the wandering minstrel. While you know naught of the origins of the void hovering silently above the bugs' remains, a closer examination of it may offer a clue as to the minstrel's whereabouts.
TEXT_FESANV301_02961_SEQ_03: No sooner do you approach the rift than you are hurtled through time and space into what appears to be a prison cell. Within this dark, dank chamber you at last find the wandering minstrel. Hopefully he has not come to harm.
TEXT_FESANV301_02961_SEQ_04: The wandering minstrel appears no worse for wear, but it seems he fell into a trap while carrying out his mission of exterminating the insectoid menace. Destroying the final bug triggered peculiar magicks that not only transported him to your present surroundings, but also stripped him of his ability to teleport. With no way out, he thought to examine the remains of a bug that followed him through the void. He deduced there is a secret command that, once uttered, will dispel the magicks that hold him there. He attempted to probe its mechanical mind but what he found was a complex labyrinth seemingly bereft of rhyme or reason. Having exhausted himself after days of searching, he asks that you take up the quest in his stead.
TEXT_FESANV301_02961_SEQ_05: After navigating the seemingly endless corridors of the insectoid's mind for what feels to be ages, you discover a pattern and soon ascertain the command that will grant the wandering minstrel his freedom. With a strum of his harp he utters the words and you are whisked away, but not back to Nophica's Well. You find yourself on a plane between time and space, and are soon confronted by one Naoki Yoshida...
TEXT_FESANV301_02961_SEQ_06: You open your eyes, and the figure before you is not Naoki Yoshida but the wandering minstrel. Was it all a dream? In any case, the both of you are returned to Eorzea safe and sound. Together you make for Ul'dah, lest Nonora grow sick with worry.
TEXT_FESANV301_02961_SEQ_07: Nonora's eyes grow wide with wonder as you regale her with your tale of rescue. With peace assured for the ongoing celebration, the minstrel offers you his thanks with a short tribute to your heroism in verse. The final note from his harp still hangs in the air as fireworks blossom in the skies above. The three of you bask in the warm glow of the illuminations, quietly offering prayers to those lost in the Calamity.
TEXT_FESXMS301_03009_SEQ_00:
Amh Garanjy needs your help to make a success of this year's Starlight Celebration.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESXMS301_03009_SEQ_01:
The land is filled with the merriment of the Starlight Celebration once again. Owing to a recent theft of decorations, however, the festival now suffers from a lack of staff, as many have been tasked with tracking down the perpetrators. Amh Garanjy bids you consult with Baenfaeld in Bentbranch Meadows if you wish to be of assistance.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESXMS301_03009_SEQ_02: The children of Bentbranch Meadows are inconsolable following the theft of the decorations they worked so hard to prepare. Luckily, Baenfaeld has a proposal. He and a trio of crimson-clad bears have been preparing a special treat for the festival, sure to bring a smile to one and all. Once you have chosen one of the three bears to act as your mount, the next part of the plan can be put into action.
TEXT_FESXMS301_03009_SEQ_03:
Having selected the right bear for the job, you are now ready to bring cheer to the local youngsters. Head to the location marked on the map, and throw a starburst while riding  to spread some festive joy.

※Speak with the Starlight Bear handler in Bentbranch Meadows to mount .
TEXT_FESXMS301_03009_SEQ_04:
The first attempt was a roaring success, met with smiles and laughter. The next in line to witness the bears' unique brand of merrymaking is a lad named Taff, over by the chocobo stables.

※Speak with the Starlight Bear handler in Bentbranch Meadows to mount .
TEXT_FESXMS301_03009_SEQ_05: Taff was somewhat impressed by the pyrotechnics, although not as delighted as the other children. It seems he has something weighing on his mind.
TEXT_FESXMS301_03009_SEQ_06: It would appear that Taff has vital information relating to the theft of the decorations. However, the other locals dismissed his account, despite his conviction. Needless to say, your adventurer's instincts compel you to follow this line of inquiry.
TEXT_FESXMS302_03010_SEQ_00:
Will Taff's testimony help solve the mystery of the stolen decorations?
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESXMS302_03010_SEQ_01:
It appears that treants stole the Starlight Celebration decorations, and the wandering pilgrim saw them heading southward. Baenfaeld has gone to Galvanth's Spire to scout ahead, and you agree to rendezvous with him there.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESXMS302_03010_SEQ_02: Baenfaeld reveals that the treants have converged at the Mirror Planks. Speak with the Starlight Bear handler stationed by the Mirror Planks to proceed to the next phase of the plan.
TEXT_FESXMS302_03010_SEQ_03:
The Starlight Bear handler requests you ride your trusted bear once more, and use starbursts to halt the treants in their tracks.

※Participate in the FATE “Bad Luck Comes in Trees” to apprehend the culprits.

※Speak with the Starlight Bear handler near the Mirror Planks to mount .
TEXT_FESXMS302_03010_SEQ_04: The treants have been subdued. It is time to return to Bentbranch Meadows and tell Taff the good news.
TEXT_FESXMS302_03010_SEQ_05: Taff is delighted to hear from Baenfaeld and yourself that most of the treants have been caught and the majority of the decorations recovered. Your efforts have contributed greatly to the case of the stolen Starlight Celebration goods, but several treants still evade capture. There may yet be need of your services.
TEXT_FESHLW401_03011_SEQ_00:
An investigator for the Adventurers' Guild appears to be more than a little concerned.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESHLW401_03011_SEQ_01:
It is a day like any other in Gridania, except that a wolfman from Doma has wandered into the city and expressed a desire to join the Continental Circus. Said circus is, of course, no place for any good-hearted individual─beastman or otherwise─and the investigator is desperate to save the Lupin from a life of devilry. For lack of a better plan, he begs you to join the Continental Circus along with the Doman traveler.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESHLW401_03011_SEQ_02: Soga, the Lupin come from distant Doma, is pleased to make your acquaintance and pleasantly surprised that you do not regard him with fear and uncertainty like so many others. He explains that he wishes to turn his uncommon appearance to his advantage by joining the troupe, where he believes he will be welcomed with open arms and be rich in “nakama” or some such. Yet all who wish to become a member of the Continental Circus must first receive the blessing of the Impresario...
TEXT_FESHLW401_03011_SEQ_03: The Impresario is delighted to receive you and Soga, stating that he is more than willing to permit you to join. First, however, you must complete a simple task. To wit, you must frighten several Gridanians for reasons the Impresario is quick to obfuscate. While Soga may use his gods-given gifts to accomplish this, you must rely on other means provided by the Continental Circus: a guise of the werewolf, which you may use to assume a rather more beastly form!
TEXT_FESHLW402_03012_SEQ_00:
The Impresario's eyes gleam with hungry expectation.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESHLW402_03012_SEQ_01:
That you may strike fear into the hearts of the people of Gridania more effectively, the Impresario has furnished you with a guise of the wolf. Before you can begin your campaign of terror, he asks that you present yourself to him in your full wolflike splendor. To wit, you must equip a werewolf head, a werewolf body, a pair of werewolf arms, and a pair of werewolf bottoms, which may be obtained from a werewolf attire coffer.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESHLW402_03012_SEQ_02: The Impresario declares you to be a hideous, monstrous abomination, with a true gift for horror. With his blessing, you may now go forth and spread terror together with Soga.
TEXT_FESHLW402_03012_SEQ_03: If you wish to do something right, you must give it your very all. So believes Soga, who encourages you to make a feral growl of some sort to maximize your fear potential. With the chat mode in Say, use your keyboard or the software keyboard to enter “GRRR!” to frighten your first victim.
TEXT_FESHLW402_03012_SEQ_04: Soga's suggestion works like a charm, and the man is duly frightened by your growl. Emboldened, the Lupin proposes that you make a game of it by attempting to scare three more Gridanians apiece. Once again, with the chat mode in Say, use your keyboard or the software keyboard to enter “GRRR!” to frighten three more residents of the city.
TEXT_FESHLW402_03012_SEQ_05: Sneaking up behind people and growling in their general direction has proven to be a reliable way of eliciting a terrified response─at least in your experience. But has Soga enjoyed the same success as you?
TEXT_FESHLW402_03012_SEQ_06: It would seem that Soga had more and more difficulty scaring the people of Gridania as time went on, perhaps because they had grown more accustomed to his Lupin features. In any event, the many people with whom you interacted expressed an interest in acquiring werewolf costumes of their own, which should doubtless please the Impresario.
TEXT_FESHLW402_03012_SEQ_07: The Impresario is delighted to have received so many Gridanians eager to join in the revels by dressing as wolves like you did. When Soga overhears him speaking of a “Night of Devilry,” however, the Impresario asserts that he was only speaking of the “Light of Equality”─a rather nebulous ideal or some such─and quickly takes his leave, assuring you and Soga that he will provide formal contracts for you both to join the Continental Circus at some point in the near future. Whatever the troupe's true objectives, the people of Gridania and Soga seem to be satisfied. One can only hope that the Adventurers' Guild investigator will be as well.
TEXT_FESHLW402_03012_SEQ_08: Regardless of the circumstances which led to this particular resolution, the investigator is glad to hear that Soga is no longer interested in joining the Continental Circus, and that the people of Gridania are no longer fearful of wolfmen. While the haunted manor is still of concern, the investigator promises that he and his comrades will keep an eye on it and ensure that no Nights of Devilry come to pass.
TEXT_FESHLW403_03013_SEQ_00:
An investigator for the Adventurers' Guild has a lingering worry on his mind.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESHLW403_03013_SEQ_01:
The Adventurers' Guild investigator has recently heard that the preparations for the Continental Circus's haunted manor are now complete. Admittedly, given the failure of the troupe's plans in stoking the fears of the populace, this development is of less concern than before, but if you have a mind to investigate, a certain illusionist can tell you more.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESHLW403_03013_SEQ_02: Though exhausted from having to distribute guises of the werewolf to the public day and night, the illusionist is pleased to confirm that the haunted manor is indeed now open to the public. Should you wish to experience the manor's “amusements” for yourself, you need only seek out one the troupe's harlequin guides.
TEXT_FESNYR501_03014_SEQ_00:
The inoshishi bugyo is in need of a helping hand.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESNYR501_03014_SEQ_01:
A delegation led by the inoshishi bugyo has come from the Far East in the hopes of sharing their customs with the people of Eorzea during the coming Heavensturn festival. For reasons unbeknownst to him, however, the people of Limsa Lominsa have failed to show even the faintest glimmer of interest. To that end he turns to you, an adventurer native to Eorzea, in the hopes of winning the townsfolk over. Together with his faithful boar, Ibukimaru, he asks you to spread word of their plans for the festival, and the advent cakes that will be handed out to any who should come to partake in their revelry.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESNYR501_03014_SEQ_02: You find Ibukimaru in the company of a potential celebrant, though it is plain he cares not for the boar's affectionate glances. His discomfort soon gives way to enthusiasm, however, when you explain the bugyo's plans for Heavensturn. Before taking his leave, he asks if you are certain about this year's totem animal. As he tells it, word has spread about town that it is the year of the cat. Hopefully this rumor has not yet spread too far.
TEXT_FESNYR501_03014_SEQ_03: Ibukimaru's attention is drawn next to a melancholy maiden, all by her lonesome. Upon hearing of the Heavensturn celebration, a glimmer of hope returns to her eyes, for she was all but certain the event had been canceled. She quickly takes her leave, thoughts likely swimming with thoughts of rice cakes, but the cause for her misunderstanding remains a mystery.
TEXT_FESNYR501_03014_SEQ_04: You catch up to Ibukimaru and discover him in the company of a rather disgruntled Roegadyn who asks for assistance in doing away with your boar companion. When you tell him Ibukimaru is part of the Heavensturn celebration, he is utterly flabbergasted. It seems someone convinced him the boar had caused a commotion so great the festival was called off. The inoshishi bugyo is sure to take comfort in knowing these untruths have been exposed.
TEXT_FESNYR501_03014_SEQ_05: While relieved by your report, the inoshishi bugyo is at a loss as to who would try to sabotage the festival. Enter the neko bugyo. He believes the cat has been denied its rightful place as a totem animal and intends to seek his revenge by ruining this year's celebration. In fact, he claims to have made powerful allies in Eorzea who will help see his plans come to fruition. No sooner does he take his leave than the mochi daikan arrives bearing terrible news. The mochi pounding sites are under siege by strange, feline creatures, and with no mochi for advent cakes, there can be no festival. And so you set out to save the mochi by participating in the FATE “A Mochi Catastrophe” in one of the following locations: southeast of the Zephyr Gate in middle La Noscea; east of the Salt Strand in lower La Noscea.
TEXT_FESNYR501_03014_SEQ_06: Amidst flying fur and perilous pounding, you somehow emerge unscathed with sufficient mochi for the bugyo's advent cakes. He is certain to be relieved to hear this.
TEXT_FESNYR501_03014_SEQ_07: Thanks to your efforts, the Heavensturn celebration is off to a rousing start, but the neko bugyo is not yet willing to admit defeat. When his gaelicat cohort fails to come to his aid, however, he collapses to the ground, lamenting the shattered dreams of cats everywhere. He begins to reminisce about a simpler time, when all he wanted was to share his love of cats with the world. Suddenly inspired by this stroll down memory lane, he proclaims he will see that dream realized, even if it requires nefarious means to do so. The neko bugyo then takes his leave, vowing revenge against the boar come next Heavensturn. A pity it will not be next year's totem animal. Nevertheless, this year's festival is safe, and the people of Limsa Lominsa can celebrate in peace.
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_SEQ_00:
Nonotta needs your assistance in solving a Hatching-tide hiccup.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_SEQ_01:
Nonotta recruits you to help her with a Hatching-tide conundrum. According to the distressed Lalafell, Jihli has been denied her customary prophetic dream this year and thus the Dreamers have settled for arranging an egg hunt around town. The festival eggs in question, however, appear to have been stolen. Join forces with the Hatching-tide hunter near the Greatloam Growery, and see what can be done to save the celebrations.

※Please note that you will not be able to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_SEQ_02: You meet with the Hatching-tide hunter, and launch an investigation into the missing eggs. Follow the festival cap-bedecked tracker's advice, and begin your search for clues in the vicinity of the Botanists' Guild.
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_SEQ_03: You have uncovered several traces of the egg thief. Rendezvous with the Hatching-tide hunter, and deliver the material clues you recovered from the scene.
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_SEQ_04: After reviewing the evidence at hand, the Hatching-tide hunter seems convinced that a spriggan is responsible for the missing festival eggs. Follow on the heels of your fellow investigator, and head in the direction the tracks appear to lead: the Yellow Serpent Gate.
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_SEQ_05: You arrive at the Yellow Serpent Gate to find that the tracker has already captured a suspicious, egg-carrying spriggan. Even as you discuss the need for further interrogation, however, a Miqo'te mender arrives and vehemently insists that this spriggan is innocent. Following a brief explanation of their own efforts to retrieve the stolen goods, the conjurer convinces you to guide “Riggy” on another foray into the true thief's lair. Speak with the Miqo'te mender again when you are ready to attempt her linkpearl strategy.
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_SEQ_06: Thanks to your expert guidance, Riggy's raid on the spriggan lair is a resounding success. Take your spoils, and deliver them to the waiting Nonotta at Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre.
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_SEQ_07: You make your egg delivery to Nonotta, and it seems at first that the case has been brought to a close. But while a spriggan was indeed responsible for spiriting away the eggs, the Hatching-tide hunter deduces that the true mastermind behind the events was none other than Jihli Aliapoh herself! Jihli happily confesses to the crime, and explains how her deceit was in fact inspired by one of her prophetic dreams. Recreating her vision this year is a door to unexpected encounters, and she would have your assistance in organizing the egg hunt which is to follow...
TEXT_FESEST402_03080_SEQ_00:
Jihli requests your assistance with the Hatching-tide egg hunt.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESEST402_03080_SEQ_01:
Jihli has hinted that the egg hunt will act as a catalyst for festival-goers to enjoy their own unexpected encounters. Take the basket holding the Hatching-tide egg and hide it near the Lancers' Guild.

※Please note that you will not be able to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESEST402_03080_SEQ_02: You leave the egg-laden basket nestled amongst the other Hatching-tide decorations. Wait nearby, and witness the events which unfold.
TEXT_FESEST402_03080_SEQ_03: You look on as your carefully placed basket becomes the locus upon which two disparate paths converge. Return to Jihli, and describe the scene which took place.
TEXT_FESEST402_03080_SEQ_04: Jihli is delighted to hear your recounting of the serendipitous exchange. The way the Dreamer tells it, however, there are more unexpected encounters just waiting to hatch...
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_SEQ_00:
Lisette de Valentione requires help with a matter close to her heart.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_SEQ_01:
Valentione's Day, that celebration of ardor and affection, is come to Eorzea once more, and the indomitable Lisette de Valentione has returned to spread the message of love across the land. This year, she and her crew are collaborating with the Sanctum of the Twelve to deliver an all-new experience in matchmaking, and she cordially invites you to participate before seamlessly transitioning into a request. She asks that you lend a hand to a trainee named Astrid, whom she worries is too sober and rational to discharge her duties. If you have a mind to oblige, you will find the girl nearby at Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_SEQ_02: A few sentences into your acquaintance, Astrid reveals that her preparation for the affinity test has stalled. The three moogles tasked with setting up the venue have abandoned their work, and at this rate the event cannot begin. It falls to you to seek out the moogles and discover the reason behind their untimely desertion.
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_SEQ_03: You speak with each of the moogles in turn, and they all blame their lack of motivation on Astrid's affinity test, which they complain is “stiff and dry,” “all remonstrance and no romance,” and “dull and uninspired.” Yet in spite of their insistence─or perhaps because of it─you cannot shake the sense that laziness is also a factor. Thus informed, you turn your steps back to Astrid.
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_SEQ_04: Astrid is distraught to learn that her affinity test is looked upon so unfavorably by her own helpers. Nevertheless, she is determined to rectify the issues raised and make the test fit for public enjoyment. Here, Hortefense shamelessly maneuvers himself into the conversation and suggests that you turn to a moogle for advice. Though loath to accept any sort of help from her brother-in-law, Astrid concedes that he speaks true, and together you set off to find Kuplu Kumu, the leader of the Sanctum choir.
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_SEQ_05: Upon being apprised of the situation, Kuplu Kumu confesses that he had anticipated a problem with the affinity test. Whereas Astrid attempted to bring tangibility to love, love is anything but tangible. From the moogle's words, Astrid comes to understand that what her test needs is a dose of fun. While she and Kuplu Kumu discuss ways to improve it, you are tasked with rounding up the three lazy moogles. They are like to be found over by the Leatherworkers' Guild, their preferred place for being unproductive.
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_SEQ_06: Though initially uncooperative, the moogles respond well to your magic words. Together they flutter off back to Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre, and you follow in their wingbeats.
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_SEQ_07: Astrid happily reports that, thanks to Kuplu Kumu's input, her affinity test has been brought up to acceptable standards of fun. Furthermore, the three moogles have returned and promptly completed their work on the venue. All that remains, then, is to have a couple actually trial the test, henceforth known as the Valentione's Ceremony, and Astrid would have you and your chosen partner do the honors. When you are ready, the House Valentione servant will escort you to the venue. At the ceremony's conclusion, you will receive a Valentione's Day chocolate, which Astrid bids you bring to her.
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_SEQ_08: The trial ceremony is concluded, and you return to Astrid with the Valentione's Day chocolate. Satisfied with the results, she declares the ceremony ready to be opened to the public. Offering you her heartfelt thanks, Astrid assures you that she will be fine from here on. Your work is done; time to report back to Lisette.
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_SEQ_09: Lisette is pleased to hear that all has gone well with her little sister, whom she wishes to be independent. And when Astrid returns with news of the ceremony's positive reception, Lisette takes the opportunity to declare her traineeship complete. Astrid's experiences this day will doubtless make her into a fine emissary, and you take pride in the knowledge that you were a part of her journey. May she succeed in her mission to till the fields of love within people's hearts.
TEXT_FESVLT402_03083_SEQ_00:
Lisette would inform you of an event back by popular demand.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESVLT402_03083_SEQ_01:
With her customary glee, Lisette informs you that the fortune-tellers from a previous year's celebration are back to offer couples a glimpse of their future together. If you wish to avail yourself of their services, form a party with one other adventurer and go before each of them in turn.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESVLT402_03083_SEQ_02: You and your chosen partner now know your potential for great riches, grand adventure, and genuine love. Time to report back to Lisette, who will be eager to hear how you fared.
TEXT_FESVLT402_03083_SEQ_03:
Lisette reminds you that, whether the outlook is promising or no, it is not the be-all and end-all. What matters most is taking your first step on the long journey of love.
...Of course, if you so wish it, you can always ask Lisette for another telling of your fortune.
TEXT_FESPDY401_03084_SEQ_00:
This reporter from the Mythril Eye seems eager to ask you a question.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESPDY401_03084_SEQ_01:
A reporter from the Mythril Eye is stopping all passersby to take a survey about this year's Little Ladies' Day celebration, and that includes you. As he tells it, Ul'dah is abuzz with talk of the festivities planned, the main event being a special performance by the Songbirds. After taking note of your thoughts on the matter, he encourages you to speak with the royal seneschal over on Emerald Avenue to learn more.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESPDY401_03084_SEQ_02: The royal seneschal is heartened by your enthusiasm to take part in the performance. But you cannot join without first being properly dressed for the occasion. He explains to you that everyone who attends will require a special set of garments and illuminations, offering you a promissory note to redeem a set for yourself. The royal seneschal then sends you off to the Weavers' Guild and Alchemists' Guild, eagerly awaiting your return.
TEXT_FESPDY401_03084_SEQ_03: After a brief visit to the Weavers' and Alchemists' guilds, you are now the proud owner of three stylish Songbird ensembles and a set of illuminated rods. The royal seneschal will be glad to hear you procured them without incident.
TEXT_FESPDY401_03084_SEQ_04:
With your costume and lights in hand, all you need do now is wait for the show to begin. Until then, the royal seneschal offers to hold onto your newly acquired raiments and instructs you to speak with the royal handmaiden to better prepare for the performance. 

※To participate in the FATE, you must first speak with the royal handmaiden on Emerald Avenue and receive the “Face in the Crowd” status effect.
TEXT_FESPDY401_03084_SEQ_05: Ul'dah is alive with the sound of music, and you helped make it possible. Though the show is over, the energy in the air is palpable. A pity the royal seneschal's duties kept him away from the merrymaking. He would no doubt be glad to hear your impressions of the Songbirds's performance.
TEXT_FESPDY401_03084_SEQ_06: The royal seneschal is expressing his gratitude for your taking time to see the Songbirds when they happen to pass by. They each offer you a heartfelt thanks before making a quick exit to prepare for their next show. The support of the people of Ul'dah has helped the Songbirds reach new heights in their musical prowess, but the celebration is far from finished. The streets continue to echo with their sweet birdsong. Should you be interested in seeing them perform once more, you can be certain they will be looking for you in the crowd.
TEXT_FESPDY402_03085_SEQ_00:
The royal seneschal seems deeply upset despite the jovial atmosphere.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESPDY402_03085_SEQ_01:
The Songbirds continue to fill the streets with sweet melodies. Far removed from the glowing lights and cheers of the crowd before them, however, they spied an unexpected sight─a young girl sulking by her lonesome, seemingly lost. Knowing they cannot abandon their tight schedule of performances, the royal seneschal turns to you for help in locating this wayward soul.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESPDY402_03085_SEQ_02: You find a young girl near the Gate of Nald, sullen and withdrawn. She has lost a gift from her parents─a necklace and pair of earrings─and is too racked with worry to enjoy the day's festivities. Your offer to search for them in her stead is met with disbelief followed by heartfelt gratitude. She tells you she remembers where they were lost, but rather than explain in words, she draws you a picture of the location. With her artwork in hand, you exit the gate out into central Thanalan.
TEXT_FESPDY402_03085_SEQ_03: Finding a vista resembling the young girl's drawing was no easy task, but eventually a familiar view catches your eye. Indeed, you have found the correct locale, and an inspection of the area turns up a necklace and earrings. They are so old and worn, however, you question if they are what you were sent to find. The only thing left to do is return to Ul'dah and see if the jewelry you found is truly hers.
TEXT_FESPDY402_03085_SEQ_04: The young girl is overcome with joy at the sight of the jewelry. She is taken by the ardor with which you came to her aid, saying she at last knows what it means to be treated as a princess for a day. Before leaving to join in the Little Ladies' Day celebration, she makes a final request: deliver her necklace and earrings to a man named Tobyn at Crescent Cove.
TEXT_FESPDY402_03085_SEQ_05: Tobyn takes the jewelry in hand and quickly turns pale. After you explain what brought you out to Crescent Cove, he hesitantly concludes that the young girl you encountered was the spirit of his late aunt. She disappeared as a child on Little Ladies' Day, her family of the belief she was abducted and sold for some nefarious end. The reason for her ghostly visit to Ul'dah, he believes, is she never had the opportunity to enjoy Little Ladies' Day and be treated like a princess. But thanks to you, her unfinished business is complete. The royal seneschal will certainly be happy to hear the news.
TEXT_FESPDY402_03085_SEQ_06: The royal seneschal is shocked to hear of your paranormal encounter. Though he finds your story implausible, he takes solace in knowing the girl's spirit is finally at rest.
TEXT_FESGSC201_03133_SEQ_00:
This dismayed maiden has a horrifying story to tell about the Gold Saucer.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESGSC201_03133_SEQ_01:
Still trembling from her brush with the paranormal, a dismayed maiden tells you the Gold Saucer is now host to spirits from beyond. Fearing such a disturbance could force the establishment to close down, she pleads with you to seek out Godbert Manderville, owner of the Gold Saucer, and lend him your aid to deal with this otherworldly threat.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESGSC201_03133_SEQ_02: Godbert offers you a warm welcome, but quickly takes note of your grave expression. He wastes no time in telling you what he knows of the apparitions that have taken residence in the Saucer. Though he has yet to attain an accurate description of them, his staff claim they were last seen at Event Square.
TEXT_FESGSC201_03133_SEQ_03: A nearby patron, seemingly down on his luck, tells you of his plan to catch, not ghosts, but faeries he claims are hiding in the Saucer. He claims to have seen them heading in the direction of Wonder Square.
TEXT_FESGSC201_03133_SEQ_04: You find yet another patron whose story is more confusing than the last. He claims to have seen a pair of balloons traversing the halls toward Round Square in a rather lively fashion.
TEXT_FESGSC201_03133_SEQ_05: As you enter Round Square, you see a most unexpected sight. Not ghosts, faeries, or balloons, but moogles. Perhaps now you can ascertain the truth behind the Gold Saucer's troubles.
TEXT_FESGSC201_03133_SEQ_06: The moogles were, in fact, the otherworldly creatures that had both patrons and staff in a panic. Taking a keen interest in cultures other than their own, they could not resist the temptation of a festival at the Gold Saucer. They soon rush off to Entrance Square to apologize for the trouble they have caused.
TEXT_FESGSC201_03133_SEQ_07: You return to Entrance Square, the moogles in tow. Thankfully Godbert is not angry for their presence─far from it. He considers the moogles to be honored guests, and intends to waive away the recent happenings at the Saucer as part of the festival. He then takes his leave to inform the staff of their arrival, so that they may enjoy a day of mirth and merriment.
TEXT_FESGSC202_03134_SEQ_00:
This moogle suitor is in need of advice.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESGSC202_03134_SEQ_01:
The moogles are free to enjoy the sights and sounds of the Gold Saucer at their leisure. As the moogle maiden runs off, excited to begin their romp through the grounds, the moogle suitor makes a confession. The purpose for their coming to the Saucer is so he can ask for her paw in marriage. Before that can happen, however, he wishes to take her on the perfect romantic outing, and he needs your help. Having laid bare his plans, he rushes after his love to Event Square.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESGSC202_03134_SEQ_02: Their outing will begin with the Moogle's Paw. Or so they think. When they arrive, the machine is already in use. The moogle suitor suggests they patiently wait their turn, but so long as they remain hidden, the moogle maiden fears the patrons in front of them may never realize others are waiting. Fearing his lady love grows despondent, the moogle suitor excuses himself to seek your advice. He follows your words to the letter, and he seems to have pleased his companion as a result. Seeking a brief respite, they make for Wonder Square.
TEXT_FESGSC202_03134_SEQ_03: At last, they have a chance to rest. The view from the upper floor of Wonder Square is beautiful, and the moogle suitor intends to make the most of the moment. At a loss as to how to do that, he once again turns to you for sage council. Your plan seems to have worked. All things considered, the moogle maiden appears to be enjoying herself. They prepare to return to Entrance Square, where the moogle suitor plans to make a bold move.
TEXT_FESGSC202_03134_SEQ_04: You offer the moogle suitor a few final words of encouragement. Emboldened, he returns to the moogle maiden to profess his love, and ask her to marry him. The result is...not what you expected. But regardless of the dubious outcome, the couple is pleased with how the day turned out.
TEXT_FESGSC202_03134_SEQ_05: The moogle suitor did not woo his lady love as he had hoped, but he is not a quitter. As they plan to remain at the Gold Saucer a while longer, perhaps there is hope he will win her heart. With your help, of course.
TEXT_FESSUM401_03135_SEQ_00:
Mayaru Moyaru would invite you to prove your skills in the ultimate test of acrobatic aptitude.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESSUM401_03135_SEQ_01:
Another Moonfire Faire has come to Eorzea, its arrival marked by gaudy decorations and chaperones dressed in festival garb. While the event is celebrated throughout the realm, Mayaru Moyaru informs you that the main attraction awaits in Costa del Sol. However, he is suspiciously secretive as to the nature of this attraction, and it seems you will have to go and see it for yourself.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESSUM401_03135_SEQ_02: Upon arriving in Costa del Sol, you are greeted by the sight of several wooden structures. Haermaga, the grand chaperone of the Moonfire Faire, reveals that they form an obstacle course, the centerpiece of this year's festivities. The event organizers believe that the sight of Adventurers' Guild members risking life and limb to complete an increasingly difficult series of challenges will inspire the younger generation to one day become adventurers themselves. Haermaga waits patiently while you summon the courage needed to become an Eorzean Nimble Warrior.
TEXT_FESSUM401_03135_SEQ_03: Just as you are about to register to compete, a somewhat timid youth named R'fhul Tia and his little sister R'majha arrive. The older sibling states his intention to face the Eorzean Nimble Warrior course. However, only members of the Adventurers' Guild are allowed to enter. Despite lacking the necessary credentials, R'fhul Tia is able to convince Haermaga to bend the rules, on the condition that you go first to demonstrate the correct method for completing the course. Beaudefoin the chaperone stands at the foot of the wooden behemoth, ready to give the next set of instructions.
TEXT_FESSUM402_03136_SEQ_00:
Beaudefoin will be your guide on the path to becoming an Eorzean Nimble Warrior.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESSUM402_03136_SEQ_01:
Beaudefoin explains the simple rules of the Eorzean Nimble Warrior course. Each of the three sections is marshaled by a Moonfire Faire chaperone, to whom you must speak before proceeding any further. J'nangho is the first chaperone and can only be reached by a series of carefully measured leaps.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESSUM402_03136_SEQ_02: Upon witnessing your completion of the first test, J'nangho is pleased but not surprised by your success. She warns you that greater challenges must be overcome to arrive at Hildelana's platform at the end of the second section.
TEXT_FESSUM402_03136_SEQ_03: As you step onto the next stage of the course, the steep increase in difficulty is apparent from the outset. Each jump and balancing act is more perilous than the last, and you breathe a sigh of relief when you finally reach Hildelana. While she is clearly delighted that you have made it this far, she is nonetheless quick to impress on you that the worst is still to come...
TEXT_FESSUM402_03136_SEQ_04: Faced with the imposing final section of the course, you step forward with trepidation. Knowing that every leap could end in dismal failure, you feel as though your heart is in your throat as you slowly ascend the tower. At long last, the goal is in sight, and with one final jump, your triumph is secured. P'obyano the chaperone welcomes you with a beaming smile, and elated cheers can be heard from the spectators watching from Costa del Sol. There can be no doubt in the minds of the awed onlookers that the Adventurers' Guild boasts the most courageous, nimblest warriors Eorzea has ever seen.
TEXT_FESSUM403_03137_SEQ_00:
Haermaga wishes to shower you with praise, while R'fhul Tia prepares to tackle the obstacle course.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESSUM403_03137_SEQ_01:
Following your emphatic conquest of the Eorzean Nimble Warrior course, you return to Haermaga to share the good news. In light of your inspirational display, R'fhul Tia eagerly prepares for his own attempt. R'majha races ahead to find a spot from which the two of you can watch her brother's acrobatics.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESSUM403_03137_SEQ_02: Immediately after setting foot on the starting platform, R'fhul Tia charges forward to make the very first jump. Unfortunately, he possesses all the airborne grace of a sodden sponge and plunges unceremoniously in the water below. Fearing for his safety, R'majha rushes over to check on her crestfallen sibling.
TEXT_FESSUM403_03137_SEQ_03: After dragging himself to shore, R'fhul Tia regains his composure and tries to hide his embarrassment with laughter. His sister takes offense at this and storms off without explaining the reason for her anger. As you and R'fhul Tia continue the conversation without her, she disappears from view entirely. Realizing she is now missing, R'fhul Tia asks you to help search for her.
TEXT_FESSUM403_03137_SEQ_04: You eventually find R'majha on the eastern shore, having covered a surprising distance in such a short time. Her excursion has done nothing to brighten her mood, and she stubbornly refuses to talk to her brother. R'fhul Tia suggests splashing her with water to help ease the tension.
TEXT_FESSUM403_03137_SEQ_05: The splashes of cold sea water do the trick, setting R'majha to giggling and washing away her black mood. She explains her frustration at seeing her brother's jovial reaction to his abysmal performance on the obstacle course. R'fhul Tia has long claimed it his dream to become an adventurer, and as such, his sister expected him to treat the contest more seriously. She also expresses concern about his plans to leave home in search of fame and fortune. R'fhul Tia assures her that although he may be parted from his family, he will not place himself in unnecessary danger and will return safe and well. Once you are satisfied that the matter has been concluded, you return to Haermaga.
TEXT_FESSUM403_03137_SEQ_06: Haermaga is visibly moved to hear that R'fhul Tia decided to become an adventurer after he witnessed the guild's acts of heroism at a previous Moonfire Faire. He thanks you for your various contributions and invites you to enjoy the remainder of the festival.
TEXT_FESANV401_03138_SEQ_00:
Dural Tharal is eyeing you eagerly.

※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESANV401_03138_SEQ_01:
Dural Tharal, renowned reporter for the Mythril Eye, has solicited your help in what promises to be a splendid story. The Immortal Flames will soon be hosting “The Calamity Retold,” military exercises which draw from the lessons of the imperial invasion that took place years past. The Lalafell plans to interview people about their experiences of that time, and bids you accompany him that you might offer your unique perspective on the matter. The first stop is the Hall of Flames, where you will meet with an officer of the order.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESANV401_03138_SEQ_02: According to the flame commander, the military exercises are intended to cultivate awareness of the Garlean threat within citizens, many of whom have forgotten how close Ul'dah came to becoming a battlefield during the Calamity. Then, it was only by the valor of audacious adventurers that the city was spared, and the commander hopes that the Immortal Flames may continue to rely upon you and yours. The first interview thus concluded, Dural Tharal bids you join him at the Pugilists' Guild for the next.
TEXT_FESANV401_03138_SEQ_03: At the Pugilists' Guild, you hear an account of the imperial invasion from a fellow adventurer, who speaks of the Garleans' use of propaganda to sow panic. And while the tactic succeeded in weakening the wills of some, in others it served only to strengthen the spirit of resistance─a spirit that still lives on today. Satisfied with the fruits of this interview, Dural Tharal sets off for the Thaumaturges' Guild, there to meet with another who lived through the horrors of the Calamity.
TEXT_FESANV401_03138_SEQ_04: Her eyes glazing over, the careworn thaumaturge recounts her experience in the foreboding days leading up to the Calamity. As the red moon Dalamud drew closer, its dark influence unleashed hordes of voidsent upon the land. But as they did the imperial invaders, adventurers again rose to contend with this threat and protect the people. The thaumaturge takes her leave, but not before expressing her gratitude and respect for all of adventurerkind. The next interview is the last, and Dural Tharal turns his steps towards the Gate of the Sultana, where he will speak with a long-serving Brass Blade.
TEXT_FESANV401_03138_SEQ_05: A veteran of the Battle of Carteneau, the unassuming Brass Blade attributes his survival to two things: dumb luck and brave adventurers, the latter of whom intercepted an imperial unit en route to flank Eorzean forces. The man then returns to his post, but not before joining his voice to the chorus of gratitude for adventurers. With that, Dural Tharal's interviewing comes to an end, and he asks that you accompany him back on the Ruby Road Exchange.
TEXT_FESANV401_03138_SEQ_06: Thanking you for your honest opinion of the interviews, Dural Tharal declares that he will next seek out a mysterious minstrel who is strumming out songs about the Calamity. Should this be of interest to you, the reporter invites you to join him at the end of the Ruby Road Exchange, where the musician has set his stage.
TEXT_FESANV401_03138_SEQ_07: Having greeted you warmly, the wandering minstrel begins caressing his lyre, drawing forth notes at once sad and sweet. As the song resounds in your mind, you are whisked away to a place beyond the reach of time and space. Before you stands a strange yet familiar figure─a man named Naoki Yoshida, who offers you profuse thanks for your tireless efforts in making the world a better place. Scarcely do you begin to gather your thoughts, however, than your visit to this realm comes to an end, and you find yourself on the Ruby Road Exchange once more, batting your eyelids to the sound of Dural Tharal's vigorous clapping. After the reporter leaves, the minstrel favors you with another song, one whose cryptic words confound even as they seem to speak to you. Thankfully, the minstrel's parting message is less cryptic: even as we keep our gaze upon the future, let us never forget those we have lost. For it is their memory that gives us the strength to carry on.
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_SEQ_00:
Kipih Jakkya has caught the scent of a story and needs help chasing it down.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_SEQ_01:
Kipih Jakkya, reporter for The Raven, tells you about a rumor that has been making its rounds of late. Apparently, an unusual black vehicle has been sighted in Thanalan along with peculiar mechanical soldiers, and there is growing concern that they may be some unknown type of Garlean weaponry. Kipih petitions your assistance to pen her story, and in case you should be amenable, she directs you to the vicinity of Black Brush, where the black vehicle was most recently sighted.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_SEQ_02: At Black Brush, you come upon the black vehicle and its owner, a young man by the name of Noctis, who appears to be very far from home. His vehicle, the Regalia, has broken down, and he is relieved to learn that you know people who might be able to repair it. Soon after, you are joined by a crew from Garlond Ironworks and Cid himself, who promises to do his best with the Regalia. It then transpires that not only is Noctis acquainted with the mechanical soldiers, which he calls magitek troopers, but that both he and his automated adversaries hail from a world entirely different from your own. At Cid's suggestion, Noctis goes off to search for the magitek troopers in hopes of finding a way to return home. Follow Noctis and help him to defeat the magitek troopers by participating in the FATE “Like Clockwork” at the Clutch in central Thanalan.
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_SEQ_03: You and Noctis encounter a squad of magitek troopers and promptly vanquish them, along with a towering warmachina that had somehow managed to escape notice till now. The task thus concluded, Noctis turns his steps towards Black Brush, and you follow on his heels.
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_SEQ_04: On the road, Noctis laments that while the enemies indeed came from his world, they offered no clues as to how he might make his way back. For now, the two of you decide to return to the Regalia before seeking further help.
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_SEQ_05: After hearing about your battle with the magitek troopers, Cid expresses his interest in examining their technology, and bids you salvage their parts from future encounters. These parts may be delivered to one of the Ironworks hands posted at Black Brush and in each of the three city-states. Just as Cid is explaining that he had moved the Regalia to keep it away from prying eyes, Kipih Jakkya arrives on the scene and begins bombarding Noctis with questions. In exchange for receiving help to find his way home, Noctis agrees to an exclusive interview, and he sets out for Ul'dah with Kipih.
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_SEQ_06: Arriving in Ul'dah at the interview's conclusion, you learn that Noctis had been traveling with his comrades on his way to meet his beloved fiancée. Satisfied with her harvest, Kipih reiterates her promise to help Noctis find the answers he seeks. At that moment, she receives a call from one of her colleagues, and turning back to you excitedly, she bids you and Noctis make ready for a journey on the trail of a hopeful lead.
TEXT_FESBKC002_03159_SEQ_00:
Kipih Jakkya is eager to set out with you and Noctis.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESBKC002_03159_SEQ_01:
Kipih informs you that there have been new sightings of mechanical soldiers in the Twelveswood. In order to ascertain the truth of these rumors, it is decided that you will head to Gridania to seek out eyewitnesses.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESBKC002_03159_SEQ_02: Upon arriving in Gridania, you proceed to make inquiries about the mechanical soldiers. While no one you speak with turns out to be an eyewitness, you are reasonably satisfied that the magitek troopers are indeed here in the Twelveswood. It is time to take your findings to Kipih, who awaits at Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre.
TEXT_FESBKC002_03159_SEQ_03: Based on your findings, Kipih believes that you should be able to find the magitek troopers if you were to keep watch at the Bramble Patch, in the East Shroud. Eager as ever, Noctis sets out immediately, and at Kipih's behest you hurry after him.
TEXT_FESBKC002_03159_SEQ_04: At the Bramble Patch, you are reunited with Noctis and begin lying in wait. As the night deepens, a bloodcurdling roar cuts through the silent gloom, and you hasten towards the sound to come face-to-face with a fell fiend. Though the creature is fearsome, working together with Noctis, you succeed in laying it low.
TEXT_FESBKC002_03159_SEQ_05: Noctis is perturbed that a daemon, a monster from his world, has also found its way to Eorzea. Taking your rest after the taxing battle, you trade tales over a simple camp meal and learn a little more about Noctis─and perhaps yourself as well.
TEXT_FESBKC002_03159_SEQ_06: Back in Gridania, Noctis is crestfallen at being unable to find a way home, but Kipih promises that she will keep working to uncover more leads. Not given to waiting around, Noctis goes off to explore Gridania, and Kipih bids you accompany him.
TEXT_FESBKC002_03159_SEQ_07: You find Noctis browsing the Black Rabbit Traders' stall; it appears he is quite taken by the fashion of Eorzea. Your visitor is keen to explore some more, and you are happy to oblige him.
TEXT_FESBKC003_03160_SEQ_00:
Noctis feels the need to unwind.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESBKC003_03160_SEQ_01:
Wishing to make the most of his time in Eorzea, Noctis declares that he will go fishing. He asks you to join him before heading off in the direction of the Jadeite Thick in the Central Shroud.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESBKC003_03160_SEQ_02: To the tranquil susurration of the forest, Noctis reveals to you his worry that he may never find his way home. Brief though it was, the fishing session helps to lift his spirits, and he finds his determination anew. You then turn your steps back to Gridania to rejoin Kipih, but not before taking something called a “photo” together as a memento.
TEXT_FESBKC003_03160_SEQ_03: You and Noctis return to the city to find Kipih in a flustered state. Apparently, magitek troopers have also appeared in Ixali territory, their presence alarming the beastmen and spurring them to summon forth their goddess, Garuda. Upon hearing the name, Noctis reveals that he vanquished a being by the same name back in his world, and is confident that the feat can be repeated here. While Kipih sets out to secure a loan of Cid's airship to bear you to the Howling Eye, Noctis bestows upon you his power─the ability to warp. Once your preparations are in order, you may proceed to the Carline Canopy, where Kipih will be waiting.
TEXT_FESBKC003_03160_SEQ_04: Arriving at the Howling Eye, you come face-to-face not with the Lady of the Vortex, but a creature bearing an uncanny resemblance to her. Recognizing Noctis as the Chosen King, the Garuda-like being proceeds to make trial of him─together with you as his comrade.
TEXT_FESBKC003_03160_SEQ_05: At the end of a turbulent struggle, you and Noctis emerge triumphant and are declared worthy. The divinity then opens a portal through which Noctis may return home, but not before Cid and Kipih make their entry with the newly repaired Regalia.
