Lisette cheerily explains to you that the votes have been all but counted, and announces that the winner of the contest is none other than Astrid. She bids you accompany Astrid as an unbiased observer, such that you might render a sound decision on her behalf. Astrid then instructs you to wait just beyond her arranged meeting spot with your masked client.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESVLT605_03756_SEQ_02: You accompany Astrid─newly minted as this year's emissary of love─to visit your heretofore masked client, who reveals himself to be none other than Guildmaster Ywain of Lancers' Guild fame. Though somewhat skeptical, he takes her suggestion to expand his horizons to heart, and the two of them make their way to the Leatherworkers' Guild where Ywain is scheduled to deliver a shipment of animal hides. Upon their arrival the all-too-serious soldier promptly manages to make a fool of himself by confessing his search for love to Guildmaster Geva. As she eyes Ywain in a manner that suggests she wants to turn his hide into a sack, the three of you are joined by none other than the notorious naturalist Marcette. Spying the collection of rare animal skins in Ywain's possession, she swiftly volunteers him to be her newest research assistant, whisking him off to parts unknown without so much as a second thought.
TEXT_FESVLT605_03756_SEQ_03: Her mission to introduce Ywain to a member of the fairer sex accomplished─at least, in the most charitable sense of the word─Astrid suggests that the both of you return to deliver a report to Lady Lisette.
TEXT_FESVLT605_03756_SEQ_04: Upon your return, Lady Lisette carefully weighs the events of the day. Though not entirely convinced at the outset, after asking your thoughts and reconsidering the matter for herself, she triumphantly declares Astrid's trial a success. Astrid rejoices, and with her sister's blessing, the newly crowned emissary of love steps confidently into her hard-earned position as mistress of ceremonies for this year's Valentione's Day. Your own duty done as well, you are free to enjoy the festivities as you see fit before going forth and returning to your adventures.
TEXT_FESVLT606_03757_SEQ_00:
Lisette has an important announcement to share with one and all.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESVLT606_03757_SEQ_01:
Lisette cheerily explains to you that the votes have been all but counted, and announces that the winner of the contest is none other than Bert. She bids you accompany Bert as an unbiased observer, such that you might render a sound decision on her behalf. Bert then instructs you to wait just beyond his arranged meeting spot with your masked client.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESVLT606_03757_SEQ_02: You accompany Bert─newly minted as this year's emissary of love─to visit your heretofore masked client, who reveals himself to be none other than Guildmaster Ywain of Lancers' Guild fame. Though somewhat skeptical, Ywain humors Bert's suggestion to take up woodworking, and the two of them make their way to the Carpenters' Guild where they are greeted by a skeptical Guildmaster Beatin. The ever-serious soldier stutters that he has come seeking a better understanding of love─a confession which Beatin, as is his wont, egregiously mishears and misinterprets as a desire to deeply understand lumber. Convinced that he has found a kindred spirit in his fellow guildmaster, Beatin whisks Ywain off to the depths of the Twelveswood, that they might bond over their newfound shared passion for the wonderful world of wood.
TEXT_FESVLT606_03757_SEQ_03: His mission to find a passionate encounter for Ywain complete—at least, in the most charitable sense of the word—Bert eagerly suggests that you both return to Lady Lisette to deliver word of his triumph.
TEXT_FESVLT606_03757_SEQ_04: Upon your return, Lady Lisette carefully weighs the events of the day. Though not entirely convinced at the outset, after asking your thoughts and reconsidering the matter for herself, she triumphantly declares Bert's trial a success. The passionate young man rejoices, and with her Lady Lisette's blessing, the newly crowned emissary of love steps confidently into his role as master of ceremonies for this year's Valentione's Day. Your own duty done as well, you are free to enjoy the festivities as you see fit before going forth and returning to your adventures.
TEXT_FESVLT607_03758_SEQ_00:
Lisette has an important announcement to share with one and all.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESVLT607_03758_SEQ_01:
Lisette cheerily explains to you that the votes have been all but counted, and announces that the winner of the contest is none other than Rodrigault. She bids you accompany Rodrigault as an unbiased observer, such that you might render a sound decision on her behalf. Rodrigault then instructs you to wait just beyond his arranged meeting spot with your masked client.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESVLT607_03758_SEQ_02: You accompany Rodrigault—newly minted as this year's emissary of love—to visit your heretofore masked client, who reveals himself to be none other than Guildmaster Ywain of Lancers' Guild fame. With some skepticism, Ywain agrees to take part in a meditation exercise at Rodrigault's suggestion, and the two of them make their way to Stillglade Fane where they are greeted by Brother E-Sumi-Yan. Their conversation is suddenly interrupted by Sylphie, however, who astutely ascertains precisely what sort of love the guildmaster truly seeks, and begins to lecture him on matters including personal hygiene, whisking him off to the Twelve know where that she might transform him into a less offensively odored individual.
TEXT_FESVLT607_03758_SEQ_03: Cool and confident as always despite the unexpected turn of events, Rodrigault observes that his approach did indeed spark an encounter that has the potential to reverse your client's fortunes. He strides confidently off to report his clear success to Lady Lisette, with the clear expectation that you will be along in tow.
TEXT_FESVLT607_03758_SEQ_04: Upon your return, Lady Lisette carefully weighs the events of the day. Though not entirely convinced at the outset, after asking your thoughts and reconsidering the matter for herself, she triumphantly declares Rodrigault's trial a success. The studious scholar of love rejoices in his own subdued way, and with Lady Lisette's blessing, the newly crowned emissary of love steps into his role as master of ceremonies for this year's Valentione's Day. Your own duty done as well, you are free to enjoy the festivities as you see fit before going forth and returning to your adventures.
TEXT_FESEST601_03846_SEQ_00:
The revelrous rabbit in Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre wishes to share the joy of Hatching-tide with you.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESEST601_03846_SEQ_01:
In Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre, you come upon Jihli Aliapoh, who regales you with the history of the event known as Hatching-tide─a festival born of her vision of the Twelve Archons of the Sixth Umbral Era. As she tells it, this year she was blessed with another vision: this one not of storied heroes, but of fluffy rabbits─which may in part explain her curious appearance. Though what she has in mind is not immediately clear, one thing is: she requires your aid to make the festival a success. Should you be inclined to lend your assistance, seek out her colleague Nonotta by the Carline Canopy and see what you might do on the celebrants' behalf.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESEST601_03846_SEQ_02: You find Nonotta, herself curiously dressed as an oversized hare, who is all too eager to share with you her plight. To wit, a veritable legion of chickens painstakingly procured by her and Jihli have flown the coop, placing their meticulous plans for this year's festivities in peril. Put your hen-hunting skills to the test and go forth to recover these exceptional egg-laying specimens, that the celebration might not meet a premature demise.
TEXT_FESEST601_03846_SEQ_03: After a hair-raising, feather-ruffling encounter, you succeed in tracking down the chickens as per Nonotta's request. Report back to your client and let her know that the deed is done.
TEXT_FESEST601_03846_SEQ_04: Nonotta rejoices that you have successfully tracked down all of her lost chickens and led them back to the coop. She bids you join her back at Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre, where you might share the news of your triumph with her compatriot Jihli Aliapoh.
TEXT_FESEST601_03846_SEQ_05: Back at the amphitheatre, Jihli rejoices upon hearing that the chickens have been returned, allowing Hatching-tide to begin in earnest. After Nonotta takes her leave, Jihli informs you in secret that she believes you to be the key to the success of this year's festivities. If you feel so inclined, wait around and offer your aid when the time is right.
TEXT_FESEST602_03847_SEQ_00:
Jihli Aliapoh would see the Hatching-tide festivities begin in a grand fashion.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESEST602_03847_SEQ_01:
At Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre, Jihli Aliapoh expresses her gratitude once more for your devoted efforts in returning her precious chickens to their coop. She further explains that preparations are underway for this year's main event─a grand procession which will march down the streets of Gridania, presenting a gift to each and every child in attendance. Should you still be inclined to assist, seek out Nonotta and offer your aid.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESEST602_03847_SEQ_02: Nonotta rejoices at your return and further explains the situation at hand: as you speak, a number of patrons recruited by the Dreamers are putting the finishing touches on the decorative eggs that will be the highlight of the event. She bids you travel to the designated meeting place in her stead to accept the shipments of eggs, and deliver them back to her when the deed is done.
TEXT_FESEST602_03847_SEQ_03: You wait at the locations specified by Nonotta, and in turn are greeted by multiple personages dressed as rabbits, each of whom seem most strikingly familiar despite the disguises that conceal their identity. One by one, they deliver to you a shipment of ornate eggs hollowed out and housing a number of delightful gifts for the children of Gridania. Having safely taken the last shipment into your inventory, you set off back again to make your own delivery to Nonotta.
TEXT_FESEST602_03847_SEQ_04: Nonotta expresses her gratitude for your delivery of eggs, expressing her excitement that the curtain may finally rise on the event for which the Dreamers have meticulously prepared. When you are ready, make for Old Gridania that you might take your proper place in the procession.
TEXT_FESEST602_03847_SEQ_05: Thanks to you and your friends, the procession went off with nary a hitch, your gift of ornamental eggs serving to put a smile on the faces of countless children in Gridania. Your own expression beaming in satisfaction, you set off to share the news with Nonotta.
TEXT_FESEST602_03847_SEQ_06: Nonotta is most happy to hear that the procession was a success, as she well suspected it would be as soon as you agreed to be involved. She quickly dashes off for the amphitheatre to share the news with Jihli, and bids you join her to receive the praise you deserve.
TEXT_FESEST602_03847_SEQ_07: Back at the amphitheatre, Jihli profusely thanks you and Nonotta for your efforts in making this year's Hatching-tide an event to remember, further confessing that she left her post to take part in the procession herself. Rejoicing at the thought that the smiling children today will one day share the joy of the festival she dreamed up with their own children─and so on down to posterity─she smiles in satisfaction and relief, and welcomes you to return to take part in the celebration as often as you like till such time as the season draws to a close.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_SEQ_00:
The royal seneschal is eager to recruit others to join in the festivities.

※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_SEQ_01:
Little Ladies' Day has come to Eorzea once again, and after speaking with the royal seneschal, you agree to join his quest to see that no young woman goes without a smile on her face. Lady Aldiytha of House Thorne, ever a proponent of this special day, appears to know just where to start. She tells you of a downcast Lalafell with flaxen hair, whom she spied among the festive crowds, and enlists your aid in finding her. Hurry to Emerald Avenue, that you might find this troubled soul and set her heart at ease.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_SEQ_02: One of Ul'dah's citizens informs you that he spotted a Lalafell with flaxen hair just moments before you spoke with him. He recalls her despondent air, which stood out against the cheerful crowds around her. He says she plodded off towards the Sapphire Avenue Exchange. Continue following her trail of sorrow.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_SEQ_03: The next citizen you speak with tells a familiar story: she caught sight of a forlorn young Lalafell trudging through Ul'dah, this time in the direction of the Gold Court.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_SEQ_04: Once again you find yourself a step behind, as a bystander tells you of the girl he saw ascending to the Hustings Strip. However, an end may be near, as he surmises that the girl is likely a patient at Frondale's Phrontistery, which is but a short distance from your present location.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_SEQ_05: Near the entrance to Frondale's Phrontistery you finally find the young Lalafell. Although she is frightened at first, the girl calms after Aldiytha explains your purpose. The girl introduces herself as Momoru, and relates to you the tragic tale of her friend Lorie, who had planned to celebrate Little Ladies' Day with Momoru but was forced to stay inside the Phrontistery after a sudden onset of her illness. Lady Aldiytha is moved by Lorie's plight, and proposes bringing the merriment to Lorie and the other children in the ward. Momoru's spirits brighten upon hearing the idea, but first you must obtain permission from Damielliot, director of the Phrontistery.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_SEQ_06: You have arrived at Frondale's Phrontistery, and must now seek out Damielliot. Speak with the Phrontistery alchemist to enter the children's ward.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_SEQ_07: Damielliot readily agrees to bring the celebrations to the Phrontistery, and hatches a plan to shift the timing of the children's scheduled examinations so that you and the others have ample time to acquire decorations and furnish the ward. He asks you to summon each of the children to the examination room while he makes the necessary preparations.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_SEQ_08: The children─although somewhat unwillingly─make their way to the examination room, leaving the ward unoccupied save for Damielliot and the others, who make plans to acquire the necessary decorations. In the meantime, you have been tasked with inviting a certain guildmaster to the ward. Momoru is ready to depart to the Weavers' Guild to seek an audience with Redolent Rose.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_SEQ_09: Momoru tells you of the long nights Lorie has spent fawning over Redolent Rose's designs and thread work, and hopes that a visit from him will serve to improve her friend's condition more than any medicine ever could. Eager to meet the guildmaster in the flesh, she hurries to the Weavers' Guild, bidding you to follow.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_SEQ_10: Redolent Rose, ever willing to foster the interest of budding weavers, agrees to speak with Lorie without hesitation. He will meet you at Frondale's Phrontistery after first taking care of some pressing matters.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_SEQ_11: You return to the Phrontistery to see it adorned with trimmings whose grandeur rivals that of a peach tree in full bloom. Speak with everyone gathered before starting the party in earnest.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_SEQ_12: Not long after you arrive, Redolent Rose follows, and Lorie is surprised as she is delighted to see her idol in the flesh. Lady Aldiytha presents the other children with gifts: hair ornaments made with peach blossoms, which are said to ward off sickness. She also presents Damielliot with a monocle, in homage to the royal physician whom the sultan sent to care for his princess so many Little Ladies' Days ago. The party is off to a great start, and it is time to mingle.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_SEQ_13: Momoru is a changed Lalafell, and all trace of the sadness which once shrouded her has vanished. She thanks you and welcomes you to return to the children's ward so long as Little Ladies' Day is being observed. Lady Aldiytha, although overjoyed to see the smiles of the children, regretfully informs you that she must return to her manor before her family begins to fuss over her absence. Before departing, however, Aldiytha bids you speak with Damielliot to receive your own special gift.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_SEQ_14: Damielliot adds his thanks before presenting your reward: a wreath of peach blossoms and a monocle. Although Little Ladies' Day may eventually come to an end, these mementos will serve to keep its spirit alive and well all year round.
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_SEQ_00:
Damielliot has the flustered look of a man who has been asked one too many questions.

※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_SEQ_01:
While your impromptu Little Ladies' Day at Frondale's Phrontistery was a rousing success, Damielliot informs you that not all is well. It would seem Redolent Rose's visit was both a blessing and a curse, as the other young girls now expect Damielliot to arrange a special guest for each of them. The children's requests are fanciful at best, and Damielliot, overwhelmed with the magnitude of the task, humbly requests your aid in securing audiences with some of the storied figures you have met in your journeys. Reauverre has asked each of the girls to write a letter to the person─or persons─they would like to meet. Read them, and if anyone you know might fit the descriptions contained within, inform Reauverre and he will summon the others to the foyer.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_SEQ_02: Everyone awaits with bated breath as you present to them one of Eorzea's most esteemed personages. The children are delighted to hear their stories and receive their advice, and your guests appear just as delighted to share. The meeting ends with smiles all around, and Damielliot is eager to thank you for your part in arranging it.
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_SEQ_03: After thanking you profusely, Damielliot reiterates that you are welcome to visit the Phrontistery at any time, so long as the day's festivities are afoot in Ul'dah. He also reminds you that the children would be thrilled if you were to bring even just one more of your colorful comrades along with you.
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_SEQ_00:
Nanaphon is glancing about with a hint of frantic desperation.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_SEQ_01:
A hopeful Nanaphon has asked for your assistance with a staffing problem at the Gold Saucer. It seems that an influx of visitors during a highly successful MGP campaign has shown the establishment to be woefully shorthanded, and the call has gone out for temporary helpers. After indicating your willingness to lend a hand, Nanaphon requests that you make your way to the Saucer and meet with his supervisor at Entrance Square.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_SEQ_02: Shortly after your arrival at Entrance Square, you are greeted by a grateful Roland. He introduces you to the chief attendant, and thus begins your stint as a Gold Saucer employee. As instructed, your first task is to meet the guides in each square, and learn the basics of the available attractions that you might provide advice to any indecisive or overwhelmed guests.
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_SEQ_03: You have dutifully listened to the explanations provided by the Gold Saucer guides. The time has come to return to the chief attendant, and put your knowledge of the Saucer's diverse amusements to the test.
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_SEQ_04: Trusting in your claim to readiness, the chief attendant immediately sets you to work responding to the needs of flustered visitors. After a short but intense bout of providing hospitality, you set your sights on collecting your payment at Entrance Square.
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_SEQ_05: You return once more to the chief attendant, who provides an evaluation of your performance. Roland himself is generous with both his praise and appreciation of your efforts, but it seems the staffing dilemma in the Saucer is not yet over...
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_SEQ_00:
The chief attendant appears eager to retain your services.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_SEQ_01:
The chief attendant remains concerned that his shorthanded staff will fail to meet the demands of the campaign crowd. He bids you report to the guides responsible for hospitality in Event Square, Round Square, or Wonder Square, and put yourself at the disposal of the Saucer's guests.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_SEQ_02: You have rendered what service you may to the Saucer's visitors. Return to Entrance Square and report to the chief attendant.
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_SEQ_03: Upon returning to the chief attendant, you receive both praise for your efforts and payment for your service. Should you wish to provide further assistance, it seems the Saucer's special campaign is set to continue...
TEXT_FESSUM601_03966_SEQ_00:
Mayaru Moyaru's beaming smile is betrayed by a hint of desperation in his eyes.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESSUM601_03966_SEQ_01:
Once again, the sun's scorching rays herald the arrival of the Moonfire Faire to Eorzea, but it appears that they have also brought something deadly in their wake. Reports from the Fishermen's Guild tell of a gargantuan man-eating shark terrorizing the shores of Costa del Sol, and the hosts of the festivities are desperately looking for help to drive off this threat before anyone comes to harm. Speak to Haermaga in Costa del Sol to volunteer your aid to this beleaguered celebration.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESSUM601_03966_SEQ_02: Haermaga greets you heartily, eager to have any assistance he can get. He informs you that Gegeruju has begun assembling a special team of researchers to combat this maritime threat, and asks you to stand watch with him while awaiting their arrival. No sooner do you begin scanning the horizon than the terrible shark emerges from the waters, sending revelers running for their lives. As you prepare for a fight, however, a voice urges you to stand down, and you turn to see a woman who introduces herself as Thracie, leader of the self-styled Bombardiers. Their objective is to use the kobolds' expertise in all matters explosive to blast the shark back into the depths whence it came. To do so, they have constructed an artificial Bombard, the very threat which spurred the inception of the Moonfire Faire. Although Haermaga is skeptical of their methods, it is the best plan available, so you agree to aid the Bombardiers in their mission. Speak with Thracie to hear the particulars.
TEXT_FESSUM601_03966_SEQ_03: You learn that the Bombardiers mean to control the artificial Bombard by way of a traditional Lalafellin dance known as the flame dance. She teaches you the steps, explaining that it can be used to stoke the Bombard's flames for combat or to rekindle them when they burn low. Make expert use of the steps to guide the Bombard to victory over the deep-sea menace.
TEXT_FESSUM601_03966_SEQ_04: True to its name, the Bombard bursts in a dazzling explosion, sending the shark scurrying back into the ocean. The Bombardiers celebrate their victory, and Thracie tasks you with reporting the triumph to Haermaga at once.
TEXT_FESSUM601_03966_SEQ_05: Haermaga is surprised the haphazard plan worked, but is nonetheless pleased at its outcome. Thracie ponders how such a massive and feral creature wound up on the shores of Costa del Sol, and just as she is about to drop the subject, she is taken aback by the sudden appearance of a miniature monster at her heels. Thracie's scream echoes down the beaches, followed soon after by Captain Foerzagyl of the Endeavor. He was looking for the tiny shark, who has been his steadfast companion ever since it was plucked from the ocean during a fishing voyage. You quickly dismiss any connection between the two creatures as Foerzagyl hurries back to his ship, and decide to content yourself with a job well done, and a summer well rescued.
TEXT_FESSUM602_03967_SEQ_00:
Haermaga has a message for you from the host of the festivities.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESSUM602_03967_SEQ_01:
Haermaga congratulates you on behalf of the Adventurers' Guild before informing you that Gegeruju has expressed great interest in the dance that saved his faire. Speak with the wealthy merchant to see what he wants from you.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESSUM602_03967_SEQ_02: Gegeruju thanks you personally before requesting that you arrange an encore performance of the flame dance. He seems most interested in making it a permanent part of the festivities, and seems particularly keen to see his Miqo'te dancers learn the steps. Speak with the festival-goers and recruit any who are willing to learn a few new tricks.
TEXT_FESSUM602_03967_SEQ_03: Dancers up and down the beaches of Costa del Sol are setting the sands ablaze with their passion, and you have assembled a group worthy of Costa del Sol's discerning owner. Jiriri is standing by to inform you of what to do next.
TEXT_FESSUM602_03967_SEQ_04: Jiriri furnishes all the dancers with the proper attire, and they begin their performance, dancing with grace and ardor that would inspire even the most cynical soul. Cheers come from the crowd when the dancers finish, the loudest of which comes from Gegeruju. Summer is in the air, and this year's Moonfire Faire promises to be the most spirited one yet.
TEXT_FESANV601_03973_SEQ_00:
The centerpiece of this year's Rising festivities is a work of art courtesy of J'bhen Tia, who hopes to foster goodwill among the citizens of Ul'dah.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESANV601_03973_SEQ_01:
The Rising festival is known for bringing a splash of color to Ul'dah each year. On this occasion, a work of fine art in stained glass serves as the focal point, and its creator, J'bhen Tia is on hand to explain his inspiration. He has chosen to depict one of the pivotal moments in Ul'dahn history prior to the Calamity in which Nanamo Ul Namo addressed the rioting masses, imploring them to put aside their grievances and instead cooperate for the greater good. To accompany the artwork, a wandering minstrel of great renown is due to give a recital to commemorate the event, and J'bhen Tia would like you to help distribute flyers to drum up as large a crowd as possible.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESANV601_03973_SEQ_02: In the process of publicizing the Rising's special attractions, you meet several members of the Ul'dahn citizenry. While they come from various walks of life, they are all keen to savor the delights on offer, and agree to attend. You then make for the Sapphire Avenue Exchange, where you have arranged to meet J'bhen Tia.
TEXT_FESANV601_03973_SEQ_03: You spot J'bhen Tia in the midst of the bustling market, though it appears that trouble is brewing. His friend Astin, a moneylender, is engaged in a heated argument with a local merchant, and it falls to J'bhen Tia to diffuse the situation. The artist explains that disputes such as these are precisely the reason why he chose the subject matter for his stained glass art, with Astin a prime example of one whose compassionate side is overshadowed by his obsession with turning a profit. The two of you agree to meet back at the Ruby Road Exchange to prepare to receive the attendees at the Rising celebrations.
TEXT_FESANV601_03973_SEQ_04: Upon your return, you find J'bhen Tia decidedly crestfallen as a group of children look on sheepishly. Your new acquaintance is struggling to find the words to explain precisely what has happened, but it is clear he would benefit from your moral support.
TEXT_FESANV602_03974_SEQ_00:
J'bhen Tia's heart is not the only thing that is broken.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESANV602_03974_SEQ_01:
In J'bhen Tia's absence, the stained glass that he had so painstakingly created has been accidentally shattered by a group of children who got a little too close to the exhibit. With the opening of the Rising festivities fast approaching, the only viable option is to piece together the artwork as best you can before the spectators arrive.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESANV602_03974_SEQ_02: With your gift for solving puzzles, the stained glass art is restored to more or less its original state. Once J'bhen Tia has glued the reassembled shards into the frame, his work will be ready to be put on display once more.
TEXT_FESANV602_03974_SEQ_03: J'bhen Tia is ecstatic that the exhibition is able to go ahead despite the catastrophe that had befallen his artwork. With the event due to start, he asks if you might persuade his childhood friend Astin to attend. Their relationship has been somewhat troubled of late, and J'Bhen feels that the invitation would be better received if delivered by a third party, namely, you.
TEXT_FESANV602_03974_SEQ_04: It soon becomes apparent that Astin was fully aware of the exhibition, but he had decided not to attend. Since he is an infamous moneylender, he was concerned that J'bhen Tia's reputation would suffer if their association became public knowledge. Nonetheless, he is prepared to consider the invitation, though it is still unclear whether he will actually make an appearance.
TEXT_FESANV602_03974_SEQ_05: The art exhibition and accompanying song courtesy of the wandering minstrel are met with resounding applause, and many in the crowd were deeply moved by the message of goodwill towards one's fellow man. Astin, who had made up his mind to attend after all, found the tale of the Sultana's Seven particularly relevant to his current situation. He chooses to give up the life of a moneylender in order to return to working as an art dealer, and he offers to find buyers for J'bhen Tia's stained glass. The young virtuoso is overjoyed that Astin has turned over a new leaf and offers you his heartfelt thanks in not only rescuing the exhibition, but also their friendship. He then mentions that the wandering minstrel is looking for you, though you will need to speak with him yourself to find out why.
TEXT_FESANV602_03974_SEQ_06: The wandering minstrel expresses his appreciation for your part in this year's Rising festival, and offers a song by way of reward. You are then swept away on the waves of a divine melody to another realm entirely, free from the bounds of time and space. You are met by the enigmatic Naoki Yoshida and his Lalafellin companions, who appear to have been expecting you. Though his words are somewhat cryptic, his sincerity is unmistakable. You are eventually returned to the present day, whereupon the minstrel welcomes you back from your waking dream. He performs one last song, while the fireworks above fill the night sky.
TEXT_FESHLW701_03995_SEQ_00:
The Adventurers' Guild investigator is on the lookout for a suspiciously scary personage.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESHLW701_03995_SEQ_01:
The Adventurers' Guild investigator relates to you his plight: as All Saints' Eve approaches, a shifty figure known as the Scarlet Snout has been making the rounds about Gridania, unsettling the local populace. Sadly, the investigator's best efforts have turned up little in the way of leads as to what this individual is up to. At his behest, you agree to aid him in his quest by inquiring among the locals in hopes of learning more about this red-nosed ruffian.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESHLW701_03995_SEQ_02: Through your inquiries with the townspeople─some more cooperative than others─it soon becomes apparent that the Scarlet Snout has made contact with several individuals, inviting more than a few of them to a banquet of sorts. Concerned for their fate, you begin to make your way back to Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre to relate to the guild investigator all that has transpired.
TEXT_FESHLW701_03995_SEQ_03: After conferring with the investigator, you agree that the best course of action is for you to attempt to initiate contact with the Scarlet Snout yourself. At your client's behest, you set out to lie in wait by the river near the Leatherworkers' Guild until the man with the protuberant proboscis approaches you.
TEXT_FESHLW701_03995_SEQ_04: Sure enough, the so-called Scarlet Snout─now revealed to be an itinerant clown by the name of Papa Gruff─finds you and extends an invitation to his banquet, much as he did with the other residents of Gridania. Unable to yet discern whether he means well or ill, you head back to the Leatherworkers' Guild to inform the investigator of your meeting and discuss your next course of action.
TEXT_FESHLW701_03995_SEQ_05: Hearing your story, the Adventurers' Guild investigator is duly suspicious, but nevertheless suggests playing along with your quarry, that you might obtain more concrete information. So it is that you make for Bentbranch Meadows, where you will seek out a vantage point a stone's throw from the agreed-upon location, that you might spy upon Papa Gruff and his interactions with his other guests from a safe distance.
TEXT_FESHLW701_03995_SEQ_06: As you survey the scene, it does not take long for the entire Gruff clan to appear. A chill runs up your spine as you overhear them discussing their dark plot to realize something called the Night of Devilry by feeding on the fear and life energies of their guests. Somewhat shaken, you decide to return to the investigator and elucidate to him this rather disturbing turn of events.
TEXT_FESHLW701_03995_SEQ_07: The investigator is to no small degree concerned, but at the same time assures you that the Adventurers' Guild has sent aid in the form of an expert on all matters occult. Going off to see to your preparations, you agree to return to the investigator when you are ready to meet the man in question and see what perfect plan he has devised.
TEXT_FESVLT701_03996_SEQ_00:
Lisette de Valentione appears mildly distressed.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESVLT701_03996_SEQ_01:
You approach a distressed Lisette de Valentione and learn of her ongoing struggle to educate Astrid, an apprentice emissary. In the midst of their discourse, a moogle by the name of Kupka Kupp appears, and promptly enlists both you and Astrid in a matter of the heart─it seems that his dear friend Elyne requires a special measure of encouragement. After reading her letter idolizing you as an adventurer, it is decided that some time spent at the melancholy girl's long-dreamed-of seaside might help in the formation of a plan. Kupka bids you meet him on the coast of middle La Noscea, near the mouth of the Agelyss River.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESVLT701_03996_SEQ_02: Upon arriving at the mouth of the river, it occurs to Astrid that a painting of the sparkling sea might help lift Elyne out of her melancholy. Kupka volunteers his artistic talents, then suggests that the exotic scent of the flowers which bloom to the northwest of Tiller's Rest would add another stimulating element to Elyne's gift. The chore of picking said flowers falls to you.
TEXT_FESVLT701_03996_SEQ_03: You carefully select some sweet-smelling flowers to present alongside Kupka's painting. Return to the moogle at the mouth of the Agelyss River.
TEXT_FESVLT701_03996_SEQ_04: Kupka appears well pleased with your floral selection. Using pigments prepared by Astrid, the moogle has already completed a masterpiece of a picture. The gift of encouraging love is ready. He urges you both to return with him to Gridania and search for Elyne at her usual haunt: Sweetbloom Pier.
TEXT_FESVLT701_03996_SEQ_05: Alongside you and Astrid, Kupka presents a starstruck Elyne with the painting and its fragrant accompaniment. Although momentarily buoyed by the thoughtful gift, the young lady sinks back into despondency when pressed to explain her recent dearth of enthusiasm. It would seem that despite her efforts in martial training, Elyne despairs of ever mastering the skills needed to venture beyond the Twelveswood. A few inspiring words from you, her hero, however, has an almost magical effect in improving her outlook. Thus emboldened, Elyne reveals she has a favor she would ask of you...
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_SEQ_00:
Elyne is gazing at you with expectant eyes.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_SEQ_01:
Elyne explains to you her favor: she would ask that you act as her escort, so that her parents will permit her to travel with Kupka Kupp on his mission to Ul'dah. After agreeing to her request, it is decided that your little group will assemble for departure at the Gridanian airship landing.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_SEQ_02: You meet with an elated Elyne at the airship landing and board the airship together. As she struggles to contain her excitement, the ever-dutiful Kupka explains that they must first pay a visit to the royal seneschal at the Ruby Road Exchange.
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_SEQ_03: Upon your arrival, you make straight for the Ruby Road Exchange and the royal seneschal. Just before the Songbirds arrive to accept their fan letters, however, Astrid delivers a missive of her own─it seems that Lisette would take advantage of the close timing of Valentione's Day and Little Ladies' Day to host a joint event of some kind. It is then that Elyne suggests that the performers don Valentione-styled costumes, a proposal which is received enthusiastically by all involved. An excited Astrid immediately offers to return to Gridania to make the necessary arrangements. In the meantime, the seneschal wonders if you would be willing to lend him a helping hand...
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_SEQ_04: You indicate your willingness to help, and the royal seneschal outlines his errand─a simple delivery to Frondale's Phrontistery. Once there, he asks that you seek out Lady Aldiytha in the children's ward and place the package in her hands.
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_SEQ_05: Elyne, giddy at her first adventurer-like task, discovers that her delivery was actually a gift of sweets for the patients of the children's ward. Lady Aldiytha encourages her to help hand them out, and Elyne and Kupka enjoy spending time with some newly made friends. With the job complete, Kupka suggests you return to the seneschal and see if Astrid has arrived with the costumes.
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_SEQ_06: The seneschal informs you that Astrid has indeed returned and is helping the Songbirds into their new outfits. You accompany Elyne to the stage and, following the performance, the three singers impart some words of wisdom to the would-be adventurer. It is almost time for the young lady to head home...
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_SEQ_07: Although ready to leave, Elyne is already making plans for her next trip to Ul'dah. As you prepare to board the airship, however, Astrid mentions that Lisette would like to see everyone at the amphitheatre upon your return to Gridania.
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_SEQ_08: You duly report to Lisette, and Elyne thanks you all effusively for making her dreams come true. Astrid and Kupka, too, are grateful for the experience, learning as they have that there is more to being an emissary than either one imagined. Pleased with her pupil's growth, Lisette reassures everyone that Valentione's Day─and the opportunity to spread more love and affection─is far from over!
TEXT_FESXMS601_04017_SEQ_00:
'Tis that season of the year again, and Amh Garanjy is making plans for an extra special Starlight.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESXMS601_04017_SEQ_01:
Amh Garanjy greets you with a smile, heartened by your arrival. It would seem the ever-unflappable Starlight celebrant has been plagued by more trouble than usual in preparing for this year's festivities─such that the celebration itself is in peril if she cannot secure a capable helping hand, and quickly. Further complicating matters is the presence of Kamlito Halito, son of a prominent merchant from Ul'dah, who has been sent by his father to observe the festivities, but appears to believe himself above it all. Nonetheless, the presence of the Saint of Nymeia is evidence enough that a miracle or two may lie in your future. Should you be willing to lend your aid, you need only speak to her saturnine colleague by the waterwheel storage cabin.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESXMS601_04017_SEQ_02: The Starlight celebrant welcomes your generous offer of assistance. Your first task, if you choose to accept it: make for the Conjurers' Guild and clean up the most indecorous decorations put up in the area by Kamlito Halito, who clearly has a less-than-stellar understanding of what the Starlight season is all about.
TEXT_FESXMS601_04017_SEQ_03: Thanks to your diligent work in cleaning up the unsightly decorations left by Kamlito Halito, the scene has now been set to deck the streets with décor more suitable for the season. Return to the saturnine Starlight celebrant with the unneeded baubles and report that your task is done.
TEXT_FESXMS601_04017_SEQ_04: Taking the improper decorations in hand, the celebrant thanks you for your efforts in his typically unenthusiastic manner, and sets off to decorate the town in more traditional Starlight fashion. He encourages you to return to Amh Garanjy, who will no doubt be overjoyed with your contributions and looking to reward you accordingly.
TEXT_FESXMS601_04017_SEQ_05: Amh Garanjy beams a smile upon your return, ever more confident that she has found the helper she needs to see that this year's Starlight Celebration is one to remember. Expressing her hope that Kamlito Halito, too, will come to understand the spirit of the season in time, she bids you reward yourself for your efforts with a present from the twinklebox. She further explains that her colleague Baenfaeld, as well, has received missives of gratitude from around the realm intended for you, and encourages you to peruse them from time to time. Many more preparations must be made before Starlight can commence in earnest, and your further aid would be more than appreciated.
TEXT_FESXMS602_04018_SEQ_00:
Amh Garanjy will not rest until she has seen to it that this year's Starlight Celebration is the best ever.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESXMS602_04018_SEQ_01:
Harried as ever with the seemingly never-ending preparations for Starlight, Amh Garanjy welcomes your offer of continued assistance. To that end, she bids you consult with young Isainne, whom the celebrant-in-chief has tasked with ensuring that the decorations in Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre are up to seasonal standards.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESXMS602_04018_SEQ_02: You arrive at the amphitheatre, where Isainne laments that her associate Kamlito Halito has once again failed to capture the spirit of the season─if the talk about town is to be believed. Follow her to the Shaded Bower to see precisely what might be the matter with the slipshod snowmen he made.
TEXT_FESXMS602_04018_SEQ_03: After a brief discussion with Isainne over by the Shaded Bower, you come to the conclusion that the snowmen all appear to be facing the wrong direction. Survey the scene and see if you can't set things straight.
TEXT_FESXMS602_04018_SEQ_04: A turn there, a twist here, and the snowmen now face a more intuitive direction, so as to welcome festival-goers to stores selling seasonal delights. Take pride in a job well done, and share your observations with young Isainne.
TEXT_FESXMS602_04018_SEQ_05: You report back to young Isainne, who is predictably overjoyed at seeing what you have done with the snowmen. Your rejoicing is interrupted, however, by the ever-abrasive Kamlito Halito, who looks down his nose at your efforts, defending the “efficiency” of his own work and proclaiming that the entire event would be more successful were he in charge. Insulted by his insinuations that Starlight is all about greed and receiving material goods, Isainne stomps off─leading the Saint of Nymeia to come to the scene and deliver his charge a good scolding. With hope that the youth might have learned his lesson this time, you return to Amh Garanjy to claim another hard-earned reward.
TEXT_FESXMS602_04018_SEQ_06: Back at the amphitheatre, Amh Garanjy offers her gratitude for your continued aid in preparing for the Starlight festivities, and bids you reward yourself for your efforts with yet another present from the twinklebox. She asks that you do not go far, however─much and more yet needs be done before the celebration can commence in earnest, and your further assistance would be more than appreciated.
TEXT_FESXMS603_04019_SEQ_00:
Amh Garanjy remains hard at work preparing for the Starlight Celebration of a lifetime.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESXMS603_04019_SEQ_01:
No rest is to be had for the weary, as preparations for the annual Starlight Celebration proceed at a breakneck pace. Amh Garanjy welcomes your generous offer of continued aid, and bids you assist with the latest task: to wit, seeing the Starlight Tree─the most recognizable symbol of the event─is ready for the festivities. The head celebrant bids you speak to her colleague for all the details.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESXMS603_04019_SEQ_02: Amh Garanjy's ever-enthusiastic colleague informs you of a troubling matter regarding the Starlight Tree─it appears that someone or something has been gnawing away at its trunk, leaving it in danger of toppling over at an inopportune moment. At the celebrant's suggestion, make your way to the Carpenters' Guild to see if one of the artisans there might be able to lend their wisdom and talents to rectify the situation.
TEXT_FESXMS603_04019_SEQ_03: Upon arriving at the Carpenters' Guild, you have no trouble finding a willing and able woodworker, who happily agrees to work her magic to reinforce the tree trunk. Your task done, you prepare to report back to the celebrant, who is sure to be overjoyed with your efforts.
TEXT_FESXMS603_04019_SEQ_04: As predicted, Amh's colleague is overjoyed to hear your task was a resounding success, and the tree stands stronger than ever. Offering a few musings on Kamlito Halito and his seemingly newfound dedication to his work, she then bids you return to the amphitheatre and check to see how your colleague is faring.
TEXT_FESXMS603_04019_SEQ_05: Back in the amphitheatre, you come upon Kamlito Halito, who is in the midst of making a snowman for the festivities. As hinted at by the celebrant's words, it appears he is a changed man, his recent interaction with young Isainne having given him cause to reflect upon the true meaning of Starlight and his own role in the celebration.
TEXT_FESXMS603_04019_SEQ_06: Amh welcomes you back with a smile, pleased to see you have once again proven more than up to the task. She shares with you a few thoughts on the significance of the festival─a signficance that perhaps Kamlito Halito has finally come to understand as well─before inviting you to pop yet another of the lids off the twinklebox and claim your reward. There is much to be done before the festivities can be kicked off in earnest, however, meaning that your continued help will doubtless still be in high demand.
TEXT_FESXMS604_04020_SEQ_00:
Amh Garanjy is determined to make miracles happen this Starlight season.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESXMS604_04020_SEQ_01:
Amh Garanjy welcomes you back, eager to accept your aid in continuing the preparations for the impending Starlight Celebration. Your task, if you choose to accept it: help ensure that the delightfully decorative snowmen adorning the town stay intact until the season has come and gone. You strike off to hear the details of the task from the less animated of the chief celebrant's associates.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESXMS604_04020_SEQ_02: Subdued in manner yet nonetheless grateful for your aid, the celebrant outfits you with a shard of the miraculous substance known as eternal ice, the arcane contrivance which gives the snowmen their remarkable staying power. Bidding you to attend to the snowmen on the way to the manor district to the north, he sets off with young Isainne to see to the remaining ones.
TEXT_FESXMS604_04020_SEQ_03: The eternal ice shard now safely housed inside the snowman's breast, you rest easy that it will not melt away too soon and break some poor child's heart. Return to the vicinity of the Lancers' Guild, that you might inform the celebrant that your task is complete.
TEXT_FESXMS604_04020_SEQ_04: Back at the Lancers' Guild, the celebrant thanks you for your efforts before heading off to see to yet another stage in the preparations. You share a moment with Isainne, who laments that─for reasons she seems hesitant to divulge in detail─her dear mother and father will be unable to join her for Starlight this year. As she rushes off to tackle her next task, your mind inexplicably turns to your colleague Kamlito Halito. Head back to the amphitheatre and see whether or not the spirit of the season has truly taken hold in the young man's heart.
TEXT_FESXMS604_04020_SEQ_05: Back at the amphitheatre, you come upon an uncharacteristically unenthusiastic Kamlito Halito hard at work building snowmen, with Isainne cheerfully encouraging him alongside. When the girl suggests that the snowmen would appreciate having some friends, the now-motivated youth is more than happy to oblige, and asks that you go on ahead and report to Amh Garanjy, that he might remain behind until the job is done to his satisfaction.
TEXT_FESXMS604_04020_SEQ_06: You return to Amh Garanjy, who is once more encouraged by the thoroughness with which you have completed your tasks, as well as with Kamlito Halito's change of heart. Confident that there are still more miracles to be had this Starlight, all present resolve to redouble their efforts to see that no child goes unsmiling this season.
TEXT_FESXMS605_04021_SEQ_00:
Amh Garanjy's passion for decking the town with Starlight decorations knows no bounds.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESXMS605_04021_SEQ_01:
Thanks in no small part to your own efforts, preparations for the Starlight Celebration are proceeding apace, but there is still much that needs be done before the festivities can commence in earnest. As the next order of the day, Amh Garanjy would task her favorite helper with replenishing the supply of seasonal wreaths, which is already running dangerously short of demand. Speak with the chief celebrant's passionate colleague to see how you might serve to that end.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESXMS605_04021_SEQ_02: Ever in the spirit of the season, the celebrant joyfully informs you that one of her contacts at the Botanists' Guild has generously offered to donate an ample supply of wreaths to the cause. Make for the Botanists' Guild in her stead and procure the much-needed goods, that no doorway in Gridania might go unadorned this Starlight.
TEXT_FESXMS605_04021_SEQ_03: Your botanist contact at the guild is clearly in a giving mood, as he happily provides you with all the wreaths you could ask for and then some. You strike off back to Greatloam Growery, confident that the celebrant will be overjoyed to see your most impressive haul.
TEXT_FESXMS605_04021_SEQ_04: As expected, the celebrant is beside herself with joy to see your mission a success, and a healthy supply of lovingly crafted Starlight wreaths ready to be distributed to the townspeople. Your rejoicing is interrupted, however, when you overhear the conversation of a mother and son passing by alluding to Isainne having troubles at home. Though the celebrant invites you to return to Amh Garanjy and claim another well-deserved gift from the twinklebox, you cannot help but be concerned about this news regarding your young friend...
TEXT_FESXMS605_04021_SEQ_05: Back at Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre, you pop another lid off the twinklebox and claim your present at Amh Garanjy's urging. Almost immediately, you are joined by Kamlito Halito, who seems to have taken his passion for snowman-building to still greater extremes, and shortly after that by none other than the Saint of Nymeia himself. After expressing his admiration for his young charge and the genuine passion with which he now pursues his Starlight preparations, he sheds light on the concerning situation surrounding Isainne. As he tells it, the girl's father is gravely ill, forcing the child to spend her days working to save up coin for a remedy─one so rare that it is all but impossible to come by even for those few who could afford it. As the saint and Kamlito muse as to what might be done to bring succor to Isainne's family, all of you agree that you must strive to do all that you can in the moment to see that the girl's Starlight is a truly special one.
TEXT_FESXMS606_04022_SEQ_00:
Amh Garanjy is putting the finishing touches on what promises to be a Starlight Celebration for the ages.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESXMS606_04022_SEQ_01:
With preparations for the Starlight Celebration all but completed, the time is nigh for your final task─fashioning a decoration that will serve as a personal gift to your fellow helper Isainne in her time of greatest need. Amh Garanjy encourages you to reflect on all you have learned about your young friend and what she wants most this season, and to let inspiration carry you where it will. Giving deep thought to the matter, you set out to make one child's Starlight dreams come true.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESXMS606_04022_SEQ_02: After a good time spent meticulously packing and re-packing snow and experimenting with assorted articles of garb, you manage to achieve what you were striving for─a delightful recreation of Isainne and her beloved parents in snowman form. Stepping back to admire your work, you make a wish in your heart that it brings even the faintest of smiles to your young friend's face.
TEXT_FESXMS606_04022_SEQ_03: You return to Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre, where you are greeted by your friends and colleagues. Amh Garanjy, Kamlito Halito, and no lesser a personage than the Saint of Nymeia himself lavish praise upon you for your most inspired work, and Isainne is nigh moved to tears at your most touching gesture. The saint further brightens the mood with the news that they were able to procure sufficient quantities of the remedy, meaning that Isainne's father might be cured of his dreadful malady at last, allowing them to celebrate the season as a family after all. What began with a worry that the festivities might be called off entirely has ended with a Starlight miracle for the ages. Happy to have played your part to see smiles come to the realm once more, you bid a fond farewell to your companions and set out to enjoy the season in your own way.
TEXT_FESNYR801_04023_SEQ_00:
The tora bugyo is seeking a fellow feline fanatic.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESNYR801_04023_SEQ_01:
A delegation led by the tora bugyo is come to share their Far Eastern customs during the Heavensturn festival. As he explains it, they plan to perform a special ceremony to ward off evil spirits from the land, but the rite requires the participation of one who calls said land home. You agree to lend a helping hand, and so they bid you make for middle La Noscea that you may assist in the spiritual rite by participating in the FATE “Tora Tora, Burning Bright” 

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESNYR801_04023_SEQ_02: The ritual is a resounding success and the mighty tiger is vanquished by your hand. The tora bugyo will be most pleased to hear the land's foul spirits have been banished.
TEXT_FESNYR801_04023_SEQ_03: You feel a great satisfaction having completed your role in the ritual. Though your work is complete, you suspect the tora bugyo has more on his mind.
TEXT_FESNYR802_04024_SEQ_00:
The tora bugyo is keen to share some tasty treats.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESNYR802_04024_SEQ_01:
No Heavensturn celebration is complete without advent cakes, the staple sweet of the celebration. To ensure as many people as possible can partake, he offers you a sizable store to take to the mochi daikan on the lower decks of Limsa Lominsa.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESNYR802_04024_SEQ_02: You are relieved of your advent cakes in record time, but not before an unexpected meeting with old acquaintances. Nevertheless, your work is done, and the tora bugyo will be pleased to see you empty-handed.
TEXT_FESNYR802_04024_SEQ_03: This year's Heavensturn has been a resounding success, and the tora bugyo offers his sincerest thanks for your help. The celebration is not yet over, however, and so he bids you make merry and enjoy the remainder of the festivities.
TEXT_FESGSC501_04054_SEQ_00:
Ollier is in need of a helping hand.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESGSC501_04054_SEQ_01:
Ollier shares with you his plight. As the Gold Saucer attendant tells it, a robbery has taken place, and one of his closest friends and colleagues has been unfairly named the primary suspect. Feeling pity for the man, you agree to accompany him to the Manderville Lounge, that he might fill you in on the details.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESGSC501_04054_SEQ_02: At the lounge, Ollier apprises you of the specifics regarding the incident at hand. It would seem his friend, a man named Hugue, has come under suspicion primarily for his proximity to the scene of the crime, as well as a blemish on his record from when he committed an act of petty theft some years ago. Ollier, however, remains convinced that the true culprit is to be found elsewhere. Swayed by his words─and with the blessing of Master Roland─you agree to conduct an investigation of your own in hopes of getting at the truth of the matter.
TEXT_FESGSC501_04054_SEQ_03: To expedite your investigation, Ollier presents you with a journal which might be used to record any testimony you may hear─or observations you might make─in your survey of the crime scene and the surrounding areas. He then suggests that you might begin your effort by speaking to a nearby attendant who, at a glance, appears visibly apprehensive about something or other.
TEXT_FESGSC501_04054_SEQ_04: You question the attendant, who you learn was manning the Mini Cactpot counter at the time of the crime. The man insists that he saw no suspicious personages behind the counter, and is therefore confused and dismayed as to how this dastardly crime could have been carried out. Recording the attendant's words in your journal, you set off to speak once more with Ollier, more determined than ever to get to the bottom of this mystery.
TEXT_FESGSC501_04054_SEQ_05: Pleased to see that his journal is serving you well, Ollier encourages you to scour the Saucer high and low, talking to as many people as you can, and leaving no Triple Triad table unturned in your search for clues that might shed light on the mystery. When you feel you have gathered all the information out there to be gleaned, speak with the man again that you might share with him any deductions you have made.
TEXT_FESGSC501_04054_SEQ_06: Armed with your trusty journal and the observations recorded in its pages, you share your deductions before a tribunal headed by Master Roland. After a series of arguments, objections, and considerable deliberation, a verdict is rendered, and the case at long last comes to a conclusion. Speak with Ollier again, that you might hear his thoughts on this turn of events.
TEXT_FESGSC501_04054_SEQ_07: Ollier shares with you his impressions on all that has transpired, and thanks you once more for your efforts on his dear friend's behalf. He further explains that he would present you with a more tangible gift as a token of his gratitude, and bids you collect it from one of his colleagues.
TEXT_FESGSC502_04055_SEQ_00:
The Gold Saucer attendant is determined to see that you are duly rewarded for your efforts on his colleagues' behalf.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESGSC502_04055_SEQ_01:
The stern-faced attendant thanks you for your investigative efforts, which he learned all about from Ollier. He bids that you speak with Grege, his colleague who mans the entrance, to collect the gift that has been prepared for you by the Saucer staff.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESGSC502_04055_SEQ_02: Expressing his admiration for your sleuthing skills, the attendant Grege presents you with your hard-earned reward. You take it in hand and stride out into the Saucer's halls, taking pride in the knowledge that justice has been served this day.
TEXT_FESGSC503_04056_SEQ_00:
Ollier can't help but get the sense that something is eating away at you.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESGSC503_04056_SEQ_01:
You share with Ollier your lingering doubts that your prior investigation arrived at the whole truth behind the matter of the stolen horn. Convinced that the true culprit remains at large, Ollier agrees to persuade Master Roland to reopen the case, that justice might at last be served. Armed once more with your trusty inspector's journal, you head out once more into the halls of the Saucer, vowing that this time no clue will escape you.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESGSC503_04056_SEQ_02: Having gleaned all that you can from your survey of the Saucer and questioning of its denizens, you share your deductions before a tribunal headed by Master Roland, and once again, a verdict is rendered. You then set out to speak once more with Ollier, that you might hear his thoughts on the outcome.
TEXT_FESGSC503_04056_SEQ_03: You speak with Ollier, who expresses his thanks for your diligent efforts on Hugue's behalf. With the case at last brought to a conclusion, you bid the Saucer attendant farewell and take your leave.
TEXT_FESSUM701_04082_SEQ_00:
Mayaru Moyaru will stop at nothing to see that you enjoy the seasonal festivities to the fullest.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESSUM701_04082_SEQ_01:
Mayaru Moyaru eagerly welcomes you to celebrate this year's Moonfire Faire. As he tells it, the highlight of this year's festivities is to be a delightful dessert commissioned by the ever-generous Master Gegeruju, and his colleagues would welcome the aid of an adventurer like yourself in preparing it. He invites you to speak with his colleague Haermaga should you be so inclined to join the effort.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESSUM701_04082_SEQ_02: Haermaga offers a hearty welcome, seemingly greatly relieved at your arrival. It would seem that preparations for the dessert Master Gegeruju has commissioned have hit an unfortunate snag─to wit, the ice that is to serve as the primary ingredient for the frosty delight is nowhere to be found. He encourages you to check in with his fellow faire attendant P'obyano and see what you might glean about its whereabouts.
TEXT_FESSUM701_04082_SEQ_03: P'obyano greets you and relates the situation in detail. Commissioned to craft the most delicious frozen dessert the realm has ever seen, a renowned confectioner named Nekeke struck out to the northern seas in search of the finest ice in all Eorzea─and naught has been heard from her since. As P'obyano ponders what might have befallen her special guest, you are interrupted by a scream coming from the beach. The faire attendant confirms that it is none other than Nekeke who appears to be drowning in the water, and you quickly rush to the confectioner's aid.
TEXT_FESSUM701_04082_SEQ_04: Rescued from an untimely demise, Nekeke pieces together her fragmented memories and relates to you her travails. In retrieving a chunk of pristine ice from the harsh, snow-swept northern isles, it would appear that she inadvertently brought along with it a particularly blustery fiend that was responsible for sinking her ship, and now threatens to wreak havoc on the typically peaceful shores of Costa del Sol. P'obyano is quick to assure her, however, that you and your friends are more than up to the task of quelling this menace, and the two of you set off to consult with Haermaga about what might be done.
TEXT_FESSUM701_04082_SEQ_05:
You apprise Haermaga of the situation, and are heartened indeed when a contingent of veteran battlers appears out of the blue to assist you in dispatching the Bombard threat. Steeling yourself for a heated battle, you prepare to face the explosive fiend. Make for the Isle of Endless Summer, and do your part to save the Moonfire Faire by defeating the Ice Bombards in the FATE “A Blizzard of Bombards.”

※The FATE “A Blizzard of Bombards” can only be completed as a Disciple of War or Magic.
TEXT_FESSUM701_04082_SEQ_06: Thanks to the bravery of you and your companions, the blustery Bombard menace has been banished from the Isle of Endless Summer, and Nekeke can at long last commence work on her masterpiece. Pay visit to the confectioner and let her know that she need worry about exploding balls of ice no longer.
TEXT_FESSUM701_04082_SEQ_07: With the beaches of the Isle of Endless Summer safe once more, Nekeke vows to create a dessert that will please the Master Gegeruju's discerning palate and aesthetic eye. All that remains is to wait for her to complete her work before the festivities can truly begin.
TEXT_FESSUM702_04083_SEQ_00:
Nekeke has a mind to whip up the finest frozen dessert you've ever laid eyes on.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESSUM702_04083_SEQ_01:
Nekeke thanks you again for dispatching the Bombard menace she unwittingly brought upon Costa del Sol. Free to finally perform the duties for which she was summoned, she takes to the kitchen to begin work on her latest masterpiece. In the meantime, she encourages you to go for a stroll on the beach with P'obyano, as well as to share news of her progress with Master Gegeruju if you are so inclined.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESSUM702_04083_SEQ_02: After thanking you once more for your efforts, P'obyano shares with you a tale of her and Nekeke's past. Friends since childhood, the two have long looked up to adventurers─and in fact chose to pursue their current professions as a tribute to those like you who keep the people of Eorzea safe. The time having passed by in an instant, you suppose that Nekeke might be finished with her task.
TEXT_FESSUM702_04083_SEQ_03: You return to Nekeke, who cheerfully announces that the dessert that is to serve as the highlight of this year's festivities is all but complete. Waiting eagerly with your friends, you are swept away by the masterfully fashioned confection, as well as by the snow shower summoned from the skies somehow by Nekeke's frosty, fluffy companions─one of whom, surprisingly enough, seems determined to join you on your adventures. With all coming to a triumphant end, you wish Nekeke and your friends well and stride forth to enjoy the festivities as they commence in earnest.
TEXT_FESEST701_04089_SEQ_00:
Jihli Aliapoh greets you with anxious enthusiasm.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESEST701_04089_SEQ_01:
Jihli Aliapoh shares with you her prophetic dream for this year's Hatching-tide, a vision wherein rabbits and chickens work paw in claw to decorate the town for the annual event. She explains, however, that there has been a slight hiccup in the preparations, and asks that you look for her egg-collecting colleague Nonotta at the Greatloam Growery.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESEST701_04089_SEQ_02: You find Nonotta in costume at the Greatloam Growery, and she introduces you to Master Pawlin─the owner of a flock of excitable chickens. After listening to Nonotta's woes, you are suddenly tasked with facing down an escaped hen. Gazing deep into the feathery fiend's soulless eyes, you sense quite distinctly that the flock wants Pawlin to dish out their extra-special feed...
TEXT_FESEST701_04089_SEQ_03: Pawlin confirms that he does indeed have a special mix for extra-special occasions. Once they have finished feeding the voracious birds, however, an exhausted and miserable Nonotta pleads with you to undertake the perilous duty of egg collection. She stands ready to send you off with a basket and a prayer.
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_SEQ_00:
Nonotta is in need of your egg-collecting eggcellence.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_SEQ_01:
You indicate your readiness to brave the gauntlet of bellicose beaks, and Nonotta sends you over to Pawlin and the Dreamer's Run.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_SEQ_02:
You speak with Pawlin, who unlocks the door to his little darlings' temporary home. Enter the Dreamer's Run, and do your part to save Hatching-tide by collecting eggs in the FATE “An Eggsistential Threat.”

※The FATE “An Eggsistential Threat” can only be completed as a Disciple of War or Magic.
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_SEQ_03: You have ventured into the Dreamer's Run and claimed its yolk-filled treasures. Report your success to Nonotta.
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_SEQ_04: Duly impressed by your unparalleled egg-collecting skills, Nonotta showers you with praise and gratitude. It is past time your precious cargo was conveyed to Jihli where she anxiously awaits at Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre.
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_SEQ_05: Jihli joyously accepts your hard-won eggs, and turns her attention to the important tasks of baking and painting. Meanwhile, Nonotta asks that you accompany her to the front of the amphitheatre, where you are to distribute gifts of thanks to the multitude of Hatching-tide helpers.
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_SEQ_06: While Nonotta is busy removing the poultry-based filth from her costume, you hand out presents to an eclectic group of pleasantly surprised festival decorators. Your current task complete, you can now report to Jihli for further instructions.
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_SEQ_07: Jihli thanks you once more for your assistance, before remarking on the unusual number of moogles and sylphs in attendance. The celebration, it seems, is a grand success. Jihli's final instructions to you are simple: throw yourself in amongst the rabbits and the chickens, and join in the festival fun!
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_SEQ_00:
Kipih Jakkya is looking around in consternation.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_SEQ_01:
Kipih Jakkya, reporter for Gridanian tabloid The Raven, shares with you the details of her latest potential scoop. It would seem she is hot on the trail of some mysterious figure responsible for buying up a suspicious quantity of Nymeia lilies, but needs someone familiar with Ul'dah to assist in her investigations. Perhaps the notables of the Quicksand can aid in your inquiries.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_SEQ_02: Mistress Momodi herself fields your questions, the description you provide reminding her of a request made by the infamous “wandering minstrel” involving the transport of a sizable cargo to the Alchemists' Guild. Although conceding the similarities may be mere coincidence, you nevertheless decide to pay a visit to Guildmaster Severian.
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_SEQ_03: The self-absorbed Severian almost dismisses you out of hand, but at the last moment recalls a task to process a vast quantity of floral material. His brief flicker of interest in the subject soon extinguished, the guildmaster directs you to speak with the guild's steadfast receptionist, Deitrich, for the details.
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_SEQ_04: Without revealing the nature of the finished product, Deitrich explains that the fruits of their labor are to be distributed amongst the populace over the course of the Rising. If Kipih would learn more, it seems there is no recourse left but to accost the minstrel himself. It is time to return to the Quicksand.
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_SEQ_05: After digesting the information you brought back from the Alchemists' Guild, Kipih agrees that an “on the spot” interview is in order. According to the Quicksand's clientele, the minstrel should be preparing to put on a performance in the vicinity of the Ruby Road Exchange.
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_SEQ_06: The wandering minstrel welcomes your questions, relieved to hear that his surprise was not inadvertently spoiled. On the contrary, rather than turn you away, the nomadic musician insists that you participate in his plan to distribute bundles of custom-made potpourri to the masses. Kipih suggests that the two of you return to the Quicksand, whence news of your aromatic offerings should reach a wide and varied audience.
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_SEQ_07: You finish handing out your bundles of calming potpourri, warmed by the knowledge that your efforts will help soothe hearts yet suffering from the violence of the Calamity. Return to the wandering minstrel at the Ruby Road Exchange and report the completion of your task.
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_SEQ_08: You locate the itinerant bard, and Kipih is moved to share her own memories of the Calamity. The exchange inspires the minstrel, who composes a verse dedicated to the continued safe passage of those who yet ascend the path out of catastrophe and despair. Without warning, you are transported beyond the boundaries of time and space, to meet and speak with the enigmatic Naoki Yoshida. Upon your return to “reality,” the minstrel favors you with yet another composition, compounding his wishes that you─indeed, all who seek to survive in this world─are afforded the smoothest road possible for the journey still to come.
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_SEQ_00:
Lisette de Valentione has her mitts full this Valentione's Day.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_SEQ_01:
Kupka Kupp, emissary of ardor and affection, finds himself overtaxed this Valentione's Day. To aid in his deliveries, his postmoogle betters have provided him with a fledgling courier by the name of Pukty Piko who, unfortunately, is ignorant in the ways of the heart. This postmoogle's cynicism is so dire, in fact, it threatens to spoil these romantic festivities entirely. To rectify the situation, Lisette takes it upon herself to enlist both you and Astrid in the aid of this hopeless moogle. The two of you are to accompany Pukty as she makes her rounds, all the while instructing her in the myriad meanings of love. Having assented to this scheme, the postmoogle and her chocobo companion make for their first delivery at the Carpenters' Guild, where she awaits you.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_SEQ_02: Upon your arrival, you discover that the recipient of the parcel is out on an errand. Pukty Piko, eager to get on with her other assignments, is only moments away from dropping the package right where she floats, but is successfully stopped by both you and Astrid. You convince the moogle that the gift must be hand-delivered, so you set off for the Botanists' Guild, where you blindly assume the carpenter has gone.
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_SEQ_03: As predicted, you find the carpenter at the Botanists' Guild, where Pukty Piko at last makes good on the delivery. The once-surly man thanks you profusely, which leaves Pukty Piko perplexed: why such gratitude over a mere delivery? Astrid explains that joy, in all its forms, is meant to be shared with others, and that the man chose to impart some of his happiness to those who delivered his gift. The postmoogle appears receptive to this first lesson in love, and you set off for the next delivery at the Whistling Miller.
