TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_SEQ_04: Pukty Piko is shocked to find that her second parcel, delivered to an anxious girl, contained nothing more than rosy seashells and a simple card. The recipient, however, is overjoyed at the gift─an assurance of safety from a friend adventuring abroad, from whom she had been eagerly awaiting news. Pukty Piko thus learns that each person has their own unique way of sharing love and affection.
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_SEQ_05: The third parcel, delivered to a man at Apkallu Falls, is a pair of earrings from Ul'dah intended as a birthday gift. The customer's excitement is palpable as he explains his desire to see his wife happy on her special day and share their remaining years together. His gratitude also inspires a strange sensation in Pukty Piko─which Astrid is pleased to inform her is none other than a form of love. With all three deliveries fulfilled and the moogle's inner life enriched, the time has come to return to Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre.
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_SEQ_06: Kupka Kupp is ecstatic to hear of Pukty Piko's progress and to watch her blossom into the dutiful postmoogle of penned passions she was always meant to be. Bolstered by the steady growth his protégée has displayed, he admits he has another task for you all, one of a slightly more delicate nature.
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_SEQ_00:
Kupka Kupp has a matter of the heart on his mind.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_SEQ_01:
A distraught Kupka Kupp tells you of a young Elezen woman by the name of Aloyse, who has suddenly begged the moogle to rescind a letter she posted only moments ago. According to Kupka, tears were sparkling in her eyes as she fled the scene, and now, left only with a vague understanding of where she has gone, the postmoogle begs you and your friends' assistance in locating her. Astrid and Kupka Kupp are to search Greatloam Growery, while you and Pukty Piko are to head to Nophica's Altar.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_SEQ_02: You have found Aloyse, who expresses contrition for worrying Kupka Kupp. She departs with haste to Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre, telling you she will divulge all there.
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_SEQ_03: Aloyse explains that Ezolmile, an Ishgardian blue blood, has sought her hand in marriage. Though she is delighted by the prospect of a life so happily situated with her beloved, she confesses to a worry she cannot shake: she is not noble herself. Heart heavy with doubt, she retrieved her letter, which contained her acceptance, before it could be sent off. Pukty Piko, now wiser to all things romantical in nature, insists she not give up so easily, and together with you and the other emissaries she writes her message anew. Kupka Kupp and Pukty Piko set off at once to see to the delivery, leaving Aloyse to wait for her darling's reply with bated breath.
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_SEQ_04: Anxiety coursing through her─and unwilling to let her future be decided without her present─Aloyse races off toward the Gentry's Ward, where Ezolmile could be poring over the contents of her letter this very moment. Astrid, concerned for the young woman, urges you to follow her.
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_SEQ_05: Upon arriving at the Gentry's Ward, you find that Ezolmile has not only received Aloyse's letter, but is in the middle of reading it as well. No sooner has he absorbed his beloved's words than he makes to write a reply. Aloyse returns to Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre with all haste to ensure that she is present when Kupka Kupp and Pukty Piko rejoin the group with his correspondence. Lisette, left out of your adventure to the Gentry's Ward, must be getting impatient.
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_SEQ_06: Pukty Piko and Kupka Kupp return shortly after you, and deliver Ezolmile's letter to Aloyse. Her beloved's reply is of the sweetest nature, and he writes to say that nothing can stand between them and marital bliss. To everyone's surprise, Ezolmile makes an appearance and the two lovebirds leave to discuss their future in a more private setting. So touched is Pukty Piko by the sight of the happy couple that her pom transforms into the shape of a heart, and she becomes a full-fledged emissary of ardor and affection. Kupka Kupp, pink with pride, asks for her continued cooperation during these most jovial festivities.
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_SEQ_00:
Pukty Piko appears to be beset with troubles.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_SEQ_01:
Word of your deeds has spread, and now citizens have turned to the emissaries of ardor and affection en masse for assistance with their assorted woes. Left alone to field this sudden influx of patrons, Pukty Piko seeks your aid in tidying up these poor people's problems. Speak with her to begin the arduous─though no doubt rewarding─task of giving these citizens a reason to smile this Valentione's Day.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_SEQ_02: Pukty Piko appreciates all that you have done, but there are still others to whom you've yet to attend. Should you find the time, speak with Pukty again and assist those remaining...in the spirit of love!
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_SEQ_00:
It's that special time of year where the streets light up for the Starlight Celebration. Amh Garanjy is busy readying for the festivities at Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre and may just have a special task for you.

※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_SEQ_01:
Amh Garanjy welcomes you to this year's Starlight Celebration, and introduces you to her new friend─a diminutive yeti named Rudy, who appears to have something to say to her. Though you are at first at a loss to understand the words of the little snow creature, the auspice Rissai conveniently arrives on the scene. Through his interpretation, you learn of Rudy's heart-wrenching tale of rejection by his brothers, and his gratitude to the Saint of Nymeia, who saved him in his time of need after he became lost in the forest. Moved by his courage, you agree to aid him in expressing his thanks by serving as one of the saint's little helpers. Together with Rissai, you resolve to come up with a plan for how best to get Rudy involved in the Starlight Celebration.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_SEQ_02: After some deliberation, you and Rissai come up with a plan: to have Rudy help make snowball-shaped desserts for the festivities. His role as a saint's helper decided, the little yeti's eyes light up with delight. There is one rub, however, in that neither you nor Rissai has experience in making this particular kind of confection. Fortunately, Rissai has just the person in mind, and along with Rudy you set off for the Carline Canopy to seek Mother Miounne's aid.
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_SEQ_03: Thanks to Miounne, you have everything you need to make Rudy's celebratory confections─everything, that is, besides the necessary ingredients. There is shopping to be done, and Rudy is eager as always to take on the task. The first item on your list is flour from the Whistling Miller in Old Gridania.
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_SEQ_04: You watch over Rudy fondly as he conducts his very first errand, managing to obtain the necessary flour with little difficulty on his own thanks to the shopping list provided by Mother Miounne. Eager to continue, he scampers off to the Botanists' Guild for the next ingredient: cooking oil.
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_SEQ_05: Though his beastly appearance initially spooks the shopkeep, Rudy once again manages to triumph over the odds and successfully complete his task. Flour and cooking oil both safely in hand, you and your friends prepare to return to the Carline Canopy to start making your Starlight treats.
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_SEQ_06: Mother Miounne guides you and Rudy through the confection-making process with an experienced, gentle hand, and before you know it, a full batch of delicious treats has been prepared. Confident that these will surely bring joy to every child who receives them, you leave Miounne to finish packing them up and set off to report back to Amh Garanjy, who will undoubtedly be delighted at your contribution to the festivities.
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_SEQ_07: Back at the amphitheatre, Amh Garanjy is overjoyed to hear of how much Rudy has accomplished already, and expresses her wish to see him grow even more. To that end, she would offer you and your friends your next duty as the saint's little helpers, if you are up to the task.
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_SEQ_00:
Amh Garanjy knows just what you and your friends can do to put smiles on the children's faces.

※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_SEQ_01:
The snowball cakes you made with Rudy have been packed along with Mother Miounne's other gifts and shipped to Bentbranch Meadows, where they are to be delivered to the children. You, Rudy, and Rissai make your way to the Shroud to seek out Baenfaeld, the celebrant in charge of the task.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_SEQ_02: Upon seeing the sheer number of gift boxes entrusted to your care, Rissai suggests splitting the task, that you might more swiftly place presents into the young ones' hands. You resolve to follow the ever-eager Rudy and keep watch over him as he passes out his handmade snowball treats.
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_SEQ_03: Rudy gives a gift box to every child he meets. While some are skeptical at first, their faces light up when they see, smell, and taste the delightful and delicious seasonal treats. The children's joy is reflected in Rudy's elated expression at seeing his confections bring so much happiness to those around him. His job done, it appears the little yeti has something to say to you.
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_SEQ_04: Rudy appears to be expressing his satisfaction at being able to serve as one of the saint's little helpers this Starlight. With all the presents safely in the hands of the children, you set out to return to Baenfaeld, who will surely be happy to hear how well this year's gifts were received.
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_SEQ_05: You and Rudy reunite with Rissai and Baenfaeld, but there is unfortunately little time to celebrate your success, as Rudy's brothers─a monstrous pair of yetis─burst into Bentbranch Meadows, intent on taking him back home. Rudy, however, has a thing or two to say to them. With your encouragement─and a confidence altogether new to him─he proudly tells them of how he created the greatest snowball cakes of his life, and helped spread joy to the children this Starlight. One taste of the treats in question is all it takes for his brothers to see how far Rudy has come, and they apologize for treating him so poorly all these years. Finally accepted by his family for who he is, it appears Rudy is ready to return to the mountains.
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_SEQ_06: Rudy is beside himself with gratitude for the role you played in making his first Starlight experience such a memorable one. Much to his delight, the Saint of Nymeia has also left him a letter praising him as the finest little helper of the season. Moved by how far your little friend has come in such a short time─if sad that you must say goodbye─you and Rissai wish Rudy well as he follows his brothers back to their home in the mountains. With nothing left to do here, it is time to report back to Amh Garanjy so that she, too, can take pleasure in your exploits.
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_SEQ_07: Amh Garanjy gives her sincerest thanks for everything you did for Rudy. Moved by his hard work and determination to spread joy to everyone around him, she feels the joyous spirit of the Starlight Celebration burn with a renewed vigor within her. His job here done, Rissai, ever the wanderer, bids you farewell and sets off in search of exotic lands and delightful desserts. For you, however, the festivities are still in full swing, as Amh Garanjy informs you that none other than the Saint of Nymeia himself would have a word with you in person.
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_SEQ_00:
A certain esteemed personage would speak to you immediately, and Amh Garanjy is ready to introduce you.

※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_SEQ_01:
Amh Garanjy informs you that none other than the Saint of Nymeia is asking after you. Though neither of you are sure why, it would appear he has specifically requested your presence in person. Seek him out and see what he would ask of you.

※Please note that you will not be able to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_SEQ_02:
The Saint of Nymeia wishes you a merry Starlight, and proceeds to explain his plight. It would seem he finds himself at a loss regarding what sort of new gifts he should fashion for the children this year, and would have you join him on a stroll through the town in hopes the sights might inspire him. You resolve to accompany him to one or more scenic locations─chosen from among Apkallu Falls, the Lancers' Guild, the Leatherworkers' Guild, the marketplace, the watermill, and the Greatloam Growery─before making your way to Nophica's Altar.

※You must be accompanied by the Saint of Nymeia to complete this task. Speak with him again should you become separated.
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_SEQ_03: The saint appears satisfied with the inspiration your stroll together has provided him, though he doubtless would appreciate it even more if you were to accompany him to another location or two.
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_SEQ_04: The sight of the scenic Gridanian streetscapes veiled in snow, and the vigor and vitality of its people have filled the Saint of Nymeia with renewed energy, enthusiasm, and a healthy dose of Starlight spirit. Declaring his intention to craft little snow globes for the children depicting the picturesque scenes that inspired him so, he returns to his workshop, leaving you to report back to Amh Garanjy at the amphitheatre.
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_SEQ_05: Amh Garanjy welcomes you back from your excursion, and provides you with a gift left especially for you by the saint himself in appreciation for your efforts. Your task complete, you are free to enjoy the Starlight Celebration as you like for as long as the festivities continue. Should you wish to pay the saint a visit once more before season's end, he would certainly welcome your company.
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_SEQ_00:
Marabel looks you up and down, a glint in her eye.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_SEQ_01:
Marabel is seeking an experienced adventurer to aid her entry for this year's Little Ladies' Day walk-off. You agree to help by surveying the Ul'dahn citizens about their impressions of this holiday.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_SEQ_02: Having successfully surveyed the citizens, you head toward Eshtaime's Aesthetics to report your findings to Marabel.
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_SEQ_03: Inspired by the citizens' responses, Marabel quickly sets to work on assembling your costume. You decide to wait for her at the designated location per her instructions.
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_SEQ_04: As the fates would have it, you will be strutting atop the stage in this year's Little Ladies' Day walk-off. You make your preparations ere approaching Marabel, who awaits on Emerald Avenue, once more.
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_SEQ_05: You and Marabel manage to take first place in the Little Ladies' Day walk-off and add your names to the annals of fashion fame. She is overjoyed, and you head back to offer her a word of congratulations.
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_SEQ_06: Galvanized by her first fashion victory, Marabel sets forth in pursuit of her next goal: launching a brand of her own. As thanks for lending your support, she offers to help you select an outfit should you wish to participate in Masked Rose's Fashion Check.
TEXT_FESPDY702_04472_SEQ_00:
Marabel is beaming with pride.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESPDY702_04472_SEQ_01:
As thanks for helping her win the Little Ladies' Day walk-off, Marabel has offered to lend you her styling expertise in your efforts to outfit a model of your own. You agree to come up with a concept and report back to her near the stage.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESPDY702_04472_SEQ_02: Marabel has prepared a dazzling ensemble for your chosen model─who, for their part, seems quite pleased with this change of costume. You decide to thank Marabel for her services.
TEXT_FESPDY702_04472_SEQ_03: Pleased with your foray into the fashion world, Marabel has agreed to provide further styling assistance for a model of your choosing. You kindly accept, promising to stop by again if time permits.
TEXT_FESHLW702_04520_SEQ_00:
The Adventurers' Guild investigator has someone to introduce to you.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESHLW702_04520_SEQ_01:
The investigator introduces you to Marke, an expert on the occult sent by the guild to assist you in apprehending the Scarlet Snout. After sharing a brief explanation on the nature of the so-called Night of Devilry, he presents you with two of his prized inventions that he hopes will serve to make your journey much less precarious. Properly equipped, you prepare to make for the Scarlet Snout's domain and steel yourself for the battle ahead.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESHLW702_04520_SEQ_02: The Scarlet Snout informs you that the feast is now ready to welcome visitors. Equipped with the tools you need to ensure your safety in the spectral realm, you go to seek out the harlequin guide under the Bentbranch Meadows bridge or in the Acorn Orchard, that you might be shown to the banquet. Once you have completed your business at the Phantoms' Feast, the Adventurers' Guild investigator will be eagerly awaiting evidence of your experience there in the form of one of the pumpkin cookies the Snout is said to be distributing to his guests.
TEXT_FESHLW702_04520_SEQ_03: You regale the Adventurers' Guild investigator with a tale of your time at the feast. He thanks you for your efforts, and assures you that he has warned the other invitees not to take the Snout up on his offer, so that there will be no further victims. Assured that the denizens of Gridania are safe from the red-nosed fiend's trickery, you consider paying the festivities another visit or two to make sure there are no other lost souls in need of your help.
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_SEQ_00:
Mayaru Moyaru looks eager to regale you about all there is to know of the latest Moonfire Faire.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_SEQ_01:
Noticing the sweat on your brow from the summer heat, Mayaru Moyaru motions you to visit Costa del Sol so you can cool down by taking a dip in its serene waters. He implores you to enjoy the Moonfire Faire festivities while you are there, and mentions the return of a mysterious attraction. To learn more, it seems you must speak with his colleague, Haermaga, in the seaside resort.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_SEQ_02: Haermaga quickly reveals to you that the mysterious returning attraction is none other than the Eorzean Nimble Warrior course─albeit reborn. He mentions that he has a request he wishes to make of you, if you are willing to help. Speak with him again to accept his request.
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_SEQ_03: Haermaga's request concerns R'fhul Tia, whom he feels has let his early success get to his head. He wants you to act as a guiding star for the young adventurer, and set him back upon the right path. To do so, you will first need to speak with R'fhul Tia.
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_SEQ_04: Both of R'fhul Tia's apprentices introduce themselves to you at his behest. Though he seems quite confident he will succeed in his attempt through the Eorzean Nimble Warrior course, you notice that the two of them and R'majha are worried about him. Proceed to the destination to watch how he performs.
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_SEQ_05: R'fhul Tia's attempt ended in failure. After such a fall, he is in dire need of help. Render him aid with all haste.
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_SEQ_06: R'fhul Tia's apprentices do not mince words in expressing their disappointment with him, and shortly thereafter take their leave. He cannot seem to understand what he did wrong, but fortunately for him, he still has you.
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_SEQ_00:
R'fhul Tia is mired in the depths of despair.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_SEQ_01:
R'fhul is unresponsive to the sound of your voice. He may need a bigger gesture to wake him from his stupor, such as an attempt to /comfort him.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_SEQ_02: After speaking with you and Beaudefoin, R'fhul Tia finally understands where he went wrong in his initial attempt through the Eorzean Nimble Warrior course. To inspire him to do his best, you have opted to join him in tackling the course this time. Speak with Beaudefoin to get started.
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_SEQ_03: You have begun your attempt through the Eorzean Nimble Warrior course. Speak with Hildelana upon reaching the halfway point.
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_SEQ_04: You have made it past the halfway point. Speak with P'obyano upon reaching the end of the course.
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_SEQ_05: After completing the course, you proudly watch on from ahead as R'fhul Tia, following your example, tries his best to complete the course─and successfully manages to do so. Seeking a moment to rest, he suggests you take this opportunity to give R'mahja the good news.
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_SEQ_06: After seeing their mentor try his best, R'fhul Tia and his impassioned pair of apprentices were able to make up. Your work concluded, it's time to report the day's events to Haermaga.
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_SEQ_07: You have reported everything that happened to Haermaga. For the time being, it seems there is no need to worry about R'fhul Tia and his apprentices. It's time to relax, don your reward, and enjoy the festivities.
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_SEQ_00:
The wandering minstrel has a request for an experienced adventurer.

※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_SEQ_01:
Making your way through the Ruby Road Exchange during the Rising, you encounter the wandering minstrel, who asks you to take a fledgling adventurer under your wing. Thus do you make your way to the Gate of Nald, there to await a soul who has just embarked upon the path of adventure.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_SEQ_02: It doesn't take long for an aspiring adventurer to wander through the gate, nor for you to identify him. You approach the bright-eyed lad, who introduces himself as Nhagi'a Jakkya. He gratefully accepts your offer of help, and heads to the Quicksand to register with the Adventurers' Guild, as you yourself once did.
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_SEQ_03: With the stroke of a pen and a few words of encouragement from Momodi, Nhagi'a's registration is complete. In view of your experience, the Quicksand proprietress then tasks you with giving the lad the grand tour, beginning with recommending a guild in Ul'dah to join.
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_SEQ_04: Your sage advice helps Nhagi'a to settle on a guild. Wasting no time, he rushes off to add his name to its roll, but not before requesting to meet again afterwards. When the lad doesn't return after a good while, you decide to look in on him at the guild.
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_SEQ_05: To your relief, you find Nhagi'a more than holding his own. After apologizing for keeping you waiting, he informs you that a peculiar minstrel had approached him with a task, and bade him come to the Ruby Road Exchange to speak further. Curiously, your own presence is also requested, and you make your way to see the client together.
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_SEQ_06: As you had suspected, the client turns out to be the wandering minstrel. The man reveals that, in seeking inspiration for his next composition, he contrived to bring you and Nhagi'a together─an adventurer old and an adventurer new─in a reminder that the present owes its existence to the past. Having thus established his vision, the minstrel then asks each of you to bring him an object with a connection to the Calamity, the event which gave rise to the realm's rebirth. Excited for his first-ever task as an adventurer, Nhagi'a suggests taking your search to the Sapphire Avenue Exchange, where many vendors peddle their wares.
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_SEQ_07:
You join Nhagi'a at the Sapphire Avenue Exchange, and together begin looking for your objects.

※You must be accompanied by Nhagi'a Jakkya to complete this task. Speak with him again should you become separated.
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_SEQ_08: You have visited a number of vendors and found promising wares for your purposes. Believing you've seen enough, Nhagi'a suggests heading to a quiet spot to discuss what you will bring to the minstrel.
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_SEQ_09: You reveal your selection to Nhagi'a, but he chooses to keep his a surprise. Having then acquired your respective items, you head back to the Ruby Road Exchange, where the wandering minstrel awaits.
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_SEQ_10:
You present your acquisition to the minstrel, who declares its suitability for his composition before turning his attention to Nhagi'a. The lad reveals his object to be the scrapbook of articles taken from The Raven, the Gridanian tabloid where his sister works as a reporter. During the Calamity, said sister traveled the realm, interviewing adventurers about their journeys, and her tales instilled in him the desire to see the world. Your combined contributions serve to inspire the minstrel, who conceives of a verse and proceeds to perform it. No sooner does he strum the first chord than you are transported to a place beyond time and space, where you meet with the mysterious Naoki Yoshida. The man thanks you for continuing to grace the realm with your presence, and hints that change is coming. Yet come what may, he hopes that your journey together shall ever continue.

Returning to reality, you bid Nhagi'a well as he sets off on his own. And after the young adventurer has disappeared from sight, the minstrel performs for you another song─one of futures unknown and journeys unending. Hardships may await upon the road ahead, and there may be times when you feel defeated. But so long as you harbor love for this world, ever shall there be a place for you in it.
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_SEQ_00:
Ollier is in dire need of an adventurer's assistance.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_SEQ_01:
Ollier and his fellow attendants have been hard at work spreading the word across the realm of all the Gold Saucer has to offer, but it seems there is a rub─one of his colleagues has lost his confidence entirely, and the man refuses to admit that there is a problem. Ollier would have you inquire with the poor man as an impartial third party, and begs that you accompany him to Limsa Lominsa, where the individual in question is currently on assignment.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_SEQ_02: Speaking to Ollier upon your arrival in Limsa Lominsa, you learn that the dispirited colleague of whom he spoke is none other than Senor Sabotender─the Gold Saucer's star mascot and mood-maker. Whatever could be responsible for his uncharacteristic lack of motivation? All you can do is speak to the succulent staff member and inquire for yourself.
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_SEQ_03: You inquire with Senor Sabotender in hopes of gleaning the reason behind his recent malaise, but receive only a knowing gaze and beckoning arm in response. It would appear the Gold Saucer's mascot would prefer to discuss the matter out of the earshot of any potential eavesdroppers.
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_SEQ_04: As you survey your surroundings in search of Senor Sabotender, you are greeted instead by one Nanaphon─the young thespian inside the succulent green suit. The lad explains that while he has traveled with his colleagues here to Limsa in hopes of spreading the word about the Gold Saucer, he has found himself unable to sufficiently express the full extent of its wonders, as he has been sworn to a vow of silence so as to conceal Senor Sabotender's true identity. He rejoices when you offer to be his voice, and promises to share his finely honed sales pitch that you may contribute to the promotional effort.
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_SEQ_05: Fully enlightened by Nanaphon as to all the Saucer has to offer, you are now prepared to share the joy of Eorzea's foremost entertainment destination with the denizens of the city. You stride towards the Aftcastle ready to join Senor Sabotenor in your effort to reel in a host of new paying customers.
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_SEQ_06: At the Aftcastle, you are rejoined by Nanaphon, who once again has donned his Senor Sabotender suit and sealed his lips tight. Exchanging a determined glance with your succulent friend, you prepare to go forth into the city and give the sales pitch of your life.
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_SEQ_07: Through your earnest efforts, the residents of Limsa Lominsa now are well versed in the vast array of wonders that await them at the Manderville Gold Saucer. You prepare to reconvene with Senor Sabotender, in the hopes that your spiny companion is satisfied with your achievements.
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_SEQ_08: Though he speaks not a word, Senor Sabotender's intent gaze makes it clear that he is deeply appreciative of all you have done to help make his mission a success. Ollier, as well, arrives on the scene, announcing that all staff have been summoned back to the Saucer at once. Your work in Limsa Lominsa done, you are free to join them in the return voyage.
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_SEQ_09: Back at the Saucer, Ollier expresses his profound gratitude for having won over a plethora of new patrons for the establishment─some of whom it would seem have already made the trip. Senor Sabotender, for his part, welcomes the new guests in his inimitable style. Accepting a small token of thanks from the Saucer staff, you take your leave, satisfied that you have done right by your friends─smooth-skinned and prickly alike.
TEXT_FESNYR901_04588_SEQ_00:
The usagi bugyo sees great fortune in your future.

※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESNYR901_04588_SEQ_01:
This Heavensturn, the usagi bugyo, a member of a Far Eastern delegation come from Hingashi, is eager to introduce the good people of Eorzea to a tradition sure to change their fortune for the better. Eyeing you carefully, he ascertains that you are an adventurer, and mentions a request he would make of you. Dangling the opportunity to acquire your very own set of Far Eastern armor before you, he bids you speak with his colleague, an omikujishi standing near the Tempest Gate.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESNYR901_04588_SEQ_02: As you approach the Far Eastern omikujishi, you find him with a dismayed expression on his face, and soon learn that he has experienced difficulty in getting the townspeople to take an interest in omikuji, a form of fortune-telling native to the Far East. Never one to turn down a soul in need─and with a set of your very own yoroi on the line─you agree to assist him by spreading word of the attraction to any who will listen on the upper decks of Limsa Lominsa.
TEXT_FESNYR901_04588_SEQ_03: From the Drowning Wench to the Missing Member, you have spread word of the fortune-telling spectacle to people from all walks of life, including a storm lieutenant of the Maelstrom, and even the pirate captain of the Sanguine Sirens herself. You can only hope that enough folk were enticed by your words to give the omikujishi the audience he deserves.
TEXT_FESNYR901_04588_SEQ_04: Upon returning to the omikujishi, he thanks you for your assistance, and asks that you remain at his side to see the fruits of your labor. As the townspeople amass and read their fortunes, you observe reactions both of glee and despair. Should you find yourself with a moment to spare, there may be another matter you can assist the omikujishi with.
TEXT_FESNYR902_04589_SEQ_00:
The Far Eastern omikujishi appears troubled by what he is seeing.

※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESNYR902_04589_SEQ_01:
Concerned by the Far Eastern omikujishi's worried expression, you approach him once more to discover what may have caused the furrow in his brow. Before you can say a word, however, he asks for a moment of your time, nodding in Beaudefoin's direction. His desire to lift the adventurer's spirits is quickly apparent, and though he makes a valiant effort to do so, the despondent man can no longer see reason. Convinced that his words cannot reach the down-on-his-luck adventurer, the omikujishi instead turns to you, asking that you too make an attempt to cheer the poor man up.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESNYR902_04589_SEQ_02: Despite your best efforts to rally Beaudefoin's spirits, it is to no avail. The omikujishi refuses to give up on the crestfallen man, however, and asks that you try to reach him once more with a different approach.
TEXT_FESNYR902_04589_SEQ_03: Seeing that your second attempt to rouse Beaudefoin is unfruitful, the omikujishi bids him recite the contents of the fortune, only to discover the dejected man had never read the whole thing. And yet, upon reading it, Beaudefoin somehow manages to sink even further into the depths of despair. The omikujishi, having at last lost patience, reads the remainder of the fortune himself. The fortune's final words of guidance, and a well-placed remark from yourself are what finally release Beaudefoin from the clutches of his own fear. But no sooner has he been made to see reason than the mochi daikan appears before you out of breath, bringing distressing news of an adventurer in trouble. Believing this adventurer to be Hildelana, Beaudefoin rushes off to the rescue. Concerned whether Beaudefoin is in the right state of mind to be saving anyone, the omikujishi asks that you follow after him, to which you oblige.
TEXT_FESNYR902_04589_SEQ_04: Though you find Hildelana and Beaudefoin free from any serious harm, the same cannot be said for Beaudefoin's beloved armor. The adventurer pair set off to visit the armorer and promise to find you again later. The mochi daikan suggests that you both return to Limsa Lominsa, and report the current state of affairs to the omikujishi.
TEXT_FESNYR902_04589_SEQ_05: Just as you finish reciting the tale of Beaudefoin and Hildelana's rescue to the omikujishi, the pair return as promised. Having heard that naught can be done for Beaudefoin's armor, and moved by his selfless act, the usagi bugyo insists that the adventurer accept a set of yoroi from the Far Eastern delegation. The omikujishi reminds the flabbergasted man, still unable to believe his luck, that omikuji should be seen as a guide, and not as one's fate set in stone. With a new set of armor in tow, Beaudefoin and Hildelana are ready to set off on a new adventure, their bond of friendship tempered by the day's events. Turning to you, the omikujishi thanks you for your service, offering you a set of yoroi of your own, and the opportunity to draw as many omikuji as you wish. With your obligations thus fulfilled, you are free to enjoy the remainder of the festivities to your heart's content.
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_SEQ_00:
Jihli Aliapoh is simply dying to talk to an adventurer─preferably you─about eggs.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_SEQ_01:
After wishing you a very happy Hatching-tide and sharing with you the details of her latest vision, Jihli Aliapoh wastes no time in enlisting your services to deal with a most pressing concern that threatens to interfere with this year's festivities. To wit, she would ask you to make haste to the Greatloam Growery and do what you can to procure eggs from Master Pawlin's flock of fine chickens─a task which has proved an unexpected challenge thus far. You set out for the farm in hopes of seeking out one Nonotta─a friend of Jihli's who will provide further enlightenment as to the task required of you.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_SEQ_02: At the Greatloam Growery, a crestfallen Nonotta informs you that Master Pawlin's flock of fine birds has fled the farm along with the so-called “happy bunnies”─rabbit-like creatures of legend said to bring all who encounter them good fortune. At Jihli's dear friend's behest, you agree to search for the creatures, in the hopes that this year's Hatching-tide festivities might resemble those foretold.
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_SEQ_03: Following the trail of your quarry, you learn that the rabbits and chickens ran off in the direction of New Gridania. You resolve to head there and see if there are any leads to be had.
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_SEQ_04: Try as you might to track down the fugitive rabbits and chickens, they as yet elude your grasp─having fled this time out of the city and into the forest. Make for the Central Shroud and hunt down these rogue birds and bunnies, that the Hatching-tide festivities may yet be saved.
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_SEQ_05: Putting your keen hunting skills to good use, you manage to round up the entire menagerie of runaway critters. With a sigh of relief, you resolve to make for the city and report to Jihli Aliapoh, who will no doubt be tickled pink to hear of your success.
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_SEQ_06: Back in town, Jihli offers her profuse thanks for your efforts, further explaining that the chickens have settled down and appear ready and willing to offer their eggs to you in abundance. Hatching-tide can now go off without a hitch! Nonotta offers to finish decorating the eggs so that you and your newfound friends may take to the streets and distribute them just as Jihli envisioned in her dreams─and with any luck, bring good fortune to one and all in the process.
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_SEQ_07: With assistance from newfound friends both feathered and floppy-eared, you have completed the task of handing out decorative eggs to a host of appreciative Gridanians. And isn't that what Hatching-tide is all about? Probably! Jihli Aliapoh will no doubt be overjoyed to hear of your contributions toward seeing that this year's Hatching-tide is another resounding success.
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_SEQ_08: Jihli Aliapoh rejoices at your return, offering her profuse gratitude for your efforts in saving this year's Hatching-tide from the brink of disaster. Relieved that her dreams have once again brought smiles and joy to the denizens of Gridania, she presents you with a charming mammet fashioned to resemble the auspicious rabbits which you have grown to know and have mixed feelings about. You are now free to enjoy the Hatching-tide festivities to your heart's content, or continue to assist the Dreamers in giving the gift of eggs should you so desire.
TEXT_AKTKUA102_04644_SEQ_01: After a brief and seemingly reluctant explanation regarding island sanctuaries, Baldin has offered you his services. Speak with him any time you would like to visit an ally's island.
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_SEQ_00:
Lisette de Valentione's gaze is sultry, yet her eyes wander uneasily.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_SEQ_01:
Lisette de Valentione, vaunted emissary of love and ardor, is having sister trouble─to wit, said sister is being stubbornly insistent that she relieve Lisette of her Valentione's Day duties this year. Upon further inquiry, you discover that her demand stems from a desire to allow Lisette time with her own beloved during this season of romance. After you pledge your support to Astrid, Lisette finally consents to her younger sister's wishes, counseling her to stay true to her heart as she fulfills her duty as an emissary of affection.

Now wearing her sister's proverbial shoes, Astrid asks you to accompany her colleague, an emissary-in-training named Emilie, on a promotional tour around Gridania. You speak to Emilie to get started, but not before you take note of the cheerful determination on Astrid's face─and her uncharacteristically frilly outfit. 

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_SEQ_02:
You and Emilie set off towards the Leatherworkers' Guild to begin your advertising campaign. The lilt of a haltingly improvised love poem tells you Astrid is also hard at work.

※You must be accompanied by Emilie to complete this task. Speak with her again should you become separated.
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_SEQ_03: You managed to snag the interest of a Gridanian resident with your enthusiastic pitch. Next, Emilie suggests you head towards the Shaded Bower.
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_SEQ_04: You secure another participant for the festivities, but Emilie seems somewhat thrown by his compliment. Shaking off her reaction, she proclaims the Centaur's Eye as your next destination.
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_SEQ_05: Emilie successfully invites another potential merrymaker, but in the next breath confesses her uneasiness towards her own state of dress. In truth, she admits, she would rather wear something “adorable” rather than “handsome,” but felt it her supporting duty to contrast Lady Astrid's attire. After encouraging her to share her true feelings with Astrid, you part ways for a time to let Emilie gather her thoughts.
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_SEQ_06: You meet Emilie back at Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre only to find Lady Astrid looking rather bedraggled. Apparently, receiving the attentions inspired of her “adorable” outfit has been exhausting, and yet she feels it is her duty as Lady Lisette's successor to weather it nonetheless. Emilie takes this chance to admit her own discomfort, and you both urge Astrid to consider that love of one's natural preferences is as worthy a love as any other. Astrid is bolstered by your encouragement and vows to become the sort of emissary she is best suited to become─after changing into a suit herself, that is. Exchanging outfits, Astrid and Emilie continue facilitating this year's Valentione's Day celebrations with undeniable and radiant confidence.
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_SEQ_00:
The Adventurers' Guild investigator has the look of a man with a plan.

※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_SEQ_01:
All Saints' Wake is upon us once more, and as is apparently now custom, the Adventurers' Guild has hired an investigator to keep a close eye on the Continental Circus. In the hopes of supplanting their schemes before they can take root, he plans to sponsor a costume cortege. To promote the event, he bids you drink a potion provided by the Alchemists' Guild to transform yourself into a frightful creature fit for the occasion and speak with the townspeople.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_SEQ_02: You imbibe a curious concoction and transform yourself into a delightfully monstrous creature. Thus transfigured, all that remains is to spread word about Gridania of the costume cortege.
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_SEQ_03: Shock and intrigue are the order of the day as your disguise incites interest in the costume cortege. If the event is to be a success as in previous years, however, yet more people must be made aware of the investigator's event. To that end, you return to Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre to select another potion.
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_SEQ_04: You imbibe another curious concoction, transforming again into a festive-yet-frightful creature. Once more you set forth to tell people of the planned costume cortege.
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_SEQ_05: Gridania is abuzz with talk of the costume cortege, meaning your work in disguise is complete. You go to meet with the Adventurers' Guild investigator near the Leatherworkers' Guild, who will surely be glad to hear of your success.
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_SEQ_06: The Adventurers' Guild investigator is overjoyed to hear so many people are eager to attend the costume cortege, but not for the reasons you suspect. He soon reveals the real investigator has been transformed into a hapless monster, and that he is none other than Papa Gruff, the troublemaking clown. His plans to bring about the Night of Devilry seem to be proceeding apace as he takes his leave of you, but the appearance of a mysterious figure offers you a sliver of hope in the form of a plan.
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_SEQ_07: The Wake doctor means to reveal Papa Gruff's true identity by way of questionable cookies designed to dispel his glamour. To do that, she will disguise you as someone Papa Gruff trusts, allowing you the opportunity to offer him said cookies. After giving it some thought, you settle on the appearance of Mama Gruff.
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_SEQ_08:
Through the power of alchemy, you are transformed into Mama Gruff. With questionable cookies in hand, you make for the riverbank, hopeful you can lower Papa Gruff's guard and convince him to take the Wake doctor's bait.

※Should the transfiguration fade, speak with the Wake doctor to change into Mama Gruff again.
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_SEQ_09: With an impressive display of both cunning and charm, you convince the disguised Papa Gruff to eat one of the Wake doctor's cookies. No sooner does he take a bite than his glamour is dispelled, reverting him to his impish form. Papa Gruff is not deterred by this setback, but the arrival of the Wake doctor gives him pause, as he recognizes her as the fabled Great Gourd. Despite Papa Gruff's mischief making, the Wake doctor bids you allow the festival to continue as planned, promising to discipline the imp and prevent any further disruptions. The Night of Devilry thus averted, the Wake doctor bids you report back to the Adventurers' Guild investigator, and assure him that all will be well.
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_SEQ_10: With Papa Gruff's plans foiled, and a surplus of curative potions on hand, the investigator can see no reason to cancel the costume cortege. He thanks you for your assistance, and bids you partake in the festivities you labored so tirelessly to defend.
TEXT_FESHLW802_04656_SEQ_00:
The Wake doctor is not one to be kept waiting.

※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESHLW802_04656_SEQ_01:
As thanks for thwarting Papa Gruff's scheme, the Wake doctor would invite you somewhere special. She bids you speak with the unusual usher beside her should you wish to discover her surprise.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESHLW802_04656_SEQ_02: You follow the usher to an eerie and wholly unfamiliar place. Perhaps the Wake doctor is somewhere close by to explain where you are and the surprise she has in store.
TEXT_FESHLW802_04656_SEQ_03: Her guise as the Wake doctor cast aside once more, the pumpkin-headed apparition has revealed that this mysterious place─the very surprise she had in store for you─is, in fact, her home. Unsettling though her residence may be, she has nonetheless graciously invited you to stay for as long as you like. Perhaps she would be willing to tell you more about herself, should you choose to stick around.
TEXT_FESHLW803_04657_SEQ_00:
The harlequin guide is eager to put you to work.

※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESHLW803_04657_SEQ_01:
Though you may be finished with the costume cortege, it is not finished with you. Using one of their perfectly safe concoctions, the harlequin guide bids you take on the guise of another creature to help spread word of the costume cortege.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESHLW803_04657_SEQ_02: The putrid taste of the concoction remains in your mouth with no sign of disappearing, but you have nonetheless transfigured yourself successfully. The time is ripe for a spot of frightful fun to help spread word of the costume cortege.
TEXT_FESHLW803_04657_SEQ_03: With at least a few additional people now scared out of their wits, you return to Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre to tell the harlequin guide of your terrifying trip through town.
TEXT_FESHLW803_04657_SEQ_04: The harlequin guide is thankful for your efforts, but that is not to say he would refuse further assistance from you. Should time allow, he invites you to return for a scary good time.
TEXT_FESXMS801_04658_SEQ_00:
Amh Garanjy is looking for an adventurer filled with Starlight cheer.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESXMS801_04658_SEQ_01:
Amh Garanjy, celebrated Starlight celebrant, introduces you to Laurenssen, an associate professor of folklore visiting from Sharlayan. Laurenssen has come to Eorzea in pursuit of the truth─to wit, the origin of Starlight reindeer symbolism. He hopes to prove beyond a shadow of a doubt that reindeer of eld once delighted young children with illusions, and he requires the aid of a cheerful adventurer such as yourself to set the stage for his experiment. You set off to gather a crowd of younglings, but Blitzen, the reindeer at the crux of this operation, shakes his head dolefully, seemingly less than enthusiastic...

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESXMS801_04658_SEQ_02: Despite asking various children to come and see your magical reindeer, you end up with only a single taker. Reflecting upon where you might have gone wrong, you head back to Laurenssen.
TEXT_FESXMS801_04658_SEQ_03: Laurenssen is disgruntled by the dearth of rosy-cheeked younglings, but decides to try the experiment nonetheless. It ends in abject failure and Laurenssen temporarily excuses himself to regain his composure. You listen to the soothing sounds of Apkallu Falls and wait for his return as you contemplate the finer points of mortal existence.
TEXT_FESXMS801_04658_SEQ_04: No matter how long you wait, Laurenssen fails to return. A lesser  might simply abandon him, but no─this is the season of generosity, and you are a greater . You set off towards the Greatloam Growery to find him.
TEXT_FESXMS801_04658_SEQ_05: Laurenssen admits that he believes the children of Gridania are to blame for his experiment ending in failure, as they were not sufficiently inspiring for his reindeer─who is notably absent. Realizing his companion is no longer shaking his head dolefully beside him─or anywhere, for that matter─Laurenssen rushes off. You remind yourself that you are a champion of the people, and follow him before he trips and hurts himself.
TEXT_FESXMS801_04658_SEQ_06: The confident scholar proclaiming his unassailable theories but moments ago is now a shivering mess of nerves. Visibly twitching with the anxiety of losing his trusted assistant, Laurenssen vows to find Blitzen, but it is painfully evident he will need a touch of reassurance from an adventurer's heart before he is fit enough to try...
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_SEQ_00:
Associate Professor Laurenssen is experiencing some panic.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_SEQ_01:
In light of his reindeer's disappearance, Laurenssen's calm is disintegrating faster than a snowman in midsummer. Being the kind-hearted soul you are, you prepare to /soothe him like none but a somewhat exasperated adventurer can.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_SEQ_02: Thanks to your diligent patting, Laurenssen regains his composure and is ready to find Blitzen. He sends you off towards Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre to gather witness testimonies, while he retraces his steps back to Apkallu Falls.
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_SEQ_03: Witness testimony has informed you of Blitzen's likely whereabouts. You jingle merrily as you run for some reason, but such things are hardly unusual during the Starlight season. Pay it no mind and head for New Gridania.
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_SEQ_04: You and Laurenssen successfully find Blitzen and, rather unexpectedly, the Saint of Nymeia, who has one of those faces you swear you've seen somewhere before. With a little hinting, Laurenssen realizes the error of his ways. He resolves to think less selfishly and more of the children, and as though fate intends to hold him to it, a despondent and childlike wail breaks out from the other side of the aetheryte plaza.
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_SEQ_05: Upon investigating the source of the noise, Laurenssen is faced with a weepy child in search of her mother. After a crucial assist from Blitzen, who effortlessly quells the child's hysterics with a spectacular illusion, Laurenssen uses his own special powers of shouting very loudly to summon the missing mother without incident. Family reunited and balance restored, the three of you tromp back to Amh Garanjy.
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_SEQ_06: Amh Garanjy thanks you for your help, Laurenssen thanks you for your patience, and Blitzen honks loudly. It is clear now that the mystical illusions of reindeer are only triggered by genuine feelings of fondness and concern for children, and cannot be recreated under contrived pretenses. Embracing this reality with goodness in his heart, Laurenssen asks you to accompany him on a turn of Gridania to deliver cheer and spectacle to as many children as you can find.
TEXT_FESNYX001_04679_SEQ_00:
The ryu metsuke seeks the aid of a kindly adventurer.

※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESNYX001_04679_SEQ_01:
The ryu metsuke is pleased to inform you that this year's Heavensturn celebration, which sees the draconic ryu honored in the Far East, is underway. However, he is not so pleased to inform you that their mascots─chocobo chicks dressed in ryu costumes─are struggling to win over the locals. Wishing to discover the cause of the cold reception, the metsuke bids you assist his delegation's leader, the ryu bugyo, who can be found at the edge of the Aftcastle with her feathered friend.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESNYX001_04679_SEQ_02: You encounter the ryu bugyo at the Aftcastle, who is eager to present Ryunosuke to her two-person audience─you, and a young girl sitting by her side. Yet while the bugyo's passion cannot be faulted, she fails miserably in her attempt to capture the girl's interest. As she is speaking to you of her woes afterwards, she realizes that Ryunosuke has wandered off after the girl, and asks for your help to find them. Thus do you make your way to the Drowning Wench, hoping to discover clues regarding their whereabouts.
TEXT_FESNYX001_04679_SEQ_03: After a ryu-related misunderstanding, you manage to explain the situation to Skaenrael, who informs you that she saw a girl with a chocobo chick pass through the tavern. However, the guardswoman has no idea where they may have since headed, and at the ryu bugyo's behest, you next take your search to the lower decks.
TEXT_FESNYX001_04679_SEQ_04: You have spoken with several locals on the lower decks. Among other tidbits, you learn that the young girl you seek is named Sibly, and that she fears for the safety of her merchant father, who will soon be embarking on a long voyage. Armed with this knowledge, you go to relay your findings to the ryu bugyo at Bulwark Hall.
TEXT_FESNYX001_04679_SEQ_05: The ryu bugyo is pleased to hear that you have ascertained Sibly's destination. Eager not only to be reunited with Ryunosuke, but to explain the significance of his attire, your armor-clad companion sets off for the Agelyss River in middle La Noscea, where the young girl is believed to be, and you follow on her heels.
TEXT_FESNYX001_04679_SEQ_06: You manage to find Sibly by the riverbed with Ryunosuke at her side. The girl apologizes for causing you trouble, but ere she can take her leave, the bugyo broaches the subject of her father and his impending voyage. Sibly explains that, on account of Llymlaen not being chosen this Heavensturn, she thought that she might instead pray to a Far Eastern deity to keep her father safe. Thus did she seek out the bugyo, only to find her too focused on her own mission to lend an ear. Reflecting upon her blunder, the bugyo is inspired by Ryunosuke and the nearby waterfalls to tell a new tale about the ryu, assuring Sibly that it will grant her comfort.
TEXT_FESNYX002_04680_SEQ_00:
The ryu bugyo has a mind to make for Woad Whisper Canyon.

※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESNYX002_04680_SEQ_01:
Having taken a moment to contemplate her approach, the ryu bugyo is now ready to tell her tale. She sets off for the waterfalls at Woad Whisper Canyon, which she believes will provide the perfect backdrop.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESNYX002_04680_SEQ_02: Over the quiet rush of the falls, the ryu bugyo tells you of the mighty Seiryu, one of the Four Lords of Far Eastern myth. According to the tales passed down through the bugyo's line, Seiryu was a deity who possessed mastery over water, which he used to aid mortals by quelling storms and calming seas. The existence of such a benevolent being serves to assure Sibly, who gives the bugyo her heartfelt thanks. With her task thus accomplished to her satisfaction, the bugyo suggests returning to Limsa Lominsa.
TEXT_FESNYX002_04680_SEQ_03:
Their initial dilemma with Sibly resolved, the ryu bugyo and Ryunosuke greet you with newfound confidence. Hoping to continue her draconic discussions with those of the upper decks, the bugyo is eager to try approaching the locals once more. For this, too, she requests your assistance, and together you set off to seek out those who may be receptive to her message.

※You must be accompanied by the ryu bugyo and Ryunosuke to complete this task. Speak with either of them again should you become separated.
TEXT_FESNYX002_04680_SEQ_04:
The ryu bugyo is overjoyed that she and Ryunosuke have inspired the residents of Limsa Lominsa to take an interest in the ryu. With your primary task completed, you head back to the Aftcastle to rejoin the ryu metsuke.

※You must be accompanied by the ryu bugyo and Ryunosuke to complete this task. Speak with either of them again should you become separated.
TEXT_FESNYX002_04680_SEQ_05: Upon arriving at the Aftcastle, you are pleased to discover a lively crowd gathering before the ryu metsuke, who you manage to spot in its midst. With an exuberation that nearly defies his years, he thanks the ryu bugyo for her service to their divine beast. The bugyo, however, will not accept the praise alone, and credits you and Ryunosuke for your tireless efforts to make this Heavensturn a successful celebration. Even as she ponders a suitable reward for your invaluable aid, the chocobo chick flutters towards your side with many a happy kweh. Both the bugyo and the metsuke interpret the gesture to mean that he wishes to join you, and you duly accept the honor. Thus accompanied by the new year's symbol of good fortune, you take a moment to revel in the celebration you have helped save.
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_SEQ_00:
The royal seneschal has a new event in mind to bring smiles to all the princesses of the realm.

※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_SEQ_01:
The royal seneschal informs you that for this year's Little Ladies' Day celebration, he and Aldiytha Thorne have formulated a plan to distribute replicas of an antique folding fan to all who attend the day's festivities. Seeking to learn more about the fan, Aldiytha took it upon herself to investigate its origins, but has since been forced to halt her investigation due to her frail constitution. To lighten her burden, the royal seneschal entreats you to go to her aid, to which you promptly agree. With relief in his voice, he directs you to the Gold Court in the Steps of Thal, where he believes she is resting on a bench.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_SEQ_02: You find Aldiytha downcast, frustrated that she is unable to meet with two people she had arranged appointments with due to her sickly state. Bringing you up to speed, she explains that the plan for this year's celebration came into fruition when she found an antique folding fan in her home, the Thorne manor. After some research, she discovered that a fan of identical design was once used by Princess Edvya more than three centuries ago, when the audacious princess used it to perform a dance. Aldiytha, charmed by the tale, informed the royal seneschal of her desire to replicate the storied fan and incorporate it into the festivities, and so the plan to distribute fans to festival-goers was born. It was at this juncture, however, that the artisan in charge of the reproduction revealed that the fan itself was one of recent make, and not in fact from the era of the Thorne Dynasty. Desperate for answers, and unable to turn to her father, Aldiytha instead arranged to meet with a historian and a reporter with knowledge on the subject. Unable to rise to the occasion, she bids you meet with them in her stead.
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_SEQ_03: True to your word, you meet with the historian and reporter, but nothing could have prepared you for the revelations you would discover. You learn that the fan not only belonged to Aldiytha's mother, but that such fans in particular have traditionally been used in the Little Ladies' Dance, a dance passed down from mother to daughter in the Thorne family for generations. Eager to deliver the news to Aldiytha, and simultaneously perplexed as to how she is unaware of her own family's legacy, you make for the Gold Court.
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_SEQ_04: Aldiytha, visibly distressed by your report, confesses that she had no idea the fan belonged to her mother, nor that it was used in a long-standing family tradition. While she suspects her father had his reasons for withholding the truth from her, she is nevertheless determined to uncover it for herself, and begs your assistance once more. To learn more of her mother, Claudia Thorne, and the Little Ladies' Dance, she bids you speak with well-to-do individuals in the vicinity of the Sapphire Avenue Exchange and Eshtaime's Aesthetics.
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_SEQ_05: You speak with two nobles who, as fortune would have it, knew Claudia Thorne, and discover that she seldom attended social functions as a result of her having had a delicate constitution. Yet despite her frequent bouts of illness, she left her mark on these two individuals, such that they well remember their interactions with her. One noblewoman─who, in turn, reveals herself to be an old friend of Claudia's─reflects fondly on the time she learned the Little Ladies' Dance, and is inspired to teach it to Aldiytha when she learns of her predicament. Meanwhile, a restless nobleman conversely recalls a bittersweet memory of Claudia─of a time when she performed the Little Ladies' Dance for him during a Little Ladies' Day celebration many years ago, only to collapse from exhaustion. Aldiytha would surely wish to be apprised of your discoveries, and so you make ready to return to the Gold Court once more.
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_SEQ_06: You return to Aldiytha, and learn that the noblewoman from earlier indeed stopped by to teach her the dance. Delighted, you present your findings to her. Upon hearing what you have to say, she begins to suspect that her father has been keeping secrets from her out of concern for her health, but is interrupted in the midst of her musings by Rodolph's sudden arrival. He informs you both that her father, Fortin, has been worried sick about her since she disappeared from the manor, and is presently searching for her in the vicinity of the Ruby Road Exchange. Asking that you stay by her side so that she can muster the courage to face her father, you set off to meet the stringent head of House Thorne.
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_SEQ_07: Much to your surprise, you discover that the restless nobleman you met earlier was in fact Aldiytha's father, Fortin. He reveals that he hid the truth from Aldiytha because the folding fan and Little Ladies' Dance served as painful reminders of losing the woman he loved. Aldiytha expresses sympathy for how he feels, and then to his amazement, performs the dance to perfection, bringing him back to a Little Ladies' Day long ago, when Claudia once did the same for him. Moved by his daughter's performance, he at last gives in to her wishes, pledging to serve as her seneschal for the remainder of the celebration─as long as she agrees not to push herself. Grateful for your unending support, Aldiytha offers you a replica of the fan and instructions on how to perform the dance yourself. Before you go, she announces her intention to distribute fans and share the history of the dance with as many people as possible, in hopes of making this Little Ladies' Day one to be remembered.
TEXT_FESEST901_04721_SEQ_00:
You feel eyes upon you. And they're not just Jihli Aliapoh's.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESEST901_04721_SEQ_01:
Jihli Aliapoh welcomes you to this most auspicious celebration of Hatching-tide, inspired by her annual prophetic dreams of the legendary Twelve Archons. She admits that this year's vision was rather peculiar because it featured tonberries, creatures of myth known less for their seasonal whimsy and more for their habit of mercilessly stabbing things. This dream proved prophetic indeed, when sylphs descended upon Gridania, dismantling decorations, harassing residents, and otherwise making a nuisance of themselves. These mischievous creatures are deathly afraid of the tonberries' wilting (yet adorable?) gaze, and with the help of a self-proclaimed tonberry connoisseur named Hamlyn, Jihli Aliapoh's volunteers have donned tonberry costumes to scare off the sylphs. They are shorthanded, however, and Hamlyn just so happens to have a costume in your size...

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESEST901_04721_SEQ_02:
Hamlyn eagerly paws you into a tonberry guise and you set off to deter any rascally sylphs you might find. While this is not how you anticipated spending your Hatching-tide, you comfort yourself with the knowledge that you will be enjoying the festivities in no time.

※You must be wearing the tonberry guise to complete this task.
TEXT_FESEST901_04721_SEQ_03: You successfully shoo away a bevy of troublemaking sylphs. Surely not even Hamlyn's uncomfortable heavy breathing will dampen your feeling of accomplishment...probably.
TEXT_FESEST901_04721_SEQ_04: After pawing you out of the tonberry guise again, Hamlyn bids you share your report with Jihli. The eyes of his tonberry mask glint as he clutches your slightly sweaty costume in both hands. Best not to think too hard about it.
TEXT_FESEST901_04721_SEQ_05: Jihli is delighted to hear that the sylphs' mischief has been thwarted and that festival preparations are once more proceeding apace, but Nonotta shatters this brief reprieve with panicked reports of mayhem in the Central Shroud. The caravan of Archon eggs─a most crucial decoration─has been beset upon by angry sylphs and the delivery mammet is malfunctioning in its attempt to prevent total highroad robbery. In this moment of distress, Hamlyn giggles his delight, as he claims to have a brilliant plan that is sure to save the day. You need only ask...
TEXT_FESEST902_04722_SEQ_00:
Hamlyn is quivering in his excitement.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESEST902_04722_SEQ_01:
It turns out that Hamlyn's master plan to restore peace to the plundered caravan is strikingly similar─if not utterly identical─to the plan you carried out not moments ago. If it will solve your sylph dilemma long enough to get your hands on some glorious eggs, however, you're willing to give it the old Archon try. You head to the Central Shroud and prepare to combat the sylphs' jealous mood with some green of your own.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
※The FATE “Don't Be Sylphish” can only be completed as a Disciple of War or Magic.
TEXT_FESEST902_04722_SEQ_02: After a frantic scuffle involving sylphs, a giant mammet, and more shuffling than is comfortable for the average tonberry, you manage to recover the scattered Archon eggs. Panting from exertion and pleased to be free of your sweaty guise (once more pawed off you by an overzealous Hamlyn), you trek back to Gridania to give Jihli the good news.
TEXT_FESEST902_04722_SEQ_03: Hamlyn is singing your praises─or, more accurately, the noble tonberry's praises─with phlegmy excitement when you arrive, lamenting only the absence of large crowds who might have witnessed the miraculous feats performed by his adorable idols. As it turns out, enough townsfolk were present to warrant extending personal thanks for returning their precious eggs─which they ought to decorate as tonberries to prevent any further sylph shenanigans, Hamlyn helpfully suggests. While Hamlyn could not be less subtle in his tonberry touting, you can't deny the modicum of truth in his suggestion, and really, you'd just like to get on with it already. Jihli smiles and officially proclaims the start of Hatching-tide─let the eggy, eggy, stabby fun begin!
TEXT_FESSUM901_04723_SEQ_00:
Mayaru Moyaru is calling upon all adventurers to join the hottest event of the year.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESSUM901_04723_SEQ_01:
Eorzea bakes under the sun like an egg over a hot flame, and during such times it falls upon the Adventurers' Guild to offer the realm succor through merriment in the form of the Moonfire Faire. Mayaru Moyaru informs you that in addition to the acclaimed Eorzean Nimble Warrior course, the festivities are being guarded by a brave hero called the Sunshine Savior. However, there are always more hands needed at Costa del Sol, and he encourages you to report to Haermaga if the spirit of volunteering stirs within you.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESSUM901_04723_SEQ_02: As a fellow member of the guild, Haermaga welcomes you with open arms. He asks for your help in solving a pressing issue with the fledgling Sunshine Savior. The chaperone explains that a young man named Lyonell was recruited for the role, but his spirits took a turn for the worse after he arrived in Costa del Sol. Haermaga seems to think a bit of guidance will bolster his confidence, and you agree to offer what aid you can. The young man is standing by near the aetheryte, and Haermaga asks you to follow him there to make introductions.
TEXT_FESSUM901_04723_SEQ_03: The future guardian of Costa del Sol makes an awkward first impression, revealing that the source of his distress is an aversion to having his face exposed to prying eyes. Haermaga does not skip a beat, however, and seems to have a potential solution to the problem at the ready. He asks Lyonell to follow him to a nearby storehouse and asks that you await their return on the shores of the beach.
TEXT_FESSUM901_04723_SEQ_04: The pair arrive to meet you with Lyonell bedecked in a garish costume, the design of which was apparently commissioned by Haermaga himself─a design understandably met with much scorn by his fellow chaperones. Regardless of the outfit's tastefulness, it seems to have restored Lyonell's confidence, and the young man stands ready to protect the Moonfire Faire's revelers.
TEXT_FESSUM901_04723_SEQ_05: Lyonell's spirits are in high supply, and he is eager to prove himself worthy of the title of Sunshine Savior. However, he acknowledges that he yet has much to learn, and asks that you assist him until he can stand on his own two feet as the beach's protector. If the events of previous Moonfire Faires are any indicator, it will not be long until he is tested.
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_SEQ_00:
Haermaga is eager to send the Sunshine Savior forth into the sands of Costa del Sol.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_SEQ_01:
Lyonell informs Haermaga that you have agreed to help him learn the ins and outs of helping those in need. The chaperone is keen on this idea, and instructs him to keep watch over the revelers on the northeastern shores of Costa del Sol. Your task is to help the youth spot any signs of trouble, and offer advice on how best to keep the peace.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_SEQ_02: With your steady hand to guide him, Lyonell can now count several deeds of heroism of his own. Every savior needs rest, however, and Beaudefoin soon arrives to take over watch duty. The youth is eager to share tidings of his success with Haermaga and asks you to accompany him.
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_SEQ_03: Haermaga is pleased with Lyonell's progress, and explains that his costume is modeled after the Phoenix of legend. Just like that legendary bird, the chaperone hopes that Lyonell can be reborn, and thus recover his lost confidence. This hope is soon tested when an enormous shark emerges from the ocean depths, and Lyonell is forced to drive it back in an impressive display of bravery. After the fight, Lyonell stands dumbfounded at his own actions, and you somehow get the feeling he may require one final nudge in the right direction.
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_SEQ_04: Your presence returns Lyonell to his senses, and he is at last able to look the people he saved in the eyes. While he seems to have suffered no more than surface wounds, Haermaga instructs him to get checked nonetheless. The chairman asks you to join him in awaiting Lyonell's return, while you both keep watch for any further fiends.
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_SEQ_05: Lyonell returns with a triumphant smile on his face. For your part in bringing the young adventurer into his own, Haermaga makes you an honorary Sunshine Savior, rewarding you with the selfsame costume that gave Lyonell the confidence for heroics. You are now free to enjoy the Moonfire Faire and all its pleasures, for the savior of the sands' watch has only just begun.
TEXT_FESGSC701_04727_SEQ_00:
Kipih Jakkya needs help penning her next hit article.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESGSC701_04727_SEQ_01:
Kipih Jakkya informs you that her publication, The Raven, has been invited to write an article to promote the exciting event underway at the Gold Saucer. She seeks another perspective to add a bit of spice to her report, and she requests the insight of an adventurer─namely, you. She asks that you meet her at the entrance to the Gold Saucer, where a member of the staff awaits to greet you.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESGSC701_04727_SEQ_02: You arrive at the Gold Saucer to see that two other reporters have been invited, and the attendant Ollier explains that he wishes for each to write a piece espousing the locale's charm to their respective audiences. He then reveals that a mammet hunt has been arranged for the guests, and that the reporter to find the most wind-up Godberts will be granted an exclusive interview with the Gold Saucer's owner. To even the odds, the other two reporters team up, and quickly set off into the din of their surroundings. Eager to win this once-in-a-career opportunity, Kipih Jakkya wishes to discuss strategy sooner rather than later.
TEXT_FESGSC701_04727_SEQ_03: Kipih Jakkya suggests a divide and conquer strategy, with each of you searching two sections of the massive casino for the mammets. You are tasked with searching Wonder Square and Round Square for any sign of the miniature Mandervilles.
TEXT_FESGSC701_04727_SEQ_04: After a thorough search, you manage to find both mammets before your opponents. Kipih managed to find one herself, and with your victory now assured, she instructs you to meet her back at the entrance so you can report to Ollier.
TEXT_FESGSC701_04727_SEQ_05: You and Kipih present the three mammets to Ollier, and he declares you the winners of the exclusive interview with Godbert Manderville. The attendant stands ready to call upon the elusive goldsmith, and while Kipih Jakkya seems eager to avail herself of her prize, the sounds of clinking coins and revelry call to you from deeper within the Gold Saucer.
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_SEQ_00:
Ollier stands at the ready to call upon the Gold Saucer's proprietor.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_SEQ_01:
As promised, Ollier summons Godbert Manderville to give you a personal tour of the Gold Saucer. The elusive goldsmith seems more than eager to show off his creation, and suggests that you first head to the aetheryte plaza before continuing further.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_SEQ_02: During the tour, you learn facts about the Gold Saucer that none but Godbert himself have been privy to and gain a newfound appreciation of the locale's history. Kipih Jakkya appears more than satisfied with the interview and is eager to begin her article. Before you depart, however, Godbert encourages you to visit Ollier, who has a parting gift to give you.
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_SEQ_03: Ollier presents you with a gift to commemorate this rare opportunity, and encourages you to return whenever you please. It would be best to do so soon, however, while the MGP flows freely and the smiles come easily.
