TEXT_FESANV901_04765_SEQ_00:
Kipih Jakkya is looking a worried sister.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_SEQ_01:
Kipih Jakkya, a reporter for The Raven, was meant to meet her brother Nhagi'a during the Rising celebration, but the appointed hour has come and gone without him appearing. You are tasked with helping to find the lad, beginning by making inquiries at the Ruby Road Exchange.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_SEQ_02: You learn from the locals that Nhagi'a is performing some manner of work for the wandering minstrel. Thus informed, you make your way to the Gold Court to find the musician.
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_SEQ_03: The wandering minstrel tells you that he is hosting an exhibit called the letter forest, which displays anonymously penned letters of gratitude and encouragement. In order to collect letters from outside of Ul'dah, the man has dispatched a chocobo carriage with Nhagi'a as an escort. However, the carriage is late to return, and the minstrel apologetically asks you to conduct a search. Having thus found a likely lead, you bear the news to Kipih, who awaits you near the Quicksand.
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_SEQ_04: You apprise Kipih of your findings. As the wandering minstrel suggested, you take yourselves to Black Brush Station to look for the carriage and Nhagi'a.
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_SEQ_05: No sooner do you arrive at Black Brush Station than you learn from a traveling merchant that bandits have fallen upon a carriage over by the Clutch. Wasting no time, you and Kipih rush to the scene and scare the highwaymen away before they can overwhelm Nhagi'a. Thus are the siblings reunited─although Nhagi'a's utterance that he needs to grow stronger to gain Kipih's approval appears to give her pause. Nhagi'a then continues on to Ul'dah with the carriage to complete his delivery, and you and Kipih likewise head back to join the wandering minstrel at the Gold Court.
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_SEQ_06: Reporting to the minstrel, Nhagi'a is critical of himself for needing your help to complete his task. His obsession with doing everything alone does not sit well with Kipih, who declares that she can't consent to his being an adventurer any longer. If he wishes to remain one, he must win her over─and it begins with pondering why he first embarked upon this path. Though saddened, Nhagi'a agrees to think on the matter and goes off, leaving you with the minstrel and a grim-faced Kipih.
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_SEQ_07: Despite how it may have appeared, Kipih assures you that she wants her brother to succeed and be happy. However, she is worried that unless he changes his ways, he is likely to meet an early demise, or at best know an arduous life.
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_SEQ_00:
Kipih Jakkya is again looking a worried sister.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_SEQ_01:
While Nhagi'a ponders matters, Kipih asks that you watch over him, and the wandering minstrel adds his voice to her request. Thus do you set off after the young adventurer, who went in the direction of the Sapphire Avenue Exchange.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_SEQ_02: You find Nhagi'a in the midst of rumination. He explains to you that he was a burden to Kipih in the past, and he doesn't wish to be a burden again. That is his motivation for wanting to become a capable adventurer who doesn't need to depend on others, and he struggles to see why that is wrong. In his search for an answer, he decides to consult Momodi, and makes his way to the Quicksand.
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_SEQ_03: The chat with Momodi works wonders, and Nhagi'a comes to the realization that, at some point, his desire to prove himself to his sister had displaced his own motive for being an adventurer. Back outside the Quicksand, you turn to Nhagi'a to see what he intends to do next.
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_SEQ_04: Nhagi'a tells you that he now has an answer for Kipih, and when they speak, he wants to show her one of the letters he collected. To that end, he asks you to help him find the letter in the Gold Court, and together you go to rejoin the wandering minstrel.
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_SEQ_05: The wandering minstrel is happy for Nhagi'a to borrow the letter in question. The three of you then proceed to search for the missive, which is identifiable by the drawing of a blue chocobo that adorns it.
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_SEQ_06: A brief search yields what appears to be the letter you seek, and you take it over to Nhagi'a.
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_SEQ_07: Nhagi'a confirms that this is indeed the letter he wishes to show to Kipih, and he promptly heads over to the Weavers' Guild, where she had indicated that she had business. Wishing to know how events unfold, the wandering minstrel bids you accompany the young adventurer for his meeting with his sister.
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_SEQ_08: At the Weavers' Guild, you watch on as the siblings bare their hearts to one another. Nhagi'a declares that he will no longer obsess over doing everything alone, having remembered why he became an adventurer in the first place. Relieved, Kipih takes the opportunity to remind him of how, as a young boy, he had told her that he wanted to simply be a free-spirited adventurer who traveled the world and lent a helping hand to those in need. Saddened to see that boy lose his way, Kipih had spoken sternly, but it was never her intent to deny him his calling, and she wholeheartedly supports him now as he continues on his path. Thus does the tale come to a happy conclusion, and you bid the two a fond farewell as they return to walking their respective paths.
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_SEQ_09: You report back to the wandering minstrel, who expresses his gladness for the siblings. Inspired by these events, he conceives of a verse and proceeds to perform it. Even as the first chord resounds in your ear, you find yourself hurtling through unknown skies aboard an airship, where you meet with the mysterious Naoki Yoshida. The man thanks you for your enduring support, and shares his excitement for what yet lies ahead, before sending you back to reality. After you return to yourself on the streets of Ul'dah, the minstrel performs for you another song─one imbued with the hope that you will never forget whence you came, for therein lies the strength to forge on in the face of adversity.
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_SEQ_00:
This Starlight Celebration volunteer is beaming at you. At least, you think so─their face is difficult to discern through such mighty facial hair.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_SEQ_01:
The bearded volunteer who greets you is Amh Garanjy, Starlight celebrant and expert of all things both wintery and cheerful. This year, the Starlight festivities are honoring the Saint of Nymeia with special recreations of his classic garments─most prominently, his glorious red coat and great, big, bushy beard. Such a visage is sure to bring delight to any youngling, but it seems there is at least one lad who cannot agree, as he stares longingly at the festive merriment before fleeing to locations unknown. Saulinne, a young lady worried for his happiness, petitions your assistance, which you happily provide by questioning Gridania's residents for further details on this mysterious moper.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_SEQ_02: Weaving your way through crowds of citizens and sightseers, you question a number of children and an on-duty Wailer to yield the information you need. Now all that's left is to tell Saulinne of wayward Tenny's whereabouts.
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_SEQ_03: Saulinne wastes no time in heading straight for the Greatloam Growery as soon as she hears what you have to say. You follow her, resisting the urge to tweak the carrot nose of a snowman along the way.
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_SEQ_04: Upon speaking with him, Tenny's melancholy takes shape─his father was relocated to Gridania for work, and this is his first Starlight away from his friends in Ul'dah. You determine that the most realistic solution to his problem is mailing gifts to said friends─a decision enthusiastically supported by a particularly iconic Saint of Nymeia who boasts superior crafting skills and flawless facial hair. Saulinne pledges her assistance as well, and so it is that you are enlisted as the official courier for Tenny's gifts. Your first task is delivering an update to Amh Garanjy whilst the Saint of Nymeia instructs the eager younglings in the art of handicrafts.
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_SEQ_05: Upon hearing that you have been volunteered to deliver gifts, Amh Garanjy cheerfully volunteers you to wear a Saint of Nymeia outfit while you do so. You accept the proffered bundle of red cloth, unable to reject the joyful look of anticipation on her face and wondering what fantastical world of Starlight awaits you beyond the beard...
TEXT_FESXMS902_04782_SEQ_00:
Amh Garanjy is grinning eagerly, her wide eyes sparkling more than usual.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESXMS902_04782_SEQ_01:
Amh Garanjy can't wait to see you dressed up as the Saint of Nymeia─or, rather, she will wait forever until you are dressed up as the Saint of Nymeia. In an effort to avoid the crippling effects that eternity might have upon you both, you unfold the unorthodox saint's garments and make yourself presentable.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESXMS902_04782_SEQ_02: In both style and spirit, you have become one with the Saint of Nymeia. Now it is time to carry out in deed what you have been tasked by appearance, so you make for the Greatloam Growery to pick up Tenny's gifts whenever they are ready.
TEXT_FESXMS902_04782_SEQ_03: Tenny, with the help of Saulinne and a notably absent snowy-bearded gentleman, has completed crafting his presents: simple-yet-beautiful woven bracelets. He earnestly instructs you to seek out his friend Momolao, who should reliably be found playing near the Quicksand. Straightening your beard, be it literal or proverbial, you sally forth to deliver Tenny's precious offerings.
TEXT_FESXMS902_04782_SEQ_04: Momolao is delighted with the gift, admitting that all of Tenny's friends have been unseasonably gloomy due to his recent move. You are directed towards the Gold Court and Milvaneth Sacrarium to find Larkin and Othuel, respectively, with the prediction that they will be nothing short of ecstatic to receive their presents.
TEXT_FESXMS902_04782_SEQ_05: The painstakingly woven gifts have been delivered accordingly, affirming what you have always known─that distance means nothing in the face of true friendship. Bearing a physical representation of such a bond, you return to Gridania to deliver joyful tidings and a present for Tenny himself.
TEXT_FESXMS902_04782_SEQ_06: Tenny is touched by his friends' thoughtfulness, with the realization that birds of a feather flock to bracelets together. Saulinne is relieved that the melancholy boy she was so worried about is now free to frolic with Starlight merriment as any good youngling should, and the two youths recognize the burgeoning friendship between them. You smile, reckoning that now is as good a time as any to apprise Amh Garanjy of the situation.
TEXT_FESXMS902_04782_SEQ_07: There is little Amh Garanjy wishes for more than happy younglings, and your deeds have done much to deliver her such. Indeed, Saulinne and Tenny arrive to cheerfully extend their thanks and receive their Starlight presents. As you watch the youngsters scurry off to play, carefree and optimistic, you reflect upon your role in bringing their happiness to fruition. Perhaps it is too soon to hang your fur-trimmed hat after all...
TEXT_FESXMS903_04783_SEQ_00:
Amh Garanjy brightens when she sees you, glancing at a sack brimming with Starlight goodies.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESXMS903_04783_SEQ_01:
Reluctant to abandon your duties as the Saint of Nymeia, you agree to distribute presents to younglings passing by Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre. Sack of gifts in hand, you pass through the swinging gates and assume your most saintly expression.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESXMS903_04783_SEQ_02: A happy child and an unexpected encounter─what more could one ask of the Starlight Celebration? Still mulling over all that was said, you report back to Amh Garanjy.
TEXT_FESXMS903_04783_SEQ_03: Thanking you for a job well done, Amh Garanjy invites you to come and help with the Starlight Celebration again, should you feel inclined. In the meantime, she wishes you all possible happiness and a very happy Starlight indeed!
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_SEQ_00:
The Adventurers' Guild investigator is eyeing the festive displays with a healthy dose of suspicion.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_SEQ_01:
While the saints of Eorzea sleep off their night of revelry, the wicked come out to play. All Saints' Wake is once again come to Gridania, and the Adventurers' Guild has sent a lone investigator to ensure that ghastly ghouls do not overrun the city as in ages past. While all appears civil for now, the investigator is certain that the pumpkin-headed apparition is brewing a devious plot and recruits you to approach her under the guise of cooperation. After winning her confidence, you are to put an end to any schemes you uncover.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_SEQ_02: Your stint as an undercover mischief-maker is cut short when the pumpkin-headed apparition reveals that she knows the investigator is investigating her. She seems unperturbed, however, and assures you that she works to make this year's festivities thrilling, but not horrifying. To this end, she asks you to aid Papa Gruff, a voidsent-turned-clown who is apparently having trouble providing the townspeople with merry thrills. He can be found near the Leatherworkers' Guild─that is, if an angry mob has yet to chase him off.
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_SEQ_03: You come across Papa Gruff just as he is about to start his show. Joining the audience of one, you observe as he turns a common pumpkin into the supposed embodiment of terror: a small puppy that brings a hearty laugh to the Wood Wailer in attendance. Nonplussed by this reaction, Papa Gruff is eager to receive your help in understanding the subtleties of fright, and already seems to have an idea on how you can teach him.
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_SEQ_04:
Papa Gruff asks you to accompany him on a tour of the All Saints' Wake festivities near both the Leatherworkers' Guild and Lancers' Guild, during which you will instruct him on what form the decorative pumpkins should take. Your guiding words are “Frighten enough to tickle, but not scar.”

※You must be accompanied by Papa Gruff to complete this task. Speak with him again should you become separated.
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_SEQ_05: With your guidance, Papa Gruff transforms pumpkins throughout Gridania into creatures that evoke dread and delight in equal measure, with not one person fleeing in terror or laughing in mockery. Papa Gruff wishes to test his understanding of these lessons, and so asks you to accompany him to another pumpkin display near Apkallu Falls.
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_SEQ_06: Voluntarily exercising restraint for possibly the first time in his life, Papa Gruff performs an All Saints' Wake illusion that entertains without a single tear shed. Emboldened by this success, he decides to try again, and instructs you to accompany him to another display of pumpkins by the Whistling Miller.
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_SEQ_07: A frightened young woman is trembling by the pumpkin display when you arrive, insisting that she was accosted by what seemed to be a horrible monster while she was tilling the fields at the Greatloam Growery. Knowing that Papa Gruff's creations can't move far on their own, you fear that actual voidsent may be lurking within Gridania. Your only course of action is to make haste to the Growery and hope that what the botanist saw in those fields has yet to leave for more populated areas.
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_SEQ_08: The voidsent in question is eager to show itself and seems to be intent upon reviving the ancient traditions of the Night of Devilry, when monsters once roamed free and people cowered in fear. Papa Gruff, however, flatly refuses to participate in this lesser voidsent's plot, citing the wisdom he has gained as a master of both mischief and mirth. Apparently drawn by the scent of half-baked schemes, the pumpkin-headed apparition appears and summarily turns the rogue voidsent into a sad little gourd. She chuckles fondly at Papa Gruff's newfound maturity, but acknowledges that it is yet too early to celebrate, as other fiends still prowl Gridania to foment chaos among its populace...
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_SEQ_09: The pumpkin-headed woman bestows upon you a wand, which she says will enable you to turn voidsent into pumpkins with a single motion. You are to scour Gridania with haste to prevent the Night of Devilry from making a much-dreaded return and ensure that All Saints' Wake remains a joyous event for all.
TEXT_FESHLW902_04786_SEQ_00:
Papa Gruff is eager to rid Gridania of his wicked brethren.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESHLW902_04786_SEQ_01:
Papa Gruff decides that the best course of action will be to split up. Claiming responsibility for the troubled botanist and lingering voidsent in the Greatloam Growery, he sends you off towards eastern Gridania, where he senses more voidsent lurk. Wand in hand, you sally forth to flush out the lingering spooks with your pumpkin-producing All Saints' Charm.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESHLW902_04786_SEQ_02: The city is free of voidsent, and the burgeoning wave of terror is transformed into a shower of happiness as Gridania's citizens delight in the show you give them. With your task complete, all that is left is to report your success to Papa Gruff at Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre.
TEXT_FESHLW902_04786_SEQ_03: Papa Gruff was as successful as you were, and just as the pumpkin-headed apparition is chuckling her approval, the once-frightened botanist approaches you with her guildmaster, offering both thanks and a batch of pumpkin cookies. The clown is so taken with the flavor of gratitude that he becomes more committed than ever to spending this All Saints' Wake delivering shriek-accompanied smiles. Glowing with the satisfaction of her plan seen to fruition, the pumpkin-headed apparition asks you to relate all that has happened to the Adventurers' Guild investigator, in hopes he may direct his suspicious gaze elsewhere.
TEXT_FESHLW902_04786_SEQ_04: Although you attempt to explain that the pumpkin-headed apparition only has Gridania's best interests at heart, the investigator remains convinced that some ulterior motive guides her actions. He will continue to keep an eye on the festivities, but fortunately relieves you of your duty, leaving you free to enjoy All Saints' Wake at your leisure.
TEXT_FESSXT101_04796_SEQ_00:
The neophyte adventurer seeks the Warrior of Light.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESSXT101_04796_SEQ_01:
After being accosted by a neophyte adventurer, you find yourself in the presence of the infamous wandering minstrel. The itinerant tale-teller shares with you a dream he had─supposedly prophetic in nature─which seems to foretell your meeting with a metaphorical “scarlet star” in some fiery landscape. Deeming the Burning Wall the closest match to this vision, he bids you accompany him to eastern Thanalan, where he hopes to witness the denouement to his celestial vision.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESSXT101_04796_SEQ_02: The minstrel waxes philosophical for a time before returning to the matter at hand. He suggests using a spyglass to scan the surrounding terrain from the nearby vantage point. If there is indeed meaning to his dream, you may spy something unusual...
TEXT_FESSXT101_04796_SEQ_03: You spot the crumpled form of a young man, and upon rushing over to render aid, you learn that his name is Clive and that he has no memory of how he arrived at the Burning Wall. The minstrel offers to escort Clive to the Phrontistery, where a physician might more closely assess his condition. There is little more for you to do but make your way to Scholars' Walk and wait.
TEXT_FESSXT101_04796_SEQ_04: Clive informs you that while he is in good physical health, he is as yet unable to remember recent events─or much at all, for that matter. Unwilling to abandon one in such a vulnerable state, you and the minstrel agree to assist Clive with recovering his missing memories.
TEXT_FESSXT101_04796_SEQ_05: Clive thanks you for your kind assistance. Although troubled by his mental fugue, he nevertheless seems willing to delay departure until you give the word.
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_SEQ_00:
Clive is ready to travel to Gridania.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_SEQ_01:
Having failed to jog Clive's memories with a visit to Ul'dah, it has been decided that you shall journey next to Gridania. Although apparently unfamiliar with airship travel, the young man is eager to continue onward.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_SEQ_02: Despite retaining knowledge of general concepts such as swords and combat techniques, Clive still struggles with the existence of functional airships. With great effort, he sets the infuriating inconsistency of his memory loss aside and devotes his energies to moving forward.
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_SEQ_03:
As a newcomer to Gridania, Clive must rely on you to guide him around the city. The Carline Canopy should thus make for a logical first stop.

※You must be accompanied by Clive to complete this task. Speak with him again should you become separated.
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_SEQ_04: Upon entering the Carline Canopy, Clive is visited by a fragmented memory of a similar place...but nothing more. He looks to the tavern's exit, desperate to see more.
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_SEQ_05: The sight of a chocobo ignites a spark of recognition in Clive. He seems certain that he once had his own feathered mount, but can recall no other details. With little else forthcoming, you may as well continue onwards.
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_SEQ_06: Clive pauses at Gridania's aetheryte, wondering if the glittering construct could be a “Mothercrystal.” Quickly realizing that it is far too small, he sets his sights on the next point of potential interest.
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_SEQ_07: Upon approaching the Adders' Nest, Clive reacts strongly when a returning scout makes mention of the primal Garuda. After learning of Clive's situation, Commander Heuloix expresses his sympathies and offers to arrange a meeting with the Elder Seedseer, believing it to be the best hope for his recovery. The aforementioned scout bids you find him at Nophica's Altar when you are ready for your audience.
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_SEQ_08: Kan-E-Senna provides Clive with further details of Garuda's appearance and disposition, yet while he finds it all somewhat familiar, he cannot help but feel something is awry. Appearing as if from nowhere, the wandering minstrel proposes that this disconnect stems from the fact that Clive himself is not of this world─a conclusion reached after an extensive survey of the surrounding settlements turned up not even a single soul who had met their distinctively tattooed visitor before. Furthermore, the Elder Seedseer concludes that Clive's amnesia is not the result of illness or injury. Rather, she speculates he is suppressing some awful truth─one he must confront by breaking through a barrier of his own making.
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_SEQ_09: As Clive ponders his confounding dilemma, the wandering minstrel suggests that the heat of battle may provide the solution. Asked only to prepare for war, you are to await the enigmatic performer at Apkallu Falls.
TEXT_FESSXT103_04798_SEQ_00:
Clive seems somewhat bemused.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESSXT103_04798_SEQ_01:
Clive confesses bemusement at the minstrel's plan, but is nonetheless willing to follow his instructions. After explaining the way to Apkallu Falls, you set off for your nearby destination.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESSXT103_04798_SEQ_02: Judging by Clive's reaction to the mention of Ifrit, the wandering minstrel believes he has identified the root cause of the scarlet star's amnesia. His lyrical magicks weave a replica of the Bowl of Embers, within which you and Clive confront the Lord of the Inferno─an entity which soon blurs and changes to more closely match the creature of Clive's befogged memories.
TEXT_FESSXT103_04798_SEQ_03: At the culmination of his fiery duel, Clive breaks through his mental barrier, and at last accepts the truth that the monstrous beast before him...is himself. You then return victorious to the real world, but it seems you have not returned alone: Clive's resolve has manifested an old companion from the swirling aether. The loyal Torgal will serve as a guide to lead Clive home to his own world─or so the delighted musician asserts. And after listening to the continuation of Clive's harrowing tale, the minstrel is adamant that this journey begin at the beginning: the Burning Wall.
TEXT_FESSXT103_04798_SEQ_04: Now that you have arrived in the vicinity, the minstrel looks to Torgal to lead Clive the rest of the way. But will the hound guide his master true as the minstrel believes?
TEXT_FESSXT103_04798_SEQ_05:
With Torgal in the lead, you set off alongside Clive and the minstrel. The destination you seek appears to lie somewhere within the twists and turns of the Burning Wall...

※If you part ways with Clive and the wandering minstrel or fall behind Torgal, return to the starting point and speak with Clive, the wandering minstrel, or Torgal to try again.
TEXT_FESSXT103_04798_SEQ_06: You accompany Clive back to the very spot where you first found him. It seems the Burning Wall's relation to the Phoenix of your world played a part in Clive's unexpected arrival, a connection forged by the bond with his brother─the Phoenix of his world. With memories restored and answers yet to find, Clive bids you farewell as his time in Eorzea comes to an end.
TEXT_FESSXT103_04798_SEQ_07: Now that you have seen Clive safely home to Valisthea, the wistful minstrel declares the adventure over. He rewards you for indulging his strange request, presenting you with a whistle to summon a likeness of Clive's loyal hound, Torgal. Though your time together was short, you cannot help but wonder what further trials await Clive on his own star, some unimaginable distance away...
TEXT_SUBGSC901_04801_SEQ_00:
For once, Lewena appears to be entertained.

※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_SUBGSC901_04801_SEQ_01:
Lewena, a Gold Saucer regular in constant pursuit of a good distraction, has taken great interest in a mysterious new attraction known as Blunderville. Though she provides you with a cursory explanation, she bids you find Wy at Wonder Square if you wish to see the Saucer's latest enterprise for yourself.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_SUBGSC901_04801_SEQ_02: With Wy's assistance, you wander your way into Blunderville Square─a most whimsical hall populated by Saucer staff and colorful bean-like creatures.
TEXT_SUBGSC901_04801_SEQ_03: Upon your arrival to Blunderville Square, the receptionist gazes at you expectantly, and stands ready to answer the inevitable slew of questions you might have.
TEXT_SUBGSC901_04801_SEQ_04: The Beankeep is overjoyed to welcome you to Blunderville Square's vivid halls, and enlightens you on the attraction's history. As she tells it, challengers undertake numerous obstacle courses in hopes of qualifying for a prize among prizes─a glamorous golden crown. Should you wish to win this prestigious reward, you must prepare yourself for a show of epic proportions.
TEXT_FESVLX001_04808_SEQ_00:
Astrid is not-so-subtly indicating her desire for you to approach.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESVLX001_04808_SEQ_01:
In need of a helping hand, Astrid de Valentione, head emissary of the Valentione's Day celebrations, asks that you check on the whereabouts of the apprentice emissary Emilie, who has been preparing a mysterious surprise for the day's festivities near Fen-Yll Fineries. Being the chivalrous soul that you are, you happily oblige. 

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESVLX001_04808_SEQ_02: You find Emilie practicing under the trees not a stone's throw from Fen-Yll Fineries. She is grateful for your concern but remains coy as to what exactly has kept her occupied for so long. She insists you return to Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre if you wish to find out.
TEXT_FESVLX001_04808_SEQ_03: Astrid thanks you for retrieving Emilie, who is now ready to reveal her surprise. As she performs the so-called “love heart,” you feel the slight fluttering of butterflies in your stomach. Explaining that she hopes this bold expression of affection will inspire others to act on their feelings, Astrid wishes you to join Emilie in displaying it for the townsfolk, but soon realizes that even two ardent souls may not be enough to cover all of Gridania. With perfect timing, Lisette de Valentione enters the stage, eager to lend her assistance. Your numbers thus buoyed, Astrid asks that you speak with her when you are ready to begin.
TEXT_FESVLX002_04809_SEQ_00:
The time is ripe to inspire Gridanians to listen to their hearts.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESVLX002_04809_SEQ_01:
Astrid marks a few areas on your map where you are to perform the love heart for any who appear in need of encouragement. Steel yourself for a journey to bestow ardor and affection with this newfound gesture.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESVLX002_04809_SEQ_02: Though the audacious pose understandably takes lovelorn Gridanians by surprise, it proves effective in inspiring them to act on their feelings. With your work done, it is time to return to Astrid at Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre.
TEXT_FESVLX002_04809_SEQ_03: Whilst you and Emilie are sharing your experiences with Astrid, a distraught Lisette stumbles before the stage, claiming to have seen Hortefense meeting with a secret lover. While somewhat doubtful of this assertion, Astrid urges Lisette to be brave and confront her betrothed so she might get to the truth of this matter. Finding courage in the symbol of the heart─a symbol originating from her ancestor, the Countess Arabelle─Lisette storms off to show Hortefense the error of his alleged ways. Worried for her sister, Astrid asks you and Emilie to follow Lisette to the Carline Canopy.
TEXT_FESVLX002_04809_SEQ_04: You find Lisette struggling to express herself before Hortefense and a young woman. After you offer her a word of encouragement, Lisette at last demands an explanation from her beau. Before he can utter a word, however, the young woman reveals that she had merely sought Hortefense's advice in courtship. Surprised, yet relieved, Lisette performs the newfound gesture of ardor and affection for the maiden, telling her to follow her heart. With the misunderstanding resolved, Emilie suggests you both return to Astrid, who is undoubtedly eager to learn of how matters fared.
TEXT_FESVLX002_04809_SEQ_05: Astrid thanks you for supporting her sister and expresses her joy that Emilie's tender expression has raised interest in the symbol of the festival─the heart. Full of hope that more and more folk will be inspired to learn of its history and the story of its creator, she wishes you the happiest of Valentione's Days, performing her own adorable rendition of the love heart.
TEXT_FESPDY901_04810_SEQ_00:
Jihli Aliapoh is looking for someone to help make a dream come true.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESPDY901_04810_SEQ_01:
As dependably as eggs fall from a laying hen, this year's Hatching-tide festivities are being overseen by none other than Jihli Aliapoh, whose ambitions extend further than ever before. She describes to you her dream of a goobbue upon a stage in Ul'dah, and details her plan to hold a tandem celebration of both Hatching-tide and Little Ladies' Day which will spread joy across two of Eorzea's city-states. However, she must first convince the planners of Little Ladies' Day that the goobbue performer she hired poses no danger to the people. The royal seneschal has traveled from Ul'dah on behalf of his peers, and Jihli has instructed you both to visit Bentbranch Meadows, where the goobbue is even now delivering joy to all and sundry.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESPDY901_04810_SEQ_02: After being dazzled by the masterful display of Aldemund's goobbue companion, Peatie, the royal seneschal is convinced that she would be the perfect fit for Little Ladies' Day. She must first win the hearts of the people of Gridania, however, and for that Aldemund requires your aid. It seems Peatie suffers from a minor case of stage fright, and Aldemund would have you ride on the goobbue's head to reassure her as she delivers smiles to the people.
TEXT_FESPDY901_04810_SEQ_03: Peatie shows no sign of discontent as you mount her head. Now, the people of Gridania await to have the spirit of Hatching-tide stirred within them.
TEXT_FESPDY901_04810_SEQ_04: The sound of cheers can be heard reverberating throughout Bentbranch Meadows, a clear indication of Peatie's successful performance. Aldemund will undoubtedly wish to hear of this favorable outcome.
TEXT_FESPDY901_04810_SEQ_05: You arrive to see Aldemund's store of eggs depleted─a true sign that Peatie's show made a splash. Although Aldemund believes her place on Ul'dah's stage is secured, the final decision comes down to the judgment of the royal seneschal.
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_SEQ_00:
The royal seneschal has reached a decision.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_SEQ_01:
The royal seneschal appears to be Peatie's biggest fan, and he invites both her and Aldemund to Ul'dah, that the goobbue might be the star attraction of this year's Little Ladies' Day. Requesting your assistance in comforting Peatie as she becomes accustomed to the crowds, he departs to Ul'dah to make preparations for her grand debut. Aldemund and Peatie have business to attend to in Gridania before they follow, so the performer asks you to go ahead and await their arrival.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_SEQ_02: The royal seneschal informs you that the planning committee for Little Ladies' Day has agreed to welcome Peatie with open arms, and now he asks you to help do what you can to spread the same sentiment among the city's populace. He bids you travel to the Steps of Thal and drum up interest in the coming entertainment.
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_SEQ_03: While not everyone you speak with is accepting of a goobbue in their city at first, you manage to convince several to attend the show, with some even expressing excitement at the prospect. Who knows how far their enthusiasm might spread? As the show draws near, all that remains is to visit the stage and report your success to the royal seneschal.
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_SEQ_04: You arrive at the stage on Emerald Avenue to see a crowd much larger than the one in Gridania, all waiting in anticipation. It seems the presence of so many expectant guests has caused Peatie to freeze up, but Aldemund suggests that you /rally her spirits to shake her out of this fluster.
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_SEQ_05: Although Peatie is initially too frightened to respond to your encouragement, a few heartfelt words manage to break her loose from the clutches of fear and give her a newfound sense of determination. With the goobbue ready for her big show, you can now join the crowd and cheer for her success.
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_SEQ_06: Peatie takes the stage and dazzles all present with her performance, earning a hearty applause that makes her beam with pride. The royal seneschal appears eager to speak with you after this roaring success.
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_SEQ_07: The show is the talk of Ul'dah, and Peatie basks in the people's adoration. Realizing that she is meant to keep on this road and that his best days as a performer are behind him, Aldemund asks that you take his companion along on your adventures. You accept the now-famous goobbue into your company without hesitation, and the royal seneschal and Jihli Aliapoh encourage you both to enjoy the remainder of the celebrations in Ul'dah and Gridania. With so much merrymaking across the realm, smiles will come easy for some time yet.
TEXT_FESGSC801_04814_SEQ_00:
Quevain is convinced that the truth is out there.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESGSC801_04814_SEQ_01:
Quevain, writer for The Thavnairian Truth, is come to Ul'dah on the heels of a rumor surrounding the Manderville Gold Saucer's recent festivities. A horde of water imps has allegedly appeared in the Saucer's gilded halls, and the journalist is keen to learn the creatures' motives for his newest article. Hoping to gather more information on the scene, Quevain requests your assistance in the matter, and bids you join him at Entrance Square.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESGSC801_04814_SEQ_02: Quevain is disheartened to discover that the imps he sought to write about are naught more than attendants in costume. Though his initial plans have gone awry, he decides instead to write of the imps' relation to the Gold Saucer's festivities, based on an intriguing lead he received regarding the event's creation. With newfound determination, he rushes off to glean more information, and entrusts you with inquiries at Wonder Square.
TEXT_FESGSC801_04814_SEQ_03: You approach a Gold Saucer attendant, who gleefully explains to you how the March of the Imps came to be. The more pertinent details elude the attendant, however, and he suggests you make for the Manderville Lounge to find the imp who coined the idea for the March.
TEXT_FESGSC801_04814_SEQ_04:
Upon your arrival at the Manderville Lounge, you are accosted by the imposing imp, who promptly confers upon you a set of impish attire. His cries are unintelligible, yet in his vigorous gestures and overwhelming gaze, you are well aware of the task he has thrust upon you: you must march through Event Square in costume and entertain the Saucer's patrons if you wish to obtain the knowledge you seek.

※You must be wearing the impish attire to complete this task.
TEXT_FESGSC801_04814_SEQ_05: With your newfound wealth of impish charm, you have brought comfort and cheer to several of the Saucer's guests. The imposing imp will surely be pleased to hear of your progress, and awaits you back at the Manderville Lounge.
TEXT_FESGSC801_04814_SEQ_06: Now divested of your temporary attire, you present yourself to the imposing imp once again. He heartily gestures in the direction of Entrance Square─where Quevain awaits your arrival─and urges you to follow.
TEXT_FESGSC801_04814_SEQ_07: In the midst of your report to Quevain, you are approached by Godbert Manderville, who admits his involvement in the March of the Imps' creation. Undeterred by the lingering questions of the imps' origins, Quevain believes that Godbert's imp-related discoveries will be more than enough to captivate The Thavnairian Truth's readers. As thanks for promoting the Saucer's festivities, Godbert ensures that you do not leave empty-handed, and presents you with your very own impish attire, that you might enjoy the remainder of this golden celebration in costume...if you so choose.
TEXT_FESANX001_05015_SEQ_00:
The wandering minstrel seeks an adventurer both willing and able to help put the finishing touches to this year's Rising celebrations.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESANX001_05015_SEQ_01:
A lady by the name of Ayoyo has already recruited the wandering minstrel to her cause─that being the planning and execution of the grand finale of the Rising fireworks display. He recruits you in turn, the task apparently calling for the assistance of a seasoned adventurer. He begs that you meet with him and Ayoyo by the base of the Coral Tower in Limsa Lominsa's upper decks to learn more.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESANX001_05015_SEQ_02: You speak with Ayoyo and offer to lend her your strength in producing a firework display that will long remain in Lominsan memory. The minstrel proposes that you begin by interviewing those who have gathered in the city to learn their inner thoughts.
TEXT_FESANX001_05015_SEQ_03: You meet with Ayoyo by the entrance to Hawker's Alley, and split up to begin your polite interrogation of the populace.
TEXT_FESANX001_05015_SEQ_04: You speak with a sample of the people assembled in and around Hawker's Alley, and gain insight into their thoughts and feelings come Rising season. You head for the ferry docks to wait for Ayoyo to complete her own research.
TEXT_FESANX001_05015_SEQ_05: Ayoyo finds you by the ferry docks and you compare notes. Having come to some conclusion regarding the ideal nature of the crowning display of this year's festivities, she departs for the Aftcastle to inform the wandering minstrel. She bids you meet her there.
TEXT_FESANX001_05015_SEQ_06: You and Ayoyo rendezvous with the wandering minstrel and inform him of your plans. However, there are many and more hurdles that must be cleared before said plans can be put into effect. Ayoyo asks for your continued assistance in seeing her vision realized.
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_SEQ_00:
Ayoyo asks for your continued assistance in seeing her plan for the Rising fireworks realized.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_SEQ_01:
Before preparations begin in earnest, Ayoyo must have her ideas approved by the head of the organizing committee: Reyner Hansred, leader of the Yellowjackets. To that end, you accompany her to the Coral Tower, hopeful the commodore can be won to your cause.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_SEQ_02: Commodore Reyner approves Ayoyo's plan on the condition that she convince the Black Sails to provide the ships from which the salute will be fired. A step in the right direction, you regroup outside the Coral Tower to consider your next move.
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_SEQ_03: Ayoyo wishes to retain your services in the next round of negotiations. Fearing she may fail to find the right words to persuade the pirates, she asks you take a leading role in navigating the upcoming parley. When you are ready, she will await you at the Anchor Yard.
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_SEQ_04: Together with the help of Ayoyo and the wandering minstrel, you succeed in stirring the captains of the Black Sail factions to action. They soon take their leave, leaving the three of you to settle your nerves and make ready for the celebration.
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_SEQ_05: Ayoyo is overjoyed at seeing her plan fast approaching fruition. With little time to spare, she has already entrusted your reward for helping her to the wandering minstrel. She bids you go and speak with him to collect it, and while away the hours until the ceremonial salute is ready to fire.
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_SEQ_06: You join the wandering minstrel, and together gaze upon Ayoyo's salute both to fallen friends and those who set sail for new adventures. With this, another year's journey begins.
TEXT_FESSUX001_05182_SEQ_00:
Mayaru Moyaru is scouring the Aftcastle for any sun-beaten souls who might not have heard about this year's Moonfire Faire.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESSUX001_05182_SEQ_01:
Mayaru Moyaru has informed you that the Moonfire Faire is presently being held in Costa del Sol. Travel to Eastern La Noscea and speak to Haermaga, the chief chaperone, to learn more.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESSUX001_05182_SEQ_02: In the midst of your conversation with Haermaga, a bloodcurdling scream rends the air. Clearly some manner of threat has descended upon the faire, but what? Track down the terrified tourist to find out.
TEXT_FESSUX001_05182_SEQ_03: The terrified tourist is quick to inform you that a strangely off-kilter creature has fled to the east. Perhaps there are more clues to be found in that direction.
TEXT_FESSUX001_05182_SEQ_04: According to the sweaty guest, the mystery creature was green in color and appeared to be doing a jig. It eventually traipsed away, though not before conveniently leaving behind what appeared to be part of its body. Further investigation will surely lead you to answers.
TEXT_FESSUX001_05182_SEQ_05: Truth be told, the needle left behind at the scene is enough to clue you in to the creature's identity. Sure enough, when Beaudefoin and P'obyano come running up moments later, your theory proves correct: there are cactuars on the loose, and now it's up to you to track them down.
TEXT_FESSUX001_05182_SEQ_06: You locate the cavorting cactuar, and a refreshing gust from Beaudefoin's uchiwa succeeds in calming it. Unfortunately, there are six more still unaccounted for. Trusty uchiwa in hand, you and your companions must now set off to soothe the rest of the savage beasts.
TEXT_FESSUX002_05183_SEQ_00:
Moonfire Faire chaperone Beaudefoin is prepared to help you track down a half-dozen wayward cactuars.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESSUX002_05183_SEQ_01:
Beaudefoin has armed you with a festival uchiwa. Should you encounter a cavorting cactuar within the bounds of Costa del Sol, make sure to mollify it with a hearty /uchiwasshoi.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESSUX002_05183_SEQ_02: The well-aimed gusts from your uchiwa have led to the successful capture of two cactuars. Return to P'obyano and hand over your quarry.
TEXT_FESSUX002_05183_SEQ_03: With your two captured cactuars now safely under surveillance, the missing pets have all been accounted for. Be sure to apprise Haermaga of the good news.
TEXT_FESSUX002_05183_SEQ_04: Haermaga is grateful that you put an end to the crisis before any of the faire-goers could come to harm. Owing to your efforts, the summer festival blithely blazes on─but at the very least, you are now given leave to enjoy what remains of it!
TEXT_FESHLX001_05184_SEQ_00:
The pumpkin-headed apparition is on the lookout for an able adventurer.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESHLX001_05184_SEQ_01:
The pumpkin-headed apparition informs you of an unfortunate fiend unable to enjoy the All Saints' Wake festivities. At her behest, you go to meet Papa Gruff near the Greatloam Growery to learn more of this voidsent, and see if you cannot aid them in some manner or another.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESHLX001_05184_SEQ_02: It transpires that the fiend in question is none other than Papa Gruff's erstwhile partner, Philcox. Alas, it seems that, due to creative differences, the pair has disbanded. Dutifully, you set forth to seek out Philcox and hear his side of the story.
TEXT_FESHLX001_05184_SEQ_03: You find Philcox in a somewhat frenzied state. As you are unable to hold a productive conversation with him, you have no choice but to /soothe him before attempting to speak with him again.
TEXT_FESHLX001_05184_SEQ_04: With some gentle gesturing, you are able to render Philcox more amenable to dialogue. He explains his lack of talent for magicks, yet also alludes to another talent altogether: the ability to detect negative feelings within people. Having been apprised of his circumstances, you follow Philcox to Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre, where he intends to have a few words with the pumpkin-headed lady.
TEXT_FESHLX001_05184_SEQ_05: With you by his side, providing the necessary moral support, Philcox lays bare his thoughts and feelings before the pumpkin-headed apparition. After a little coaxing and a few leaps of logic─from the point of view of a voidsent, at least─Philcox realizes he can use his powers to help the commonfolk, and in doing so garner their appreciation in the form of gastronomic gifts. Boasting of his newfound potential to Papa Gruff, the latter suggests a contest to determine whose approach is superior. You can but pray their rivalry does not get out of hand...
TEXT_FESHLX002_05185_SEQ_00:
After a nudge in the right direction, Philcox is ready to embark on his mission.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESHLX002_05185_SEQ_01:
Perhaps put off by the ghoulish ambience of the amphitheatre, Philcox complains of being unable to concentrate and takes his leave. You set off after him, steeling yourself for whatever shenanigans await.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESHLX002_05185_SEQ_02:
Philcox's grasp of Gridanian geography appears to be somewhat lacking. He has requested that you, with your superior knowledge of the local thoroughfares, lead him to the flustered fellow he has located with his powers.

※You must be accompanied by Philcox to complete this task. Speak with him again should you become separated.
TEXT_FESHLX002_05185_SEQ_03: Together with Philcox, you locate your quarry, who proceeds to divulge the source of his woes. It seems he found and promptly unfound a lost child, and lacks the time to look for her due to a prior engagement. You and the fiend offer to look for her in his stead, and set off towards Westshore Pier to search for the distressed damsel.
TEXT_FESHLX002_05185_SEQ_04: Brimming with confidence and buoyed by his recent successes, Philcox manages to reunite the young girl with her mother. He then sets out to find yet another despairing personage, and this time without your assistance. At his suggestion, you return to the pumpkin-headed apparition at Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre, bearing news of Philcox's exploits.
TEXT_FESHLX002_05185_SEQ_05: The vying voidsent can only boast a single cookie apiece, and so their contest ends in a draw. A slightly defiant Philcox gets the recognition he has long sought from his former partner, before being reminded that the prize for which he should strive is the affection of the good folk of Gridania─and the foodstuffs that may be had into the bargain. Fiend-sitting duties at an end, you are free to make the most of All Saints' Wake.
TEXT_FESNYX101_05186_SEQ_00:
The hebi bugyo wishes to test your knowledge of Heavensturn customs.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESNYX101_05186_SEQ_01:
After a thorough summary of Heavensturn history, the hebi bugyo invites you to take part in her delegation's dubiously named quiz. You are instructed to seek out the blue hebi yoriki at Limsa Lominsa's Aftcastle.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESNYX101_05186_SEQ_02: Having tracked down your quarry and answered her question, you learn of a certain serpent─the tsuchinoko─that is said to be a particularly potent bringer of luck. Ready for the next round of your trivia trial, you seek out the yellow hebi yoriki near the Drowning Wench.
TEXT_FESNYX101_05186_SEQ_03: The second question proves no match for your wealth of general knowledge. The Far Easterner goes on to tell you of the Great White Tsuchinoko, an especially enigmatic tsuchinoko that has attained almost mythological status. Armed with this tidbit, you make for the Bismarck, where the red hebi yoriki awaits.
TEXT_FESNYX101_05186_SEQ_04: The final quizmaster, impressed with your erudition, hands over your prize: an expertly crafted white tsuchinoko ornament. Along with the keepsake, you are given the task of informing the hebi bugyo that the delegate's stock of prizes has been depleted. To this end, you set off for the Aftcastle.
TEXT_FESNYX101_05186_SEQ_05: In a fortuitous turn of events, it transpires the “ornament” conferred upon you was in fact the genuine article, and you find yourself in charge of a squidgy serpent companion. With this newfound friend─and auspicious symbol of the new year─in tow, you are free to celebrate this tradition you now know a little more about.
TEXT_FESXMX001_05227_SEQ_00:
Amh Garanjy is in a spot of bother.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESXMX001_05227_SEQ_01:
As you make your way through Gridania during the Starlight Celebration, you come upon the celebrant Amh Garanjy. According to the Miqo'te, a new attraction is to be held for this year's festivities in the form of a market called the Starlight Stalls. However, the preparations are behind schedule, and Amh Garanjy requests your aid in investigating the reason for the delay. To that end, she bids you join her at the stalls, which you may travel to by speaking with the guide at the amphitheatre.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESXMX001_05227_SEQ_02:
You have arrived at the Starlight Stalls, located on Gridania's outskirts. Catching sight of Amh Garanjy near the entrance, you make your way over to her to receive further instructions.

※In the event that you leave the Starlight Stalls, you may return by speaking with the Starlight Stalls guide at Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre.
TEXT_FESXMX001_05227_SEQ_03: Amh Garanjy proposes that you each speak with a number of workers in order to learn what troubles they might be experiencing. She sets off to attend to the task, and you do the same.
TEXT_FESXMX001_05227_SEQ_04: You have traded words with some workers in the midst of preparation. Satisfied with your findings, you go to share them with Amh Garanjy.
TEXT_FESXMX001_05227_SEQ_05: You inform Amh Garanjy that a combination of the cold and tiredness are to blame for the slow progress of the stalls. As you ponder ways to revive the weary workers, two little friends, Saulinne and Tenny, appear and beg to help. Amh Garanjy gladly accepts their offer, and it is decided that you and the children will see to finding something suitably revitalizing to distribute to the workers.
TEXT_FESXMX001_05227_SEQ_06: Saulinne and Tenny are excited as only children can be for the opportunity to help. Inspired by their enthusiasm, you are determined to see that the Starlight Stalls may open as planned.
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_SEQ_00: Saulinne is fairly champing at the bit to get started.
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_SEQ_01: With Saulinne and Tenny's agreement, you settle on a hot and sweet drink as the ideal thing to offer to the cold and weary workers. Wasting no time, the children rush off to the Carline Canopy in order to source the beverage, and you follow after them.
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_SEQ_02:
You broach the subject of the beverage to Miounne, who kindly provides mulled punch for you to distribute. And the Saint of Nymeia, having fortuitously overheard your conversation, further furnishes you with a chocobo to aid you in your task. Having thus acquired what you need, you make your way back to the Starlight Stalls.

※You may travel to the Starlight Stalls by speaking with the guide at Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre.
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_SEQ_03: At the stalls, the children propose splitting up to hand out the punch, and you are given the care of the cask-carrying chocobo. Your feathered companion regards you expectantly, eager to get to work.
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_SEQ_04:
At your word, the chocobo begins following you, and together you proceed to make your way around the stalls to offer a warming drink to workers.

※You must be accompanied by the eager chocobo to complete this task. Speak with it again should you become separated.
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_SEQ_05: You have finished distributing the punch, which was received with much appreciation. Your task complete, you go to rejoin the children.
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_SEQ_06: You find Saulinne and Tenny just as they hand out their last mugs. The pair happily report that all the stalls will soon be ready, and bid you fetch Amh Garanjy from Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre.
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_SEQ_07: Amh Garanjy is delighted to hear that the mulled punch worked wonders, and the Starlight Stalls may finally open. With the celebrant at your side, you make your way back to the venue.
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_SEQ_08: In no small part due to your efforts, the Starlight Stalls are now open, and Amh Garanjy expresses her gratitude for you and your fellow helpers. Recognizing the celebrant's efforts in turn, the children urge her to take a break, and together you savor steaming-hot mugs of mulled punch beneath the winter sky.
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_SEQ_09: Having seen off the children and the chocobo, Amh Garanjy hands you the latter's unique barding─a gift from the Saint of Nymeia himself─before bidding you enjoy the celebrations to the fullest. Needing no prompting, you go off to take in the sights, sounds, and smells of the market you helped to make possible.
TEXT_FESNYX201_05229_SEQ_00:
The uma bugyo would entreat your aid for the Heavensturn festivities.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESNYX201_05229_SEQ_01:
It is Heavensturn once more, and a delegation has arrived from the Far East to host a celebration for the year of the horse. Speaking with its leader, the uma bugyo, you learn that her assistant, the uma yoriki, is having difficulty handling their mascot. She begs you lend the man your aid, and you set off in the direction of the Drowning Wench to find him.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESNYX201_05229_SEQ_02: Outside the Drowning Wench, you come upon the uma yoriki and the mascot: a unicolt, the young of a unicorn. Daunted by its new surroundings, the creature refuses to obey its carer, but sensing your pure intent, it is apparently willing to promote the planned Heavensturn procession with you. In light of this, the uma yoriki asks that you take the unicolt in his stead and spread word of the event.
TEXT_FESNYX201_05229_SEQ_03:
With the unicolt in tow, you set forth to promote the procession to people at the Drowning Wench.

※You must be accompanied by the uma-no-unicolt to complete this task. Speak with it again should you become separated.
TEXT_FESNYX201_05229_SEQ_04:
You inform some patrons of the Drowning Wench about the procession, with the unicolt playing its part to attract interest. Next, you look to spread the word in other parts of the upper decks.

※You must be accompanied by the uma-no-unicolt to complete this task. Speak with it again should you become separated.
TEXT_FESNYX201_05229_SEQ_05:
You have informed a good number of people about the Heavensturn procession. Satisfied, you make your way back to the Aftcastle to report to the uma bugyo.

※You must be accompanied by the uma-no-unicolt to complete this task. Speak with it again should you become separated.
TEXT_FESNYX201_05229_SEQ_06: The uma bugyo expresses her gladness at seeing the unicolt thrive under your care. And thanks to your promotional efforts, she expects there to be a good crowd for the procession, which will commence as soon as the preparations are complete.
TEXT_FESNYX202_05230_SEQ_00:
The uma bugyo is eager to get the Heavensturn procession underway.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESNYX202_05230_SEQ_01:
The Heavensturn procession will soon commence outside the Zephyr Gate. The uma bugyo cordially invites you to attend, to which end you make your way to middle La Noscea, where the uma yoriki awaits.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESNYX202_05230_SEQ_02:
Shortly after you join the uma yoriki, riders from the three Grand Companies arrive with their horses to participate in the procession. When the unicolt expresses its desire to join in, the uma yoriki relents on the condition that you will be accompanying it. The main procession then departs, leaving you to make your way to the destination with the unicolt.

※You must be following the uma-no-unicolt to complete this task. Speak with it again should you become separated.
TEXT_FESNYX202_05230_SEQ_03:
At your word, the unicolt sets off at a spirited run, and you follow after it towards the spectators gathered ahead.

※You must be following the uma-no-unicolt to complete this task. Speak with it again should you become separated.
TEXT_FESNYX202_05230_SEQ_04:
Having delighted the crowd, the unicolt looks at you expectantly, eager to continue on its way.

※You must be following the uma-no-unicolt to complete this task. Speak with it again should you become separated.
TEXT_FESNYX202_05230_SEQ_05: Under your watchful eye, the unicolt safely arrives at the procession's end. There, it is warmly received by the uma yoriki and Grand Company riders, who muse about the common ground Eorzea and the Far East share in the unicorn. Your part in the festivities thus completed, you make your way back to the Aftcastle to report to the uma bugyo.
TEXT_FESNYX202_05230_SEQ_06: In no small part due to your assistance, the procession has fulfilled its intended purpose and more besides. Noticing the bond you have developed with the unicolt, the uma bugyo bids you take it with you. Together with your small-but-spirited companion, you look forward to the journeys in the year ahead.
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_SEQ_00:
Amh Garanjy could use some help from an adventurer.
※ This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_SEQ_01:
Strolling through the Starlight Celebration festivities in Gridania, you encounter Amh Garanjy, enthusiastic Starlight celebrant. With grand plans to provide kinderpunsch, a kind of mulled punch, to festivalgoers, Amh Garanjy entreats your aid in the preparations. Thankful for your willing assent, she bids you join her at the Starlight Stalls, which you may travel to by speaking with the Starlight Stalls guide at Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_SEQ_02:
You have arrived at the Starlight Stalls, located on Gridania's outskirts, where you catch sight of Amh Garanjy. You make your way over to her to hear further details on the planned punch.

※In the event that you leave the Starlight Stalls, you may return by speaking with the Starlight Stalls guide at Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre.
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_SEQ_03: Speaking with Amh Garanjy and Mother Miounne, you learn of the plan to create three separate types of kinderpunsch to represent Gridania, Limsa Lominsa, and Ul'dah─each to be served in an appropriately decorated festive mug. Miounne is still unsure of the best blends to encapsulate the other cities, but there are doubtless some experts on regional cuisine among the visitors to the Gridanian markets. You keep an eye out for anyone who may be able to furnish you with advice and inspiration for the mulled punch recipes.
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_SEQ_04: You have acquired some useful pointers from several visitors to Gridania. Eager to share your findings with Amh Garanjy, you make your way back to Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre.
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_SEQ_05:
Brimming with inspiration, Amh Garanjy sets about making arrangements to procure the required ingredients. In the meantime, she bids you speak to the children visiting the Starlight Stalls and inform them of the upcoming kinderpunsch on offer. She suggests you take note of any preferences they express, to better recommend a refreshment to their tastes.

※You may travel to the Starlight Stalls by speaking with the guide at Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre.
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_SEQ_06: The children are now suitably informed and enthused. Your task accomplished, you go to seek out the saturnine Starlight celebrant in order to assist in serving the kinderpunsch.
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_SEQ_07: All the children have been furnished with beverages and are pleased as punch. At the encouragement of the saturnine Starlight celebrant, who steps in to relieve you of your duties, you return to Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre to inform Amh Garanjy of the success at the stalls.
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_SEQ_08: While all the children enjoyed their drinks, it seems that Joultain─a young boy with a strong wanderlust─is particularly replete with festive cheer, thanks to the help of a certain adventurer. If, inspired by the spirit of Starlight, you wish to assist with the punch stall once more, you may speak to the saturnine Starlight celebrant at the Starlight Stalls.
TEXT_FESPDX001_05237_SEQ_00:
The royal seneschal is planning something new for Little Ladies' Day.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESPDX001_05237_SEQ_01:
After finding great success with the Songbirds, the royal seneschal has plans to debut a new act for Little Ladies' Day: the Seneschal Prince. The young man auditioned to play the part, however, has failed to return from picking up his costume. The royal seneschal asks that you make your way to Eshtaime's Aesthetics and see what has befallen Picot, his up-and-coming star.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESPDX001_05237_SEQ_02: You find Picot trying and failing to convey his costume ideas to a flustered Marabel. It comes to light that the “Seneschal Prince” does not, in fact, know what makes a good seneschal, and he recruits you to form a general consensus of the role by thoroughly questioning the townspeople of Ul'dah.
TEXT_FESPDX001_05237_SEQ_03: You speak to three Ul'dahn residents and gather their thoughts on the topic of seneschals. Picot awaits your revelations at the Gold Court.
TEXT_FESPDX001_05237_SEQ_04: Having learned the qualities people expect in a seneschal, Picot declares himself ready to serve the waiting audience. When it comes to settling the specifics of his princely persona, however, it seems he desires your continued assistance.
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_SEQ_00:
Picot ponders over an appropriate direction for his stage persona.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_SEQ_01:
Picot shares with you the reason he first became a singer, describing in bittersweet detail the shows he would perform for his ailing childhood friend. He hopes that by taking his act to the Little Ladies' Day stage, his voice will then rise high enough and loud enough to reach her ears even in Thal's somber halls. To that end, he asks that you accompany him to said stage, and seek out inspiration that will help him finalize the details of his Seneschal Prince costume.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_SEQ_02: You examine the stage and its surrounds alongside Picot, and in so doing, he forms a definitive image of how he wishes to present his stage persona: as the Seneschal Prince, he will both serve and entertain. Picot lists off the tasks which now stand before him─including his plans for organizing refreshments from the Quicksand's festival menu─and you offer to convey his finalized costume idea to the waiting Marabel over near Eshtaime's Aesthetics.
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_SEQ_03: Marabel listens to your explanation of Picot's costume with her customary enthusiasm. She seems to know exactly what will best encapsulate a seneschal's poise and a prince's style, and sends you back to the royal seneschal with a promise that the outfit will be ready in time for the performance.
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_SEQ_04: You relay the good news to the royal seneschal, then sit back to enjoy the show. Picot delivers on his promise of hospitality, inviting the audience to partake of the Quicksand's provided repast before entertaining them with his practiced routine. The performance reaches its finale, and you join the elated singer to share in his triumph.
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_SEQ_05: Picot is overjoyed by the favorable response from the crowd, and the royal seneschal congratulates his new performer on a stunning debut. Wondering for a moment if his own lost princess was looking on, Picot vows to make the most of this opportunity to bring delight to all who attend his shows. The Seneschal Prince presents you with a matching costume as thanks for your patient assistance, then heads off to prepare for his next appearance. Everything has turned out well, yet the Little Ladies' Day festivities have only just begun─you should heed the royal seneschal's advice and go and enjoy them while they last!
TEXT_FESESX001_05242_SEQ_00:
Jihli Aliapoh has a great deal to say about Hatching-tide.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESESX001_05242_SEQ_01:
Jihli Aliapoh shares with you her vision for this year's Hatching-tide celebration, which involves a clutch of improbably floating eggs delighting crowds with their festive whimsy. Alas, the decorations commissioned to recreate her dream were shattered in an unfortunate cart incident. Determined to salvage the situation, she and Nonotta enlist your help in crafting another batch.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESESX001_05242_SEQ_02: Though Nonotta's supplier is fresh out of egg components, he takes pity on your plight and gifts you a crate of surplus materials. After inspecting the contents, Nonotta seizes on the idea of creating a set of egg-shaped parasols. To prevent further delay of the festivities, you agree to beg help from the local guilds to craft the necessary parts.
TEXT_FESESX001_05242_SEQ_03: Hoping to see the Hatching-tide celebrations go ahead as planned, Geva pledges the guild's assistance. In return, she asks that you provide the water-repellent solution required to turn leather into durable parasol canopies. Already in possession of the necessary ingredients, Nonotta leaves to make arrangements, but not before tasking you with delivering timber to the Carpenters' Guild. Planks in hand, you set off to see Beatin.
TEXT_FESESX001_05242_SEQ_04: Once apprised of the situation, the timbermaster too agrees to aid your cause. Safe in the knowledge that the lumber you delivered will be sawn and lathed into parasol parts with all due care, you make for the Black Rabbit Traders' stall where Nonotta awaits.
TEXT_FESESX001_05242_SEQ_05: The Lalafellin Dreamer explains that she has arranged to have the appropriate alchemical solution concocted, and ordered some extra accoutrements besides. No doubt Jihli will be keen to hear of your progress while you wait for Nonotta to arrive with the finished prototype.
TEXT_FESESX001_05242_SEQ_06: You inform Jihli of your efforts thus far, and explain the plan to substitute the original eggs with festive parasols. With the guilds crafting the components and Nonotta handling the logistics, the first phase of parasol preparation draws to a close.
TEXT_FESESX002_05243_SEQ_00:
Jihli Aliapoh is patiently waiting to see the parasol prototype.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESESX002_05243_SEQ_01:
Nonotta presents the prototype parasol to Jihli, who instantly expresses her approval. Having received the Dreamer's blessing, the Lalafell leaves to begin mass production. In the meantime, you agree to accompany a parasol-brandishing Jihli in search of potential Hatching-tide celebrants. Speak with her in Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre when you are ready to embark.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESESX002_05243_SEQ_02:
With Jihli in tow, you set off for the market, seeking out those who might wish to take part in the celebrations.

※You must be accompanied by Jihli to complete this task. Speak with her again should you become separated.
TEXT_FESESX002_05243_SEQ_03: Among the hustle and bustle of the market, you encounter three individuals with a discerning eye for eggs. Each proves more than willing to gather at the amphitheatre when promised a parasol of their own, and will no doubt spread word of the exciting accessory on their way.
TEXT_FESESX002_05243_SEQ_04: Satisfied at having found sufficient celebrants, Jihli stows her parasol for the time being. She shares her intention to return to the amphitheatre to see how many have gathered, and invites you to join her at your leisure.
TEXT_FESESX002_05243_SEQ_05: You return to Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre to find a parasol-toting crowd gathered around the stage. As Jihli revels in the sight, Maisenta appears with the news that she, too, has been handing out parasols to those enamored with the ovoid accessories. Picturing delighted parasol bearers throughout the city, Nonotta suggests the scope of Jihli's vision has reached far beyond the amphitheatre, as it was perhaps always meant to do. Thrilled that the dream of myriad floating eggs has been fully realized, the pair repay your assistance with an Archon egg parasol of your very own. Duty done, you are free to enjoy the remainder of this year's Hatching-tide!
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_SEQ_00:
Astrid has need of an adventurer to resolve a quandary in love.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_SEQ_01:
As you are taking in the romantic air of the Valentione's Day celebrations in Gridania, you come upon Astrid de Valentione, the head emissary of ardor and affection. She wastes no time recruiting your aid in assisting a botanist named Laurovic, who has provided the roses which are being distributed for the festivities, but is experiencing difficulties of his own in love. To that end do you make your way to the Greatloam Growery, there to learn from the man the details of his dilemma.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_SEQ_02: Speaking with Laurovic, you learn that he seeks to be reunited with his love, an Ishgardian botanist named Sylginie, who had left without a word. The roses being given out were grown from the seeds she had entrusted to him, in hopes that she might be compelled to return to Gridania to see them. And though return she has, she soon vanished again amidst the throng, and Laurovic bids you help him to find her. So it is that you set forth in search of a silver-haired Elezen maiden wearing a rose earring.
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_SEQ_03: After a search in the city, you succeed in locating Sylginie. While she admits that she still loves Laurovic, for reasons she does not disclose, she says that she is too ashamed to meet him, and asks that he be told to forget her.
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_SEQ_04: You break the bad tidings to Laurovic, who struggles to come to terms with Sylginie's request. It is then that Ser Titouan, a knight of House Haillenarte, announces himself. It transpires that the roses used in the celebration are the Driancoin, a prized variety that withered in the freeze that descended upon Coerthas following the Calamity. When this happened, it was believed that Sylginie, who had tended the Haillenarte rose gardens, fled for the shame, and it is to ascertain the truth of the matter that Ser Titouan has come to Gridania. Refusing to give up on his love, Laurovic asks for permission to search with the knight, who proposes spreading a rumor to draw out Sylginie. Your course of action thus decided, the three of you split up to recruit citizens to your cause.
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_SEQ_05: You approach a number of citizens, all of whom are more than willing to do their part for love. Your task satisfactorily accomplished, you make your way to the Greatloam Growery to rejoin your companions in anticipation of Sylginie's appearance.
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_SEQ_06: The ruse goes as planned, with Sylginie soon arriving out of concern for Laurovic, who apologizes for his deception before asking her why she left the Driancoin seeds with him before vanishing. As you and Titouan watch on, Sylginie explains that she wished only to save the rose, but having failed her house as well as violated its rules, she felt that she did not deserve to be happy. Laurovic vehemently disagrees, and proffering a bouquet on one knee, he begs her to remain and grow roses with him. In turn, Ser Titouan gives his assurance that Sylginie will not be punished, and after a moment's silence, she finally allows herself to smile as she accepts Laurovic's heartfelt invitation.
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_SEQ_07: Laurovic thanks you and Ser Titouan for helping him and Sylginie to be reunited. After the knight takes his leave, the couple set off to report the happy tidings to Astrid at the amphitheatre, and you are asked to accompany them.
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_SEQ_08: Astrid rejoices at the blissful end to Laurovic and Sylginie's tale, and expresses her delight that the Driancoin should reunite those who grew them. The rose will doubtless continue to help people to convey the depths of their hearts, during this Valentione's Day and the days beyond.
TEXT_FESANX101_05297_SEQ_00:
The wandering minstrel is in search of inspiration.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESANX101_05297_SEQ_01:
Making your way through Limsa Lominsa during the Rising, you come upon the wandering minstrel at the Aftcastle.
