The man seeks inspiration for a new song, and requests your aid in speaking with the locals for their tales. To that end do you head together to the Drowning Wench, where you chance to witness Baderon in conversation with a fiery Miqo'te child named R'tcha. The young one wishes to become an adventurer so that she might leave the city alone, but Baderon turns her down out of concern for her safety. Worried that she might still attempt to sneak out, however, the tavernkeep bids you keep an eye on her, and suggests that you begin by speaking with Klindrael, the Yellowjacket stationed at the Tempest Gate.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESANX101_05297_SEQ_02: You learn from Klindrael that a child fitting R'tcha's description did indeed leave the city via the gate. Finding it suspicious, however, the sentry alerted her comrade Ayoyo, who has likely stopped R'tcha outside, and you waste no time setting out to find them.
TEXT_FESANX101_05297_SEQ_03: No sooner do you emerge in lower La Noscea than you locate R'tcha and Ayoyo. Acknowledging the little one's determination, the minstrel makes a proposal: rather than becoming an adventurer, R'tcha could employ the services of one instead. So it is that you are tasked with escorting R'tcha to Oschon's Torch, that she might verify the rumor of child-abducting ghosts, with the affable Ayoyo also volunteering to come along.
TEXT_FESANX101_05297_SEQ_04: Having asked you your name, R'tcha offers you her thanks for your assistance. In helping her to fulfill her goal, so too may you help the minstrel to find inspiration, and you resolve to see your young client safely to the lighthouse.
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_SEQ_00:
R'tcha is champing at the bit to set forth.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_SEQ_01:
At young R'tcha's word, your little adventure to Oschon's Torch begins. Ayoyo suggests first striking east to Madman Bridge, and thither do you make your way.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_SEQ_02: As you take in the sights at Madman Bridge, R'tcha reveals that her parents died in the Calamity, and she lives at an orphanage. After taking a moment to digest this revelation, your party continues on south, to Oschon's Embrace.
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_SEQ_03: At the dizzying heights of Oschon's Embrace, R'tcha again brings up the subject of her parents, but struggles to express herself. As she wrestles with her thoughts, she presses on to the Gods' Grip, with you and Ayoyo following after her.
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_SEQ_04: At length Oschon's Torch comes into view, and the mention of its keeper spurs R'tcha to divulge more about her parents. The two were lighthouse keepers who went missing when the Calamity struck, and R'tcha had been torn between wanting to disprove the rumor that they had become vengeful spirits and meeting them again. Seemingly finding courage in voicing her feelings, she continues resolutely on her way.
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_SEQ_05: Further along the road, your party makes a brief stop at a vantage point to marvel at the impossible landscape wrought by the Calamity. The view impresses upon R'tcha the scale of the destruction, and she cannot help but wonder how her parents had felt that fateful day. Without further word, she sets off for the lighthouse ahead, there to speak with its keeper Rostnzeh and come face-to-face with the truth.
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_SEQ_06: It is with mixed feelings that R'tcha learns from Rostnzeh that no ghosts haunt any lighthouse he knows. The man had been acquainted with R'tcha's parents, however, and he gladly shares what he remembers of them. When the Calamity unleashed a monstrous tidal wave on Vylbrand, the couple had fought desperately to protect their lighthouse. Though they lost their lives in the trying, they saved full many by doing their duty to the last. The knowledge serves to comfort R'tcha, and at Rostnzeh's invitation, you stay the night to hear more tales about her parents. So it is that R'tcha attains closure, and inspired by her parents' bravery, she resolves to become someone who helps others.
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_SEQ_07: Back at the Aftcastle, you bid a fond farewell to your companions. Ayoyo informs you that the wandering minstrel has taken himself to the Anchor Yard, and you seek him out to report on the success of your excursion.
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_SEQ_08: The minstrel listens intently as you recount your adventure with young R'tcha. The tale provides him with the inspiration he sought, and he proceeds to compose a verse in your presence. No sooner does he strum out a chord on his harp than you find yourself whisked away to a mysterious place, where you are greeted by the enigmatic Naoki Yoshida. The man thanks you for the stories you have woven, and expresses his excitement for those you have yet to weave, before returning you to the Anchor Yard. There, as spectacular fireworks fill the night sky with vibrant color, the minstrel performs his new song─a song of journeys fulfilling, which he dedicates to you, who bring joy through the stories you gather and deliver. No matter how great your burdens, these same stories shall be your strength─a beacon to light your way in the darkness.
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_SEQ_00:
If you haven't heard about this year's Moonfire Faire, Mayaru Moyaru will steer you in the right direction.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_SEQ_01:
To slake your thirst for freedom from this hot Eorzean summer, Mayaru Moyaru suggests you pay a visit to Costa del Sol, where the Moonfire Faire is being held on the Queen Lhaminn, a remodeled ship. Promised unparalleled recreation, you sally forth to witness the seaside delights at hand.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_SEQ_02: Chief Chaperone Haermaga was hoping Mayaru Moyaru would send along someone like you, which makes you suspect your visit might entail more than fun and games. Sensing your curiosity, the Roegadyn invites you to learn more aboard the Queen Lhaminn.
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_SEQ_03: Haermaga gives you an overview of the ship's activities: cannon rides, water chutes, a swimming bath, and even a stage for performers. Additionally, Lhaminn's Coastguard works tirelessly to ensure the guests' comfort and security, and it is to this group of elite swimmers Haermaga would recruit you. P'obyano has been charged with uniform allocation, so you inquire with her before setting out on your first patrol.
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_SEQ_04:
After a bit of digging, P'obyano pulls out a set of maritime attire expertly tailored to your size. Only while wearing it will you be recognizable to those in need as an official member of the Coastguard.

※You must be wearing the costume provided by P'obyano to complete this task. Speak with her again to prolong or restore the guise.
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_SEQ_05: On your patrol, you witness the gaiety of the guests alongside the dedicated efforts of your fellows in Lhaminn's Coastguard. Beaudefoin and R'fhul Tia are both especially pleased with the thoughtful design of the uniforms. When you encounter Hildelana, however, a more pressing matter is raised: one of the water chutes' wooden support beams has begun to splinter beneath the surface. She elects to remain nearby to direct the guests away from it, but this is only a stopgap measure until Haermaga is informed.
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_SEQ_06: With your patrol concluded, you report your observations to Haermaga, who assures you that he will arrange for the splintering beam to be repaired at once. Your conversation is interrupted, however, by a call for help somewhere on the coastline. By the sound of it, a woman is in distress─but before you can rescue her, you will need to find her.
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_SEQ_07: The moment the drowning woman is located, Haermaga leaps into action. Once she is brought ashore, he decides the best place for her to rest is aboard the Queen Lhaminn, where a healer is on standby for emergency situations precisely like these. It seems the two of you were meant to be introduced in a less dramatic fashion, but to what end, Haermaga has yet to reveal.
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_SEQ_08:
Haermaga introduces the Miqo'te woman as T'zanza, the Ul'dahn weaver who worked tirelessly to craft the Coastguard uniforms. Concerned about her design's functionality, she sought to observe it from afar─yet ended up requiring the Coastguard's assistance in the process. Though she laments the trouble she caused, she feels proud to have contributed to the safety of the event. Lhaminn's Coastguard, for its part, has nothing but praise for her work.

Since you have completed your shift, Haermaga makes good on his promise to let you keep the maritime attire, though this gift may naturally lead to another patrol or two around the facility─if only for safety's sake.
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_SEQ_00:
The ebullient citizen can barely contain his enthusiasm for the Gold Saucer festivities.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_SEQ_01:
On Emerald Avenue, you encounter an effusive fellow spreading word of the Gold Saucer festivities. Having caught your attention, he shares news of a rumor regarding the venerated Triple Triad player, King Elmer III. He stops short of sharing any pertinent details, however, instead directing you to speak with Ollier the attendant in Card Square should this tidbit have piqued your interest.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_SEQ_02: As the attendant begins to expound on the matter, King Elmer III himself appears and reveals that the rumor concerns his skills, or supposed lack thereof, at the Triple Triad table. Fearing the deleterious impact on the king's reputation and reverberations among both past and potential challengers, Ollier seeks to discern the source of the rumor and tasks you with gathering information in Wonder Square.
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_SEQ_03: Having spoken with three patrons, it seems the rumor is not widely believed and that King Elmer III enjoys the support of some very ardent fans. However, reported sightings of the card champion wandering the Saucer may warrant further inquiry. You make for the aetheryte plaza to share your findings with Ollier.
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_SEQ_04: Given that King Elmer III has remained faithfully at his post, the attendant is alarmed by the reports of an errant king. The simplest explanation: an impostor is frequenting the squares and hallways of the Gold Saucer. Keen to locate the pretender, Ollier enlists your help in surveying the glittering vastness of Event Square.
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_SEQ_05: In the distance, you glimpse a green-robed individual lose a game of Triple Triad in dramatic fashion. On approach, the man declares himself to be King Elmer III and challenges you to a match, but turns tail and flees when he notices Ollier's stern gaze. As the attendant dutifully dashes off in pursuit, you spot something laying on the red carpet mere ilms away from where the impostor was standing.
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_SEQ_06: The object in question reveals itself as a Triple Triad card emblazoned with King Elmer III. You carefully stow the card and move to reconvene with Ollier, who may be able to shed light on its provenance.
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_SEQ_07: According to the ever-professional attendant, the card is a limited-edition print─one of several commissioned as gifts for King Elmer III's adoring supporters. Surmising that the impostor himself is one such fan, you resolve to lure the false king out of hiding by using the card as bait. You are to wait by the main counter, ready to leap into action when your mark appears to collect his precious lost property.
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_SEQ_08: After a daring chase and with the aid of the true King Elmer III, the pretender is surrounded. He confesses that he assumed the king's identity in order to feel stronger, a charade that spun wildly out of control. Far from excoriating the misguided fellow, King Elmer shares his own struggles as a Triple Triad player, offering advice on how to improve and ultimately inviting his doppelganger to face him fair and square─not as an impostor, but as an accomplished player in his own right. At any rate, with the false king repentant, the rumor ought not spread further. No doubt Ollier will wish to thank you for your efforts.
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_SEQ_09: The grateful attendant gifts you a limited-edition King Elmer III card as a token of appreciation for your assistance in quelling the rumor. He bids you make the most of the Gold Saucer's ongoing festivities─particularly those of the Triple Triad variety, if the fancy strikes.
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_SEQ_00:
Astrid's Valentione's Day plans have gone awry.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_SEQ_01:
Astrid and Emilie tell you of their plans to serve giant cakes to guests at the Valentione's Day celebrations. A plan that has apparently hit a snag in cake production. Emissaries of love were dispatched to assess the situation at the pâtisserie and should be returning ere long. To that end, Astrid and Emilie invite you to meet them at the entrance to Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre.

※Please note that you will not be able to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_SEQ_02: Kupka Kupp recounts the run-in with rampaging mammets, hells-bent on preventing cake completion. Well-practiced as you are in tasks that require a certain physical prowess, you agree to head to the pâtisserie and quell the confectionery crisis.
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_SEQ_03: You leave the mammets defeated but unbroken as you emerge from the pâtisserie. Astrid will no doubt be thrilled to hear of your success.
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_SEQ_04: With the finished confectionery being transported to Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre, the festivities can soon get underway. And yet, Astrid cannot help but wonder what possessed the mammets to turn their ire on the pâtissiers. It seems as though Kupka Kupp may have an inkling.
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_SEQ_05: Upon closer observation, Kupka Kupp noticed traces of moogle magicks upon the mammets. The only other moogle who entered the pâtisserie should have been Kupna Kuko, who helped procure the fruit for the cakes. Kupka suggests asking him for further information, with your intimidating presence to help loosen any hesitant tongues. Giving your assent, you begin the search for Kupna Kuko by the Lancers' Guild.
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_SEQ_06: Kupna Kuko admits that the entire incident was a misguided attempt to help, with the moogle magicks intended to compel the mammets to work harder instead leading to dangerous malfunction. With the issue resolved─and Kupna Kuko suitably abashed─the group heads back to Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre to get the celebrations underway.
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_SEQ_07: Festivalgoers partake of the many giant Valentione's Day cakes with unconcealed delight. As people share a delicious treat with their loved ones and savor a moment of happiness, the celebration of ardor and affection is once more in full swing.
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_SEQ_00: The Dawn Hunt tracker has need of an intrepid adventurer.
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_SEQ_01: The Dawn Hunt tracker informs you that something has been killing the fauna of Shaaloani. Before he and his fellow hunters could begin a proper investigation, however, they received an unusual mark bill for a beast they believe to be responsible. Knowing of your exploits in felling Valigarmanda, they can think of no one better to aid them in seeking out this quarry. You agree to assist, and the tracker bids you speak with their equally unusual client, who should be near the tavern in Hhusatahwi.
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_SEQ_02: As you scan the dusty roads of Hhusatahwi, your eyes fall upon a curiously clad, feline-esque creature─its visage vaguely matching the tracker's description. The self-described “Felyne” entreats your aid in hunting a monster known as Guardian Arkveld, who has been disrupting the ecosystem of Shaaloani. Having agreed to lend your aid, the Felyne explains to you how they and their quarry arrived in these lands. With you now brought up to speed, your fuzzy friend sets off towards the town's exit, clearly expecting you to follow.
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_SEQ_03:
The stray Felyne asks that you take the lead in searching the plains of Shaaloani for traces of Arkveld, given your greater knowledge of the area. You find the request reasonable enough, and so you happily oblige.

※You must be accompanied by the stray Felyne to complete this task. Speak with them again should you become separated.
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_SEQ_04: You find traces of a beast, but soon discover they do not belong to Arkveld. The search must go on.
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_SEQ_05: You discover yet more traces, but they too do not belong to Arkveld. Your investigation continues.
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_SEQ_06: After scouring the grasslands for any telltale signs of Arkveld, your efforts at last bear fruit when you uncover distinctive gouges and fragments in the soil─evidence of the creature's chain-like tendrils. Your Felyne friend bids you collect samples to aid in tracking the beast by scent. To that end, they introduce you to their companion: a creature known as a Seikret, possessed of a keen sense of smell. Once it has taken in Arkveld's scent, all that remains is for you to climb onto its back and begin your pursuit.
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_SEQ_07: You begin your expedition, conversing with your Felyne companion as you roam the wilds, until at last you happen upon the remains of an animal. The beast is largely intact, showing no signs of predation, leading the Felyne to believe it was felled by Guardian Arkveld. Before they can explain further, however, a disturbance in the distance draws your attention. Turning towards the sound, you find that what the stray Felyne colorfully describes as a “turf war” has broken out between Guardian Arkveld and the Serpentlord Ttokrrone. Without delay, you rush to the scene and hurl a dung pod at the two monsters, inciting Ttokrrone to flee. Arkveld appears to then take your measure before making its own departure. Having seen the direction it fled, you and your Felyne companion regroup to plan your next steps.
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_SEQ_08: Your companion informs you that they have been hard at work preparing a Camping Kit since you ventured off to investigate Arkveld's whereabouts. When you are ready to settle down for battle preparations, you need only inform them.
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_SEQ_09:
Now that you have a camp in order, it is time to see to your preparations for the battle. The stray Felyne appears to be ready and waiting to do just that.

※You may travel to the Windward Wilds by speaking with the stray Felyne on the Pyariyoanaan Plain.
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_SEQ_10: The Felyne stresses that one does not simply embark on a hunt on an empty stomach, and thus urges you to grill meat and eat your fill ere you face your silvery foe. With aplomb, you do as told. Newly invigorated, you feel ready to take on anything.
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_SEQ_11:
Content with your battle preparations, the Felyne informs you the time is come to enter Guardian Arkveld's lair. You steel yourself for what is sure to be a monster hunt to remember.

※The Windward Wilds can be accessed via the Duty Finder.
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_SEQ_12: The Guardian fought tooth and nail─and with lashing chain-like tendrils─yet you emerged victorious. Having carved its hide, you suspect your client will wish to have words now that the threat has been eliminated.
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_SEQ_13: Congratulating you once more on your triumph, your Felyne friend is reminded that it is no closer to finding a way home. Rather than despair, however, the Felyne is eager to explore what the continent of Tural has to offer, hoping to find a means of return in the process. Yet before setting off on a new adventure, the Felyne insists on informing the Dawn Hunt tracker that the threat has been eliminated, and so the two of you make for Tuliyollal.
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_SEQ_14: Informing the Dawn Hunt tracker of Guardian Arkveld's demise, the Felyne is inspired to ask whether the scales you carved from the fiend's hide might be used to craft equipment. As fortune would have it, the nearby smithy can do just that─and more, should you provide the requisite materials. Amid this discovery, the Felyne's feathered companion appears, seemingly eager to remain by your side. Your friend is happy to let the Seikret follow its heart, and now intends to follow their own. Bidding you farewell, the Felyne sets off on a grand adventure to find their way home. Should the mood for monster hunting strike again, any scales you pry from Guardian Arkveld will earn you rich rewards from the smithy.
TEXT_FESHLX101_05375_SEQ_00:
The pumpkin-headed apparition proffers out her hand in invitation.

※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESHLX101_05375_SEQ_01:
The pumpkin-headed apparition glows with delight as she informs you that the infamous Continental Circus has returned to Gridania, reserving the local haunted manor for a ghoulish masquerade befitting All Saints' Wake. She senses, however, that aught is amiss within its confines, and urges you speak with the genial guiser to guide you to the manor's gates.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESHLX101_05375_SEQ_02:
The Haunted Manor teems with seasonal spectacles of all sorts─including a pumpkin-headed gentleman who appears ready to greet you. Speak with him to learn more about the Continental Circus's masquerade.

※In the event that you leave the area, you may return by speaking with the genial guiser at Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre.
TEXT_FESHLX101_05375_SEQ_03: The pumpkin-headed gentleman─known as the Impresario─welcomes you warily to the masquerade, unfondly recalling his previous embroilments with adventurers. Though he and his troupe once sought to take advantage of mortal guests in years past, he claims to have turned over a new leaf, and though he urges you to listen to the cries of joy echoing throughout the manor, you are answered with naught but screams of terror. Perplexed by such a reaction, the Impresario bids you investigate the cause of this commotion, starting with the manor's second floor.
TEXT_FESHLX101_05375_SEQ_04: With your search of the second floor complete, you return to the ground floor of the manor, keeping your eyes open for any conniving creatures or frightened guests.
TEXT_FESHLX101_05375_SEQ_05: Your investigation of the manor reveals that the Continental Circus's troupe members have begun to run amok, terrifying the participating patrons. The Impresario must be informed of his fellows' wrongdoings, and he awaits your report in the manor foyer.
TEXT_FESHLX101_05375_SEQ_06: The Impresario is flummoxed upon hearing of the turmoil his fellow thespians are causing, as he believes any action he takes will serve only to encourage them further. You too find yourself at a loss, until the voice of the pumpkin-headed apparition rings clear in your mind. It would seem you must return to Gridania for the solutions you seek.
TEXT_FESHLX101_05375_SEQ_07: The pumpkin-headed apparition is sympathetic to the Impresario's plight and eager to aid in your quest to calm the Continental Circus's unruly members. To do so, she requires a bag of All Saints' cookies from the shady smock, as well as a decorative pumpkin from the Greatloam Growery.
TEXT_FESHLX101_05375_SEQ_08: With pumpkin and cookies procured, the apparition will have all she needs to concoct her creation. Deliver them to her at Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre, that she might begin her work in earnest.
TEXT_FESHLX101_05375_SEQ_09: The apparition thanks you for your assistance in gathering the required materials, assuring you once more that her solution will quell the current uproar in the manor. When her preparations are complete, she plans to inform you at her earliest convenience.
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_SEQ_00:
The pumpkin-headed apparition appears ready to put her plans into action.

※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_SEQ_01:
With the pumpkin-headed apparition's work nearly complete, she bids you return to the Haunted Manor and locate the Impresario within. You can only imagine what sort of creation she has in mind to resolve the situation.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_SEQ_02: Both you and the Impresario are shocked to discover the pumpkin-headed apparition's “gift”─a large, enchanted doll resembling the Impresario, complete with illusory magicks. With no time to lose, you are tasked with operating the mechanical Ambulario and calming the cacophony in the manor once and for all.
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_SEQ_03:
Armed with your new Ambulario and its dazzling illusions, you must seek out the Circus members and guests. Using your new powers of pacification, you may use the Ambulario's tricksome pumpkins to order the voidsent back to their ringleader, and its rain of treats to placate the manor's guests.

※Speak with the Impresario in the Haunted Manor to mount the Ambulario.
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_SEQ_04: Those on the second floor have been pacified by the Ambulario's illusions. Your work is only partially done, however, as the first floor still awaits.
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_SEQ_05: The clockwork creature's charms prove a rousing success, and quiet has returned to the manor. The Impresario should be delighted to hear the news, and awaits your return to the foyer.
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_SEQ_06: As the Impresario tells it, both ghoul and guest now gambol joyfully together in the night─just as he initially envisioned. He wishes to relay his thanks to the Ambulario's creator, who should still be loitering about Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre.
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_SEQ_07: Upon your meeting with the pumpkin-headed apparition, it is clear that the joys of All Saints' Wake have begun to spread throughout Gridania, and children flock to the manor for treats. After years of devilish deeds, the Impresario is moved by the display, and vows to continue his efforts to provide his mortal guests with memorable performances. He humbly entrusts you with the Ambulario, and use its likeness to the Impresario to spread word of his troupe across the realm.
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_SEQ_00:
A stylish Dreamer is smiling at you. Already, your day has improved.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_SEQ_01:
The stylish Dreamer is none other than Jihli Aliapoh, founder of the imminent Hatching-tide festivities. This year, Jihli's prophetic dream featured golden eggs that floated up from thick swathes of flora, prompting the creation of an egg hunt through the Black Shroud's foliage. Jihli's cohort, Nonotta, was charged with preparing the arena for participants, but enough time has passed without word of the proceedings for Jihli to become worried. She tasks you with finding Nonotta, who may have returned to Gridania.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_SEQ_02: You find Nonotta in the aetheryte plaza, bearing an adorable pair of chicken spectacles and no little consternation. Apparently, the egg hunting arena has been overrun by a plant so stubborn it cannot be trimmed or culled, leading Nonotta to wonder if the flora may be potentially dangerous leafkin. Accepting a piece of the peculiar plant for reference, you head to the Carline Canopy to question patrons, while Nonotta heads for the Botanists' Guild.
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_SEQ_03: The leaf in your possession seems likely to belong to a strain of flytrap that easily regenerates, and you are not the first to inquire about such plant life─an “eccentric” alchemist seems to have preceded you. Having learned all you can, you return to the aetheryte plaza to share your findings with Nonotta.
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_SEQ_04: The Botanists' Guild has determined that the leafkin in question is so resilient that the pieces in your possession are technically still alive. Shelving that disturbing notion for the time being, you share what you discovered with Nonotta, and the two of you decide to follow up with the alchemist.
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_SEQ_05: Herberin, the indubitably eccentric alchemist, passionately offers his assistance in creating a concoction that might help combat the stubborn leafkin. Indeed, he has barely finished agreeing before he dashes off to purchase the necessary ingredients, Nonotta trailing in his wake.
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_SEQ_06: Between Herberin's brilliance and Nonotta's garden scythe, you have all you need to begin culling the intrusive leafkin in earnest. Nonotta goes on ahead to secure transportation, so when you are ready to clean up the egg arena, make your way to Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre.
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_SEQ_07: All is in readiness for some much needed Sprig Cleaning. Speak with an egg usher in Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre or the Acorn Orchard to swing your scythe and reap the rewards.
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_SEQ_08: Your blade has tasted leafkin flesh. Speak with Nonotta to debrief from your mission.
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_SEQ_09: Nonotta praises you for a job well done and Herberin seems delighted with not only the results of his alchemical solution, but the copious amounts of floral samples your mowing has produced. As the Elezen skips off to study to his heart's content, you report back to Jihli Aliapoh to reassure her that Hatching-tide festivities may carry on as planned.
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_SEQ_10:
Jihli is surprised to hear of the troublesome leafkin, but glad that the arena is fit for preparing an egg hunt. Just as she expresses a wish to thank Herberin for his assistance, the alchemist barrels into the amphitheatre, hollering success. His eyes, once brutally burned by leafkin venom, have been cured thanks to a solution concocted from the regenerative leafkin samples you provided him. The optimism he expresses for what this breakthrough means for the world of alchemy leads Jihli to realize that her dream represented not simply an egg hunt, but the rising hopes for the future.

Thanks to your efforts, Hatching-tide festivities may now begin in earnest, but given the resiliency of troublesome traps, you will never lack for leafkin to trim. Stop by for Sprig Cleaning whenever you have a moment, and enjoy the rest of these spring celebrations.
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_SEQ_00:
Ollier locks eyes with you in a cordial, yet slightly desperate plea for help.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_SEQ_01:
On the bustling Steps of Nald do you cross paths with Ollier, an attendant of the Gold Saucer. Relieved to find a capable adventurer in the crowds, he wastes no time requesting your assistance in promoting the Make It Rain Campaign. You agree to his proposal, and he promptly bids you follow him to the Gold Court, where he intends to explain the finer details of your task.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_SEQ_02: You arrive at the Gold Court to find the Nagxian performer Ajisai and her troupe of Globe-trotter Otters entreating a crowd to celebrate the Make It Rain Campaign. Once Ollier introduces you all properly, he and Ajisai task you with accompanying the lead otter, Usosuke, across the Steps of Thal, and are ready to enact their plans when you are.
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_SEQ_03:
To more efficiently promote the Gold Saucer's premier event, Ollier offers you a set of themed clothing, as well as a charming otter-shaped backpack. Outfitted with equipment fit for this golden occasion, you are set to seek out Usosuke at his first destination.

※If you should lose your uniform, speak with Ollier again to be reoutfitted.
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_SEQ_04: At the Sapphire Avenue Exchange, Usosuke instantly gains the adoration of a mother and daughter with his otterly charms, while you give voice to his excitement and convince the pair to visit the Gold Saucer. His work there completed, Usosuke dashes off towards the Weavers' Guild, expecting you to follow.
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_SEQ_05: Usosuke's gentlemanly gait attracts the attention of a stylish young man, who immediately questions the otter about his peculiar wardrobe. You expound upon his Mandervillian aesthetic, as well as the many attractions that await the fashion-conscious at the Gold Saucer. With another prospective patron won over, Usosuke scurries off towards the Goldsmiths' Guild.
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_SEQ_06: As you arrive in the vicinity of the Goldsmiths' Guild, you spot Usosuke with a trio of laborers. Captivated by the otter's garb, one of the men reveals that he and his companions helped construct the Gold Saucer in the wake of the Calamity. Usosuke, moved by the history of these men and their tale of the first Senor Sabotender, dashes back to the Gold Court with a newfound glint of determination in his eyes.
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_SEQ_07: With your rounds of the Steps of Thal ended, you report back to Ajisai, who notes a marked change in Usosuke's countenance. Thanks to your assistance, the otter has gained a new goal: to pose like Senor Sabotender and captivate audiences wherever he may go. Both Ajisai and Ollier express their gratitude to you for joining Usosuke, after which Ollier suggests you make for the Gold Saucer to claim your reward.
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_SEQ_08: As Ollier guides you through the Gold Saucer, the results of your collective endeavors are plain to see: throngs of smiling crowds line the corridors, dazzled by the Globe-trotter Otters and their newly learned poses. At the end of it all stands Godbert Manderville, who insists you keep your otter backpack and proudly presents you with a mammet modeled after Usosuke himself. Before he departs, Godbert reminds you to take advantage of the Make It Rain Campaign yourself─and that you will always be welcome in his halls.
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_SEQ_00:
The royal seneschal has need of an inquisitive adventurer.

※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_SEQ_01:
No sooner are you greeted by the royal seneschal than you overhear an impassioned bout of monologuing from none other than Dural Tharal, reporter for the Mythril Eye. The loquacious Lalafell plans to write an article regarding the financial success of the Songbirds and the Seneschal Prince─star performers of Little Ladies' Day─and bids you accompany him as an impartial interviewer as he gathers information.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_SEQ_02: Dural Tharal reiterates that the key to his piece's success will be direct statements from fans of the Songbirds and Seneschal Prince. He suggests searching near the Gate of Nald for those clad in the singers' colors, as they will likely provide him with earnest feedback.
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_SEQ_03: You and Dural Tharal interview a pair of fans donning red and blue─the colors of Songbirds Ulala and Masha Mhakaracca. While the two provide differing and illuminating opinions on their favorite pair of performers, more fans remain to be interviewed. Following a clue regarding a seasonal-themed menu at the Quicksand, you and the Mythril Eye reporter choose the tavern as your next destination.
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_SEQ_04: The festive mood in the Quicksand is palpable as you and Dural Tharal enter, and you immediately encounter fans proudly donning yellow and purple─those of the Songbird Narumi and Picot, the Seneschal Prince. With their enthusiastic testimonials heard and noted, Dural Tharal requests one last interview with a bystander he observed at the Ruby Road Exchange, and thus the two of you make for the main street once more.
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_SEQ_05: In a fateful twist, the young bystander Dural Tharal eyed at the Ruby Road Exchange is none other than Aldiytha Thorne, heir to House Thorne of Little Ladies' Day fame. As she gazes upon the boisterous spectacle from afar, she expounds upon the value of enjoying one's favorite pastimes. Inspired by Aldiytha's observations, Dural Tharal expresses his thanks to the young Thorne for her time and looks to you for another word.
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_SEQ_06: Duly satisfied with what he learned from interviewing Aldiytha and fans of the Little Ladies' Day performers, Dural Tharal encourages you to participate in one final task: the concert itself.
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_SEQ_07:
The royal seneschal is overjoyed to hear of your plans, inviting you to join the main event without a moment's hesitation. Dural Tharal would prefer to take a more objective observation of the festivities, however, choosing to watch from afar while you mingle with the fans. When you are ready, the seneschal bids you speak with the royal handmaiden to acquire the garments and illuminations you will require to make the most of the entertainment to come.

※To participate in the FATE, you must first speak with the royal handmaiden on Emerald Avenue and receive the “Face in the Crowd” status effect.
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_SEQ_08: Having cheered to your heart's content, you take a moment to recompose yourself, making a mental note to return to the royal seneschal and report on the experience.
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_SEQ_09: You return to the royal seneschal and Dural Tharal, both of whom are eager to hear of your firsthand participation. More than satisfied with your account, Dural Tharal bids you farewell as he and the royal seneschal offer their gratitude for your efforts. But there are yet more shows to come this season, and perhaps even opportunities to speak with the performers themselves...
TEXT_FESPDX102_05445_SEQ_00:
The royal seneschal is eager to offer you a rare opportunity.

※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESPDX102_05445_SEQ_01:
As thanks for aiding Dural Tharal and potentially spreading word of the Songbirds and Seneschal Prince further, the royal seneschal agrees to let you briefly chat with a performer of your choice. Once you have decided which of the four you'd like to speak with, you may present your answer to the royal seneschal, who will fetch your first choice.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESPDX102_05445_SEQ_02: You briefly converse with your chosen performer, who is grateful for your contributions this season and requests your continued support. With the chat concluded, the royal seneschal awaits your report at the Ruby Road Exchange.
TEXT_FESPDX102_05445_SEQ_03: The royal seneschal informs you that your participation in this year's festivities has been a great inspiration to the Songbirds and the Seneschal Prince. Should you wish to speak with the other performers, the royal seneschal gleefully bids you return to the Ruby Road Exchange during the festivities at any time.
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_SEQ_00:
Come rain or shine─ceaseless, unrelenting shine─Mayaru Moyaru will ensure adventurers are aware of the Moonfire Faire.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_SEQ_01:
Mayaru Moyaru has painted an enticing picture of the Moonfire Faire underway at Costa del Sol. Should you tire of simply enjoying yourself, the grand chaperone, Haermaga, could no doubt use the assistance of a capable member of the Adventurers' Guild.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_SEQ_02: Speaking with Haermaga, you learn that the renown of the Queen Lhaminn has spread far and wide, attracting a great many visitors to the faire. For better or worse, some have little experience with the ocean. Worried for their safety, Haermaga and the other chaperones have contrived an attraction less likely to result in incidents requiring the Coastguard's attention. You scour the sands for signs of P'obyano, who will be able to tell you more.
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_SEQ_03: P'obyano enthusiastically introduces the inflatable mografts to be used in a gentle ride along the coast. Although the rafts will follow a safe, predetermined route, nothing is ever certain at sea. As such, P'obyano has been searching for willing and able adventurers to escort guests on the Watery Wings Pleasure Cruise. Agreeing to accompany the maiden voyage of the moogles, you set out to find the pleasure cruise chaperone on the La Noscean shore.
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_SEQ_04: Although you find the chaperone and the guests, it seems the Miqo'te maiden is overcome with fright. You agree to speak with her and offer some words of reassurance.
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_SEQ_05: Heartened by your reliable presence, Lho Mujuuk has resolved to ride the mograft. Eavan and the staff await your command to send the rafts off on their maiden voyage.
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_SEQ_06: One uneventful pleasure cruise later, P'obyano asks the first guests and their accompanying adventurer for feedback to further improve the attraction. Having exchanged ideas of varying practicality, P'obyano ushers the eager pair of faire-goers aboard the Queen Lhaminn and requests that you report to Haermaga in her stead.
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_SEQ_07: Gratified to hear that the latest Moonfire Faire attraction allows newcomers to dip their toes into the ocean in a non-threatening way, Haermaga presents you with your very own inflatable mograft. Word spreads quickly, and throngs of eager faire-goers descend upon the Watery Wings Pleasure Cruise─many of whom will, no doubt, be in need of a reliable escort.
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_SEQ_00:
Haermaga is trying to catch your eye.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_SEQ_01:
Haermaga informs you that some visitors to the faire have requested you personally as their escort for the Watery Wings Pleasure Cruise. With no small amount of trepidation, you head down to speak to the pleasure cruise chaperone for more details.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_SEQ_02: The chaperone fetches your acquaintances, who seem eager to ride the inflatable mografts. You are only too happy to oblige, and make your preparations to climb aboard and set out on the ocean excursion.
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_SEQ_03: Your acquaintances seemed to enjoy the cruise, in their own way. You decide to return to the Queen Lhaminn to let Haermaga know that the faire has a couple more satisfied visitors.
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_SEQ_04: Though grateful for your help, Haermaga suspects that there may yet be other faire-goers who would prefer your personal attention. Should you wish to assist with the pleasure cruise again, you need but let him know.
TEXT_FESXMX201_05464_SEQ_00:
Amh Garanjy is keen to impart the tale of the Starlight Celebration upon passersby.

※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESXMX201_05464_SEQ_01:
After exchanging pleasantries with Amh Garanjy, she mentions that Associate Professor Laurenssen has been invited to recreate a certain Starlight tradition. Before either can further elaborate, a young boy named Aitken interrupts with an entreaty for aid. His friend in Bentbranch Meadows is unable to make the trip to Gridania to enjoy the Starlight Celebration, and he wishes to find some way to bring the festivities to her. Fortunately, the Starlight tradition that Amh Garanjy and Laurenssen plan to recreate this year involves a reindeer-drawn sleigh spreading joy and cheer, and Bentbranch Meadows would make a perfect first stop on its Starlight journey. With your purposes aligned, the first step is to find capable and willing artisans to assist in the sleigh's construction. You resolve to speak with Guildmasters Beatin and Geva, of the Carpenters' and Leatherworkers' Guilds respectively.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESXMX201_05464_SEQ_02: Happy to help bring festive joy to the children, Beatin and Geva agree to construct the sleigh. With everyone set to convene at the Starlight Stalls, you head to Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre to speak with the guide.
TEXT_FESXMX201_05464_SEQ_03: Upon arriving at the Starlight Stalls, it is clear that Aitken and Laurenssen have accumulated most anything that might be needed in the construction of a sleigh. Laurenssen seems eager to fill you in on the particulars.
TEXT_FESXMX201_05464_SEQ_04: With the Saint of Nymeia and some other children joining the team, work on the sleigh can finally begin in earnest. Beatin and Geva appreciate the assistance of a master goldsmith─as the saint surely is─while the children are simply delighted by his presence. Your task, under the watchful eye of acting supervisor Laurenssen, is to provide aid where required to ensure that everything proceeds smoothly.
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_SEQ_00:
Associate Professor Laurenssen relishes the role of supervisor.

※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_SEQ_01:
Laurenssen suspects that the children, so eager to volunteer, may find themselves unused to working in such cold. Since it is important to keep one's workers comfortable and productive, he suggests that you present them with a mug of kinderpunsch. Agreeing with the sentiment, you head over to speak with the saturnine Starlight celebrant distributing the mulled punch.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_SEQ_02: Having heard about the plan from Amh Garanjy, the saturnine Starlight celebrant is only too happy to provide kinderpunsch for the children. With the promise of your own mug upon returning, you take the warm beverages to where everyone is hard at work on the sleigh, ready to inspect their progress.
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_SEQ_03: The children gratefully accept the kinderpunsch while showing you their handiwork. It would appear that the artisans have successfully inspired the next generation, and work on the sleigh is progressing smoothly. After making your rounds, you work your way through the stalls to receive a piping hot mug of kinderpunsch yourself.
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_SEQ_04: Thanks to everyone's hard work, you now have a sleigh to reenact the ancient tradition. All that remains is to hitch the sleigh to the patient reindeer and put the plan into action. With Laurenssen and Aitken taking the sleigh directly to Bentbranch Meadows, you are left to make your own way there.
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_SEQ_05: Unused to physical labor of any kind, Laurenssen is exhausted from his short stint as sleigh driver. Taking the reins, you begin your tour around Bentbranch Meadows, ringing the bell in the vicinity of any children you come across.
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_SEQ_06: Sleigh bells ring out through Bentbranch Meadows, and the children flock with glee to the Saint of Nymeia. With the tradition from his records unfolding before his very eyes, Laurenssen is practically vibrating with excitement.
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_SEQ_07: Aitken brings his friend over to introduce her to the people who made this all possible. Though he may be unwilling to take the credit, his friend is not blind to all the effort he expended on her behalf. Somewhat bashfully, Aitken suggests they return to the Saint of Nymeia. Laurenssen likewise takes his leave to further observe the tradition he has recreated, leaving you to take word to Amh Garanjy of all you have witnessed.
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_SEQ_08: Though the event itself did not take place in Gridania, the children enjoyed their part in building the sleigh. So much so that they set about creating a second sleigh from the ample pile of remaining materials, crafting a personal sleigh for the adventurer who helped get the whole thing underway. Amh Garanjy passes the gift along to you, and suggests you use it to spread Starlight cheer to any children you may meet on your travels.
TEXT_SUBGSC801_05466_SEQ_00:
Whether it be dark or bright, the catlike mammet is keen to lead you right.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_SUBGSC801_05466_SEQ_01:
While wandering the Gold Saucer, a curious catlike mammet approaches you, its eyes aglow as it elaborates on the manifold surprises that await you in the Gold Saucer's new attraction, Keybound Brawler. The mammet urges you to find his colleague W'zazanh in Wonder Square, that she might guide you to this new form of entertainment.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_SUBGSC801_05466_SEQ_02: With W'zazanh pointing you in the right direction, you are soon welcomed by the futuristic golden glow of Keybound Square. Assembled in this newly appointed space is a small crowd made up of staff and guests, not to mention your enigmatic mammet guide...
TEXT_SUBGSC801_05466_SEQ_03: Although the catlike mammet elucidated the basics of Keybound Brawler to you, you spy a receptionist in the far corner of the square, ready and waiting to answer more of your burning questions.
TEXT_SUBGSC801_05466_SEQ_04: The magitype master is delighted to reveal the specifics of Keybound Brawler to you, along with the reasoning behind the catlike mammet wandering around. Now enlightened on the rules, you may make ready to enter a game and defend your territory from waves of monsters at any time.
TEXT_FESHLX201_05467_SEQ_00:
The pumpkin-headed apparition is keen to introduce you to her otherworldly acquaintances.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESHLX201_05467_SEQ_01:
The pumpkin-headed apparition marks your timely arrival, and claims a hardy adventurer like yourself will be the perfect companion for her guests─a gaggle of voidsent children who crave the company of mankind. You offer your aid to the glowing gourd, who requests your presence by the Whistling Miller to meet the children in question.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESHLX201_05467_SEQ_02: In the shadows of the Whistling Miller, you encounter the trio of young voidsent, concealing their monstrous forms with tattered, rotten old bear suits. Though they wish to more directly consort with mortals, they fear their games will rend the smallfolk to shreds. You and the pumpkin-headed apparition wager that a game of hide-and-seek might be the safest option for all involved, and plan to find a pair of well-seasoned adventurers who will be up to the task.
TEXT_FESHLX201_05467_SEQ_03: Upon searching the city, you find two adventurers intrigued by your haunted hide-and-seek endeavors. With your party secured, Pattin and the others await the good news at Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre.
TEXT_FESHLX201_05467_SEQ_04: Pattin, Dodd, and Bea can barely contain themselves in their suits as they reveal their extravagantly All Saints' Wake-themed hide-and-seek, enhanced with a touch of illusory magicks. The pumpkin-headed apparition has prepared a haunting ground for the games─and all that remains now is to play.
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_SEQ_00:
Pattin's excitement is palpable behind his beady bear eyes.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_SEQ_01:
With their plans for an enchanted hide-and-seek finalized, the voidsent children are eager to put their vanishing act to the test against you. The pumpkin-headed apparition directs you to the grave guide, and suggests you make for her haunted venue to let the games begin.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_SEQ_02:
As you enter the grounds, you find the children putting the finishing touches on their magicks for the game. Bea is poised to begin, but awaits your approval before the hiding and seeking start in earnest.

※In the event that you leave the area, you may return by speaking with the grave guide at Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre.
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_SEQ_03: After expressing your readiness to begin, the children reiterate the rules, and you are deemed to be “it”─tasked with determining which of the costumed creatures are genuine, and revealing them with all-seeing gourds. While they fine-tune the necessary magicks for the illusions, the children give you a starting round to practice with Pattin.
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_SEQ_04: With your training complete, Pattin dashes off into the darkened corridors, and the real game begins. You must use your powers of observation to find the five players, who may be striking unique poses to differentiate themselves from the illusions.
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_SEQ_05: Your deft observation skills see you successfully through the round, and all five players have been found. Dodd awaits you by the entrance, ready to play once more.
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_SEQ_06: In his excitement to go another round, Pattin volunteers himself to be “it” in the next game, and though you are without a costume, you rush through the halls and nestle into the shadows, making yourself unseen. After hiding in the silence for a time, you are found by who you assume to be Pattin, and plan to make for Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre to meet with the others.
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_SEQ_07: Upon your return to Gridania, the children and adventurers are oddly relieved at your return, and you discover that Pattin was, in fact, unable to find you... The pumpkin-headed apparition suggests a wandering spirit may have taken his form, but assures you that such specters should not pose a threat to you or the others. With that matter settled, the children present you with a tattered bear costume to match theirs─a token of their gratitude. The pumpkin-headed apparition encourages you to make the most of the season and her venues, and eagerly awaits your next meeting.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_SEQ_00:
The wandering minstrel is concerned for a visitor to Vylbrand.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_SEQ_01:
You are making your way through Limsa Lominsa during the Rising when you come upon the wandering minstrel. The man beseeches you to assist a visitor to Vylbrand in her search for an acquaintance, and agreeing to the task, you set forth to find the Keeper of the Moon in question at the Aftcastle.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_SEQ_02: It does not take you long to locate the visitor, who is in the midst of making a fruitless inquiry. Grateful for your offer of aid, the Miqo'te maiden introduces herself as Bathu Molkoh, a member of Orchestra Gridania, before revealing that the object of her search is a musical rival named A'nimuili. Apparently, A'nimuili suddenly gave up her craft to become an adventurer, and Bathu wishes to give her a piece of her mind for wasting her talents. While you sense that there is more to their relationship, you keep that thought to yourself as you head to the Drowning Wench in hopes of picking up a trail.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_SEQ_03: At the Drowning Wench, you learn from Baderon that, since signing up as an adventurer, A'nimuili has mainly accepted the little tasks. The revelation comes as a surprise to Bathu, who questions why her friend would give up her life's passion to do mundane things. The barkeep then reveals that A'nimuili has been taking on various jobs for the Rising, and suggests that you have a chat with Lyngsath, one of her recent clients.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_SEQ_04:
Bathu bids you lead the way to the Bismarck to find Lyngsath. Hopefully, the man will be able to point you in A'nimuili's direction.

※You must be accompanied by Bathu Molkoh to complete this task. Speak with her again should you become separated.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_SEQ_05: Lyngsath informs you that A'nimuili helped him set up a stall for the Rising; the festival is apparently close to her heart, and she worked like a woman possessed. While the Bismarck's head chef does not know where she is lodging, it appears she was also assisting the Yellowjackets, and so you next set off to find Ayoyo at the Coral Tower.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_SEQ_06: According to Ayoyo, A'nimuili has been helping those who suffer in the Calamity's wake, and regularly lends a hand at Llymlaen's Shoals, an orphanage in Limsa Lominsa. The headmistress, Dorathia, is presently in the vicinity of the Aftcastle, and you go to look for her.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_SEQ_07: Speaking with Dorathia, you learn that A'nimuili has been playing music for the orphans to comfort them. This leads Bathu to realize that A'nimuili did not in fact abandon her passion, but rather shares it, and she finally admits that she has missed and feared for her friend above all else. Seeing that Bathu is no longer bent on making A'nimuili return to Gridania, Dorathia reveals that she is presently working in Aleport in western La Noscea, and suggests that you take the ferry in front of the Fishermen's Guild.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_SEQ_08: At the ferry docks, Bathu expresses her gratitude to you and others for opening her eyes. She now realizes that, were she to continue on her original course, she would only create a rift between her and A'nimuili. She then sets off for Aleport, but not before begging your continued presence for her long-anticipated meeting with A'nimuili.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_SEQ_09: Shortly after you arrive in Aleport, Bathu hears a familiar voice─that of A'nimuili. So it is that the wayward friends are reunited at last, and in speaking honestly of their hopes and aspirations, they gain newfound respect and understanding for one another. With that, your part in their tale comes to an end, and you turn your steps back to Limsa Lominsa to report the happy conclusion to the wandering minstrel.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_SEQ_10: The minstrel listens intently as you recount your experiences with Bathu. Your words prompt him to muse on the nature of our connections with our fellow man, and he proceeds to perform a new verse in your presence. No sooner does he strum the first chord than you find yourself transported to a mysterious amphitheatre, where you encounter the enigmatic Naoki Yoshida. The man expresses his heartfelt hopes for your ongoing journey together, before returning you to the Anchor Yard. There, as spectacular fireworks light up the darkening sky, the minstrel favors you with another song─a song which he dedicates to you, who contribute to the symphony of life. Wherever your journeys may lead, may your footfalls ever resound for all to hear...
TEXT_FESANX202_05520_SEQ_00:
The wandering minstrel regards you with a curious gaze.
※This quest is available for a limited time only.
TEXT_FESANX202_05520_SEQ_01: Following the fireworks display, you inform the wandering minstrel about the mysterious vision you experienced. To your surprise, the man has an inkling as to the “enchanting concert” that was mentioned, and invites you to attend it with him. Thus do you make your way to Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre in Old Gridania, where the concert in question is to be held.
TEXT_FESANX202_05520_SEQ_02: Shortly after arriving at the amphitheatre, you are treated to a performance by a chocobo head-wearing pianist. The mellow musician turns out to be an esteemed predecessor of the wandering minstrel, and he gives you his heartfelt thanks along with words both enigmatic and encouraging. The melodies that reverberate in your heart will surely be your strength, and you look forward to the many adventures still to come.
